01PZ023.description: When you summon a 1 cost ally, grant it +2|+2.
01PZ023.descriptionRaw: When you summon a 1 cost ally, grant it +2|+2.
01PZ023.flavorText: "Today I present to the committee my newest invention, as demonstrated by my esteemed colleague..."
01PZ023.name: Professor von Yipp

01PZ024.description: Grant me +4|+0 and <link=keyword.Quick Strike><sprite name=QuickStrike><style=Keyword>Quick Attack</style></link> once you've played a 6+ cost spell this game.
01PZ024.descriptionRaw: Grant me +4|+0 and Quick Attack once you've played a 6+ cost spell this game.
01PZ024.flavorText: Name: Klas Henwick, Age: 51, License Type: Class 2 Conditional, Status: Revoked, Comments: Ignored repeated warnings to reduce output following lab explosion (Case 13X764NM). DO NOT PERMIT ENTRY.
01PZ024.name: Unstable Voltician

01PZ049.description: Draw 3, then reduce those cards' costs by 1.
01PZ049.descriptionRaw: Draw 3, then reduce those cards' costs by 1.
01PZ049.flavorText:
PROGRESS DAY!
Celebrate at the PLAZA OF THE SUN GATES!
See HEXTECH WONDERS!
Gasp at the DARING PORO!
Hear the MAN OF TOMORROW speak on the STATE OF TODAY!
FREE entry! 
Piltovan children welcome!
01PZ049.name: Progress Day!

01PZ006.description: I cost 1 less for each spell you've played this game.
01PZ006.descriptionRaw: I cost 1 less for each spell you've played this game.
01PZ006.flavorText: You have twenty seconds to comply.
01PZ006.name: Plaza Guardian

01PZ053.description: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Mushroom Cloud</style></link> in hand.
01PZ053.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, create a Mushroom Cloud in hand.
01PZ053.flavorText: "Mhm, that's right! Clumps of 'em, sneakin' around! They SEEM crazy, but you just don't see. Not like me! They've big plans! Big plans. Puffcaps. Cheese... sorbet. Where was I?" - Puffcap Peddler
01PZ053.name: Clump of Whumps

01PZ039.description:
To play, discard 1.
Deal 3 to anything.
01PZ039.descriptionRaw:
To play, discard 1.
Deal 3 to anything.
01PZ039.name: Get Excited!

01PZ016.description:
Create in hand a random 6+ cost spell from your regions.
Refill your spell mana.
01PZ016.descriptionRaw:
Create in hand a random 6+ cost spell from your regions.
Refill your spell mana.
01PZ016.flavorText: It only takes one epiphany to launch a legacy.
01PZ016.name: Flash of Brilliance

01PZ058.description: When I'm summoned, create 2 <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Mushroom Clouds</style></link> in hand.
01PZ058.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, create 2 Mushroom Clouds in hand.
01PZ058.flavorText: "Seen a big 'un, mmhmm! She's heavy as a horse and crafty as a krug. Gotta keep yer eye on her, I tells ya. That olâ€™ tomatoâ€™s the queen of the clump for a reason!" - Puffcap Peddler
01PZ058.name: Chump Whump

01PZ009.flavorText: "Personal flying machines? A pipe dream! I just had my apprentice throw the latest prototype out, in fact. Now, where is he?" - Piltovan engineer
01PZ009.name: Amateur Aeronaut

01PZ042.description: <link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: Give my supported ally <link=keyword.Elusive><sprite name=Elusive><style=Keyword>Elusive</style></link> this round.
01PZ042.descriptionRaw: Support: Give my supported ally Elusive this round.
01PZ042.flavorText: For many Piltovans, the great unknown is explored through science and invention, safe within their City of Progress. But a handful embark for the horizon to discover a much greater unknown: the world.
01PZ042.name: Intrepid Mariner

01PZ026.flavorText: "Pilties always think they know everything, but their maps only show the places we told 'em about! Nothing like local knowledge. Which you can have... for a price." - Ajuna Lem, Sumpsnipe Scavenger
01PZ026.name: Sumpworks Map

01PZ043.description: <link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Create in hand an exact copy of a random spell from the enemy deck.
01PZ043.descriptionRaw: Nexus Strike: Create in hand an exact copy of a random spell from the enemy deck.
01PZ043.flavorText: Those cast below the City of Progress were expected to turn on each other. But instead they bonded, found their feet as one, and created a new home. It wasn't much, but it was theirs. Zaun.
01PZ043.name: Chempunk Pickpocket

01PZ047.description: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Deal 1 to EACH Nexus.
01PZ047.descriptionRaw: Last Breath: Deal 1 to EACH Nexus.
01PZ047.flavorText: â€œIâ€™d tell ya to wear a suit, but it gets muggy as a whumpâ€™s armpit down there. Gloves though, eh? Anâ€™ if you get that gunk on yaâ€™, pray it donâ€™t touch nothinâ€™ important.â€ - Ziel, Zaunite foreman
01PZ047.name: Caustic Cask

01FR024.description:
<link=keyword.Elemental Skill><sprite name=ElementalSkill><style=Keyword>Attack</style></link>: Deal 1 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus.
<link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Revive me transformed into <link=card.transform><style=AssociatedCard>Eggnivia</style></link>.
01FR024.descriptionRaw:
Attack: Deal 1 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus.
Last Breath: Revive me transformed into Eggnivia.
01FR024.flavorText: "I was born from this hard land, and it is mine to safeguard. Time, war, even death itself will not stop my vigil."
01FR024.name: Anivia

01FR024T2.description: Deal 1 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus.
01FR024T2.descriptionRaw: Deal 1 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus.
01FR024T2.flavorText: The storm that comes before the calm.
01FR024T2.name: Glacial Storm

01FR024T1.description:
<link=keyword.Frostbite><sprite name=Frostbite><style=Keyword>Frostbite</style></link> 2 enemies.
Create an <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Anivia</style></link> in your deck.
01FR024T1.descriptionRaw:
Frostbite 2 enemies.
Create an Anivia in your deck.
01FR024T1.flavorText: "You'd challenge me on my own lands? You're ill-prepared, little one." - Anivia
01FR024T1.name: Anivia's Harsh Winds

01FR024T3.description:
<link=keyword.Elemental Skill><sprite name=ElementalSkill><style=Keyword>Attack</style></link>: Deal 2 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus.
<link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Revive me transformed into <link=card.transform><style=AssociatedCard>Eggnivia</style></link>.
01FR024T3.descriptionRaw:
Attack: Deal 2 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus.
Last Breath: Revive me transformed into Eggnivia.
01FR024T3.flavorText: "Cease your march and turn back your armies. The eye of winter has spied your conquest, and its icy claw closes tight about your treasonous hearts."
01FR024T3.name: Anivia

01FR024T5.description: Deal 2 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus.
01FR024T5.descriptionRaw: Deal 2 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus.
01FR024T5.flavorText: The storm that comes before the calm.
01FR024T5.name: Glacial Storm

01FR024T4.levelupDescription: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: If you're <link=keyword.Enlightened><style=Keyword>Enlightened</style></link>, transform me back into <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Anivia</style></link> and Level Up.
01FR024T4.levelupDescriptionRaw: Round Start: If you're Enlightened, transform me back into Anivia and Level Up.
01FR024T4.flavorText: In the depths of winter's cold embrace, the Freljord's guardian awaits the hour of her return.
01FR024T4.name: Eggnivia

01FR039.levelupDescription: If I would die, I Level Up instead.
01FR039.levelupDescriptionRaw: If I would die, I Level Up instead.
01FR039.flavorText: "Do not die for your cause. Live for it..."
01FR039.name: Tryndamere

01FR039T1.description:
Grant an ally +8|+4.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Tryndamere</style></link> in your deck.
01FR039T1.descriptionRaw:
Grant an ally +8|+4.
Create a Tryndamere in your deck.
01FR039T1.flavorText: â€œI've been told I have a... temper.â€ - Tryndamere
01FR039T1.name: Tryndamere's Battle Fury

01FR006.description: Grant an ally and all allied copies of it <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +2|+2.
01FR006.descriptionRaw: Grant an ally and all allied copies of it everywhere +2|+2.
01FR006.flavorText: "We few are Iceborn, our bloodlines infused with the Freljord's magic. Our ancestors locked away an ancient evil, and now we few stand guard to defend against its return." - Gregor the Guardian
01FR006.name: Iceborn Legacy

01FR022.description: When I'm summoned, grant the top 2 allies in your deck +1|+1.
01FR022.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, grant the top 2 allies in your deck +1|+1.
01FR022.flavorText: "Three times our reavers reached Avarosan gates, and three time they were met with ready bows. What trickery warns them of our attacks?" - Scarthane Steffen
01FR022.name: Omen Hawk

01FR042.flavorText: "You'd challenge me on my own lands? You're ill-prepared, little one." - Anivia
01FR042.name: Harsh Winds

01FR009.description: The first time I survive damage, summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Mighty Poro</style></link>.
01FR009.descriptionRaw: The first time I survive damage, summon a Mighty Poro.
01FR009.flavorText:
â€œPapa, tell the one about Braum and his door!â€
"Or when his fall split a mountain in two!"
"Oh! Whattabout when he saved the tavern from the rampaging yeti?!"
01FR009.name: Braum

01FR018.description: <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>Strike</style></link>: If I struck a unit with 0 Power, kill it.
01FR018.descriptionRaw: Strike: If I struck a unit with 0 Power, kill it.
01FR018.flavorText: Predators of the northern reaches have learned that the easiest prey are those already crippled by winter's bite.
01FR018.name: Rimefang Wolf

01FR036.flavorText: In the Freljord you can hunt, or you can starve.
01FR036.name: Avarosan Marksman

01FR045.description: When I survive damage, grant me +3|+0.
01FR045.descriptionRaw: When I survive damage, grant me +3|+0.
01FR045.flavorText: "I sealed my oath to the Winter's Claw when Sejuani gave me my first scar. Every scar since has been earned in her service."
01FR045.name: Scarthane Steffen

01FR008.description: When I'm summoned, create another random 1 cost Poro in hand.
01FR008.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, create another random 1 cost Poro in hand.
01FR008.flavorText: "A lifetime in the Freljord, and still nothin's more chillin' than the sight of this sad little fellow." - Poro Herder
01FR008.name: Lonely Poro

01FR008T1.description: When I'm summoned, create another random 1 cost Poro in hand.
01FR008T1.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, create another random 1 cost Poro in hand.
01FR008T1.flavorText: "Oho, there's a good lad! Even the coldest winter melts into spring." - Poro Herder
01FR008T1.name: Jubilant Poro

01FR055.description: Deal 4 to an enemy if it has 0 Power. Otherwise, <link=keyword.Frostbite><sprite name=Frostbite><style=Keyword>Frostbite</style></link> it.
01FR055.descriptionRaw: Deal 4 to an enemy if it has 0 Power. Otherwise, Frostbite it.
01FR055.flavorText: "When Winter rides across the land, she humbles the strong and fells the weak." - Scarthane Steffen
01FR055.name: Shatter

01FR038.levelupDescription: You've reduced the Power of 5+ enemies to 0.<style=Variable></style> When I level up, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Crystal Arrow</style></link> on top of deck.
01FR038.levelupDescriptionRaw: You've reduced the Power of 5+ enemies to 0. When I level up, create a Crystal Arrow on top of deck.
01FR038.flavorText: "When I look out over my home, I see what it is, but also what it could be. Prosperous and plentiful, not only for my people, but for all those who seek peace. The Freljord, united."
01FR038.name: Ashe

01FR038T3.description: <link=keyword.Frostbite><sprite name=Frostbite><style=Keyword>Frostbite</style></link> an enemy and all other enemies with 3 or less Health. Draw 1.
01FR038T3.descriptionRaw: Frostbite an enemy and all other enemies with 3 or less Health. Draw 1.
01FR038T3.flavorText: "All the world on one arrow." - Ashe
01FR038T3.name: Crystal Arrow

01FR038T2.description:
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: <link=keyword.Frostbite><sprite name=Frostbite><style=Keyword>Frostbite</style></link> the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> enemy.
Enemies with 0 Power can't block.
01FR038T2.descriptionRaw:
Attack: Frostbite the strongest enemy.
Enemies with 0 Power can't block.
01FR038T2.flavorText: "You are not our enemy. Our true foe is the long, lawless winter. We are all people of the Freljord, and this land belongs to all of us!"
01FR038T2.name: Ashe

01FR038T1.description:
<link=keyword.Frostbite><sprite name=Frostbite><style=Keyword>Frostbite</style></link> an enemy.
Create an <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Ashe</style></link> in your deck.
01FR038T1.descriptionRaw:
Frostbite an enemy.
Create an Ashe in your deck.
01FR038T1.flavorText: The cold strikes without warning, rendering even the strongest warrior helpless.
01FR038T1.name: Ashe's Flash Freeze

01FR029.flavorText: "Reavers approach! Sound the call and light the fires, we'll need all the help we can muster!" - Avarosan Sentry
01FR029.name: Entreat

01FR035.description: When I survive damage, grant me +3|+0.
01FR035.descriptionRaw: When I survive damage, grant me +3|+0.
01FR035.flavorText: "Avarosans nurture their young to grow old, soft, and unprepared for the heat of battle. Ours are born in the fires of war itself." - Scarmother Vrynna
01FR035.name: Unscarred Reaver

01FR028.flavorText: Yetis? I just don't think they exi--AUGHHH!
01FR028.name: Enraged Yeti

01FR020.flavorText: The soul of every avalanche is a pebble that would not stay put.
01FR020.name: Avalanche

01FR014.description: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Create 2 <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Enraged Yetis</style></link> in your deck.
01FR014.descriptionRaw: Last Breath: Create 2 Enraged Yetis in your deck.
01FR014.flavorText: "It was so tiny and peaceful! Hard to believe it would grow up to be... well... a yeti." - Avarosan Trapper
01FR014.name: Yeti Yearling

01FR049.description: When I'm summoned, your opponent summons a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Snow Hare</style></link>.
01FR049.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, your opponent summons a Snow Hare.
01FR049.flavorText:
"You cannot make a wolf from a hare."
- Winter's Claw proverb
01FR049.name: Stalking Wolf

01FR037.description: <link=vocab.Allegiance><style=Vocab>Allegiance</style></link>: Grant the top ally in your deck +3|+3 and <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link>.
01FR037.descriptionRaw: Allegiance: Grant the top ally in your deck +3|+3 and Overwhelm.
01FR037.flavorText: As the rows of reinforcements crested the ridge, the Outriders bowed their heads to the warmother. For with her--their Avarosa in the flesh, their queen Ashe--came the promise of peace.
01FR037.name: Avarosan Outriders

01FR009T1.description: When I survive damage, summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Mighty Poro</style></link>.
01FR009T1.descriptionRaw: When I survive damage, summon a Mighty Poro.
01FR009T1.flavorText: "Listen closely, 'n I'll tell you about Braum and the mightiest of his poros!" - Ingvar the Elder
01FR009T1.name: Braum

01FR009T2.description:
Grant a damaged ally +3|+3.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Braum</style></link> in your deck.
01FR009T2.descriptionRaw:
Grant a damaged ally +3|+3.
Create a Braum in your deck.
01FR009T2.flavorText:
"... Though his wounds were great, Braum threw back his head and laughed. For he knew that dire times are when heroes are made!"
- The Tale of Braum
01FR009T2.name: Braum's Take Heart

01FR026.flavorText: The power of a warhorse, the thoughtless savagery of a cat.
01FR026.name: Alpha Wildclaw

01FR030.description: <link=keyword.Frostbite><sprite name=Frostbite><style=Keyword>Frostbite</style></link> an enemy with 3 or less Health.
01FR030.descriptionRaw: Frostbite an enemy with 3 or less Health.
01FR030.flavorText: "Chilly? Ha! Let us hope that your spirits are sturdier than your summerland steel!" - Braum
01FR030.name: Brittle Steel

01FR013.description: When I survive damage, grant me +3|+0.
01FR013.descriptionRaw: When I survive damage, grant me +3|+0.
01FR013.flavorText: "I would die shivering in the cold before sharing a hearth with Ashe's weaklings. But if they desire warmth, I will give it to them.â€
01FR013.name: Scarmother Vrynna

01FR019.description: Kill all enemies with 0 Power, then <link=keyword.Frostbite><sprite name=Frostbite><style=Keyword>Frostbite</style></link> all enemies.
01FR019.descriptionRaw: Kill all enemies with 0 Power, then Frostbite all enemies.
01FR019.flavorText: Warmother Winter is the first and last foe faced by any who would invade the Freljord. Her bloodsworn are the merciless wind and the biting frost.
01FR019.name: Winter's Breath

01FR041.description: When I'm summoned, grant allies in your deck +1|+1.
01FR041.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, grant allies in your deck +1|+1.
01FR041.flavorText: "Many tribes under one banner! Perhaps one day all the Freljord will fight side by side."
01FR041.name: Avarosan Hearthguard

01FR025.description: When I'm summoned, draw a Poro if you <link=vocab.Behold><style=Vocab>Behold</style></link> a Poro.
01FR025.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, draw a Poro if you Behold a Poro.
01FR025.flavorText: A herd needs just two things: love, and company. Anything else is just fluff.
01FR025.name: Poro Herder

01FR054.flavorText: "The weak harvest, but the strong take. The little Avarosans will learn which they are!"
01FR054.name: Scarmaiden Reaver

01FR021.descriptionRaw: Attack: Deal 1 to ALL battling units.
01FR021.flavorText: "Tarkaz fought harder and better than most. He took his defeat gracefully, I thought. Well, mostly..." - Tryndamere
01FR021.name: Tarkaz the Tribeless

01FR021T1.flavorText: "... Maybe not that gracefully after all." - Tryndamere
01FR021T1.name: Tarkaz's Fury

01FR043.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Combine your Poro followers into a <link=card.transform><style=AssociatedCard>Fluft of Poros</style></link>, and grant it their stats and positive keywords.
01FR043.descriptionRaw: Play: Combine your Poro followers into a Fluft of Poros, and grant it their stats and positive keywords.
01FR043.flavorText:
"One more story, but keep quiet or mother will come!"
"Long ago, raiders attacked Avarosa's village. Her forces were few--all seemed lost. But a poro appeared and offered Avarosa its help..."
01FR043.name: Heart of the Fluft

01FR049T1.flavorText:
"Wolf or hare, winter makes prey of us all."
- Avarosan proverb
01FR049T1.name: Snow Hare

01FR033.description: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Get an extra mana gem this round.
01FR033.descriptionRaw: Round Start: Get an extra mana gem this round.
01FR033.flavorText: "These ancient cairns are reminders that we are but the latest in a long line of tribes to brave these untamed lands." - Ashe
01FR033.name: Wyrding Stones

01FR011.flavorText: Avarosans take pride in their harsh seasons and icy lands. Their keen-eyed defenders even take it a step further.
01FR011.name: Icevale Archer

01FR050.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Heal an ally or your Nexus 3.
01FR050.descriptionRaw: Play: Heal an ally or your Nexus 3.
01FR050.flavorText: "This fine old establishment's the Tipsy Owl! We've got stews and brews a'plenty to chase away the chill. Hurry on inside!"
01FR050.name: Kindly Tavernkeeper

01FR052.description: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> ALL units with 4 or less Power in play and in hands.
01FR052.descriptionRaw: Play: Obliterate ALL units with 4 or less Power in play and in hands.
01FR052.flavorText: "I dug myself out from the rubble to find a scar seared into the land around me. Smoldering ash lay where my companions had stood, and in the distance a looming form moved on..." - Bjerg the Wanderer
01FR052.name: She Who Wanders

01FR052T1.description: <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> ALL units with 4 or less Power in play and in hands.
01FR052T1.descriptionRaw: Obliterate ALL units with 4 or less Power in play and in hands.
01FR052T1.flavorText: â€œUnearthly light flooded the valley as a piercing wail rattled the rocks from the cliffs, my sinews from their bones, the very thoughts from my mind! Then... silence.â€ - Bjerg the Wanderer
01FR052T1.name: Balesight

01FR016.flavorText: "They gobble 'em up, then look at you, tongues out, happy as sheared 'nuks in the thaw askin' for more! You try sayin' no." - Avarosan treatmaker
01FR016.name: Poro Snax

01FR005.flavorText: â€œI've been told I have a... temper.â€ - Tryndamere
01FR005.name: Battle Fury

01FR023.description: Summon the top ally from your deck now and EACH <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>.
01FR023.descriptionRaw: Summon the top ally from your deck now and EACH Round Start.
01FR023.flavorText: There will come a day when an unmistakable call will resound through the Freljord. On that day, all will rise to answer it, for it announces that our ancient enemies have emerged once again.
01FR023.name: Warmother's Call

01FR047.flavorText: â€œThose who learn to roar as beasts soon forget their native tongue.â€ - Anivia
01FR047.name: Feral Mystic

01FR056.description: When I'm summoned, <link=keyword.Frostbite><sprite name=Frostbite><style=Keyword>Frostbite</style></link> enemies with 3 or less Health.
01FR056.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, Frostbite enemies with 3 or less Health.
01FR056.name: Icy Yeti

01FR027.flavorText: Avarosan folk tales speak of "Old Uncle Elnuk", a stubborn old grouch who wanted nothing more than a warm patch of grass and an argument to dig his heel into.
01FR027.name: Bull Elnuk

01FR057.descriptionRaw: Give allies +2|+2 and Overwhelm this round.
01FR057.flavorText: A lone howl echoed through the night, followed by another, then another. Within moments, the pack howled as one--a chorus of frenzied voices calling out for blood.
01FR057.name: Pack Mentality

01FR004.flavorText: "Rough out there, eh? Not to worry, the 'Owl serves up a special brew so strong it'll pull the chill outta y'bones 'n grow hair on the chest of a newborn!" - Kindly Tavernkeeper
01FR004.name: Elixir of Iron

01FR048.description: When I'm summoned, create an <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Enraged Yeti</style></link> in the top 3 cards of your deck.
01FR048.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, create an Enraged Yeti in the top 3 cards of your deck.
01FR048.flavorText: "Caught nothing all week! Either those beasts are onto me, or something's scaring 'em off..."
01FR048.name: Avarosan Trapper

01FR017.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: For the top 6 cards in your deck, summon each Elnuk and place the rest into your deck.
01FR017.descriptionRaw: Play: For the top 6 cards in your deck, summon each Elnuk and place the rest into your deck.
01FR017.flavorText: "Avarosans are like elnuks--dull-eyed grass-eaters easily felled by the unscarred. It is by numbers alone that they stay alive." - Scarmother Vrynna
01FR017.name: Troop of Elnuks

01FR046.flavorText:
"... Though his wounds were great, Braum threw back his head and laughed. For he knew that dire times are when heroes are made!"
- The Tale of Braum
01FR046.name: Take Heart

01FR012.description: Get an empty mana gem and heal your Nexus 3.
01FR012.descriptionRaw: Get an empty mana gem and heal your Nexus 3.
01FR012.flavorText: Neither ruby nor sapphire surpass the luster of the aeon stone--a brilliant gem with legendary restorative properties.
01FR012.name: Catalyst of Aeons

01FR040.descriptionRaw: Round Start: Frostbite the strongest enemy.
01FR040.flavorText: "To become one with the wild we must not hide from the cold, but revel in its savagery."
01FR040.name: Rimetusk Shaman

01FR031.descriptionRaw: Round End: Reduce my cost by 1.
01FR031.flavorText: "What was that? Sounded like a sneeze. Do glaciers... sneeze?" - Bjerg the Wanderer
01FR031.name: Ancient Yeti

01FR053.flavorText: "Ol' Longhorn here lost an eye defending the Poro King himself from an ornery wildclaw! After all, it's not the size of the hammer but the size of the heart that matters." - Poro Herder
01FR053.name: Mighty Poro

01FR010.flavorText: "I will be a torch in your heart, a shield at your side. Let me find strength to protect us and our kin, and may our lives flow together as the blood that seals this oath." - Tryndamere
01FR010.name: Bloodsworn Pledge

01FR001.flavorText: The cold strikes without warning, rendering even the strongest warrior helpless.
01FR001.name: Flash Freeze

01FR043T1.description: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Heart of the Fluft</style></link>.
01FR043T1.descriptionRaw: Last Breath: Summon a Heart of the Fluft.
01FR043T1.flavorText:
"... At first she didn't know what the little ones could do. But then another appeared, and another, 'til the hall was full of them! And every poro gathered--" 
"Bedtime! If you two aren't asleep in five minutes...!"
01FR043T1.name: Fluft of Poros

01FR032.description: When you play a spell, grant the top ally in your deck +1|+1.
01FR032.descriptionRaw: When you play a spell, grant the top ally in your deck +1|+1.
01FR032.flavorText: "Grant them keen ears to hear the wind's approach, light feet to cross the coming snows, and sharp eyes to see beyond the veil of winter."
01FR032.name: Starlit Seer

01FR051.description: If you have a Yeti, summon an <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Enraged Yeti</style></link>. Otherwise, create it on top of your deck.
01FR051.descriptionRaw: If you have a Yeti, summon an Enraged Yeti. Otherwise, create it on top of your deck.
01FR051.flavorText: "... and this one has a mouth fulla big jagged teeths an' smashy fists an super an-ger-y eyes an a HUUUGE TREE-SHAKING ROAR! Uncle Bjerg told me so!" - Ingvar the Younger
01FR051.name: Tall Tales

01FR034.description: When I'm summoned, grant me +1|+1 for each ally that has died. <style=Variable></style>
01FR034.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, grant me +1|+1 for each ally that has died.
01FR034.flavorText: "Ah, old Bjerg's been through a bit. Lost his crew up north, returned pale an' gibberin' months later. Now, it's just "giant beasts" this and "huge claws" that. That poor man..." - Kindly Tavernkeeper
01FR034.name: They Who Endure

01FR007.description: When I'm summoned, draw a unit with 5+ Power.
01FR007.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, draw a unit with 5+ Power.
01FR007.flavorText: "Y-You've gotta believe me! It was huge, I tell you, HUUUGE!"
01FR007.name: Babbling Bjerg

01FR003.flavorText: "Once I sought my place on distant battlefields. Now, I've found it beside my kin, my homestead. My eyes are theirs, and their safety is in my hands."
01FR003.name: Avarosan Sentry

01SI038.description: When another ally dies, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
01SI038.descriptionRaw: When another ally dies, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
01SI038.flavorText: Her cruelest trick wasn't slaughtering the soldiers who trusted the cries of a little girl, but sowing doubt in the survivors who returned home and ignored the pleas of their daughters.
01SI038.name: Phantom Prankster

01SI049.flavorText: "I have erred. We were not meant to peer beyond the pale curtain. Whatever insight lingers there comes at far too great a cost." - Arie Wrence, Dauntless vindicator
01SI049.name: Glimpse Beyond

01SI053.levelupDescriptionRaw: Round Start: You have 3+ other Spiders.
01SI053.flavorText: Once the head of a powerful Noxian house, Elise's dark ties to the Shadow Isles granted her unnatural youth and beauty in exchange for a few unwitting souls offered in sacrifice. An easy decision.
01SI053.name: Elise

01SI053T1.description:
If an ally died this round, summon 2 <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Spiderlings</style></link>.
Create an <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Elise</style></link> in your deck.
01SI053T1.descriptionRaw:
If an ally died this round, summon 2 Spiderlings.
Create an Elise in your deck.
01SI053T1.flavorText: That creeping feeling on your skin isn't nearly as unsettling as the one underneath it.
01SI053T1.name: Elise's Crawling Sensation

01SI053T2.descriptionRaw: Other Spider allies have Challenger and Fearsome.
01SI053T2.flavorText: Beauty is in the many eyes of the beholder.
01SI053T2.name: Spider Queen Elise

01SI057.flavorText:
"Put 'em in the cage, tum-te-dum... 
Pluck up every soul, one by one...
Never let â€˜em go, no! No sirâ€¦
Else them spirits make quite a stir..."
01SI057.name: Ancient Crocolith

01SI023.description: When you summon an <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> ally, grant it +1|+1.
01SI023.descriptionRaw: When you summon an Ephemeral ally, grant it +1|+1.
01SI023.flavorText: Only the fallen knew that she did not walk alone. Only they could see the countless companions she led down the path to lands beyond.
01SI023.name: Soul Shepherd

01SI010.flavorText: They live now as they died then: loyal 'til the very end.
01SI010.name: Onslaught of Shadows

01SI042.flavorText: That's not thunder. The Shadow of War is on the horizon.
01SI042.name: Hecarim

01SI042T1.description:
When I level up, grant your Nexus "<link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> allies have +3|+0".
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Summon 2 attacking <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Spectral Riders</style></link>.
01SI042T1.descriptionRaw:
When I level up, grant your Nexus "Ephemeral allies have +3|+0".
Attack: Summon 2 attacking Spectral Riders.
01SI042T1.flavorText: Listen. Hear him ride. The trampling of hooves. The creak of armor, long-worn and rusted. The ghostly cries of soldiers, echoes of the past. The resounding silence that follows.
01SI042T1.name: Hecarim

01SI042T2.description:
Summon 2 <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Spectral Riders</style></link>.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Hecarim</style></link> in your deck.
01SI042T2.descriptionRaw:
Summon 2 Spectral Riders.
Create a Hecarim in your deck.
01SI042T2.flavorText: They live now as they died then: loyal 'til the very end.
01SI042T2.name: Hecarim's Onslaught of Shadows

01SI027.description:
If 3+ allies have died this round, summon <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Vilemaw</style></link>.
<style=Variable></style>
01SI027.descriptionRaw: If 3+ allies have died this round, summon Vilemaw.
01SI027.flavorText: "Kneel before your fanged god. Better yet, die before it." - Elise
01SI027.name: Fresh Offerings

01SI027T1.flavorText: "Who is your god? What can your god do? Will he let you wither and die defending him? Or will he give you life and vitality like no mortal has ever known? Why serve a god who won't serve you?" - Elise
01SI027T1.name: Vilemaw

01SI048.description: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Summon an <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Escaped Abomination</style></link>.
01SI048.descriptionRaw: Last Breath: Summon an Escaped Abomination.
01SI048.flavorText: Madness and time. Never was there a more terrible pair.
01SI048.name: Cursed Keeper

01SI018.description: When I'm summoned, create a copy in hand of an ally that died this game.
01SI018.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, create a copy in hand of an ally that died this game.
01SI018.flavorText: "Little did our author know that soon the Ruinatio--the Ruin--no, no, no, that's not right, the ink's spilled again! Little did our author--no, no, no!"
01SI018.name: Scribe of Sorrows

01SI030.flavorText: In life, she was a general, a protector, a hero. But as flesh gave way, she was left with naught but the blazing fires of retribution--an undying spirit of vengeance.
01SI030.name: Kalista

01SI030T2.description: Each round, the first time I attack revive an attacking <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> copy of the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> dead allied follower. This round, we're bonded and it takes damage for me.
01SI030T2.descriptionRaw: Each round, the first time I attack revive an attacking Ephemeral copy of the strongest dead allied follower. This round, we're bonded and it takes damage for me.
01SI030T2.name: Kalista

01SI030T1.description:
If an ally died this round, deal 4 to a unit.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Kalista</style></link> in your deck.
01SI030T1.descriptionRaw:
If an ally died this round, deal 4 to a unit.
Create a Kalista in your deck.
01SI030T1.flavorText: "Our spear sings for the fallen." - Kalista
01SI030T1.name: Kalista's Black Spear

01SI035.description: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Kill the 2 <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> enemies if an ally died this round.
01SI035.descriptionRaw: Play: Kill the 2 weakest enemies if an ally died this round.
01SI035.flavorText: "We were told... they called it a legend's journey. We were going to... for Demacia's future. We sailed with such hope. But all... all those lives... for what?" - Arie Wrence, Demacian soldier
01SI035.name: Rhasa the Sunderer

01SI035T1.description: Kill the 2 <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>Weakest</style></link> enemies if an ally died this round.
01SI035T1.descriptionRaw: Kill the 2 Weakest enemies if an ally died this round.
01SI035T1.name: Night Harvest

01SI002.flavorText: "What are you afraid of? It's just ONE little spider." - Lord Sassen, Hapless Aristocrat
01SI002.name: Spiderling

01SI024.flavorText: No longer bound by flesh, rider and beast became one, determined to race mindlessly into battles they no longer understood.
01SI024.name: Spectral Rider

01SI005.description: I cost 1 less for each ally that died this game.
01SI005.descriptionRaw: I cost 1 less for each ally that died this game.
01SI005.flavorText: Once a beast of burden for a kingdom long forgotten, this monster now scavenges across forgotten battlefields, adding scrap to its shell, and the souls of the dead to its core.
01SI005.name: Scuttlegeist

01SI037.flavorText: I mean, there are worse ways to die.
01SI037.name: Sinister Poro

01SI048T1.flavorText: Time may have stopped, but madness remains.
01SI048T1.name: Escaped Abomination

01SI052.flavorText:
"Cling clang, go the chains, someone's out to find you,
Cling clang, oh the chains, the Warden's right behind you..."
01SI052.name: Thresh

01SI033.description:
<link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Deal damage to the enemy Nexus equal to half its Health, rounded up.
<link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Return me to hand.
01SI033.descriptionRaw:
Play: Deal damage to the enemy Nexus equal to half its Health, rounded up.
Last Breath: Return me to hand.
01SI033.flavorText: Most spirits lost themselves as the passing years eroded their memories. But anguish anchored Ledros to his past. Some things, even time cannot absolve.
01SI033.name: Commander Ledros

01SI003.description: Revive the 6 <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> allies that died this game and grant them <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link>.
01SI003.descriptionRaw: Revive the 6 strongest allies that died this game and grant them Ephemeral.
01SI003.flavorText: On certain nights, a tide of hungry spirits swells the Black Mist. It carries them across the seas to prey on the living, and feed the growing darkness with foul new unlife.
01SI003.name: The Harrowing

01SI041.description: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Revive me at the next <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link> and grant me +1|+1 for each time I've died. <style=Variable></style>
01SI041.descriptionRaw: Last Breath: Revive me at the next Round Start and grant me +1|+1 for each time I've died.
01SI041.flavorText: The old martyr remembered rallying his comrades to their doom. But it had been years since he could remember why...
01SI041.name: The Undying

01SI045.flavorText: "What kills you only makes me stronger." - Thresh
01SI045.name: Absorb Soul

01SI036.description: If an ally died this round, summon 2 <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Spiderlings</style></link>.
01SI036.descriptionRaw: If an ally died this round, summon 2 Spiderlings.
01SI036.flavorText: That creeping feeling on your skin isn't nearly as unsettling as the one underneath it.
01SI036.name: Crawling Sensation

01SI051.description: When another ally dies, or <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Refill your spell mana.
01SI051.descriptionRaw: When another ally dies, or Last Breath: Refill your spell mana.
01SI051.flavorText: He toiled night and day, perfecting his composition. Then, in the blink of an eye, a dark silence blew through him. Others screamed and ran for their lives. He noticed nothing.
01SI051.name: Tortured Prodigy

01SI012.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant an ally in hand <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> and reduce its cost by 1.
01SI012.descriptionRaw: Play: Grant an ally in hand Ephemeral and reduce its cost by 1.
01SI012.name: Oblivious Islander

01SI052T2.description:
Deal 3 to each enemy that was summoned this round.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Thresh</style></link> in your deck.
01SI052T2.descriptionRaw:
Deal 3 to each enemy that was summoned this round.
Create a Thresh in your deck.
01SI052T2.name: Thresh's The Box

01SI052T1.description: The first time I attack this game, summon another attacking champion from your deck or hand.
01SI052T1.descriptionRaw: The first time I attack this game, summon another attacking champion from your deck or hand.
01SI052T1.flavorText: "You're mine. Forever."Cling clang, oh the chains, the Warden's right behind you...
01SI052T1.name: Thresh

01SI031.description: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Grant me +1|+0 for each <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> ally you have.
01SI031.descriptionRaw: Attack: Grant me +1|+0 for each Ephemeral ally you have.
01SI031.flavorText: In death, as in life, he bellows the twisted, dark command. And in death, as in life, Hecarim's loyal knights answer, charging forth to slaughter.
01SI031.name: Iron Harbinger

01SI034.description: If an ally died this round, deal 4 to a unit.
01SI034.descriptionRaw: If an ally died this round, deal 4 to a unit.
01SI034.flavorText: "Our spear sings for the fallen." - Kalista
01SI034.name: Black Spear

01SI043.flavorText: "L-Lady Elise? Where... where did you go?"
01SI043.name: Hapless Aristocrat

01SI009.descriptionRaw: Support: Grant my supported ally +2|+0 and Ephemeral.
01SI009.flavorText: Some look at the Ruination and only see the destruction and misery. Others see the glass half full.
01SI009.name: Stirred Spirits

01SI007.flavorText: These ancient artifacts are treasured both by the living hungry to claim them, and the dead desperate to retain them.
01SI007.name: Haunted Relic

01SI007T1.flavorText: ...each spirit another victim of the relic's allure. They seethe in silence as they await the arrival of the next greedy fool.
01SI007T1.name: Unleashed Spirit

01SI056.description: When I'm summoned, give other Spider allies +1|+0 and enemies <nobr>-1|-0</nobr> this round.
01SI056.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, give other Spider allies +1|+0 and enemies -1|-0 this round.
01SI056.flavorText: "They can spin a web the size of a man in less than a minute... would you like a demonstration?" - Elise
01SI056.name: Frenzied Skitterer

01SI001.flavorText: The betrayed invoke Kalista on their dying breath, hoping her spear brings them vengeance.
01SI001.name: Vengeance

01SI019.description: Deal 3 to each enemy that was summoned this round.
01SI019.descriptionRaw: Deal 3 to each enemy that was summoned this round.
01SI019.name: The Box

01SI011.description: To play me, kill an ally.
01SI011.descriptionRaw: To play me, kill an ally.
01SI011.name: Ravenous Butcher

01SI014.description: When I'm summoned, grant other allied <link=card.mist><style=AssociatedCard>Mistwraiths</style></link> <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +1|+0.
01SI014.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, grant other allied Mistwraiths everywhere +1|+0.
01SI014.flavorText: These specters of the Isles shed their identities long ago to become amalgamations of pure, unappeasable hunger.
01SI014.name: Mistwraith

01SI006.description: Steal an enemy follower this round. (Can't play if you have 6 allies or landmarks already.)
01SI006.descriptionRaw: Steal an enemy follower this round. (Can't play if you have 6 allies or landmarks already.)
01SI006.flavorText: He woke to find his hands glistening red and the camp unusually quiet.
01SI006.name: Possession

01SI033T1.description: Deal damage to the enemy Nexus equal to half its Health, rounded up.
01SI033T1.descriptionRaw: Deal damage to the enemy Nexus equal to half its Health, rounded up.
01SI033T1.flavorText: Half a blade for half a man. A weapon broken as its wielder's vow, broken as the king it was sworn to protect, broken as the kingdom of shadow that once was blessed.
01SI033T1.name: Blade of Ledros

01SI028.description: Summon an exact copy of an ally. It's <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> and 1|1.
01SI028.descriptionRaw: Summon an exact copy of an ally. It's Ephemeral and 1|1.
01SI028.flavorText: "I lifted the body from the water to identify the poor soul. As I laid my hand upon its shoulder, it turned and showed its face. It was... me?" - Arie Wrence, Demacian soldier
01SI028.name: Splinter Soul

01SI025.description: Kill an ally to deal damage equal to its Power to anything.
01SI025.descriptionRaw: Kill an ally to deal damage equal to its Power to anything.
01SI025.flavorText: Killing means nothing to those who cannot know death.
01SI025.name: Atrocity

01SI046.description: Revive a random ally that died this round.
01SI046.descriptionRaw: Revive a random ally that died this round.
01SI046.flavorText: "The Mist severs spirit from flesh, leaving behind a foul parody of life. I have seen it corrupt my lands, so I go now to those cursed isles, to end this." - Arie Wrence, Dauntless vindicator
01SI046.name: Mist's Call

01SI050.descriptionRaw: Summon 3 Spiderlings, then grant Spider allies +1|+0.
01SI050.name: Brood Awakening

01SI016.flavorText: She appears without a sound. The terrors that follow her are far less subtle.
01SI016.name: Wraithcaller

01SI021.description: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: The next time an <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> ally attacks, revive me attacking.
01SI021.descriptionRaw: Last Breath: The next time an Ephemeral ally attacks, revive me attacking.
01SI021.flavorText: "She saw what? I see. Madness is a cruel mistress, apothecary. At least the others make some degree of sense." - Demacian surgeon
01SI021.name: Shark Chariot

01SI032.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Kill an ally, then revive it.
01SI032.descriptionRaw: Play: Kill an ally, then revive it.
01SI032.flavorText: There was a time when she sat with her father--a lord curator--as he studied the dusty tomes. He hoped one day she would take on the mantle. But not like this.
01SI032.name: Chronicler of Ruin

01SI058.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Kill an ally to summon a random follower that costs 2 more.
01SI058.descriptionRaw: Play: Kill an ally to summon a random follower that costs 2 more.
01SI058.flavorText: Spirits, lend your voices to mine! Together, we will call down a darkness unending!
01SI058.name: Ethereal Remitter

01SI054.flavorText: The dead want nothing more than to silence the ceaseless pulse of the living.
01SI054.name: Grasp of the Undying

01SI044.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Pick an ally in hand. Summon an exact copy of it. It's <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link>.
01SI044.descriptionRaw: Play: Pick an ally in hand. Summon an exact copy of it. It's Ephemeral.
01SI044.flavorText: The Ruination corrupted all those caught in its path. The kind became cruel. The brave became brutal. Reason gave way to resentment.
01SI044.name: Spectral Matron

01SI039.flavorText: Some malevolent spirits take inspiration from local fauna, twisting the familiar into the nightmarish.
01SI039.name: Arachnoid Horror

01SI020.description: When I'm summoned, revive the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> dead allied champion.
01SI020.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, revive the strongest dead allied champion.
01SI020.flavorText: What use does a dying candle have, other than to light its successor?
01SI020.name: The Rekindler

01SI029.description: Deal 1 to all enemies. Heal your Nexus 3.
01SI029.descriptionRaw: Deal 1 to all enemies. Heal your Nexus 3.
01SI029.flavorText: That which kills us makes them stronger.
01SI029.name: Withering Wail

01SI004.flavorText: Some fleeing the Ruination tried diving beneath the waves, believing the corruption wouldn't seep into the depths. They were wrong.
01SI004.name: Darkwater Scourge

01SI026.description: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Create in hand another random <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link> follower that costs 3 or less.
01SI026.descriptionRaw: Last Breath: Create in hand another random Last Breath follower that costs 3 or less.
01SI026.flavorText: He held his breath as best he could, praying the warden would move on. Little did he know, this pursuit would just be the beginning of Thresh's delighted tormentsâ€¦
01SI026.name: Warden's Prey

01SI040.description: <link=keyword.Drain><style=Keyword>Drain</style></link> 1 from a unit to summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Spiderling</style></link>.
01SI040.descriptionRaw: Drain 1 from a unit to summon a Spiderling.
01SI040.flavorText: "My... my lady! I didn't realize you were such an... an arachnophile! Could you perhaps call them away from me? L-Lady Elise? Please?" - Lord Sassen, Hapless Aristocrat
01SI040.name: Vile Feast

01SI015.flavorText: To think something so pure as love could cause something so cruel and inescapable.
01SI015.name: The Ruination

01SI055.flavorText: "As our ships near those haunted lands, I ponder this: did those nightmarish creations originate on these twisted shores? Did they ever truly live?" - Arie Wrence, Demacian soldier
01SI055.name: Soulgorger

01SI047.description: Pick a follower. Create an <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> copy of it in hand.
01SI047.descriptionRaw: Pick a follower. Create an Ephemeral copy of it in hand.
01SI047.flavorText: For a moment, she remembered. Dappled sunlight dancing across her skin, plump dewberries bursting between her teeth, and the gladeâ€™s fragile melody drifting over her on the breeze. Then... it was gone.
01SI047.name: Fading Memories

02PZ001.description:
When I'm summoned, draw 1.
Then, if you've played at least 10 other new cards this game, grant me +4|+0. <style=Variable></style>
02PZ001.descriptionRaw:
When I'm summoned, draw 1.
Then, if you've played at least 10 other new cards this game, grant me +4|+0.
02PZ001.flavorText: Nothing could stop his escape from those simpering humans. Not even a little water...
02PZ001.name: Subpurrsible

02PZ010.description: When I'm summoned, ALL players draw 1.
02PZ010.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, ALL players draw 1.
02PZ010.flavorText: Some officers rely on their instincts to crack a case. Others lean on their contacts. But Officer J.S. Harknor's strength is pure diligence, and paperwork. Lots and lots of paperwork.
02PZ010.name: Veteran Investigator

02PZ006.description:
When drawn, I cost 2 less this round.
Deal 3 to a unit.
02PZ006.descriptionRaw:
When drawn, I cost 2 less this round.
Deal 3 to a unit.
02PZ006.flavorText:
"Mind trying on these handcuffs, Mr. Berz?"
"What's in it for me?"
"You can keep them."
"...A'right then."
"You're under arrest. Take him away!"
02PZ006.name: Gotcha!

02PZ004.description:
Give an ally +2|+0 this round.
Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.selfRef><style=AssociatedCard>Vault Breaker</style></link> in hand.
02PZ004.descriptionRaw:
Give an ally +2|+0 this round.
Create a Fleeting Vault Breaker in hand.
02PZ004.flavorText: "I let my hands do the talking." - Vi
02PZ004.name: Vault Breaker

02PZ007.description: When you play a 2 cost card, draw 1 and grant it <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>.
02PZ007.descriptionRaw: When you play a 2 cost card, draw 1 and grant it Fleeting.
02PZ007.flavorText: "All detectives respond, but a good detective anticipates, and an exemplary detective prevents." - The Warden's Handbook
02PZ007.name: Insightful Investigator

02PZ002.description: When you draw a card, grant it <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> and create an exact copy of it in hand.
02PZ002.descriptionRaw: When you draw a card, grant it Fleeting and create an exact copy of it in hand.
02PZ002.flavorText: At age five, she made the world's first multi-frequency sonic knife. While not very practical (she mostly used it to slice sandwiches), it set her on her way to the Wardens' elite Armaments Department.
02PZ002.name: Chief Mechanist Zevi

02PZ008.description: While I'm in play or in hand, grant me +1|+0 when you play another card (max +8|+0). <style=Variable></style>
02PZ008.descriptionRaw: While I'm in play or in hand, grant me +1|+0 when you play another card (max +8|+0).
02PZ008.levelupDescriptionRaw: I've struck for 10+ damage in one strike.
02PZ008.flavorText: "Enforcer Vi, please! Think of the people! The collateral damage! The PAPERWORK FOR INJURY CLAIMS!" - Insightful Investigator
02PZ008.name: Vi

02PZ009.description: Create in hand a random 2 cost card from your regions. It costs 2 less this round.
02PZ009.descriptionRaw: Create in hand a random 2 cost card from your regions. It costs 2 less this round.
02PZ009.flavorText: "And thus," Officer Harknor announced, "the trail leads us to..."
02PZ009.name: Trail of Evidence

02PZ003.description:
When drawn, I cost 2 less this round.
Grow an ally to 4|4.
02PZ003.descriptionRaw:
When drawn, I cost 2 less this round.
Grow an ally to 4|4.
02PZ003.flavorText: "Trouble at the docks! Take these, and give them my regards." - Chief Mechanist Zevi
02PZ003.name: Suit Up!

02PZ008T2.description: When I <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> a unit while attacking, deal 5 to the enemy Nexus.
02PZ008T2.descriptionRaw: When I strike a unit while attacking, deal 5 to the enemy Nexus.
02PZ008T2.flavorText: "So! Looks like your buddies are all tuckered out. You wanna tell me where you hid the hextech, or d'ya wanna make friends with the wall, too?"
02PZ008T2.name: Vi

02PZ008T1.description:
Give an ally +2|+0 this round.
Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.selfRef><style=AssociatedCard>Vault Breaker</style></link> in hand.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Vi</style></link> in your deck.
02PZ008T1.descriptionRaw:
Give an ally +2|+0 this round.
Create a Fleeting Vault Breaker in hand.
Create a Vi in your deck.
02PZ008T1.flavorText: "I let my hands do the talking." - Vi
02PZ008T1.name: Vi's Vault Breaker

02PZ005.description: When I'm drawn, I cost 1 less this round.
02PZ005.descriptionRaw: When I'm drawn, I cost 1 less this round.
02PZ005.flavorText: Warden Mir's sprinting technique was a running joke among the other enforcers. Warden Kepple didn't get it.
02PZ005.name: Patrol Wardens

02BW040.flavorText: "MY GRATEST STRENF IS PREBABLE MY COMAND OF DA COMON PEEPUL AN ALSO APPARENLY MY SPELING IS RELLY GUD TO" - Note scribbled in sand
02BW040.name: Shellshocker

02BW057.flavorText: "Swear I seen the strangest things over them reefs, Cap'n. Wha's that lunk put in 'em oranges? Tha's what I wanna know..." - Petty Officer
02BW057.name: Slippery Waverider

02BW041.flavorText:
"Fear not the blasted beast ye know,
For some survive their thunder,
But what of them that broke the bow,
An' took them poor souls under?" - Found scratched into a Bilgewater tavern beam
02BW041.name: The Beast Below

02BW013.flavorText: "...and the idiot said I had hips that 'rolled like the waves'. I told him to cut the flattery, or I'd cut out his tongue."
02BW013.name: Prowling Cutthroat

02BW034.description: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Deal 2 to me and summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Powder Monkey</style></link>.
02BW034.descriptionRaw: Round Start: Deal 2 to me and summon a Powder Monkey.
02BW034.flavorText: "This one's a... souvenir. The crew nabbed it from a crazy old rival of mine. Turns out the fool's ramblings about 'ancient, mysterious powers' weren't too far from the truth..." - Miss Fortune
02BW034.name: Monkey Idol

02BW034T1.description: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
02BW034T1.descriptionRaw: Last Breath: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
02BW034T1.flavorText: "Mischievous little scamps, ain't they? More help than they seem, but word is they've got explosive tempers..." - Syren deckhand
02BW034T1.name: Powder Monkey

02BW056.description:
<link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> an enemy with less Health than me.
<style=Variable></style>
02BW056.descriptionRaw: Play: Obliterate an enemy with less Health than me.
02BW056.flavorText:
"I was sailing just the other day,
Out beyond Bilgewater Bay,
When, from the depths, she came my way,
the Wing-Eared Sunken Lady..." - "Ballad of the Wing-Eared Sunken Lady"
02BW056.name: Devourer of the Depths

02BW056T1.description: <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> an enemy with less Health than me.
02BW056T1.descriptionRaw: Obliterate an enemy with less Health than me.
02BW056T1.flavorText:
"She swallowed me whole, me skiff and me soul,
So I'm singin' this song in her belly,
And now I must wait 'til I meet my fate,
In the Wing-Eared Sunken Lady." - "Ballad of the Wing-Eared Sunken Lady"
02BW056T1.name: Devour

02BW060.description: When allies attack, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
02BW060.descriptionRaw: When allies attack, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
02BW060.flavorText: "Being short gives you a surprising advantage in a fight. Turns out, nobody ever thinks to look down."
02BW060.name: Crackshot Corsair

02BW011.description: <link=vocab.Allegiance><style=Vocab>Allegiance</style></link>: <link=keyword.Nab><style=Keyword>Nab</style></link> 1 and create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Warning Shot</style></link> in hand.
02BW011.descriptionRaw: Allegiance: Nab 1 and create a Warning Shot in hand.
02BW011.flavorText: "Y'know, friends love to help friends out. And you? I like the shine in your eye and the glint on your cutlass! It is a really, really nice cutlass."
02BW011.name: Yordle Grifter

02BW030.description:
When I'm summoned, <link=vocab.Toss><style=Vocab>Toss</style></link> 2 and create 2 Treasures in your deck.
<style=Variable></style>
02BW030.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, Toss 2 and create 2 Treasures in your deck.
02BW030.flavorText: "These days, there's more treasure 'neath the waves than above 'em, I wager. Would be easy enough pickins, if 'tweren't for her." - Jagged Butcher
02BW030.name: Shipwreck Hoarder

02BW030T2.description:
If I'm <link=vocab.Toss><style=Vocab>Tossed</style></link>, draw me instead.
Deal 5 to ALL units.
02BW030T2.descriptionRaw:
If I'm Tossed, draw me instead.
Deal 5 to ALL units.
02BW030T2.flavorText: The deckhands roared as one and hauled the chains, their treasure now just below the calm waters. Little did they know the Seascraw's legendary cannon had one final act in store.
02BW030T2.name: Keelbreaker

02BW030T1.description:
Create 5 random cards in hand. They cost 0 and are <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>.
If I'm <link=vocab.Toss><style=Vocab>Tossed</style></link>, draw me instead.
02BW030T1.descriptionRaw:
Create 5 random cards in hand. They cost 0 and are Fleeting.
If I'm Tossed, draw me instead.
02BW030T1.flavorText: Captain Finn roared out "Ye earned this, boys! Told ye the Tithe was nothin' but coward feed!" Some cheered, but not all. The waters seemed to still, save for the bubbles around the Rancour's hull.
02BW030T1.name: Treasure Trove

02BW030T4.flavorText: The terrifying beasts burst through the waves and split the hull with vice-like jaws. Though the sailors begged the Bearded Lady for mercy, their captain's greed had already sealed their fate.
02BW030T4.name: Vicious Platewyrm

02BW030T3.description:
If I'm <link=vocab.Toss><style=Vocab>Tossed</style></link>, draw me instead.
Summon 3 <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Vicious Platewyrms</style></link>.
02BW030T3.descriptionRaw:
If I'm Tossed, draw me instead.
Summon 3 Vicious Platewyrms.
02BW030T3.flavorText: The grizzled captain held his shining quarry aloft and roared out "This'll keep us fer life!" Heady cheers rang out from the crew, while around their brig, the waters began to churn...
02BW030T3.name: Platewyrm Egg

02BW019.flavorText: Lively currents of magic weave through Serpent Isles' reefs, nourishing the sea's extraordinary inhabitants.
02BW019.name: Bubble Bear

02BW007.description:
To play me, discard 2.
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Draw 2 and grant them <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>.
02BW007.descriptionRaw:
To play me, discard 2.
Attack: Draw 2 and grant them Fleeting.
02BW007.flavorText: "Ain't nothing to it, most o' the time. Tables are full of fools too busy singing 'emselves hoarse to focus on the game. Not that I mind none. Coin's coin, and it's better in my pocket than theirs."
02BW007.name: Brash Gambler

02BW014.description: When I'm summoned, create in hand a random 1 cost spell from your regions.
02BW014.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, create in hand a random 1 cost spell from your regions.
02BW014.flavorText: Most shallows teem with all kinds of marine life, but none compare to the reefs of the Azure Way. The Way is a magical, otherworldly place, full of wonder.
02BW014.name: Coral Creatures

02BW055.flavorText: Once she fires, the Hooks have to move fast. Blood in the water brings all manner of company... and none of it is welcome.
02BW055.name: Jagged Taskmaster

02BW017.description: <link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: Heal allies and your Nexus 3, then <link=vocab.Rally><style=Vocab>Rally</style></link>.
02BW017.descriptionRaw: Plunder: Heal allies and your Nexus 3, then Rally.
02BW017.flavorText: "All sailors think they so tough! Grr this. Yarr that. Yes yes. Very good. But you still need orange! Make skin pretty, make teeth stay, and make me happy. So you eat, or you swim. Easy."
02BW017.name: Citrus Courier

02BW038.description: When I'm summoned, draw a spell that costs 3 or less from your deck.
02BW038.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, draw a spell that costs 3 or less from your deck.
02BW038.flavorText: Zap once completed the Azure Way circuit in just under three minutes. She even had to dodge the Jilldaw's shattered hull near the end! The currents that day were AWESOME.
02BW038.name: Zap Sprayfin

02BW021.flavorText: "I've heard he'll swim miles to find his mark, 'n when he finds 'em, he never misses his shot. Not sure if he's a man or a fish, but it's clear he knows these waters far better'n we do." - Jagged Butcher
02BW021.name: Razorscale Hunter

02BW035.description: When I'm summoned, grant all enemies <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link>.
02BW035.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, grant all enemies Vulnerable.
02BW035.flavorText: There may be no law in Bilgewater, yet a handful of brave souls within the city's boisterous walls are unafraid of enforcing their own idea of justice.
02BW035.name: Sheriff Lariette Rose

02BW058.flavorText: Entry into the Jagged Hooks is a bloody affair. Sailors must prove they know their way around a ship, a fight, and a butcher's block. The most unsavory candidates hit all three marks in a single scrap.
02BW058.name: Jagged Butcher

02BW028.description: <link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: Play <link=card.cast><style=AssociatedCard>Cannon Barrage</style></link> 7 times on randomly targeted enemies.
02BW028.descriptionRaw: Plunder: Play Cannon Barrage 7 times on randomly targeted enemies.
02BW028.flavorText:
"Sail past the sailors, sail past the wreck,
The battle's already over.
The smoke's cleared the water, their captain's met Rex,
And their ship's ripped an' torn timber." - "Home With You, Sally"
02BW028.name: Riptide Rex

02BW028T1.description:
Deal 2 to a unit.
If it's dead or gone, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus instead.
02BW028T1.descriptionRaw:
Deal 2 to a unit.
If it's dead or gone, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus instead.
02BW028T1.flavorText: Gangplank's cruelty doesn't end with those who wrong him. To make an enemy of the Saltwater Scourge is to bring death upon everyone you hold dear.
02BW028T1.name: Cannon Barrage

02BW037.flavorText:
"Aye aye, they cried, and set off away,
To see to trouble in fair Nashramae,
But nature, she turned, and many did die,
An' the rest are off to see the all-seein' eye!" - "The All-Seeing Eye"
02BW037.name: Abyssal Eye

02BW008.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Powder Keg</style></link> or a random 1 cost follower.
02BW008.descriptionRaw: Play: Summon a Powder Keg or a random 1 cost follower.
02BW008.flavorText: Few things, he learned, could motivate a slacking sailor as promptly as a lit fuse.
02BW008.name: Petty Officer

02BW008T02.descriptionRaw: Play: Summon a random 1 cost follower.
02BW008T02.flavorText: Few things, he learned, could motivate a slacking sailor as promptly as a lit fuse.
02BW008T02.name: Petty Officer

02BW008T01.flavorText: Few things, he learned, could motivate a slacking sailor as promptly as a lit fuse.
02BW008T01.name: Petty Officer

02BW047.flavorText: It takes a special sort to make complete garbage of perfectly seaworthy gear. But if there's one thing they're good at, it's that. Just that.
02BW047.name: Dreg Dredgers

02BW004.description: When I'm summoned, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Powder Keg</style></link>.
02BW004.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, summon a Powder Keg.
02BW004.flavorText: "Aye, we could fight 'em at dawn, when their crew's awake and their cannons are primed. Or we could leave 'em a gift tonight, nice and quiet-like..."
02BW004.name: Dreadway Deckhand

02BW002.description:
When I'm summoned, draw <link=card.champ1><style=AssociatedCard>Gangplank</style></link>. 
Double all damage dealt by your spells, <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skills</style></link> and allies.
02BW002.descriptionRaw:
When I'm summoned, draw Gangplank. 
Double all damage dealt by your spells, Skills and allies.
02BW002.flavorText:
"Ohhhh, best say yer farewells and draw down the sails,
For the Dreadway's a-comin'.
We're off to the deep, where graves're replete,
'Cuz the Dreadway's a-comin'!" - "The Dreadway's a-Comin'"
02BW002.name: The Dreadway

02BW016.description:
When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Grant me +0|+1 for each card you drew last round, then shuffle my stats.
<style=Variable></style>
02BW016.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned or Round Start: Grant me +0|+1 for each card you drew last round, then shuffle my stats.
02BW016.flavorText: One prototype spun three bombs and then exploded. Later models had this early "feature" removed.
02BW016.name: Slotbot

02BW027.description: When I'm summoned, your opponent summons a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Golden Narwhal</style></link>.
02BW027.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, your opponent summons a Golden Narwhal.
02BW027.flavorText: The gold that glitters beneath the waves is neither coin nor ingot, but the lustrous horn of the Slaughter Fleet captain's clever adversary.
02BW027.name: Hunting Fleet

02BW050.description: <link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: Reduce the cost of allies in hand and deck by 2.
02BW050.descriptionRaw: Plunder: Reduce the cost of allies in hand and deck by 2.
02BW050.flavorText: "Come with us on a musical journey! Enjoy tunes from across Runeterra! Just remember--coin's required for entry, and tips are deeply appreciated..." - Show promoter
02BW050.name: Smooth Soloist

02BW015.description:
When I'm summoned, draw <link=card.champ1><style=AssociatedCard>Miss Fortune</style></link>.
While I'm attacking, all your spells and <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skills</style></link> deal 1 extra damage.
02BW015.descriptionRaw:
When I'm summoned, draw Miss Fortune.
While I'm attacking, all your spells and Skills deal 1 extra damage.
02BW015.flavorText: There's no mistaking the Syren. Her broad pearly sails and polished woodwork leave her as sleek and decorated as the captain at her helm.
02BW015.name: The Syren

02BW010.flavorText: "His picture's been on the Bounty Board longer'n most, for he's a greedy, ruthless devil that won't let anyone or anything stand in his way. Worst of all? He's... He's cute, damn it." - Gangplank
02BW010.name: Plunder Poro

02BW009.description: When I'm summoned, draw 1 at the next <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link> and grant it <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>.
02BW009.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, draw 1 at the next Round Start and grant it Fleeting.
02BW009.flavorText: "It don't make no sense to me. I was knocking 'em in easy, but the last one just... wouldn't go. Not my day, I s'pose..." - Brash Gambler
02BW009.name: Pool Shark

02BW005.description: When I'm summoned, grant the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> enemy <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link>.
02BW005.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, grant the strongest enemy Vulnerable.
02BW005.flavorText: "This your picture? Oof, you're even rougher on the eyes than advertised--let's hope your head's worth my while."
02BW005.name: Hired Gun

02BW039.description: When I'm summoned, create a random Sea Monster in hand.
02BW039.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, create a random Sea Monster in hand.
02BW039.flavorText: The lure of fortune pulls countless crews out beyond the shallows. Those poor souls soon discover how terrifying the waters can be, and why so few return.
02BW039.name: Jaull Hunters

02BW006.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Transform an ally into a random 5 cost follower.
02BW006.descriptionRaw: Play: Transform an ally into a random 5 cost follower.
02BW006.flavorText:
"Marvolio? Where... Where are my hands?"
"I will-a now make-a them appear! Tadaa! Ahem. Ta... daa...!"
"...WHERE ARE MY HANDS?!"
"OKAY, TIME-A TO GO! THANK-A YOU ALL SO VERY MUCH!"
02BW006.name: Mystifying Magician

02BW036.flavorText: Legends say a pale, horned whale once stole from the Bearded Lady. As punishment, the Lady covered the greedy creature in glittering gold, so it would forever tempt the avarice of others.
02BW036.name: Golden Narwhal

02BW033.description:
When you draw an enemy card, reduce its cost by 1.
<link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: <link=keyword.Nab><style=Keyword>Nab</style></link> 1.
02BW033.descriptionRaw:
When you draw an enemy card, reduce its cost by 1.
Plunder: Nab 1.
02BW033.flavorText: "If you want it, I've got it! Even got some 'special stock'.... Just remember, you didn't get it from me!"
02BW033.name: Black Market Merchant

02BW060T1.flavorText: "Captain's orders: bullet to the face!" - Crackshot Corsair
02BW060T1.name: Crackshot

02BW032.description: When I'm summoned, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Powder Keg</style></link>.
02BW032.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, summon a Powder Keg.
02BW032.levelupDescription: You've damaged the enemy Nexus in 5+ different rounds.<style=Variable></style>
02BW032.levelupDescriptionRaw: You've damaged the enemy Nexus in 5+ different rounds.
02BW032.flavorText: "Don't stare too long, lest he catches you lookin'. And don't speak ill of him, for he hears all Bilgewater's whispers. Here he comes. Chin low. Eyes lower." - Dreadway deckhand
02BW032.name: Gangplank

02BW032T2.description:
Deal 1 to anything.
If this kills it, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Gangplank</style></link> in your deck.
02BW032T2.descriptionRaw:
Deal 1 to anything.
If this kills it, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
Create a Gangplank in your deck.
02BW032T2.flavorText: Gangplank's version of mediation is often brief, and always bloody.
02BW032T2.name: Gangplank's Parrrley

02BW032T3.description:
When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Powder Keg</style></link>.
<link=keyword.AttackSkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Attack</style></link>: Deal 1 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus.
02BW032T3.descriptionRaw:
When I'm summoned or Round Start: Summon a Powder Keg.
Attack: Deal 1 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus.
02BW032T3.flavorText: "Seen his eyes enough to know. Ain't nothin' but pure anger there. Someday, the boss'll do to Bilgewater what it did to him." - Petty Officer
02BW032T3.name: Gangplank

02BW032T1.description:
Powder Kegs stack.
All of your spells and <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skills</style></link> deal <style=Variable>1</style> extra damage.
Destroy me when your spell or skill damages enemies or the enemy Nexus.
02BW032T1.descriptionRaw:
Powder Kegs stack.
All of your spells and Skills deal 1 extra damage.
Destroy me when your spell or skill damages enemies or the enemy Nexus.
02BW032T1.flavorText: "Where there's a keg, there's a way." - Bilgewater saying
02BW032T1.name: Powder Keg

02BW032T4.description: Deal 1 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus.
02BW032T4.descriptionRaw: Deal 1 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus.
02BW032T4.name: Powderful Explosion

02BW022.description: When allies attack, deal 1 to all battling enemies and the enemy Nexus.
02BW022.descriptionRaw: When allies attack, deal 1 to all battling enemies and the enemy Nexus.
02BW022.flavorText: "'Miss' Fortune? Out here, you call me 'Captain'."
02BW022.name: Miss Fortune

02BW022T3.description:
Deal 1 to three different randomly targeted enemies or the enemy Nexus.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Miss Fortune</style></link> in your deck.
02BW022T3.descriptionRaw:
Deal 1 to three different randomly targeted enemies or the enemy Nexus.
Create a Miss Fortune in your deck.
02BW022T3.name: Miss Fortune's Make it Rain

02BW022T2.description: When allies attack, deal 1 three times to all battling enemies and the enemy Nexus.
02BW022T2.descriptionRaw: When allies attack, deal 1 three times to all battling enemies and the enemy Nexus.
02BW022T2.flavorText: "Most people don't get close enough to see the craftsmanship on these guns. Lucky you."
02BW022T2.name: Miss Fortune

02BW022T4.description: Deal 1 three times to all battling enemies and the enemy Nexus.
02BW022T4.descriptionRaw: Deal 1 three times to all battling enemies and the enemy Nexus.
02BW022T4.flavorText: Even if you fail to hear the bawdy cries of her crew, there's no way you'll miss her laughter...
02BW022T4.name: Bullet Time

02BW022T1.description: Deal 1 to all battling enemies and the enemy Nexus.
02BW022T1.descriptionRaw: Deal 1 to all battling enemies and the enemy Nexus.
02BW022T1.flavorText: "A little something to remember me by." - Miss Fortune
02BW022T1.name: Love Tap

02BW046.description: When you play a spell, stop all enemy spells and <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skills</style></link> targeting me and give me <link=keyword.Elusive><sprite name=Elusive><style=Keyword>Elusive</style></link> this round.
02BW046.descriptionRaw: When you play a spell, stop all enemy spells and Skills targeting me and give me Elusive this round.
02BW046.flavorText: Of all Bilgewater's legendary figures, Fizz is the most mercurial. Some sailors curse him for the countless brutal wrecks littering the coast...
02BW046.name: Fizz

02BW046T3.description:
When you play a spell, stop all enemy spells and <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skills</style></link> targeting me and give me <link=keyword.Elusive><sprite name=Elusive><style=Keyword>Elusive</style></link> this round.
<link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Chum the Waters</style></link> in hand.
02BW046T3.descriptionRaw:
When you play a spell, stop all enemy spells and Skills targeting me and give me Elusive this round.
Nexus Strike: Create a Chum the Waters in hand.
02BW046T3.flavorText: ...while others insist he's just a playful child who safeguards others on their journeys home.
02BW046T3.name: Fizz

02BW046T2.flavorText: Though there may be ambiguity surrounding Fizz's temperament and intentions, there's absolutely none when it comes to Longtooth.
02BW046T2.name: Longtooth

02BW046T1.description:
Remove an attacking ally from combat to <link=vocab.Rally><style=Vocab>Rally</style></link>.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Fizz</style></link> in your deck.
02BW046T1.descriptionRaw:
Remove an attacking ally from combat to Rally.
Create a Fizz in your deck.
02BW046T1.name: Fizz's Playful Trickster

02BW026.flavorText: "Now, watch the hands, count the cards, and try to keep up. And just remember..."
02BW026.name: Twisted Fate

02BW026T5.descriptionRaw: Deal 2 and Stun the strongest enemy.
02BW026T5.name: Gold Card

02BW026T3.description: Each round, the first 3 times you play a card, I play a Destiny Card.
02BW026T3.descriptionRaw: Each round, the first 3 times you play a card, I play a Destiny Card.
02BW026T3.flavorText: "...it ain't gamblin' if you can't lose."
02BW026T3.name: Twisted Fate

02BW026T1.description:
To play, place a card from hand into your deck.
Draw 2 at the next <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link> and grant them <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Twisted Fate</style></link> in your deck.
02BW026T1.descriptionRaw:
To play, place a card from hand into your deck.
Draw 2 at the next Round Start and grant them Fleeting.
Create a Twisted Fate in your deck.
02BW026T1.flavorText: "I make my own luck." - Twisted Fate
02BW026T1.name: Twisted Fate's Pick a Card

02BW026T4.description: Deal 1 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus.
02BW026T4.descriptionRaw: Deal 1 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus.
02BW026T4.name: Red Card

02BW053.levelupDescription: When you are <link=keyword.Deep><sprite name=Deep><style=Keyword>Deep</style></link>. <style=Variable></style> When I level up, copy <link=vocab.Toss><style=Vocab>Tossed</style></link> allies that cost 4+ into your deck.
02BW053.levelupDescriptionRaw: When you are Deep.  When I level up, copy Tossed allies that cost 4+ into your deck.
02BW053.flavorText: "'Twas an anchor what broke the Rancour. Pulled Finn down, an' all. Just a handful of us left now, but night's coming... and the cold. I'm sorry, Ma. You were right. The Titan lives." - Recovered note
02BW053.name: Nautilus

02BW053T2.description:
<link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy.
Place that unit into the enemy deck if you have a <link=card.champCheck><style=AssociatedCard>Nautilus</style></link>.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Nautilus</style></link> into your deck.
02BW053T2.descriptionRaw:
Stun an enemy.
Place that unit into the enemy deck if you have a Nautilus.
Create a Nautilus into your deck.
02BW053T2.name: Nautilus' Riptide

02BW053T1.flavorText: All pay the tithe, one way or another.
02BW053T1.name: Nautilus

02BW061.description:
When drawn, I cost 1 less this round.
Grant an ally +2|+1.
02BW061.descriptionRaw:
When drawn, I cost 1 less this round.
Grant an ally +2|+1.
02BW061.flavorText: "Ain't nothin' like a hot streak to keep the chips comin'." - Twisted Fate
02BW061.name: Pocket Aces

02BW024.flavorText:
"Oi, Gav--ain't that the fella we're after? Looks like he found a friend."
"Is that... Is that a shark-man, Baz?"
"It's also a bunch more gold, mate. Come on..." - Baz and Gav, aspiring bounty hunters
02BW024.name: Double Trouble

02BW003.descriptionRaw: Plunder: Recall ANY follower into your hand.
02BW003.flavorText: "Yer workin' fer us now!" - Petty Officer
02BW003.name: Strong-arm

02BW025.descriptionRaw: Grant an enemy Vulnerable and summon Longtooth.
02BW025.name: Chum the Waters

02BW018.description:
Deal 1 to anything.
If this kills it, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
02BW018.descriptionRaw:
Deal 1 to anything.
If this kills it, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
02BW018.flavorText: Gangplank's version of mediation is often brief, and always bloody.
02BW018.name: Parrrley

02BW048.flavorText:
"Whatcha think, Baz? He don't look so tough."
"Ya sure, Gav? He broke out of prison..."
"Means he's wily, not tough. Come on!" - Baz and Gav, aspiring bounty hunters
02BW048.name: Jailbreak

02BW043.description:
To play, place a card from hand into your deck.
Draw 2 at the next <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link> and grant them <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>.
02BW043.descriptionRaw:
To play, place a card from hand into your deck.
Draw 2 at the next Round Start and grant them Fleeting.
02BW043.flavorText: "I make my own luck." - Twisted Fate
02BW043.name: Pick a Card

02BW051.description: Remove an attacking ally from combat to <link=vocab.Rally><style=Vocab>Rally</style></link>.
02BW051.descriptionRaw: Remove an attacking ally from combat to Rally.
02BW051.name: Playful Trickster

02BW054.description:
<link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy.
Place that unit into the enemy deck if you have a <link=card.champCheck><style=AssociatedCard>Nautilus</style></link>.
02BW054.descriptionRaw:
Stun an enemy.
