04IO010.flavorText: "Keep your skills sharp--it is not only the blade that strikes, but the hand behind it." - Irelia
04IO010.name: Blade

04IO007.flavorText: "To dance is to move in harmony with the motions of all things." - Zinneia, Steel Crescendo
04IO007.name: Syncopation

04IO011.description: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> an ally to create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Flawless Duet</style></link> in hand.
04IO011.descriptionRaw: Recall an ally to create a Flawless Duet in hand.
04IO011.flavorText: "Our performance will be... unforgettable." - Zinneia, Steel Crescendo
04IO011.name: Lead and Follow

04IO020T1.descriptionRaw:
Play: Draw a Slow spell.
Enlightened: I have Elusive.
04IO020T1.flavorText: "I know their songs. This is a song of mourning." - Ionian farmer
04IO020T1.name: Scattered Pod

04IO020T2.descriptionRaw:
Play: Draw a Fast spell.
Enlightened: I have Elusive.
04IO020T2.flavorText: "I know their songs. This is a song of mourning." - Ionian farmer
04IO020T2.name: Scattered Pod

04IO020T3.descriptionRaw:
Play: Draw a Burst spell.
Enlightened: I have Elusive.
04IO020T3.flavorText: "I know their songs. This is a song of mourning." - Ionian farmer
04IO020T3.name: Scattered Pod

04IO013.description:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Give an ally <link=keyword.Barrier><sprite name=Barrier><style=Keyword>Barrier</style></link> this round and draw a <link=card.champ1><style=AssociatedCard>Shen</style></link>.
Allies with <link=keyword.Barrier><sprite name=Barrier><style=Keyword>Barrier</style></link> have <link=keyword.Double Strike><sprite name=DoubleStrike><style=Keyword>Double Attack</style></link>.
04IO013.descriptionRaw:
Play: Give an ally Barrier this round and draw a Shen.
Allies with Barrier have Double Attack.
04IO013.flavorText: "Just as we fight to protect the land, the land itself rises up to defend us. We draw strength from the earth's wrath and drive out our enemies. And so, balance remains." - Ionian Priest
04IO013.name: Sacred Protector

04IO012.description: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> each ally and summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Living Shadow</style></link> in its place.
04IO012.descriptionRaw: Recall each ally and summon a Living Shadow in its place.
04IO012.flavorText: "Let them strike at shadows, where their weapons will find no purchase." - Zed
04IO012.name: Shadows of the Past

04IO009.flavorText: "What a shame, boys! All that power and just no rhythm to match it? We can't ALL be stars, I guess...!"
04IO009.name: Ribbon Dancer

04IO001.description: Each round, once you've summoned 3 other allies, refill your spell mana and draw 1. <style=Variable></style>
04IO001.descriptionRaw: Each round, once you've summoned 3 other allies, refill your spell mana and draw 1.
04IO001.flavorText: For some, music is a shared refuge from hardship and violence. For others, music is resistance.
04IO001.name: Field Musicians

04IO006.description: When you summon another ally, give me +2|+0 this round.
04IO006.descriptionRaw: When you summon another ally, give me +2|+0 this round.
04IO006.flavorText:
My dearest Kay, 
They arrived this morning in a line of ships that broke the horizon and blotted out the sunrise. Their machines set fire to the Silver Plains, and now a thick smoke crawls through the summer air. We can stand by no longer. Rake or shovel, scythe or sword, today we must go to meet our destiny. 
Know that I love you and our home more than I have words to write.
- Charred letter
04IO006.name: Coastal Defender

04SH100.description:
To play, place a card from your hand into your deck.
<link=vocab.Predict><style=Vocab>Predict</style></link>, then create an exact copy of the chosen card in hand.
04SH100.descriptionRaw:
To play, place a card from your hand into your deck.
Predict, then create an exact copy of the chosen card in hand.
04SH100.flavorText: "The actions we take today plant seeds for future trees." - Tai, Aspiring Chronomancer
04SH100.name: Careful Preparation

04SH070.description:
Give an enemy follower <nobr>-4|-0</nobr> this round.
If you have fewer mana gems than your opponent, kill it instead.
04SH070.descriptionRaw:
Give an enemy follower -4|-0 this round.
If you have fewer mana gems than your opponent, kill it instead.
04SH070.flavorText: "The sun will shine again upon Shuriman lands." - Voice of the Risen
04SH070.name: Unworthy

04SH081.descriptionRaw: Play: Grant an enemy -1|-0 and Vulnerable.
04SH081.flavorText: Each grain she spills takes a second from their lives, wearing away at them like wind.
04SH081.name: Baccai Sandspinner

04SH059T2.description: Destroy one of your mana gems to stop all enemy <link=keyword.Fast><sprite name=Fast><style=Keyword>Fast</style></link> spells, <link=keyword.Slow><sprite name=Slow><style=Keyword>Slow</style></link> spells, and <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skills</style></link>.
04SH059T2.descriptionRaw: Destroy one of your mana gems to stop all enemy Fast spells, Slow spells, and Skills.
04SH059T2.flavorText: Analysis is a mainstay of chronomancy, as many actions must be halted to consider future solutions.
04SH059T2.name: Rite of Negation

04SH059T1.description: Kill an ally to stop all enemy <link=keyword.Fast><sprite name=Fast><style=Keyword>Fast</style></link> spells, <link=keyword.Slow><sprite name=Slow><style=Keyword>Slow</style></link> spells, and <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skills</style></link>.
04SH059T1.descriptionRaw: Kill an ally to stop all enemy Fast spells, Slow spells, and Skills.
04SH059T1.flavorText: Analysis is a mainstay of chronomancy, as many actions must be halted to consider future solutions.
04SH059T1.name: Rite of Negation

04SH077.description: If you've leveled a champion, allies have +2|+0.
04SH077.descriptionRaw: If you've leveled a champion, allies have +2|+0.
04SH077.flavorText: "I saw her speak, long ago." The old soldier smiled, and for an instant, his granddaughter could picture it: Shurima, gold and gleaming, proud Azir standing over the city heralded by the Voice of the Risen. "She stirred in us all a passion we thought long lost."
04SH077.name: Voice of the Risen

04SH019.description:
When I <link=keyword.Lurker><sprite name=Lurker><style=Keyword>Lurk</style></link> or <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Grant Lurker allies <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +1|+0.
<link=vocab.RoundEnd><style=Vocab>Round End</style></link>: Place me into your deck.
04SH019.descriptionRaw:
When I Lurk or Attack: Grant Lurker allies everywhere +1|+0.
Round End: Place me into your deck.
04SH019.flavorText: "Young Jhuraa was exploring, as is his way, and in a small hidden cave, discovered some ancient texts! We took them to a translator in Marrowmark, and the scrolls... they speak of an ancient terror who stalked our ancestors. A queen. A xer'sai queen!" - Fezhaur, Vekauran elder
04SH019.name: Rek'Sai

04SH019T2.description:
To play, put a card from hand on top of your deck.
Create 2 random Lurkers in hand.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Rek'Sai</style></link> in your deck.
04SH019T2.descriptionRaw:
To play, put a card from hand on top of your deck.
Create 2 random Lurkers in hand.
Create a Rek'Sai in your deck.
04SH019T2.flavorText:
"May the sun shine, and may the xer'sai sleep."
- Merchant's prayer
04SH019T2.name: Rek'Sai's Call the Pack

04SH019T1.description:
When I level up, create 3 random Lurkers in hand.
When I <link=keyword.Lurker><sprite name=Lurker><style=Keyword>Lurk</style></link> or <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Grant Lurker allies <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +1|+0.
04SH019T1.descriptionRaw:
When I level up, create 3 random Lurkers in hand.
When I Lurk or Attack: Grant Lurker allies everywhere +1|+0.
04SH019T1.flavorText: "We have known of her terror for generations, but for our ancestors to know her, too? How old must she be? How many of our people has she butchered? The thought unsettles me greatly." - Fezhaur, Vekauran elder
04SH019T1.name: Rek'Sai

04SH138.description: Give an ally +2|+1 this round. If you have leveled a champion this game, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>The Absolver's Return</style></link> in hand.
04SH138.descriptionRaw: Give an ally +2|+1 this round. If you have leveled a champion this game, create a The Absolver's Return in hand.
04SH138.flavorText: "Everyone told me not to use this. 'No one must wield such a powerful weapon,' they said." - Akshan
04SH138.name: The Absolver

04SH089.description: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Destroy a landmark. If it's allied, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Grumpy Rockbear</style></link>.
04SH089.descriptionRaw: Play: Destroy a landmark. If it's allied, summon a Grumpy Rockbear.
04SH089.flavorText:
"Kadira broke something today! Again! It was just a stone wall this time, but it looked old and was probably important to someone's ancestor. Her excuse is that walls are built better in Tereshni, but still! I am very cross."
- Zaifa's diary
04SH089.name: Desert Naturalist

04SH089T1.description: Destroy a landmark. If it's allied, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Grumpy Rockbear</style></link>.
04SH089T1.descriptionRaw: Destroy a landmark. If it's allied, summon a Grumpy Rockbear.
04SH089T1.flavorText:
"Kadira broke something today! Again! It was just a stone wall this time, but it looked old and was probably important to someone's ancestor. Her excuse is that walls are built better in Tereshni, but still! I am very cross."
- Zaifa's diary
04SH089T1.name: Teen Spirit

04SH015.flavorText: "When this here croc was born, the others took bets on how long he'd live, assuming he was the runt of the litter and a freak to boot. Nobody thought to bet on him eatin' all his siblings. Heh."
04SH015.name: Raz Bloodmane

04SH058.descriptionRaw: Attack: Summon an attacking Sand Soldier.
04SH058.flavorText: Few are taught the ways of the desert, and even fewer given the ability to command its sands as Azir can. To wield this power and know the secrets of the sands is a gift given only to Azir's most faithful and capable followers.
04SH058.name: Sandcrafter

04SH080.description:
To play, put a card from hand on top of your deck.
Create 2 random Lurkers in hand.
04SH080.descriptionRaw:
To play, put a card from hand on top of your deck.
Create 2 random Lurkers in hand.
04SH080.flavorText:
"May the sun shine, and may the xer'sai sleep."
- Merchant's prayer
04SH080.name: Call the Pack

04SH035.descriptionRaw: Create a Lucky Find in hand.
04SH035.flavorText: "Sure, I've had good days and bad days, just like anyone. In this line of work, the bad days can get real bad, and the good days can get real rich." - Sivir
04SH035.name: Payday

04SH028.descriptionRaw:
Play: Predict.
Countdown 2: Summon a Clockling.
04SH028.flavorText: Though they might otherwise be thought of as lost to time, buried underneath years of sand, the automata were precisely placed, simply waiting to be awakened.
04SH028.name: Ancient Preparations

04SH054.description: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Waking Sands</style></link> in hand.
04SH054.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, create a Waking Sands in hand.
04SH054.flavorText: "Okay, Davu. You're gonna go in there, grab that... whatever it is, and you're going to make us rich. Me rich. You're going to make me rich. Got it? Also, if that's a trapped thing, I am real sorry in advance."
04SH054.name: Treasure Seeker

04SH002.description: When you <link=vocab.Slay><style=Vocab>slay</style></link> a unit, grant me +1|+0.
04SH002.descriptionRaw: When you slay a unit, grant me +1|+0.
04SH002.flavorText: "The baccai all fled or were spared following their failed Ascension, and none have seen them since. Who knows how long they have hidden in those dark tombs, bearing the mark of their shame?" - Scribe Kah'nir, History of the Ascended Host
04SH002.name: Baccai Reaper

04SH042.flavorText:
"MY NAME IS ZAIFA AND I LIKE WRITING STUPID THINGS IN MY STUPID BOOK WHEN I THINK EVERYONE ELSE IS ASLEEP. EVEN SAMI."
- Zaifa's diary
04SH042.name: Hibernating Rockbear

04SH032.description: <link=vocab.Reputation><style=Vocab>Reputation</style></link>: I cost 1 less and when I'm summoned, grant me <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link>. <style=Variable></style>
04SH032.descriptionRaw: Reputation: I cost 1 less and when I'm summoned, grant me Overwhelm.
04SH032.flavorText: The soldier struggled as he reached for his spear, but she leaned harder on his chest until he ceased, groaning. "No, no," she admonished, showing her sharpened eyeteeth with a wicked smile. "This is mine, now."
04SH032.name: Callous Bonecrusher

04SH055.flavorText: Before the vaults, Shurima's mercenaries and tomb robbers must learn to survive the desert's more overt threats. First, the unrelenting heat. Second, the multitude of raiders, hellbent on carnage.
04SH055.name: Ruin Runner

04SH039.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Create 4 <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Time Bombs</style></link> in your deck, then <link=vocab.Predict><style=Vocab>Predict</style></link>.
04SH039.descriptionRaw: Play: Create 4 Time Bombs in your deck, then Predict.
04SH039.levelupDescriptionRaw: I've seen you destroy 2+ allied Time Bombs.
04SH039.flavorText: Over many years, Zilean established a network of promising young mages from different times, all of whom were capable of seeing out his life's work should the unthinkable happen. Although a kind and encouraging mentor, deep sorrow creased his brow when he sought solitude, and there was a weariness in his eyes that only someone who has lived multiple lifetimes could hope to comprehend.
04SH039.name: Zilean

04SH060T1.description:
When I'm summoned, draw 1 and <link=vocab.Advance><style=Vocab>advance</style></link> other allied Time Bombs 1 round.
<link=keyword.Countdown><style=Keyword>Countdown 1</style></link><style=Variable></style>: Deal 1 to enemies and the enemy Nexus.
04SH060T1.descriptionRaw:
When I'm summoned, draw 1 and advance other allied Time Bombs 1 round.
Countdown 1: Deal 1 to enemies and the enemy Nexus.
04SH060T1.name: Time Bomb

04SH039T3.description:
To play, place a card from your hand into your deck.
<link=vocab.Predict><style=Vocab>Predict</style></link>, then create an exact copy of the chosen card in hand.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Zilean</style></link> in your deck.
04SH039T3.descriptionRaw:
To play, place a card from your hand into your deck.
Predict, then create an exact copy of the chosen card in hand.
Create a Zilean in your deck.
04SH039T3.flavorText: "The actions we take today plant seeds for future trees." - Tai, Aspiring Chronomancer
04SH039T3.name: Zilean's Careful Preparation

04SH039T2.description:
Give an allied Champion "The next time I'd die this round, fully heal me and grant me +3|+3 instead".
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Zilean</style></link> in your deck.
04SH039T2.descriptionRaw:
Give an allied Champion "The next time I'd die this round, fully heal me and grant me +3|+3 instead".
Create a Zilean in your deck.
04SH039T2.flavorText: "We cannot stop the inevitable... but we can postpone it." - Zilean
04SH039T2.name: Zilean's Chronoshift

04SH039T1.description:
<link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> copy of each non-<link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> card I saw you play last round.
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Create 4 <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Time Bombs</style></link> in your deck, then <link=vocab.Predict><style=Vocab>Predict</style></link>.
04SH039T1.descriptionRaw:
Round Start: Create a Fleeting copy of each non-Fleeting card I saw you play last round.
Play: Create 4 Time Bombs in your deck, then Predict.
04SH039T1.flavorText: Countless possibilities stretched before and behind him. He saw them all at once, a dizzying array that only he could decipher. With a single gesture, Zilean could unfold entire timelines -- but none had yet shown him how to save Icathia.
04SH039T1.name: Zilean

04SH073.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Summon an exact copy of an allied landmark.
04SH073.descriptionRaw: Play: Summon an exact copy of an allied landmark.
04SH073.flavorText:
"The nomad's step is always light, for it is unburdened by the weight of roots, and their home is forever beyond the horizon."
- The Societies of Shurima
04SH073.name: Taliyah

04SH073T2.description:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Summon an exact copy of an allied landmark. 
<link=keyword.Elemental Skill><sprite name=ElementalSkill><style=Keyword>Attack</style></link>: I deal 2 damage to my blocker 3 times. If it's dead or gone, I deal 2 damage to the enemy Nexus instead.
04SH073T2.descriptionRaw:
Play: Summon an exact copy of an allied landmark. 
Attack: I deal 2 damage to my blocker 3 times. If it's dead or gone, I deal 2 damage to the enemy Nexus instead.
04SH073T2.flavorText: Taliyah left Ionia after hearing word of monumental change in her homeland. She returned to Shurima to find an emperor reborn, her people fraught, and the xer'sai more active than ever. She had no choice but to grow beyond her years.
04SH073T2.name: Taliyah

04SH073T1.description: Deal 2 to <style=Variable>Taliyah</style>'s blocker. If it's dead or gone, deal 2 to the enemy Nexus instead.
04SH073T1.descriptionRaw: Deal 2 to Taliyah's blocker. If it's dead or gone, deal 2 to the enemy Nexus instead.
04SH073T1.name: Threaded Volley

04SH073T3.description:
<link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> a landmark you can afford.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Taliyah</style></link> in your deck.
04SH073T3.descriptionRaw:
Manifest a landmark you can afford.
Create a Taliyah in your deck.
04SH073T3.flavorText: "Come on - there's so much to see!" - Taliyah
04SH073T3.name: Taliyah's Stoneweaving

04SH091.description: When I'm summoned, if you've <link=vocab.Predict><style=Vocab>Predicted</style></link> this game, grant me +1|+1.
04SH091.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, if you've Predicted this game, grant me +1|+1.
04SH091.flavorText:
"Remember what we learned," Zilean said, his voice unusually soft - grave, even. "Are you certain you're ready?"
Khahiri gave his mentor a reassuring smile. "I'll be back soon. And besides, I've spent every day for years preparing for this moment. If not now, when?"
04SH091.name: Khahiri the Student

04SH024.description: <link=vocab.Countdown><style=Vocab>Countdown 2</style></link><style=Variable></style>: Summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Grumpy Rockbear</style></link>. Then, if you've summoned 4+ landmarks this game, grant the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> ally +2|+2. <style=Variable></style>
04SH024.descriptionRaw: Countdown 2: Summon a Grumpy Rockbear. Then, if you've summoned 4+ landmarks this game, grant the strongest ally +2|+2.
04SH024.flavorText: A Shuriman saltworker quickly learns which deposits are suitable for collection, and which are best left alone.
04SH024.name: Salt Spire

04SH003.description: When allies attack, summon an attacking <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Sand Soldier</style></link>.
04SH003.descriptionRaw: When allies attack, summon an attacking Sand Soldier.
04SH003.flavorText: "When Azir took up the mantle as emperor of Shurima, he was arrogant. Blind. He accumulated power and planned his Ascension so that he might stand as ruler over not just Shurima, but the entire world." - Scribe Kah'nir, History of the Ascended Host
04SH003.name: Azir

04SH003T2.description:
When I level up, replace your deck with the Emperor's Deck, then draw 1.
When allies attack, summon an attacking <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Sandstone Charger</style></link>.
04SH003T2.descriptionRaw:
When I level up, replace your deck with the Emperor's Deck, then draw 1.
When allies attack, summon an attacking Sandstone Charger.
04SH003T2.flavorText:
"The Emperor Azir, though haughty, is generous. Above all, he cares deeply for those who would march alongside him into Shurima's golden future, as the nation rises anew, its people once again united under his rule." 
- Scribe Kah'nir, History of the Ascended Host
04SH003T2.name: Azir

04SH003T3.description:
When allies attack, summon an attacking <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Sand Soldier</style></link>.
When you summon another ally, give us both +1|+0 this round.
04SH003T3.descriptionRaw:
When allies attack, summon an attacking Sand Soldier.
When you summon another ally, give us both +1|+0 this round.
04SH003T3.flavorText: "Short of fulfilling his destiny, Azir's lifelong friend - and newly named brother - hatefully cast him off the dais. In that fateful moment Shurima was cursed, doomed to ruin for thousands of years to follow." - Scribe Kah'nir, History of the Ascended Host
04SH003T3.name: Azir

04SH003T14.flavorText: "They appeared out of nowhere, made up of swirling sands! Then, after they had dispatched our forces, their forms simply... disappeared, melted back into the desert." - Desert Survivor
04SH003T14.name: Sandstone Charger

04SH003T5.description: When I'm summoned and <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Summon 2 <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Sand Soldiers</style></link> and grant them +2|+2.
04SH003T5.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned and Round Start: Summon 2 Sand Soldiers and grant them +2|+2.
04SH003T5.flavorText: Now more powerful than ever, Azir has raised his most loyal soldiers to lead his armies.
04SH003T5.name: Golden Herald

04SH003T4.description:
Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Sand Soldier</style></link>.
Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.selfRef><style=AssociatedCard>Arise!</style></link> in hand.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Azir</style></link> in your deck.
04SH003T4.descriptionRaw:
Summon a Sand Soldier.
Create a Fleeting Arise! in hand.
Create a Azir in your deck.
04SH003T4.name: Azir's Arise!

04SH003T10.descriptionRaw:
Enemies are Vulnerable.
Round Start: Rally.
04SH003T10.flavorText: "Observe our god-emperor! He knows the power of these lands better than any, and his army only grows. Shurima is risen, and it shall never fall again!" - Voice of the Risen
04SH003T10.name: General's Palace

04SH003T1.description: <link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
04SH003T1.descriptionRaw: Nexus Strike: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
04SH003T1.flavorText: Azir's legions were reputed to be unstoppable even before Shurima was reborn, but now they are truly innumerable.
04SH003T1.name: Sand Soldier

04SH003T8.description:
When I'm summoned, draw 1.
<link=vocab.RoundEnd><style=Vocab>Round End</style></link>: The <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>Strongest</style></link> enemy and I <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> each other.
04SH003T8.descriptionRaw:
When I'm summoned, draw 1.
Round End: The Strongest enemy and I strike each other.
04SH003T8.flavorText: "Behold! See how our champion sits astride the lion? Even the king of beasts would yield to his power, for he is the Will of Azir!" - Voice of the Risen
04SH003T8.name: Eternal Gladiator

04SH003T6.flavorText: "Those who oppose us will be reduced to dust." - Azir
04SH003T6.name: Crumbling Sands

04SH003T12.flavorText: The storm rolls in with a peal like thunder, and when it passes, it leaves nothing behind.
04SH003T12.name: Sandstorm

04SH003T11.flavorText: The emperor's golden guard moves as one, a succession of regimented warriors that is as terrifying as it is impressive to behold.
04SH003T11.name: Emperor's Guard

04SH003T7.description:
Summon an exact copy of an ally. It's <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link>.
Draw 1.
04SH003T7.descriptionRaw:
Summon an exact copy of an ally. It's Ephemeral.
Draw 1.
04SH003T7.flavorText: Between the sand, the sun, and the heat, it can be difficult to tell what is real, and what is merely a mirage.
04SH003T7.name: Shimmering Mirage

04SH003T13.description:
<link=vocab.Rally><style=Vocab>Rally</style></link>.
Summon <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Renekton</style></link> and <link=card.create2><style=AssociatedCard>Nasus</style></link>. Immediately level them up to level 3.
04SH003T13.descriptionRaw:
Rally.
Summon Renekton and Nasus. Immediately level them up to level 3.
04SH003T13.flavorText: "They will serve their emperor. My generals will make sure of it." - Azir
04SH003T13.name: Ascended's Call

04SH003T9.flavorText: Birds found in the desert climes are all considered symbols of Azir, and Shurimans find their presence a good omen.
04SH003T9.name: Emperor's Prosperity

04SH011.description: When I'm summoned, grant 3 random allies in your deck +3|+3.
04SH011.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, grant 3 random allies in your deck +3|+3.
04SH011.flavorText: The Void is full of surprises, growing every day and finding new ways to infiltrate the tower, as intrusive as a thorned blindbrush but infinitely more deadly. Inasmuch, the study of it proves difficult, as it requires similarly clever and resourceful researchers to anticipate and understand the threat.
04SH011.name: Xenotype Researchers

04SH130.description: When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link>: Summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Warlord's Palace</style></link> or <link=vocab.Advance><style=Vocab>advance</style></link> it 1 round.
04SH130.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned or strike: Summon a Warlord's Palace or advance it 1 round.
04SH130.levelupDescription: Warlord's Palace has finished its Countdown. When I level up, summon a Warlord's Hoard.
04SH130.levelupDescriptionRaw: Warlord's Palace has finished its Countdown. When I level up, summon a Warlord's Hoard.
04SH130.flavorText: "The Sentinels' code seems full of complicated restrictions. Things like 'Never take a life in the name of vengeance' and 'Fight for the world, never for yourself'. As for me..."
04SH130.name: Akshan

04SH130T5.description:
An ally you've targeted this round <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> an enemy.
Create an <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Akshan</style></link> in your deck.
04SH130T5.descriptionRaw:
An ally you've targeted this round strikes an enemy.
Create an Akshan in your deck.
04SH130T5.flavorText: "They never expect the grappling hook!" - Akshan
04SH130T5.name: Akshan's Grappling Hook

04SH130T2.description: When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link>: Summon a <link=card.create1><style=AssociatedCard>Warlord's Hoard</style></link> or <link=vocab.Advance><style=Vocab>advance</style></link> it 1 round.
04SH130T2.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned or strike: Summon a Warlord's Hoard or advance it 1 round.
04SH130T2.flavorText: "My code is far simpler--disregard any rule that prevents me from doing whatever I want."
04SH130T2.name: Akshan

04SH130T1.description:
<link=vocab.Countdown><style=Vocab>Countdown 8</style></link><style=Variable></style>: Create a <link=card.discover><style=AssociatedCard>Relic of Power</style></link> in hand.
When you target allies <link=vocab.Advance><style=Vocab>advance</style></link> me 1.
04SH130T1.descriptionRaw:
Countdown 8: Create a Relic of Power in hand.
When you target allies advance me 1.
04SH130T1.flavorText: "See that eyesore of a building? That's where the swine lives. We'll take him out, grab the loot, and be back in time for dinner." - Vekauran Vagabond
04SH130T1.name: Warlord's Palace

04SH130T6.description:
<link=vocab.Countdown><style=Vocab>Countdown 8</style></link><style=Variable></style>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Sentinel's Hoard</style></link> in hand.
When you target allies <link=vocab.Advance><style=Vocab>advance</style></link> me 1.
04SH130T6.descriptionRaw:
Countdown 8: Create a Sentinel's Hoard in hand.
When you target allies advance me 1.
04SH130T6.flavorText: When a group of survivors from the fallen city of Vekaura learned of a particular warlord's sordid history, they wasted no time making plans to seize his ill-gotten gains.
04SH130T6.name: Warlord's Hoard

04SH130T13.description: Play a <link=card.choice3><style=AssociatedCard>The Absolver's Resurrection</style></link>, a <link=card.choice2><style=AssociatedCard>Fount of Power</style></link>, or a <link=card.choice1><style=AssociatedCard>Shield of the Sentinels</style></link>.
04SH130T13.descriptionRaw: Play a The Absolver's Resurrection, a Fount of Power, or a Shield of the Sentinels.
04SH130T13.flavorText: Before the thief could even reach for her tools, a pale green fog enveloped the box, coaxing it open with a cold whisper.
04SH130T13.name: Sentinel's Hoard

04SH130T7.description: Draw 2. Your cards cost 1 less this round.
04SH130T7.descriptionRaw: Draw 2. Your cards cost 1 less this round.
04SH130T7.flavorText: "My love... Why won't you answer? Please. Answer me, Isolde. ANSWER ME!" - Viego
04SH130T7.name: Fount of Power

04SH130T14.description: Grant all enemies <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link> and create in hand a 0 cost copy of the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> ally that died this game.
04SH130T14.descriptionRaw: Grant all enemies Vulnerable and create in hand a 0 cost copy of the strongest ally that died this game.
04SH130T14.flavorText: "Fate is what I make it." - Akshan
04SH130T14.name: The Absolver's Resurrection

04SH130T8.descriptionRaw: Grant your champions everywhere SpellShield and +2|+2.
04SH130T8.flavorText: The Sentinels of Light trace their heritage back to blessed Helia. The relic stones they saved from the Ruination would become the world's greatest defense against the darkness of the Black Mist.
04SH130T8.name: Shield of the Sentinels

04SH130T10.description: Pick 1 - <link=vocab.Predict><style=Vocab>Predict</style></link> then draw 1, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Sandstone Charger</style></link>, or grant allies +1|+0.
04SH130T10.descriptionRaw: Pick 1 - Predict then draw 1, summon a Sandstone Charger, or grant allies +1|+0.
04SH130T10.flavorText: The Black Mist searched for her in everything. It cried out in his voice, grasped forward with his pleading hands, commanding her to return. But she could not. She would not.
04SH130T10.name: Relic of Power

04SH130T12.flavorText: The mist searched for her in everything. It cried out in his voice, grasped forward with his pleading hands, commanding her to return. But she could not. She would not.
04SH130T12.name: Relic of Power

04SH130T9.flavorText: The mist searched for her in everything. It cried out in his voice, grasped forward with his pleading hands, commanding her to return. But she could not. She would not.
04SH130T9.name: Relic of Power

04SH130T11.flavorText: The mist searched for her in everything. It cried out in his voice, grasped forward with his pleading hands, commanding her to return. But she could not. She would not.
04SH130T11.name: Relic of Power

04SH114.descriptionRaw:
Grant allied Sand Soldiers everywhere +1|+0.
Summon 2 Sand Soldiers.
04SH114.flavorText: They do not rest. They do not hesitate. They are uncompromising, unfeeling, unyielding.
04SH114.name: Desert's Wrath

04SH067.description: When I <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenge</style></link> an enemy, give me +2|+1 this round.
04SH067.descriptionRaw: When I Challenge an enemy, give me +2|+1 this round.
04SH067.flavorText: "It could be easily forgotten that he was once human, for the visage of the crocodile fits his love for bloody battle so well..." - Scribe Kah'nir, History of the Ascended Host
04SH067.name: Renekton

04SH067T1.description: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword></style></link>When I block or <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Deal 2 to enemies and the enemy Nexus.
04SH067T1.descriptionRaw: When I block or Attack: Deal 2 to enemies and the enemy Nexus.
04SH067T1.flavorText: "When he finally has a chance at revenge on his brother Nasus, Renekton will stop at nothing. He will destroy all, and Shurima will again be left a ruin." - Scribe Kah'nir, History of the Ascended Host
04SH067T1.name: Renekton

04SH067T4.flavorText: "So many long years in the dark with that betrayer filling his head with words of hate and resentment, breeding contempt for his brother. It only fueled his rage, made him stronger." - Scribe Kah'nir, History of the Ascended Host
04SH067T4.name: Renekton

04SH067T2.description:
Give an ally +2|+0 to give an enemy <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link> this round.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Renekton</style></link> in your deck.
04SH067T2.descriptionRaw:
Give an ally +2|+0 to give an enemy Vulnerable this round.
Create a Renekton in your deck.
04SH067T2.name: Renekton's Ruthless Predator

04SH067T5.description: Deal 2 to enemies and the enemy Nexus.
04SH067T5.descriptionRaw: Deal 2 to enemies and the enemy Nexus.
04SH067T5.name: Dominus Destruction

04SH138T1.description: Give an ally <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link> and +2|+1 this round.
04SH138T1.descriptionRaw: Give an ally Overwhelm and +2|+1 this round.
04SH138T1.name: The Absolver's Return

04SH120.description: Create a random landmark with <link=keyword.Countdown><style=Keyword>Countdown</style></link> in hand, or <link=vocab.Advance><style=Vocab>advance</style></link> your landmarks 1 round.
04SH120.descriptionRaw: Create a random landmark with Countdown in hand, or advance your landmarks 1 round.
04SH120.name: Imagined Possibilities

04SH119.description:
<link=vocab.Reputation><style=Vocab>Reputation</style></link>: I cost 3 less. <style=Variable></style>
Deal 1 to a random enemy or the enemy Nexus 5 times.
04SH119.descriptionRaw:
Reputation: I cost 3 less. 
Deal 1 to a random enemy or the enemy Nexus 5 times.
04SH119.flavorText: "This might get a little messy." - Sivir
04SH119.name: Ricochet

04SH068.flavorText: Not all xer'sai are born to butcher. Some can summon their kin with piercing shrieks that rattle the sands as well as the senses.
04SH068.name: Xer'sai Caller

04SH093.description:
Give an ally +1|+1 this round.
If you've summoned a landmark this game, give it +2|+1 instead.
04SH093.descriptionRaw:
Give an ally +1|+1 this round.
If you've summoned a landmark this game, give it +2|+1 instead.
04SH093.flavorText: "With the land's help, we WILL defend ourselves!" - Taliyah
04SH093.name: Shaped Stone

04SH079.descriptionRaw:
Predict.
Give an enemy -2|-0 this round.
04SH079.flavorText: "I have seen my destiny, and this time, I will not be stopped." - Azir
04SH079.name: Scrying Sands

04SH038.description: When I'm summoned, summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Roiling Sands</style></link>.
04SH038.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, summon a Roiling Sands.
04SH038.flavorText:
"Today, we began our journey to Nashramae! Samir is determined to cross the Great Sai before the next full moon, and is making SUCH a mess of things! I did not know a simple sandboard could collapse a whole dune. Neither did Sami. He's fine."
- Zaifa's diary
04SH038.name: Rock Hopper

04SH104.descriptionRaw: Play: Advance an allied landmark 3 rounds.
04SH104.flavorText: Whenever he seeks a moment's peace, Zilean returns to Icathia's last garden, just as he remembers it.
04SH104.name: Preservationist

04SH128.description: When I'm summoned, summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Warlord's Palace</style></link> or <link=vocab.Advance><style=Vocab>advance</style></link> it 2 rounds.
04SH128.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, summon a Warlord's Palace or advance it 2 rounds.
04SH128.flavorText: Seeing Akshan hanging underneath the fourth-floor window, Najah cursed under her breath. Pretty boy beat her to the mark. Again. Turning her dagger over in her hand, she pondered what to say to him. Maybe this time, he'd finally acknowledge her.
04SH128.name: Vekauran Vagabond

04SH109.description: Give an enemy <nobr>-4|-0</nobr> or 2 enemies <nobr>-1|-0</nobr> this round. Disable their positive keywords this round.
04SH109.descriptionRaw: Give an enemy -4|-0 or 2 enemies -1|-0 this round. Disable their positive keywords this round.
04SH109.flavorText: In parts of the desert, old ruins have sunk into sand, creating hollows where unwary travelers might join them.
04SH109.name: Quicksand

04SH109T1.description: Give 2 enemies <nobr>-1|-0</nobr> and disable their positive keywords this round.
04SH109T1.descriptionRaw: Give 2 enemies -1|-0 and disable their positive keywords this round.
04SH109T1.flavorText: In parts of the desert, old ruins have sunk into sand, creating hollows where unwary travelers might join them.
04SH109T1.name: Quicksand

04SH109T2.description: Give an enemy <nobr>-4|-0</nobr> and disable its positive keywords this round.
04SH109T2.descriptionRaw: Give an enemy -4|-0 and disable its positive keywords this round.
04SH109T2.flavorText: In parts of the desert, old ruins have sunk into sand, creating hollows where unwary travelers might join them.
04SH109T2.name: Quicksand

04SH043.description:
Deal 4 to a unit.
Summon 2 <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Sand Soldiers</style></link>.
04SH043.descriptionRaw:
Deal 4 to a unit.
Summon 2 Sand Soldiers.
04SH043.flavorText: "Go. Surround them. They cannot fight the land itself." - Azir
04SH043.name: Shifting Sands

04SH099.description:
Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Sand Soldier</style></link>.
Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.selfRef><style=AssociatedCard>Arise!</style></link> in hand.
04SH099.descriptionRaw:
Summon a Sand Soldier.
Create a Fleeting Arise! in hand.
04SH099.name: Arise!

04SH048.description:
<link=vocab.Reputation><style=Vocab>Reputation</style></link>: I cost 3 less. <style=Variable></style>
<link=vocab.Countdown><style=Vocab>Countdown 1</style></link><style=Variable></style>: Create 2 <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Lucky Finds</style></link> in hand.
04SH048.descriptionRaw:
Reputation: I cost 3 less. 
Countdown 1: Create 2 Lucky Finds in hand.
04SH048.flavorText: "Some maps take years to decipher, some traps takes months to disarm, and some vaults take weeks to navigate. But the times you pull it off? They're worth every damned second." - Sivir
04SH048.name: Inner Sanctum

04SH056.description: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Lucky Find</style></link> in hand.
04SH056.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, create a Lucky Find in hand.
04SH056.flavorText: "My friend, for you I've procured this incomparable beauty straight from the fabled Tomb of the Emperors and pulled it right from the hand of the great Renekton himself and as I rode out, I was surrounded by ten--twenty!--bloodthirsty sauren riders! Truly, a miracle that such a treasure has made it to your hands."
04SH056.name: Profiteer

04SH098T12.flavorText: "If I can't get past you, I'll just go through you." - Sivir
04SH098T12.name: Lucky Find

04SH098T10.flavorText: "Can't spend your earnings if you're dead." - Sivir
04SH098T10.name: Lucky Find

04SH098T8.flavorText: "Go on. Gimme your best shot. Then it's my turn." - Sivir
04SH098T8.name: Lucky Find

04SH098T1.flavorText: "Your tricks ain't worth the sand you're standing on, kid." - Sivir
04SH098T1.name: Lucky Find

04SH098.description: Pick a buff from among 3 to grant an ally.
04SH098.descriptionRaw: Pick a buff from among 3 to grant an ally.
04SH098.name: Lucky Find

04SH020.flavorText: Sivir made her way through life as a mercenary, and burdened herself with all the risks and rewards that came with her choice. One fateful expedition almost cost her everything, but as her blood seeped into Shurima's sands, it awoke an ancient power that would return both her and her homeland to greatness.
04SH020.name: Sivir

04SH057.description: When you summon another ally, give it +2|+0 this round.
04SH057.descriptionRaw: When you summon another ally, give it +2|+0 this round.
04SH057.flavorText: To receive the blessing of Azir is a great honor - to give a blessing in his name, an honor greater still.
04SH057.name: Inspiring Marshal

04SH103.flavorText: "And... there. Tied up, nice 'n pretty. Renekton likes his meals delivered still-squirming."
04SH103.name: Merciless Hunter

04SH120T1.description: Create a random landmark with <link=keyword.Countdown><style=Keyword>Countdown</style></link> in hand.
04SH120T1.descriptionRaw: Create a random landmark with Countdown in hand.
04SH120T1.name: Imagined Possibilities

04SH006.description: When an enemy is summoned, destroy me to grant it <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link>.
04SH006.descriptionRaw: When an enemy is summoned, destroy me to grant it Vulnerable.
04SH006.flavorText: Centuries of missteps have taught the Shurimans how to read the sands. Only they know which expanses will stand firm, and which give way. It is all the same to the layman observer.
04SH006.name: Roiling Sands

04SH076T1.description: <link=vocab.Countdown><style=Vocab>Countdown 1</style></link><style=Variable></style>: Summon exact copies of the units and landmarks stored inside.
04SH076T1.descriptionRaw: Countdown 1: Summon exact copies of the units and landmarks stored inside.
04SH076T1.flavorText:
"I like to think of this as 'capturing a moment'." 
"Ha. Clever."
- Xetsa and Zinsa, Void Researchers
04SH076T1.name: Stasis Statue

04SH065.description: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: If I have 8+ Power, give me <link=keyword.Fearsome><sprite name=Fearsome><style=Keyword>Fearsome</style></link>, <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link>, and <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>SpellShield</style></link> this round.
04SH065.descriptionRaw: Attack: If I have 8+ Power, give me Fearsome, Overwhelm, and SpellShield this round.
04SH065.flavorText: "It is said that hundreds of years ago, the river Khaleek bore a great trading outpost known as Taraleek upon its shores. That is, until one fateful day, when a mighty beast broke through the ground, and annihilated both the outpost and all who called it home. But what monster could do such a thing?" - Shuriman historian
04SH065.name: Xerxa'Reth, The Undertitan

04SH034.description: When I'm summoned, create 2 <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Instant Centuries</style></link> in hand.
04SH034.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, create 2 Instant Centuries in hand.
04SH034.flavorText: The constant rumble in the lower levels of the tower are due to The Clock Hand, the tower guardian that steadily winds the gears below.
04SH034.name: The Clock Hand

04SH034T1.description: Summon a random landmark with <link=keyword.Countdown><style=Keyword>Countdown</style></link>, or <link=vocab.Advance><style=Vocab>advance</style></link> a landmark 4 rounds.
04SH034T1.descriptionRaw: Summon a random landmark with Countdown, or advance a landmark 4 rounds.
04SH034T1.flavorText: "There is little distinction between 'what has been' and 'what will be'..." - Zilean
04SH034T1.name: Instant Century

04SH034T2.flavorText: "There is little distinction between 'what has been' and 'what will be'." - Zilean
04SH034T2.name: Instant Century

04SH034T3.descriptionRaw: Summon a random landmark with Countdown.
04SH034T3.flavorText: "There is little distinction between 'what has been' and 'what will be'." - Zilean
04SH034T3.name: Instant Century

04SH082.description:
Draw 1.
If you've <link=vocab.Slay><style=Vocab>slain</style></link> a unit this round, <link=keyword.Drain><style=Keyword>drain</style></link> 2 from the enemy Nexus.
04SH082.descriptionRaw:
Draw 1.
If you've slain a unit this round, drain 2 from the enemy Nexus.
04SH082.flavorText: Sandthrashers primarily recruit from their enemy's ranks. Whoever survives their initial assault is invited to join, or die.
04SH082.name: Ruinous Path

04SH075.description: Give enemies <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link> this round and summon 6 <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Sand Soldiers</style></link>.
04SH075.descriptionRaw: Give enemies Vulnerable this round and summon 6 Sand Soldiers.
04SH075.name: Emperor's Divide

04SH018.description: Kill an ally or destroy one of your mana gems to give all enemies <nobr>-2|-0</nobr> this round.
04SH018.descriptionRaw: Kill an ally or destroy one of your mana gems to give all enemies -2|-0 this round.
04SH018.name: Rite of Dominance

04SH009.description: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: If you've <link=vocab.Slay><style=Vocab>slain</style></link> 4+ units this game, an enemy and I <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> each other. <style=Variable></style>
04SH009.descriptionRaw: Play: If you've slain 4+ units this game, an enemy and I strike each other.
04SH009.flavorText: The bearer of a grudge's resentment only deepens, even if those they bear the grudge against are long dead.
04SH009.name: Rampaging Baccai

04SH049.description: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: If you've leveled a champion, transform me into <link=card.transform><style=AssociatedCard>Exalted Poro</style></link>.
04SH049.descriptionRaw: Round Start: If you've leveled a champion, transform me into Exalted Poro.
04SH049.flavorText: She didn't know what she had found, precisely... but it was shiny, and looked like a good snack.
04SH049.name: Destined Poro

04SH049T1.flavorText: As far as divine rulers go, she's awfully fond of snax.
04SH049T1.name: Exalted Poro

04SH045.description: Give an enemy <nobr>-2|-0</nobr> and <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link> this round.
04SH045.descriptionRaw: Give an enemy -2|-0 and Vulnerable this round.
04SH045.flavorText: Desert-dwellers know how to avoid the sun's searing and relentless heat, but those unprepared to withstand it will find their strength and energy sapped at remarkable speed.
04SH045.name: Exhaust

04SH037.flavorText: As beautiful as the Great Sai may be, it is not a place for the weak. Many lives have been lost among its rolling dunes, and while the xer'sai claim many, the land itself takes its share.
04SH037.name: Unraveled Earth

04SH107.description: Level up all level 1 Ascended allies.
04SH107.descriptionRaw: Level up all level 1 Ascended allies.
04SH107.flavorText: "The future will be written by the Ascended!" - Azir
04SH107.name: Ascended's Rise

04SH047.description: I have +1|+1 for each unit you've <link=vocab.Slay><style=Vocab>slain</style></link> this game. <style=Variable></style>
04SH047.descriptionRaw: I have +1|+1 for each unit you've slain this game.
04SH047.levelupDescriptionRaw: I've struck for 10+ damage in one strike.
04SH047.flavorText: "Nasus' newly won blessing allowed him countless lifetimes to spend in study and contemplation over the nature of life and death. But this same extended lifespan would, after the fall of Shurima, also prove to be his curse." - Scribe Kah'nir, History of the Ascended Host
04SH047.name: Nasus

04SH097.description: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Kill an enemy follower. If you've <link=vocab.Slay><style=Vocab>slain</style></link> 13+ units this game, kill all enemy followers, then summon a copy of me instead. <style=Variable></style>
04SH097.descriptionRaw: Play: Kill an enemy follower. If you've slain 13+ units this game, kill all enemy followers, then summon a copy of me instead.
04SH097.flavorText: The baccai are tasked with defending the inner sanctum to safeguard the ancient treasures there, and for the sake of mortals that might think themselves clever enough, or mighty enough, to withstand the weight of the Curator's judgment.
04SH097.name: Sanctum Conservator

04SH026.description: When I'm summoned, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Sand Soldier</style></link>.
04SH026.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, summon a Sand Soldier.
04SH026.flavorText: "As the emperor commands, both the sand and I obey."
04SH026.name: Dunekeeper

04SH102.description: <link=vocab.Allegiance><style=Vocab>Allegiance</style></link>: Draw a champion and grant it +2|+2.
04SH102.descriptionRaw: Allegiance: Draw a champion and grant it +2|+2.
04SH102.flavorText: "Our shining future lies just beneath the sands, and it is up to us to pave the way for Azir. The golden empire in the desert will rise again!"
04SH102.name: Golden Ambassador

04SH001.flavorText: Throughout his time as a student of chronomancy, Tai had to reconcile his uncertainty with his determination. It was better to have hope in a potential victory than to dwell on what could possibly go wrong.
04SH001.name: Aspiring Chronomancer

04SH022.flavorText: While all xer'sai are able tunnelers, only their dunebreakers have the mass and power needed to break through the veins of solid bedrock that snake through the Great Sai, and open up the lands beyond for further hunting.
04SH022.name: Xer'sai Dunebreaker

04SH009T1.description: <link=card.parentRef><style=AssociatedCard>Rampaging Baccai</style></link> and an enemy <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> each other.
04SH009T1.descriptionRaw: Rampaging Baccai and an enemy strike each other.
04SH009T1.flavorText: The baccai are twisted, warped versions of what they might have been - had they become part of the Ascended Host - and the rage they feel at their failure must be unleashed somewhere.
04SH009T1.name: Baccai Rampage

04SH030.description: Give an allied Champion "The next time I'd die this round, fully heal me and grant me +3|+3 instead".
04SH030.descriptionRaw: Give an allied Champion "The next time I'd die this round, fully heal me and grant me +3|+3 instead".
04SH030.flavorText: "We cannot stop the inevitable... but we can postpone it." - Zilean
04SH030.name: Chronoshift

04SH013.descriptionRaw:
When I'm summoned, draw 1.
Countdown 2: Draw 1.
04SH013.flavorText: Zilean shows those he brings to the tower what, precisely, they are looking to restore. The Preservationist is able to show them, if only a glimpse at a time.
04SH013.name: Preservarium

04SH062.description:
Start of Game: Summon 1 of me from your deck if it's all Shuriman.
<link=keyword.Countdown><style=Keyword>Countdown 25</style></link><style=Variable></style>: <link=vocab.SunDiscRestore><style=Vocab>Restore the Sun Disc</style></link>.
I <link=vocab.Advance><style=Vocab>advance</style></link> 9 rounds for each time an Ascended ally has leveled up this game.
04SH062.descriptionRaw:
Start of Game: Summon 1 of me from your deck if it's all Shuriman.
Countdown 25: Restore the Sun Disc.
I advance 9 rounds for each time an Ascended ally has leveled up this game.
04SH062.flavorText: When Azir beheld the Shuriman capital's Sun Disc, he saw it not for what it was, but what it could be--the key to returning Shurima to its former glory.
04SH062.name: Buried Sun Disc

04SH016.description:
An ally <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> a unit.
If it dies, grant allied champions <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +2|+2.
04SH016.descriptionRaw:
An ally strikes a unit.
If it dies, grant allied champions everywhere +2|+2.
04SH016.name: Siphoning Strike

04SH125.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Give an ally +2|+0 to give an enemy -2|-0 this round.
04SH125.descriptionRaw: Play: Give an ally +2|+0 to give an enemy -2|-0 this round.
04SH125.flavorText: Tena waited patiently as her pet's caustic spittle wore away the gilded bars of the palace's rear gate. Around the corner, she would soon find a hoard of unspeakably valuable treasure--more than enough to bring Vekaura back to its former glory.
04SH125.name: Vekauran Safecracker

04SH108.description: An ally <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> and <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> enemies one after another.
04SH108.descriptionRaw: An ally strikes the strongest and weakest enemies one after another.
04SH108.name: Boomerang Blade

04SH066.descriptionRaw: Predict and advance an allied landmark 2 rounds.
04SH066.flavorText: "If only you saw time as I do, you would know it is not immutable." - Zilean
04SH066.name: Time in a Bottle

04SH014.flavorText: The Clocklings were the first to wriggle free - precisely at the time Zilean had set them to wake up. They shook themselves off and went clambering over the ancient walls, seeking others of their kind.
04SH014.name: Clockling

04SH047T1.description:
An ally <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> a unit.
If it dies, grant allied champions <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +2|+2.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Nasus</style></link> in your deck.
04SH047T1.descriptionRaw:
An ally strikes a unit.
If it dies, grant allied champions everywhere +2|+2.
Create a Nasus in your deck.
04SH047T1.name: Nasus' Siphoning Strike

04SH047T2.description:
I have +1|+1 for each unit you've <link=vocab.Slay><style=Vocab>slain</style></link> this game. <style=Variable></style>
Enemies have <nobr>-3|-0</nobr>.
04SH047T2.descriptionRaw:
I have +1|+1 for each unit you've slain this game. 
Enemies have -3|-0.
04SH047T2.flavorText: "His hope revived by Shurima's rise, Nasus finally returned after years spent wandering the desert, eager to make amends with his brother. He never suspected he would find Renekton maddened by years spent suffering at Xerath's hands in the tomb, waiting for him." - Scribe Kah'nir, History of the Ascended Host
04SH047T2.name: Nasus

04SH047T3.description:
I have +1|+1 for each unit you've <link=vocab.Slay><style=Vocab>slain</style></link> this game. <style=Variable></style>
Enemies have <nobr>-1|-0</nobr>.
04SH047T3.descriptionRaw:
I have +1|+1 for each unit you've slain this game. 
Enemies have -1|-0.
04SH047T3.flavorText: "For years, Nasus and his brother Renekton served the empire. Nasus was a scholar, Renekton a fierce warrior. It was not until the two were called upon to confront the betrayer, Xerath, that Nasus was forced to make a terrible choice..." - Scribe Kah'nir, History of the Ascended Host
04SH047T3.name: Nasus

04SH021.description: When I'm summoned, create a copy of me in your deck. When you see me in a <link=vocab.Predict><style=Vocab>Prediction</style></link>, grant all allied copies of me <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +2|+2.
04SH021.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, create a copy of me in your deck. When you see me in a Prediction, grant all allied copies of me everywhere +2|+2.
04SH021.flavorText: Khahiri had only been gone a moment when he suddenly reappeared. Older by nearly a decade and wielding a strange and deadly-looking weapon, he was met with gasps of awe and concern.
04SH021.name: Khahiri the Returned

04SH101.description: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: If you've leveled a champion, heal your champions and Nexus 2.
04SH101.descriptionRaw: Round Start: If you've leveled a champion, heal your champions and Nexus 2.
04SH101.flavorText: "I have sworn myself to Azir, and to Shurima, my home! Will you not do the same?"
04SH101.name: Devoted Council

04SH012.description: When I'm summoned, <link=vocab.Advance><style=Vocab>advance</style></link> your <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Buried Sun Disc</style></link> 3 rounds.
04SH012.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, advance your Buried Sun Disc 3 rounds.
04SH012.flavorText: "Oh! That's Padjuman, one of the elders of Nashramae! I think everyone has come to our city today, papa!" - Excited onlooker
04SH012.name: Esteemed Hierophant

04SH020T2.description:
<link=vocab.Reputation><style=Vocab>Reputation</style></link>: I cost 3 less. <style=Variable></style>
Deal 1 to a random enemy or the enemy Nexus 5 times.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Sivir</style></link> in your deck.
04SH020T2.descriptionRaw:
Reputation: I cost 3 less. 
Deal 1 to a random enemy or the enemy Nexus 5 times.
Create a Sivir in your deck.
04SH020T2.flavorText: "This might get a little messy." - Sivir
04SH020T2.name: Sivir's Ricochet

04SH020T1.description: While I'm attacking, attacking allies have my keywords.
04SH020T1.descriptionRaw: While I'm attacking, attacking allies have my keywords.
04SH020T1.flavorText: "If you wanna work with me, I'll give you the same talk I give everyone: work for your share, and you'll get everything you're due. But if you slow me down, or get in my way, I'll kill you myself."
04SH020T1.name: Sivir

04SH031.description: Grant an allied landmark "My <link=keyword.Countdown><style=Keyword>Countdown</style></link> completion effect activates twice".
04SH031.descriptionRaw: Grant an allied landmark "My Countdown completion effect activates twice".
04SH031.flavorText: "Mortals spend so much of their time waiting. My fondest hope is that they all should be rewarded for their patience." - Zilean
04SH031.name: Promising Future

04SH004.description: Deal 2 to a champion or 4 to a follower.
04SH004.descriptionRaw: Deal 2 to a champion or 4 to a follower.
04SH004.flavorText: "One life in return for so many. One life so that others might thrive." - Nasus
04SH004.name: Weight of Judgment

04SH059.description: Kill an ally or destroy one of your mana gems to stop all enemy <link=keyword.Fast><sprite name=Fast><style=Keyword>Fast</style></link> spells, <link=keyword.Slow><sprite name=Slow><style=Keyword>Slow</style></link> spells, and <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skills</style></link>.
04SH059.descriptionRaw: Kill an ally or destroy one of your mana gems to stop all enemy Fast spells, Slow spells, and Skills.
04SH059.flavorText: Analysis is a mainstay of chronomancy, as many actions must be halted to consider future solutions.
04SH059.name: Rite of Negation

04SH044.descriptionRaw: Play: Advance an allied landmark 2 rounds.
04SH044.flavorText: The constructs that guard Zilean's tower are able to withstand the harsh desert for millennia, and not just for their clever construction.
04SH044.name: Clockwork Curator

04SH076.description: <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> an ally to summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Stasis Statue</style></link> in place with the ally stored inside.
04SH076.descriptionRaw: Obliterate an ally to summon a Stasis Statue in place with the ally stored inside.
04SH076.flavorText:
"Oh, Tai! Come here! We could use your help with something."
- Xetsa, Void Researcher
04SH076.name: Ancient Hourglass

04SH118.flavorText: "The box might be worth something, but whatever's inside sure as sand isn't. By which I mean, it's not worth opening. Speaking from experience, here." - Sivir
04SH118.name: Waking Sands

04SH072.description: When I'm summoned, grant allied champions and landmarks <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>SpellShield</style></link>.
04SH072.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, grant allied champions and landmarks SpellShield.
04SH072.flavorText: "Ah, you did not expect to see water in the middle of the desert. Worry not. Come, drink your fill, wash your feet. Rest in the shade awhile. This is Azir's new Shurima, and it is an oasis."
04SH072.name: Soothsayer

04SH041.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Predict><style=Vocab>Predict</style></link>. If you pick a landmark, grant me <link=keyword.Elusive><sprite name=Elusive><style=Keyword>Elusive</style></link>.
04SH041.descriptionRaw: Play: Predict. If you pick a landmark, grant me Elusive.
04SH041.flavorText:
"We had trouble earlier! A great storm threatened from the west, and Taliyah passed xer'sai tunnels to the south. I spotted a temple to the north, and we are now safe inside its terracotta walls. The others are all asleep, and my flame, like me, is ebbing. I hope I dream well."
- Zaifa's diary
04SH041.name: Sai Scout

04SH005.flavorText: The Sandthrashers do everything with their companions. Fight, hunt, kill... and eat.
04SH005.name: Bloodthirsty Marauder

04SH083.flavorText: "The fin brings fear, but the teeth bring death." - Shuriman saying
04SH083.name: Feral Prescience

04SH092.description:
Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Clockling</style></link>.
If you've <link=vocab.Predict><style=Vocab>Predicted</style></link> this game, summon 2 instead.
04SH092.descriptionRaw:
Summon a Clockling.
If you've Predicted this game, summon 2 instead.
04SH092.flavorText: "Come here and stop fussing! You have sand in your gears." - Tai, Aspiring Chronomancer
04SH092.name: The Time Has Come

04SH046.description: I cost 1 less for each time an ally attacked this game.
04SH046.descriptionRaw: I cost 1 less for each time an ally attacked this game.
04SH046.flavorText: Upon Azir's return, Shurimans caught sight of ancient beasts of legend, made of sand but no less impressive.
04SH046.name: Sandstone Chimera

04SH062T1.description:
Immediately draw 1 of each of your Ascended allies.
For the rest of the game, your level 2 Ascended allies are level 3.
04SH062T1.descriptionRaw:
Immediately draw 1 of each of your Ascended allies.
For the rest of the game, your level 2 Ascended allies are level 3.
04SH062T1.flavorText: "Shurima has known no glory like today. Come, bask in the light of our sun!" - Voice of the Risen
04SH062T1.name: Restored Sun Disc

04SH018T2.description: Kill an ally to give all enemies <nobr>-2|-0</nobr> this round.
04SH018T2.descriptionRaw: Kill an ally to give all enemies -2|-0 this round.
04SH018T2.name: Rite of Dominance

04SH018T1.description: Destroy one of your mana gems to give all enemies <nobr>-2|-0</nobr> this round.
04SH018T1.descriptionRaw: Destroy one of your mana gems to give all enemies -2|-0 this round.
04SH018T1.name: Rite of Dominance

04SH105.description: When allies attack, summon an attacking <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Sandstone Charger</style></link>.
04SH105.descriptionRaw: When allies attack, summon an attacking Sandstone Charger.
04SH105.flavorText: As they passed through the ravine, the Sandcrafter spoke the words of magic. A gust of wind echoed through the canyon and turned to the thunder of oncoming hooves.
04SH105.name: Sandswept Tomb

04SH131.description: An ally you've targeted this round <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> an enemy.
04SH131.descriptionRaw: An ally you've targeted this round strikes an enemy.
04SH131.flavorText: "They never expect the grappling hook!" - Akshan
04SH131.name: Grappling Hook

04SH074.flavorText: Once a caravan has been disabled, the hunters will occasionally retreat and allow their hatchlings to forage forward. It is here that the young xer'sai refine their instincts, learning which sounds are of the desert, and which signal their prey.
04SH074.name: Xer'sai Hatchling

04SH137.description: When I'm summoned, create a copy of me in hand if you've leveled a champion this game.
04SH137.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, create a copy of me in hand if you've leveled a champion this game.
04SH137.flavorText: The giant scarabs were thought to have perished when the Shuriman empire fell. But the Mist's creeping tendrils burrowed deep into the sands, and bound the ancient things to Viego's service.
04SH137.name: Thrumming Swarm

04SH069.description: Give an ally +2|+0 to give an enemy <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link> this round.
04SH069.descriptionRaw: Give an ally +2|+0 to give an enemy Vulnerable this round.
04SH069.name: Ruthless Predator

04SH121.description: Kill an ally or destroy one of your mana gems to draw a champion.
04SH121.descriptionRaw: Kill an ally or destroy one of your mana gems to draw a champion.
04SH121.name: Rite of Calling

04SH121T1.description: Destroy one of your mana gems to draw a Champion.
04SH121T1.descriptionRaw: Destroy one of your mana gems to draw a Champion.
04SH121T1.name: Rite of Calling

04SH121T2.description: Kill an ally to draw a Champion.
04SH121T2.descriptionRaw: Kill an ally to draw a Champion.
04SH121T2.name: Rite of Calling

04SH097T1.description: Kill an enemy follower. If you've <link=vocab.Slay><style=Vocab>slain</style></link> 13+ units this game, kill all enemy followers, then summon a copy of me instead.
04SH097T1.descriptionRaw: Kill an enemy follower. If you've slain 13+ units this game, kill all enemy followers, then summon a copy of me instead.
04SH097T1.flavorText: "We are where both gods and men find their end." - Sanctum Conservator
04SH097T1.name: Conservator's Judgment

04SH110.descriptionRaw: Manifest a landmark you can afford.
04SH110.flavorText: "Come on - there's so much to see!" - Taliyah
04SH110.name: Stoneweaving

04SH051.description: When allies attack, summon an attacking <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Sand Soldier</style></link>.
04SH051.descriptionRaw: When allies attack, summon an attacking Sand Soldier.
04SH051.flavorText: The Sandcrafters lifted their hands, willing the sand into the familiar shape of armored, faceless soldiers, a tireless army ready to fight for their god-emperor.
04SH051.name: Emperor's Dais

04SH106.description: Give enemies <nobr>-2|-0</nobr> and "<link=vocab.RoundEnd><style=Vocab>Round End</style></link>: Deal 2 to me" this round.
04SH106.descriptionRaw: Give enemies -2|-0 and "Round End: Deal 2 to me" this round.
04SH106.name: Spirit Fire

04SH129.descriptionRaw: Strike: Create a Lucky Find in hand.
04SH129.flavorText:
"Okay, Barb. That's the last of the guards on this floor, but we've still gotta keep a low profile."
"BLARGH-BLAAA!"
"Inside voice, Barbara."
"Blarb."
"That's my girl."
04SH129.name: Vekauran Bruiser

04SH090.flavorText:
"Ogh today was fun! We stopped for lunch (skallashi cheese - BLEUGH!) when Kadira spotted a poor rockdoubb asleep in the shade. Of course, she had to tug on its tail, and of course, it got mad. I hope it likes the cheese we left behind!"
- Zaifa's diary
04SH090.name: Grumpy Rockbear

04FR006.description:
When I'm summoned, summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Frozen Thrall</style></link>.
<link=vocab.RoundEnd><style=Vocab>Round End</style></link>: If the <link=keyword.Countdown><style=Keyword>Countdown</style></link> of any of your <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Frozen Thralls</style></link> is 4 or less, <link=vocab.Advance><style=Vocab>advance</style></link> them to 0.
04FR006.descriptionRaw:
When I'm summoned, summon a Frozen Thrall.
Round End: If the Countdown of any of your Frozen Thralls is 4 or less, advance them to 0.
04FR006.flavorText: "My lady appears to me in dreams, her voice near a whisper. 'Follow,' she bids me. This command I dare not disobey."
04FR006.name: Draklorn Inquisitor

04FR012.description: <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> each enemy to summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Frozen Tomb</style></link> in place with the enemy stored inside.
04FR012.descriptionRaw: Obliterate each enemy to summon a Frozen Tomb in place with the enemy stored inside.
04FR012.name: Buried in Ice

04FR016.descriptionRaw:
Grant an ally +1|+2.
Plunder: Grant +2|+4 instead.
04FR016.flavorText: "You Avarosans only grow weak and plump in your fertile fields. So rest tonight, you pitiful weaklings, and while you dream of tomorrow's bounty, we will take it." - Scarmother Vrynna
04FR016.name: Spoils of War

04FR001T1.flavorText: Freed from its icy tomb, the corrupted troll knew one thing, and one thing only - it must do as its dark mistress commanded.
04FR001T1.name: Frostguard Thrall

04FR013.description: Get an empty mana gem and grant an ally +0|+2.
04FR013.descriptionRaw: Get an empty mana gem and grant an ally +0|+2.
04FR013.flavorText: "Beware the ice... and more importantly... beware what lies within!" - Scrawled on a Freljord inn wall
04FR013.name: Cold Resistance

04FR005.description: When I'm summoned, summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Frozen Thrall</style></link> and <link=vocab.Advance><style=Vocab>advance</style></link> it 2.
04FR005.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, summon a Frozen Thrall and advance it 2.
04FR005.levelupDescription: You've summoned 2+ allies that cost 8+.<style=Variable></style> When I level up, create a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Watcher</style></link> in hand.
04FR005.levelupDescriptionRaw: You've summoned 2+ allies that cost 8+. When I level up, create a Watcher in hand.
04FR005.flavorText: "The Watchers lurk just beyond these walls, suspended in ice, frozen in time... and while they wait, I have plans that must be set in motion..."
04FR005.name: Lissandra

04FR005T4.description:
I cost 0 if you've summoned 5+ allies that cost 8+ this game. <style=Variable></style>
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> the enemy deck, leaving 3 non-champions.
04FR005T4.descriptionRaw:
I cost 0 if you've summoned 5+ allies that cost 8+ this game. 
Attack: Obliterate the enemy deck, leaving 3 non-champions.
04FR005T4.flavorText: "This is the end. As it was foretold -- as I promised. Sisters... forgive me." - Lissandra
04FR005T4.name: Watcher

04FR005T1.description:
Your Nexus is <link=keyword.Tough><sprite name=Tough><style=Keyword>Tough</style></link>.
When I'm summoned, summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Frozen Thrall</style></link> and <link=vocab.Advance><style=Vocab>advance</style></link> it 2.
<link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> 0 cost <link=card.cast><style=AssociatedCard>Ice Shard</style></link> in hand.
04FR005T1.descriptionRaw:
Your Nexus is Tough.
When I'm summoned, summon a Frozen Thrall and advance it 2.
Round Start: Create a Fleeting 0 cost Ice Shard in hand.
04FR005T1.flavorText: Few know what Lissandra sacrificed in order to gain power, her ambitions too great to be stymied by mortal trappings.
04FR005T1.name: Lissandra

04FR005T2.description:
<link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> a unit to summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Frozen Tomb</style></link> in place with the unit stored inside.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Lissandra</style></link> in your deck.
04FR005T2.descriptionRaw:
Obliterate a unit to summon a Frozen Tomb in place with the unit stored inside.
Create a Lissandra in your deck.
04FR005T2.name: Lissandra's Entomb

04FR011.descriptionRaw:
Frostbite an enemy.
Summon a Frozen Thrall.
04FR011.flavorText: "The cold elicits many reactions. Let us find out yours." - Lissandra
04FR011.name: Succumb to the Cold

04FR019T1.description: I have +1|+0 for each time you've <link=keyword.Frostbite><sprite name=Frostbite><style=Keyword>Frostbitten</style></link> enemies this game.
04FR019T1.descriptionRaw: I have +1|+0 for each time you've Frostbitten enemies this game.
04FR019T1.flavorText: The young wolves were the most nervous, but were quickly emboldened as they saw their mother lunge for the boar's throat, icy fangs flashing.
04FR019T1.name: Rimefang Pack

04FR001.flavorText: Certainly, there were enough half-witted warriors within the ranks of Trundle's disorderly army to use as front-line fodder, but Lissandra desired something much more loyal, something that served her, and her alone...
04FR001.name: Frozen Thrall

04FR007.description: <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> a unit to summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Frozen Tomb</style></link> in place with the unit stored inside.
04FR007.descriptionRaw: Obliterate a unit to summon a Frozen Tomb in place with the unit stored inside.
04FR007.name: Entomb

04FR007T1.description: <link=vocab.Countdown><style=Vocab>Countdown 2</style></link><style=Variable></style>: Summon exact copies of the units and landmarks stored inside.
04FR007T1.descriptionRaw: Countdown 2: Summon exact copies of the units and landmarks stored inside.
04FR007T1.flavorText: "Our lady will bury this world and all you know in ice." - Draklorn Inquisitor
04FR007T1.name: Frozen Tomb

04FR017.description:
Grant the top ally in your deck +2|+2.
<link=keyword.Enlightened><style=Keyword>Enlightened</style></link>: Instead, grant all allies in your deck +2|+2.
04FR017.descriptionRaw:
Grant the top ally in your deck +2|+2.
Enlightened: Instead, grant all allies in your deck +2|+2.
04FR017.flavorText: The Freljord's unrelenting cold and punishing storms kill most who enter its barren lands. But those who survive find within themselves an inner strength that spurs them onward through the rest of their lives.
04FR017.name: Ancestral Boon

04FR014.description:
When I'm summoned, heal your Nexus 2.
<link=keyword.Countdown><style=Keyword>Countdown 1</style></link><style=Variable></style>: Deal 2 to ALL units.
04FR014.descriptionRaw:
When I'm summoned, heal your Nexus 2.
Countdown 1: Deal 2 to ALL units.
04FR014.flavorText: Bizarre forms made of dark ice sprout from every surface along the ravine, their outward-facing spikes deterring any would-be intruders.
04FR014.name: Blighted Ravine

04FR009.flavorText: "I will bury the world in ice." - Lissandra
04FR009.name: Ice Shard

04FR015.description: When I'm summoned, grant Poro allies a random keyword.
04FR015.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, grant Poro allies a random keyword.
04FR015.flavorText: There is one figure said to be legendary to all porokind. It is said that, as he travels, he bestows his deserving furry friends with all manner of magical forged gifts.
04FR015.name: Fabled Poro

04FR019.description: When I'm summoned, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Rimefang Pack</style></link>. <style=Variable></style>
04FR019.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, summon a Rimefang Pack.
04FR019.flavorText: The rimefang wolves circled the drÃ¼vask, crouched low, wary. The stench of death clung tightly to it, pungent and overwhelming.
04FR019.name: Rimefang Denmother

04FR018.description:
While I'm in hand, <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: If you have 2+ Yetis, summon me and create a copy of me in your deck.
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Draw a Yeti.
04FR018.descriptionRaw:
While I'm in hand, Round Start: If you have 2+ Yetis, summon me and create a copy of me in your deck.
Play: Draw a Yeti.
04FR018.flavorText: "...and they're sneaky, too! Last time I was out there, I had found shelter in a cave, only to find yearlings in there, fast asleep. Tried to keep my distance, but then one of the big 'uns returned, tall as a mountain, and covered in ice! Now you listen to me, because..." - Babbling Bjerg
04FR018.name: Abominable Guardian

04FR010.description: Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.create1><style=AssociatedCard>Flash Freeze</style></link>, <link=card.create2><style=AssociatedCard>Fury of the North</style></link>, or <link=card.create3><style=AssociatedCard>Entomb</style></link> in hand.
04FR010.descriptionRaw: Create a Fleeting Flash Freeze, Fury of the North, or Entomb in hand.
04FR010.flavorText: The Freljordian sisters Avarosa, Serylda, and Lissandra bore tremendous power, though chose to wield it in different ways - each one distinctly merciful, martial, or malicious.
04FR010.name: Three Sisters

04NX002.flavorText: Before the news, the rumors. Before the rumors, the play. Before the play, the plot.
04NX002.name: Whispered Words

04NX010.description: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.guile><style=AssociatedCard>Guile</style></link> in hand.
04NX010.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, create a Guile in hand.
04NX010.flavorText: "Aelana, my dearest friend and colleague! Have you seen Lord Duin about...? Ah, what a shame. I was very much looking forward to catching up. I do hope he paced himself tonight. I would hate for anything to happen to the old boy..." - Lady Auvray, Black Rose Spy
04NX010.name: Thorn of the Rose

04NX021.description: When you target me, grant me +1|+0.
04NX021.descriptionRaw: When you target me, grant me +1|+0.
04NX021.flavorText: After countless battles, Beryn had vowed to never again raise his sword, even if it meant forfeiting his life. But when the strange mists swept through Noxus and overtook Thea, he knew he had to break his promise. He would free her, no matter the cost.
04NX021.name: Retired Reckoner

04NX022.description: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Midnight Raid</style></link> in hand.
04NX022.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, create a Midnight Raid in hand.
04NX022.flavorText: When her sentence ended, Thea knew she could never rejoin her people. War - and Noxus - had changed her, made her a killer. She wouldn't know peace. Instead, she put her newfound skills to use for coin in the arenas.
04NX022.name: Ruined Reckoner

04NX022T1.description: An ally starts a free attack.
04NX022T1.descriptionRaw: An ally starts a free attack.
04NX022T1.name: Midnight Raid

04NX015.description:
<link=vocab.Reputation><style=Vocab>Reputation</style></link>: I cost 2 less. <style=Variable></style>
An ally with 5+ Power <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> an enemy.
04NX015.descriptionRaw:
Reputation: I cost 2 less. 
An ally with 5+ Power strikes an enemy.
04NX015.flavorText: "The greatest threats are the ones that go unseen." - LeBlanc
04NX015.name: Bloody Business

04NX019.description: When an enemy blocks me, give me +3|+0 this round.
04NX019.descriptionRaw: When an enemy blocks me, give me +3|+0 this round.
04NX019.flavorText: Surprised by the resilience of the creature they'd found on the shore of Ionia, the young general insisted on taking it back home, eager to find out its true strength.
04NX019.name: Thrashing Snapper

04NX008.description:
<link=vocab.Reputation><style=Vocab>Reputation</style></link>: I cost 2 less. <style=Variable></style>
When I'm summoned, <link=vocab.Rally><style=Vocab>Rally</style></link>.
04NX008.descriptionRaw:
Reputation: I cost 2 less. 
When I'm summoned, Rally.
04NX008.flavorText: Within the inner chambers of the Black Rose, Noxian nobles play their pieces, and murder befalls distant victims.
04NX008.name: Incisive Tactician

04NX006.description: <link=vocab.Reputation><style=Vocab>Reputation</style></link>: When I'm summoned, transform me into an exact copy of the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> ally that <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>struck</style></link> this round. <style=Variable></style>
04NX006.descriptionRaw: Reputation: When I'm summoned, transform me into an exact copy of the strongest ally that struck this round.
04NX006.flavorText: "A secret is only worth the cost of keeping it."
