Enraged, The Aberration fixed its massive eye on the still-smoking bronze fists, unaware of the encroaching Stormcloud. Masa steeled himself as a monstrous hand fast-approached and prayed he'd bought them enough time.
05BC046T2.name: Masa, Crashing Thunder

05BC001.description: Transform a unit into a 3|3 <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Mini-Minitee</style></link> and <link=vocab.Silence><style=Vocab>Silence</style></link> it.
05BC001.descriptionRaw: Transform a unit into a 3|3 Mini-Minitee and Silence it.
05BC001.flavorText: "Oh-ho! How cute! How adorable! How TINY!" - Veigar
05BC001.name: Minimorph

05BC082.flavorText: "That hole you put in the ceiling during the last match? It's comin' outta your next paycheck!" - Karl, Arena Kingpin
05BC082.name: Bouncer & Bolt

05BC167T1.flavorText:
"...But one day he arrived, empty-handed,
And one by one, the greedy birds landed.
They pecked and scratched and mauled
'Til there was nothing left of him at all!"
- Bandle City tall tale
05BC167T1.name: Hungry Owlcat

05BC026.description: I cost 2 less if you've created 2+ cards this game. Draw 2.
05BC026.descriptionRaw: I cost 2 less if you've created 2+ cards this game. Draw 2.
05BC026.flavorText: Very few outsiders know the way to Bandle City, but strange markings in the rocks and trees of Runeterra offer hints to those who know what to look for.
05BC026.name: Hidden Pathways

05BC152.description: When Iâ€™m summoned, ALL players draw 1, then your opponent discards their highest cost card.
05BC152.descriptionRaw: When Iâ€™m summoned, ALL players draw 1, then your opponent discards their highest cost card.
05BC152.name: Aloof Travelers

05BC070.description:
When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.RoundEnd><style=Vocab>Round End</style></link>: Plant 3 <link=card.puffcap><style=AssociatedCard>Poison Puffcaps</style></link> in the enemy deck. 
Traps on enemy cards are doubled when activated.
05BC070.descriptionRaw:
When I'm summoned or Round End: Plant 3 Poison Puffcaps in the enemy deck. 
Traps on enemy cards are doubled when activated.
05BC070.flavorText: "Rule 378: A good scout is always brave, always prepared, and always daring!"
05BC070.name: Ava Achiever

05BC015.description: <link=vocab.RoundEnd><style=Vocab>Round End</style></link>: If you've damaged the enemy Nexus this round, transform me into <link=card.transform><style=AssociatedCard>Lava Lizard</style></link>.
05BC015.descriptionRaw: Round End: If you've damaged the enemy Nexus this round, transform me into Lava Lizard.
05BC015.flavorText: "Eat the pepper!" barked Nakotak, probably. "No, YOU eat the pepper!" replied Jojo, also probably. As they argued, a small lizard scuttled by, chasing a smaller fly. The two yordles looked at the lizard, then the pepper, then each other. If lightbulbs existed, one would've gone off.
05BC015.name: Bitsy Lizard

05BC145.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create1><style=AssociatedCard>Tiny Spear</style></link> or a <link=card.create2><style=AssociatedCard>Tiny Shield</style></link> in hand.
05BC145.descriptionRaw: Play: Create a Tiny Spear or a Tiny Shield in hand.
05BC145.flavorText: "My spear used to belong to a great hero, too... I made Poppy hold it for a minute!"
05BC145.name: Yordle Squire

05BC015T1.flavorText: Jojo and Nakotak screamed out giggles and giggled out screams as they fled. The Lava Lizard's flames had already singed their back fur, consumed trees, and was now starting to melt the delicate snowdrift. It was AWESOME.
05BC015T1.name: Lava Lizard

05BC140.description: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Summon an attacking random 1 cost Poro.
05BC140.descriptionRaw: Attack: Summon an attacking random 1 cost Poro.
05BC140.flavorText: "An' den DAT Bobjim da poro was like "DAT WAY!" an' so off dey went into da horizahn, with da other poros scamperin' behind, tryin' their bestest to keep up!" - Ingvar the Younger
05BC140.name: Poro Sled

05BC129.flavorText: "There's a sucker born every minute, and I'm gonna take 'em for all they got... this mech arena's gonna be a GOLD MINE."
05BC129.name: Arena Kingpin

05BC004.description: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Prank</style></link> in hand.
05BC004.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, create a Prank in hand.
05BC004.flavorText:
"Curious and playful, the otterpus are an immensely cheery bunch. Or is it otterpi? Say, didn't I pack a third sandwich?" 
- Conchologist Ecological Entry, Day 7
05BC004.name: Otterpus

05BC155.description: When you summon another ally, grant me +1|+0.
05BC155.descriptionRaw: When you summon another ally, grant me +1|+0.
05BC155.flavorText: "Small sparks become a raging blaze. We are the embers of your destruction!"
05BC155.name: Ember Monk

05BC104.flavorText: Yes, he's very cute. Yes, he has a temper. No, you don't want to see it.
05BC104.name: Primal Strength

05BC073T1.description: <link=vocab.Countdown><style=Vocab>Countdown</style></link><style=Variable></style> 3 or when you destroy me: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
05BC073T1.descriptionRaw: Countdown 3 or when you destroy me: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
05BC073T1.flavorText: "It's a real work of art, isn't it!" - Giselle, Inventive Chemist
05BC073T1.name: Scrappy Bomb

05BC218.description: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Hungry Owlcat</style></link> in hand, then grant Fae allies in hand +1|+1.
05BC218.descriptionRaw: Create a Hungry Owlcat in hand, then grant Fae allies in hand +1|+1.
05BC218.name: Fae Aid

05BC168T1.description: When I transform, deal 1 to all enemies.
05BC168T1.descriptionRaw: When I transform, deal 1 to all enemies.
05BC168T1.flavorText: So, it turns out that poking Nakotak Valley gromps with a stick causes them to react very... expansively! If only those yordles had known this through extensive, generational testing. If. Only.
05BC168T1.name: Giga Gromp

05BC066T1.description: Attach me to an ally to give it my stats and keywords while I'm <link=keyword.Attach><sprite name=Attach><style=Keyword>Attached</style></link>. When that ally leaves play, <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> me.
05BC066T1.descriptionRaw: Attach me to an ally to give it my stats and keywords while I'm Attached. When that ally leaves play, Recall me.
05BC066T1.flavorText: "Show 'em what you can do, quills!" - Yuumi
05BC066T1.name: Quick Quill

05BC066T2.flavorText: "W... h... e... r... e... s... N... o... r... r... a...? Oh dear, what should I tell it?" - Mouse steward
05BC066T2.name: Quick Quill

05BC192.description: When I'm summoned, create a random landmark that costs 2 or less in hand.
05BC192.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, create a random landmark that costs 2 or less in hand.
05BC192.flavorText: The Fussyfoot Bomberator-X did precisely what it was meant to do: sow chaos. Plus, it was easy to parallel park.
05BC192.name: Bomber Twins

05BC169.flavorText: Now you see him. Now you don't. And now you're dead.
05BC169.name: Shadowtech Walker

05BC162.description: When an ally transforms, fully heal it and grant it +1|+1 and <link=keyword.Impact><sprite name=Impact><style=Keyword>Impact</style></link>.
05BC162.descriptionRaw: When an ally transforms, fully heal it and grant it +1|+1 and Impact.
05BC162.flavorText: Chief Nakotak declared himself leader of the tribe after finding a large dinosaur bone in the snowdrifts surrounding their lands. None of the others were aware that dinosaur bones equated to tribe leadership, but also none of the others were really all that bothered. So Nakotak it was.
05BC162.name: Chief Nakotak

05BC032.description: Each round, the first Fae you play costs 2 less.
05BC032.descriptionRaw: Each round, the first Fae you play costs 2 less.
05BC032.flavorText: "Lantern follows Norra, moon moths follow Lantern, mouses follow moon moths! Follow, follow!"
05BC032.name: Gleaming Lantern

05BC166.flavorText: The first rule of experimentation: poke it, and see what happens.
05BC166.name: Pokey Stick

05BC006.description:
When I'm summoned, grant me a random keyword for each allied landmark you've destroyed this game. <style=Variable></style>
When you destroy an allied landmark, grant me a random keyword.
05BC006.descriptionRaw:
When I'm summoned, grant me a random keyword for each allied landmark you've destroyed this game. 
When you destroy an allied landmark, grant me a random keyword.
05BC006.flavorText: Wherever Ziggs went, Arnie followed, his serene demeanor a natural foil to Ziggs' chaotic zeal. His duties ranged from making sure the munitions were stocked, to putting out fires, to clapping his hands over Ziggs' ears when Ziggs (inevitably) forgot hearing protection.
05BC006.name: The Arsenal

05BC110.flavorText: "Yes, yes, you've told me all about how much she likes tea, socks, you, buttons, and collecting little bits and bobs, but you still haven't told me anything about what she LOOKS like!"
05BC110.name: Scholarly Climber

05BC063.description:
When I'm summoned, grant me +1|+0 and a random keyword.
I keep these stat buffs and keywords when I'm <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recalled</style></link>.
05BC063.descriptionRaw:
When I'm summoned, grant me +1|+0 and a random keyword.
I keep these stat buffs and keywords when I'm Recalled.
05BC063.flavorText: The Tornado maintains her calm with breathing exercises... and by channeling her inner turmoil into a vicious hurricane of deadly blades.
05BC063.name: Tornado Warrior

05BC217.descriptionRaw: Manifest a Fae and grant it +1|+1.
05BC217.flavorText: Every living thing requires sustenance. The fae are no different, though it can be hard to tell how exactly they use it.
05BC217.name: Fae Sprout

05BC180.description: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> a unit with 3 or less Power.
05BC180.descriptionRaw: Recall a unit with 3 or less Power.
05BC180.flavorText: "We are quick! We are the wind!" - Kennen
05BC180.name: Quicken

05BC040.description: <link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> an <link=card.create1><style=AssociatedCard>Otterpus</style></link> or one of 2 spells from your regions that cost 3 or less.
05BC040.descriptionRaw: Manifest an Otterpus or one of 2 spells from your regions that cost 3 or less.
05BC040.name: Trinket Trade

05BC213.description: Deal 1 to an enemy and <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> it.
05BC213.descriptionRaw: Deal 1 to an enemy and Stun it.
05BC213.name: Wallop

05BC208.description: An ally <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> an enemy. If it survives, <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> it.
05BC208.descriptionRaw: An ally strikes an enemy. If it survives, Stun it.
05BC208.name: Heroic Charge

05BC085.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Discard 1 to <link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> a Mecha Yordle and grant it <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>SpellShield</style></link>.
05BC085.descriptionRaw: Play: Discard 1 to Manifest a Mecha Yordle and grant it SpellShield.
05BC085.flavorText: "Turn it down, will ya?! I can barely hear myself counting all this money!" - Karl, Arena Kingpin
05BC085.name: Bilgerat Rascal

05BC112.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Give me <link=keyword.Barrier><sprite name=Barrier><style=Keyword>Barrier</style></link> this round or grant me <link=keyword.Impact><sprite name=Impact><style=Keyword>Impact</style></link>.
05BC112.descriptionRaw: Play: Give me Barrier this round or grant me Impact.
05BC112.flavorText: The Blastcone Seedlings are shy creatures, and while they will retreat first and foremost, if threatened...
05BC112.name: Blastcone Seedling

05BC135.description: An ally <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> an enemy. If the ally is multi-region, it <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> the enemy again.
05BC135.descriptionRaw: An ally strikes an enemy. If the ally is multi-region, it strikes the enemy again.
05BC135.flavorText: "The Acorn M1-85: a fully-automatic, oak caliber rifle with a bandlewood scope, and a purpleberry finish. Yeah, mama's cookin' up something good tonight!" - Bandle Commando
05BC135.name: Double Tap

05BC084.descriptionRaw: Play: Discard 1 to Manifest a Mecha Yordle.
05BC084.name: Squeaker

05BC171.description: <link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: Give my supported ally <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>SpellShield</style></link> and +2|+2 this round.
05BC171.descriptionRaw: Support: Give my supported ally SpellShield and +2|+2 this round.
05BC171.flavorText: Powered by gems mined from the caves beneath Bandle City, the Mechaforcer emits a defensive shield that can withstand even the strongest of weapons. It's pretty to look at too.
05BC171.name: Geode Mechaforcer

05BC184.description: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Hungry Owlcat</style></link> in hand.
05BC184.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, create a Hungry Owlcat in hand.
05BC184.flavorText:
"This is a song
About Poppy the strong!
Poppy the mightiest, frightiest... sprong!" 
- Scratched-out lyrics from the 'Songbook of Reginaldactyl and Faltimisquee, Bards Extraordinaire'
05BC184.name: Babbling Balladeers

05BC080.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, grant me 2 Impact.
05BC080.flavorText:
"I didn't choose the smash life, the smash life chose ME!"
- Post-match interview
05BC080.name: Smash & Dash

05BC116.description:
Each round, the first multi-region unit you play costs 1 less.
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> a multi-region follower.
05BC116.descriptionRaw:
Each round, the first multi-region unit you play costs 1 less.
Play: Manifest a multi-region follower.
05BC116.flavorText: It's unclear whether Bandle City ever really elected a mayor, but an enormous mustache would almost certainly be a prerequisite.
05BC116.name: Bandle City Mayor

05BC111.description: Give allies +2|+2 this round. If you've played cards from 4+ regions, give allies +3|+3 instead. <style=Variable></style>
05BC111.descriptionRaw: Give allies +2|+2 this round. If you've played cards from 4+ regions, give allies +3|+3 instead.
05BC111.flavorText: "We... look so cool right now." - Tristana
05BC111.name: Yordles in Arms

05BC145T2.flavorText: "I found it! But you can use it!!" - Yordle Squire
05BC145T2.name: Tiny Shield

05BC145T1.flavorText: "A small spear is still a spear." - Yordle saying, probably
05BC145T1.name: Tiny Spear

05BC224.description: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> an ally. The next ally you play this round with equal or less cost, costs 0 instead.
05BC224.descriptionRaw: Recall an ally. The next ally you play this round with equal or less cost, costs 0 instead.
05BC224.flavorText: "Speed of body, speed of mind!" - Kennen
05BC224.name: Transposition

05BC130.description: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Grant the top champion in your deck +1|+1 and a random keyword.
05BC130.descriptionRaw: Attack: Grant the top champion in your deck +1|+1 and a random keyword.
05BC130.flavorText: Otto's summer barbecues had something of a reputation. While enthusiastic about grilling, he left his guests few choices for the steaks other than "well done" or "extremely well done".
05BC130.name: Hothead

05BC191.description: Place an enemy unit on top of the enemy deck.
05BC191.descriptionRaw: Place an enemy unit on top of the enemy deck.
05BC191.name: Keeper's Verdict

05BC112T2.descriptionRaw: Play: Give me Barrier this round.
05BC112T2.name: Blastcone Seedling

05BC052.description: Fill your hand with random cards. They cost 0 and are<link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>. You can only play 3 more cards this round.
05BC052.descriptionRaw: Fill your hand with random cards. They cost 0 and areFleeting. You can only play 3 more cards this round.
05BC052.flavorText: One mortal's trash is another yordle's giant pile of scrap parts.
05BC052.name: Treasured Trash

05BC089.description: When I'm summoned, grant other allies +1|+1.
05BC089.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, grant other allies +1|+1.
05BC089.flavorText: The mechs and yordles were bruised, battered, beaten. Then a clarion call sounded, granting them new steam, new life: Doot doot!
05BC089.name: Trumpetecher

05BC050.description: When I'm summoned, create 2 <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Pranks</style></link> in hand.
05BC050.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, create 2 Pranks in hand.
05BC050.flavorText:
"Those who are prone to nausea should approach this gentle giant with EXTREME caution. Your insides will thank you... On a related note, I really shouldn't have eaten that second mushroom sandwich..." 
- Conchologist Ecological Entry, Day 3
05BC050.name: Benemone

05BC094.description: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Darkness</style></link> in hand if you don't have one.
05BC094.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, create a Darkness in hand if you don't have one.
05BC094.flavorText: "Yes, I'm quite sure the fellow up on the roof has many stories to tell. We all know he has lots to say. We just don't have any idea exactly WHAT it is he's saying." - Stilted Robemaker
05BC094.name: Darkbulb Acolyte

05BC014T1.description: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
05BC014T1.descriptionRaw: Round Start: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
05BC014T1.flavorText: Once enraged, the Terrordactyls tear erratically through the skies, leaving mayhem and enraptured yordles in their colorful wake.
05BC014T1.name: Terrordactyl

05BC146.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Discard 1 to create a multi-region follower in hand and reduce its cost by 1.
05BC146.descriptionRaw: Play: Discard 1 to create a multi-region follower in hand and reduce its cost by 1.
05BC146.flavorText: "Painting's not about copying what you see, it's about expressing how YOU see the world. And right now, I'm seeing that you moved again. Hold still please!"
05BC146.name: Bandle Painter

05BC235.description: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Give allies with equal or less power than me <link=keyword.Quick Strike><sprite name=QuickStrike><style=Keyword>Quick Attack</style></link> this round.
05BC235.descriptionRaw: Attack: Give allies with equal or less power than me Quick Attack this round.
05BC235.flavorText: "Poppy never listens t'me, so you better: It's not about the hammer, it's about the yordle who swings it."
05BC235.name: Yordle Smith

05BC175.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> a Celestial that costs 3 or less, Epic, or multi-region follower.
05BC175.descriptionRaw: Play: Manifest a Celestial that costs 3 or less, Epic, or multi-region follower.
05BC175.flavorText: The strangest part wasn't that the telescope got up, stretched, and started walking around, but that it insisted on dressing for the weather, so it had to find a suitably comfortable scarf.
05BC175.name: Loping Telescope

05BC182.description: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> an ally to deal 2 to anything.
05BC182.descriptionRaw: Recall an ally to deal 2 to anything.
05BC182.flavorText: "First the crack, then the boom!" - Kennen
05BC182.name: Lightning Rush

05BC069.descriptionRaw: Attack: Create a Fleeting Poison Dart in hand.
05BC069.name: Lecturing Yordle

05BC057.description: When I'm summoned, reduce the cost of your <link=card.spell><style=AssociatedCard>Darkness</style></link> <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> by 1.
05BC057.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, reduce the cost of your Darkness everywhere by 1.
05BC057.flavorText:
"It is important, when assembling one's cabal, that each maniacal member brings something unique to the supervillain table. One of my fellows, for instance, has a lethal sense of style..."
- Excerpt from Ch. 4 of "How to be a Supervillain", by Lord Veigar
05BC057.name: Stilted Robemaker

05BC108.description: When you summon another Yordle, grant it +1|+0.
05BC108.descriptionRaw: When you summon another Yordle, grant it +1|+0.
05BC108.flavorText: "Priceless is the glory of exploration, but the greatest discoveries are always... ahem... profitable."
05BC108.name: Yordle Explorer

05BC183.description:
When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Hungry Owlcat</style></link> in hand.
When you summon another Fae, grant it +1|+0.
05BC183.descriptionRaw:
When I'm summoned, create a Hungry Owlcat in hand.
When you summon another Fae, grant it +1|+0.
05BC183.flavorText:
"Gather 'round, hear what I say,
The sad tale of Grandfather Fae.
Each day he'd feed the hungry birds,
An odd mixture of seed and curds..."
- Bandle City Tall Tale
05BC183.name: Grandfather Fae

05BC188.description: When you pick a non-champion card from randomly selected options, create a copy in hand and reduce its cost by 1.
05BC188.descriptionRaw: When you pick a non-champion card from randomly selected options, create a copy in hand and reduce its cost by 1.
05BC188.flavorText: Famously shy, the elusive shellfolk are known to hide in their shells until their curiosity gets the better of them. Once emerged, their playful personalities become fully engaged, including a propensity to play tricks by expertly mimicking the sound of other sea life.
05BC188.name: Curious Shellfolk

05FR001.description: <link=vocab.RoundEnd><style=Vocab>Round End</style></link>: If you've damaged the enemy Nexus this round, transform me into <link=card.transform><style=AssociatedCard>Murkwolf Rager</style></link>.
05FR001.descriptionRaw: Round End: If you've damaged the enemy Nexus this round, transform me into Murkwolf Rager.
05FR001.flavorText: "We do not die as cowards! Instead, we fall with claws drawn and teeth bared. In doing so, we honor The Wolf." - Hyara Allseer
05FR001.name: Murkwolf Shaman

05FR001T1.description: When I transform, draw a unit.
05FR001T1.descriptionRaw: When I transform, draw a unit.
05FR001T1.flavorText: A shaman of the Murkwolf never truly dies alone. In death, they are joined by the spirits of other fallen shaman and begin their journey through the Great Beyond as a new pack.
05FR001T1.name: Murkwolf Rager

05FR002.description: <link=vocab.RoundEnd><style=Vocab>Round End</style></link>: If you've damaged the enemy Nexus this round, transform me into <link=card.transform><style=AssociatedCard>Mammoth Rager</style></link>.
05FR002.descriptionRaw: Round End: If you've damaged the enemy Nexus this round, transform me into Mammoth Rager.
05FR002.flavorText: When faced with predators, mammoth herds will surround their young calves and pregnant cows. And so the shamans of the great mammoth spirit call not just upon their spirit's physical strength but also upon the strength of unity with which it protects its family.
05FR002.name: Mammoth Shaman

05FR002T1.flavorText: Few Freljodian beasts are as fearsome as a mammoth protecting its herd.
05FR002T1.name: Mammoth Rager

05FR013.description: When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Stance Swap</style></link> in hand or, if you have one, reduce its cost to 0.
05FR013.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned or strike: Create a Stance Swap in hand or, if you have one, reduce its cost to 0.
05FR013.flavorText: "The Spirits shape our world just as we and our world shapes the Spirits. By drawing power from them we take power from within ourselves."
05FR013.name: Udyr

05FR013T5.description:
Grant allies everywhere +1|+1. Then deal 1 to EVERYTHING.
Create an <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Udyr</style></link> in your deck.
05FR013T5.descriptionRaw:
Grant allies everywhere +1|+1. Then deal 1 to EVERYTHING.
Create an Udyr in your deck.
05FR013T5.flavorText:
"Ancient ones, bolster our strength against the encroaching cold, and drive away our foes with storms of wind and ice. For we have not forgotten you or the honors you are due."
- Murkwolf Shaman's Benediction
05FR013T5.name: Udyr's Spirits Unleashed

05FR013T4.description:
When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Stance Swap</style></link> in hand or, if you have one, reduce its cost to 0. 
I have +1|+1 for each stance you've played this game. <style=Variable></style>
05FR013T4.descriptionRaw:
When I'm summoned or strike: Create a Stance Swap in hand or, if you have one, reduce its cost to 0. 
I have +1|+1 for each stance you've played this game.
05FR013T4.flavorText: "We are united as one, heart and Spirit! Together, we will drive our foes into the cold, eternal night!"
05FR013T4.name: Udyr

05FR016.descriptionRaw: Create 2 Fleeting 0 cost Stance Swaps in hand.
05FR016.flavorText: "You will see them... great Spirits of teeth and claw, scale and feather. And in that moment, you will tremble in fear and awe, and you will know that the Old Gods have not forgotten us." - Hyara Allseer
05FR016.name: Shaman's Call

05FR012.description:
When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Stance Swap</style></link> in hand. 
The first <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Stance Swap</style></link> you play each round costs 0.
05FR012.descriptionRaw:
When I'm summoned, create a Stance Swap in hand. 
The first Stance Swap you play each round costs 0.
05FR012.flavorText: Revered by all, the great shaman, Hyara Allseer, lost her sight long ago and now sees through the eyes of the hawks and eagles that nest on her mountaintop home. Now, troublesome tidings have brought her down from the mountain... she hopes the omens remain but mere visions.
05FR012.name: Hyara Allseer

05FR014.description:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>:<link=keyword.Frostbite><sprite name=Frostbite><style=Keyword>Frostbite</style></link> an enemy.
Enemies with 3 or less Power can't block.
05FR014.descriptionRaw:
Play:Frostbite an enemy.
Enemies with 3 or less Power can't block.
05FR014.flavorText: "I was there, years ago... first came the cold, biting and unrelenting. Then a storm, angry and uncaring. Last came a roar, so sharp it cut me to the bone. I fell to my knees and prayed we hadn't made a grave mistake. To call upon a great spirit is to ask for its vengeance... and its mercy." - Hyara Allseer
05FR014.name: Wrath of the Freljord

05FR010.description: Grant a Stance to an ally.
05FR010.descriptionRaw: Grant a Stance to an ally.
05FR010.name: Stance Swap

05FR010T4.description: Pick an ally. Deal 1 to EVERYTHING else.
05FR010T4.descriptionRaw: Pick an ally. Deal 1 to EVERYTHING else.
05FR010T4.flavorText: "Against the freezing night you warm us. Against our foes you bring protective flame... Spirit of fire, AID US!" - Udyr
05FR010T4.name: Ram Stance

05FR010T3.flavorText: "It is not the absence of pain I seek. It is the tenacity to fight through it." - Hyara Allseer
05FR010T3.name: Boar Stance

05FR010T2.flavorText: "The Great Bear is indomitable, and in taking it's blessing, we shall know no fear... or mercy." - Hyara Allseer
05FR010T2.name: Bear Stance

05FR017.description: Give an ally +1|+1 this round. Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Stance Swap</style></link> in hand.
05FR017.descriptionRaw: Give an ally +1|+1 this round. Create a Stance Swap in hand.
05FR017.name: Inner Beast

05FR006.flavorText: Few shaman families have served the Winter's Claw tribe as long as Chuluun's. As a shaman of great walrus, he heralds and portends the sea's bounty... and its dangers.
05FR006.name: Tusk Speaker

05FR015.description: Grant allies everywhere +1|+1. Then deal 1 to EVERYTHING.
05FR015.descriptionRaw: Grant allies everywhere +1|+1. Then deal 1 to EVERYTHING.
05FR015.flavorText:
"Ancient ones, bolster our strength against the encroaching cold, and drive away our foes with storms of wind and ice. For we have not forgotten you or the honors you are due."
- Murkwolf Shaman's Prayer
05FR015.name: Spirits Unleashed

05FR005.description: When I survive damage, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
05FR005.descriptionRaw: When I survive damage, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
05FR005.flavorText: Few scry the future as well as the shamans serving the Elk of Bones. Fewer still can stomach seeing the looming death of any who come seeking their foresight.
05FR005.name: Bone Scryer

05FR004.description: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Stance Swap</style></link> in hand.
05FR004.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, create a Stance Swap in hand.
05FR004.flavorText: "Eager and cautious. Quick and quiet. The way of the fox is the joy of seeing but not being seen. In travel and war, a wise leader honors those who follow the fox spirit. For no battle is won without pathfinders and scouts." - Scarmother Vrynna
05FR004.name: Vulpine Wanderer

05FR006T1.flavorText: "Many songs can touch your heart. My songs shake the heavens." - Chuluun
05FR006T1.name: Dance of Tusks

05IO003.description: I cost 2 less for each unit you've <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recalled</style></link> this round.
05IO003.descriptionRaw: I cost 2 less for each unit you've Recalled this round.
05IO003.flavorText:
"Himon'she, it is an honor to travel with you. The others tell me you are wise beyond measure. Where are we heading?"
"Oh dear. I was following you!" - Ahri and the Pathless Ancient
05IO003.name: Pathless Ancient

05IO004.description: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: The first time I <link=vocab.AttackStrike><style=Vocab>attack strike</style></link>, swap me with the ally to my right, then <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> it.
05IO004.descriptionRaw: Attack: The first time I attack strike, swap me with the ally to my right, then Recall it.
05IO004.flavorText: She searched for herself in other peoples' secrets. Saw herself through the eyes of so many. As she approached the forest, she wondered if it would be just another lens--or if, just this once, she'd found a mirror.
05IO004.name: Ahri

05IO004T2.description:
When you <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> an ally, reduce its cost by 1.
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Each time I <link=vocab.AttackStrike><style=Vocab>attack strike</style></link>, swap me with the ally to my right, then <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> it.
05IO004T2.descriptionRaw:
When you Recall an ally, reduce its cost by 1.
Attack: Each time I attack strike, swap me with the ally to my right, then Recall it.
05IO004T2.flavorText: "I can remember a thousand memories I've never had. From now on, I'll make my own." - Ahri
05IO004T2.name: Ahri

05IO004T1.description:
<link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> an ally to give an enemy <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link> this round.
Create an <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Ahri</style></link> in your deck.
05IO004T1.descriptionRaw:
Recall an ally to give an enemy Vulnerable this round.
Create an Ahri in your deck.
05IO004T1.name: Ahri's Charm

05IO023.description: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> an ally to give an enemy <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link> this round.
05IO023.descriptionRaw: Recall an ally to give an enemy Vulnerable this round.
05IO023.name: Charm

05IO020.flavorText: Chaos gives claws to the meek. A wolf hounds its prey and is stalled by a felled branch. A hawk dives and tumbles amidst a sudden gale. We are the branch. We are the wind.
05IO020.name: Windsinger

05IO020T1.flavorText: The wind moves all, in its own time.
05IO020T1.name: Gust

05IO007.description: When I'm summoned, draw 2 and give allies +1|+1 this round.
05IO007.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, draw 2 and give allies +1|+1 this round.
05IO007.flavorText: The forest offers its secrets freely... but few bear the courage to ask questions of it.
05IO007.name: Sai'nen Thousand-Tailed

05IO021.description:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> an ally to summon an <nobr><link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> copy of it.</nobr>
<link=vocab.Countdown><style=Vocab>Countdown 3</style></link><style=Variable></style>: Summon another <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> <nobr>copy of it.</nobr>
05IO021.descriptionRaw:
Play: Recall an ally to summon an Ephemeral copy of it.
Countdown 3: Summon another Ephemeral copy of it.
05IO021.flavorText: Once, the God-Willow grew within Omikayalan. What springs forth from that place now may be stronger, may be weaker. What matters is that it is new.
05IO021.name: God-Willow Seedling

05IO024.description: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> an ally, or spend 8 mana to summon <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> copies of the 3 <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> followers you've <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recalled</style></link> this game.
05IO024.descriptionRaw: Recall an ally, or spend 8 mana to summon Ephemeral copies of the 3 strongest followers you've Recalled this game.
05IO024.name: Children of the Forest

05IO024T2.description: Summon <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> copies of the 3 <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> followers you've <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recalled</style></link> this game.
05IO024T2.descriptionRaw: Summon Ephemeral copies of the 3 strongest followers you've Recalled this game.
05IO024T2.name: Children of the Forest

05IO001.description: When Iâ€™m summoned, give me +1|+0 and <link=keyword.Elusive><sprite name=Elusive><style=Keyword>Elusive</style></link> this round.
05IO001.descriptionRaw: When Iâ€™m summoned, give me +1|+0 and Elusive this round.
05IO001.flavorText: "They say you don't speak to save others from the weight of your knowledge. Hmm... I bet you just got tired of answering questions." - Ahri
05IO001.name: Woodland Keeper

05IO025.description: Each round, the first time you <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> a follower, summon an exact <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> copy of it.
05IO025.descriptionRaw: Each round, the first time you Recall a follower, summon an exact Ephemeral copy of it.
05IO025.flavorText: Mystery is a greater thing than its conclusion.
05IO025.name: Tail-Cloak Matriarch

05IO026.flavorText: If one is to venerate the hunt, one must pause to weep for the hunted.
05IO026.name: The Mourned

05IO006.flavorText: The forest needed a guardian, someone who could stand sentry at its borders for years, maybe centuries, without moving. Gai'sh was an eager volunteer and promptly proved his dedication with a ten-year nap.
05IO006.name: Nine Lives

05IO006T1.description:
When I'm summoned, summon a random 1 cost follower from your regions.
When I'm <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recalled</style></link>, transform me into <link=card.cardRef><style=AssociatedCard>Nine Lives</style></link>.
05IO006T1.descriptionRaw:
When I'm summoned, summon a random 1 cost follower from your regions.
When I'm Recalled, transform me into Nine Lives.
05IO006T1.flavorText: "My best quality? I sleep like a rock."
05IO006T1.name: Liminal Guardian

05IO002.description: Pick an ally being targeted by enemy <link=keyword.Fast><sprite name=Fast><style=Keyword>Fast</style></link> spells, <link=keyword.Slow><sprite name=Slow><style=Keyword>Slow</style></link> spells, or <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skills</style></link> with only 1 allied target. Stop them.
05IO002.descriptionRaw: Pick an ally being targeted by enemy Fast spells, Slow spells, or Skills with only 1 allied target. Stop them.
05IO002.flavorText: An arrow knows neither the intent of the hunter, nor the worth of its prey.
05IO002.name: Memory's Cloak

05SH014.description: When you destroy an allied landmark, deal 1 to the <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> enemy.
05SH014.descriptionRaw: When you destroy an allied landmark, deal 1 to the weakest enemy.
05SH014.flavorText:
"The two were once friends, but time and affinity made them into brothers. Certainly Azir could not have achieved all that he was able without Xerath by his side." 
- Scribe Kah'nir, History of the Ascended Host
05SH014.name: Xerath

05SH014T3.description:
Destroy an allied landmark or one of your mana gems to deal 4 to a unit.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Xerath</style></link> in your deck.
05SH014T3.descriptionRaw:
Destroy an allied landmark or one of your mana gems to deal 4 to a unit.
Create a Xerath in your deck.
05SH014T3.flavorText: "A small sacrifice in exchange for great power." - Xerath
05SH014T3.name: Xerath's Rite of the Arcane

05SH014T4.description: Destroy one of your mana gems to deal 4 to a unit.
05SH014T4.descriptionRaw: Destroy one of your mana gems to deal 4 to a unit.
05SH014T4.name: Xerath's Rite of the Arcane

05SH014T5.description: Destroy an allied landmark to deal 4 to a unit.
05SH014T5.descriptionRaw: Destroy an allied landmark to deal 4 to a unit.
05SH014T5.name: Xerath's Rite of the Arcane

05SH014T1.description: When you destroy an allied landmark, deal 3 to the <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> enemy.
05SH014T1.descriptionRaw: When you destroy an allied landmark, deal 3 to the weakest enemy.
05SH014T1.flavorText:
"If only Xerath had known that Azir planned to free him of his bondage, it might have prevented Shurima's demise... but some part of a mortal's humanity is lost when they Ascend, and any forgiveness or leniency was quickly erased from Xerath's mind." 
- Scribe Kah'nir, History of the Ascended Host
05SH014T1.name: Xerath

05SH014T2.description:
When you destroy an allied landmark or <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Deal 5 to the <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> enemy or the enemy Nexus if there are none.
If an enemy unit would die, <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> it instead.
05SH014T2.descriptionRaw:
When you destroy an allied landmark or Round Start: Deal 5 to the weakest enemy or the enemy Nexus if there are none.
If an enemy unit would die, Obliterate it instead.
05SH014T2.flavorText:
"For years he sowed seeds of revenge, plotting against Azir in the dark of the Emperor's Tomb. Xerath would see a new Shurima made in his own image, gathering the acolytes who had studied his arcane magics to serve as his army. Now, he marches on Shurima just as Azir has revived it." 
- Scribe Kah'nir, History of the Ascended Host
05SH014T2.name: Xerath

05SH017.description: When I'm summoned, if you've destroyed 4+ allied landmarks this game, grant your champions <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +2|+2 and <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link>. <style=Variable></style>
05SH017.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, if you've destroyed 4+ allied landmarks this game, grant your champions everywhere +2|+2 and Overwhelm.
05SH017.flavorText: The Herald spread her arms wide as she lifted her face to the sun, which hung bloody and red above Shurima. "Hail, the Magus Ascendant," she breathed beatifically, her voice echoing off the ring of ruined columns. "Hail, Xerath!"
05SH017.name: Herald of the Magus

05SH011.flavorText: As richly appointed as the tomb was, it did little good for the banished and the dead.
05SH011.name: Endless Devout

05SH011T1.flavorText: Xerath's new army would make better use of the tomb's many artifacts, turning useless extravagance into a powerful conduit for the Magus Ascendant's magic.
05SH011T1.name: Restored Devout

05SH011T2.description: <link=vocab.Countdown><style=Vocab>Countdown</style></link><style=Variable></style> 3 or when you destroy me: summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Restored Devout</style></link>.
05SH011T2.descriptionRaw: Countdown 3 or when you destroy me: summon a Restored Devout.
05SH011T2.flavorText: The Tomb of Emperors is no less lavish for serving as Xerath's prison. Indeed, the beauty of the place and its trappings is nothing if not a reminder of the inhabitants' fall from grace - a gilded prison.
05SH011T2.name: Sarcophagus

05SH022.description: Give an enemy <nobr>-2|-0</nobr> this round. An ally and that enemy <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> each other.
05SH022.descriptionRaw: Give an enemy -2|-0 this round. An ally and that enemy strike each other.
05SH022.flavorText: "A traveler who does not fear the desert, does not know the desert." - Shuriman adage
05SH022.name: Desert Duel

05SH003.description: <link=vocab.Countdown><style=Vocab>Countdown 3</style></link> or when I'm summoned or you destroy me: Grant the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> ally +2|+0.
05SH003.descriptionRaw: Countdown 3 or when I'm summoned or you destroy me: Grant the strongest ally +2|+0.
05SH003.flavorText: Sparking, crackling pillars rose from the sands, subverted places of power that would reinforce Xerath's already powerful army.
05SH003.name: Obelisk of Power

05SH016.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Destroy an allied landmark to grant allied <link=card.selfRef><style=AssociatedCard>Ruinous Acolytes</style></link> <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +1|+1.
05SH016.descriptionRaw: Play: Destroy an allied landmark to grant allied Ruinous Acolytes everywhere +1|+1.
05SH016.flavorText: All of Xerath's acolytes gave something of themselves in exchange for power, but his most powerful devotees were hardly more than husks of their former selves, serving as both conduit and power source for their new emperor's energy.
05SH016.name: Ruinous Acolyte

05SH018.description: Summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Stasis Statue</style></link> to store all allied units and landmarks that died or were destroyed this round inside.
05SH018.descriptionRaw: Summon a Stasis Statue to store all allied units and landmarks that died or were destroyed this round inside.
05SH018.flavorText: Magical energy does not dissipate. It is merely repurposed.
05SH018.name: Servitude of Desolation

05SH012.description: <link=vocab.Countdown><style=Vocab>Countdown</style></link><style=Variable></style> 3 or when you destroy me: Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Dami'yin the Unbound</style></link>.
05SH012.descriptionRaw: Countdown 3 or when you destroy me: Summon a Dami'yin the Unbound.
05SH012.flavorText: "At each place of power shall an obelisk be raised, an instrument through which the Magus Ascendant may draw the power from beneath the sands." - Herald of the Magus
05SH012.name: Risen Altar

05SH012T1.flavorText: "At each place of power shall we draw forth the magical energy of the land, and in so doing, bolster our great emperor's armies!" - Herald of the Magus
05SH012T1.name: Dami'yin the Unbound

05SH020.description: Create a <link=card.create1><style=AssociatedCard>Ruinous Acolyte</style></link> or an <link=card.create2><style=AssociatedCard>Obelisk of Power</style></link> in hand.
05SH020.descriptionRaw: Create a Ruinous Acolyte or an Obelisk of Power in hand.
05SH020.flavorText: "I will fashion Shurima in MY image." - Xerath
05SH020.name: Construct of Desolation

05SH015.description: When I'm summoned, draw 1. If you drew a landmark, repeat this effect.
05SH015.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, draw 1. If you drew a landmark, repeat this effect.
05SH015.flavorText: The horizon before her sang with energy. Where others saw sand and silt, she saw the ley lines, blinding lattices of pure energy that were hers for the taking.
05SH015.name: Sandseer

05SH004.description: Give an ally +2|+1 this round or destroy an allied landmark to give an ally +4|+2 this round.
05SH004.descriptionRaw: Give an ally +2|+1 this round or destroy an allied landmark to give an ally +4|+2 this round.
05SH004.flavorText: "I will rip the power from the desert, and destroy those who would oppose me!" - Xerath
05SH004.name: Unleashed Energy

05SH004T2.flavorText: "I will rip the power from the desert, and destroy those who would oppose me!" - Xerath
05SH004T2.name: Unleashed Energy

05SH004T1.description: Destroy an allied landmark to give an ally +4|+2 this round.
05SH004T1.descriptionRaw: Destroy an allied landmark to give an ally +4|+2 this round.
05SH004T1.flavorText: "I will rip the power from the desert, and destroy those who would oppose me!" - Xerath
05SH004T1.name: Unleashed Energy

05SH002.description: When you destroy an allied landmark, grant me +1|+1.
05SH002.descriptionRaw: When you destroy an allied landmark, grant me +1|+1.
05SH002.flavorText: The acolytes had been accomplished before they sought out Xerath. Now that they had studied what he had once studied himself, they were unstoppable.
05SH002.name: Waste Walker

05SH007.description: Destroy an allied landmark or one of your mana gems to deal 4 to a unit.
05SH007.descriptionRaw: Destroy an allied landmark or one of your mana gems to deal 4 to a unit.
05SH007.flavorText: "A small sacrifice in exchange for great power." - Xerath
05SH007.name: Rite of the Arcane

05SH007T1.description: Destroy an allied landmark to deal 4 to a unit.
05SH007T1.descriptionRaw: Destroy an allied landmark to deal 4 to a unit.
05SH007T1.name: Rite of the Arcane

05SH007T2.description: Destroy one of your mana gems to deal 4 to a unit.
05SH007T2.descriptionRaw: Destroy one of your mana gems to deal 4 to a unit.
05SH007T2.name: Rite of the Arcane

05NX009.description: When I'm summoned or discarded, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Twinblade Revenant</style></link> in hand.
05NX009.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned or discarded, create a Twinblade Revenant in hand.
05NX009.flavorText: The Demacians crawled to their ramparts to find death itself descending upon their walls. Though they were able to fell some of the Gray Legion, the dark tide of war soon proved unstoppable.
05NX009.name: Lost Soul

05NX006.description:
To play, discard 1.
When I'm discarded, summon an exact copy of me.
05NX006.descriptionRaw:
To play, discard 1.
When I'm discarded, summon an exact copy of me.
05NX006.flavorText:
"We have an irregularity in our midst. Though most of those we revive abhor their return to life, this fellow seems to both understand his lot, and revels in the subsequent opportunities. Curious."
- Notes from Dr. Esslanger
05NX006.name: Reborn Grenadier

05NX017.description: When I'm summoned, grant <link=keyword.Reckless><sprite name=Reckless><style=Keyword>Can't Block</style></link> to the <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> enemy.
05NX017.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, grant Can't Block to the weakest enemy.
05NX017.flavorText:
"It was the good Lady's suggestion that finally woke the creature. A small dose of iodine salt into the bloodstream, lethal to any mortal, but simply agonizing to our patient. To the risen, there is no greater motivator than pain."
- Notes from Dr. Esslanger
05NX017.name: Risen Reckoner

05NX005.description: When I'm discarded, grant your <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> ally +2|+0.
05NX005.descriptionRaw: When I'm discarded, grant your strongest ally +2|+0.
05NX005.flavorText: As Lady Noradi's powers grew, she pondered whether her powers would take root in the corpses lining Noxus's oldest tombs. She found the light of life a mere flicker in the husks, but from those wilting flames, the shadows of war still danced.
05NX005.name: Ancient Warmonger

05NX001.description:
When I'm discarded, grant your <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> ally <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link> and place me into your deck.
I have +1|+0 for each card you've discarded this game (Max +7|+0).
05NX001.descriptionRaw:
When I'm discarded, grant your strongest ally Overwhelm and place me into your deck.
I have +1|+0 for each card you've discarded this game (Max +7|+0).
05NX001.flavorText: Sion glimpsed fleeting flashes of opaque memories. Legions standing before him. Accolades. Crowns. War. A king's deathrattle. The Great Nothing. Blood. But just as soon as they floated by, they floated past, pale ribbons in the wind.
05NX001.name: Sion

05NX003.description:
To play, discard a card.
Summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Reborn Grenadier</style></link> and give it +2|+0 this round.
05NX003.descriptionRaw:
To play, discard a card.
Summon a Reborn Grenadier and give it +2|+0 this round.
05NX003.flavorText: "Rise again, my child..." - Dr. Esslanger, Pensive Physician
05NX003.name: Salt And Stitches

05NX015.description:
When I'm summoned, grant <link=keyword.Reckless><sprite name=Reckless><style=Keyword>Can't Block</style></link> to the <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> enemy.
<link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Risen Reckoner</style></link> in hand.
05NX015.descriptionRaw:
When I'm summoned, grant Can't Block to the weakest enemy.
Last Breath: Create a Risen Reckoner in hand.
05NX015.flavorText:
"The first minotaurs I revived were docile, useless beasts. Neither the thrum of war nor the threat of death could stir their senses."
- Notes from Dr. Esslanger
05NX015.name: Fallen Reckoner

05NX019.descriptionRaw: Reputation: I cost 3 less.  Summon 2 Trifarian Gloryseekers.
05NX019.flavorText: Those seeking glory will stop at nothing to find it.
05NX019.name: For Glory!

05NX013.description: When I'm discarded, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Risen Rider</style></link> in hand.
05NX013.descriptionRaw: When I'm discarded, create a Risen Rider in hand.
05NX013.flavorText:
"It was only after rubbing the rider's armor with Blackshade leaves that they were spared from the basilisk's viciousness. The plants are native to the hinterlands, just as the beasts, and are as pungent as they are poisonous."
- Notes from Dr. Esslanger
05NX013.name: Fallen Rider

05NX018.flavorText: "Upon the night, death rode." - The Lady of Blood
05NX018.name: Risen Rider

05NX001T1.flavorText:
"Though the fog lingers as we first wake Sion, the full spectrum of war stirs a life within him that is both furious and reluctant to end."
- Notes from Dr. Esslanger
05NX001T1.name: Sion Returned

05NX001T3.description:
<link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Summon <link=card.transform><style=AssociatedCard>Sion Returned</style></link>. 
When I'm discarded, grant your <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> ally <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link> and place me into your deck.
05NX001T3.descriptionRaw:
Last Breath: Summon Sion Returned. 
When I'm discarded, grant your strongest ally Overwhelm and place me into your deck.
05NX001T3.flavorText: Through the din of battle, he remembered. He remembered his life, a proud servant of Noxus. A revered general who gave his life felling Demacia's king. He remembered his death, and the empty expanse that followed. His was a good life, and a good death. But this... this was madness.
05NX001T3.name: Sion

05NX001T2.description:
To play, discard 1. Kill the <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> enemy.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Sion</style></link> in your deck.
05NX001T2.descriptionRaw:
To play, discard 1. Kill the weakest enemy.
Create a Sion in your deck.
05NX001T2.name: Sion's Roar of the Slayer

05NX012.description: To play, discard 1. Kill the <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> enemy.
05NX012.descriptionRaw: To play, discard 1. Kill the weakest enemy.
05NX012.name: Roar of the Slayer

05NX014.description: Deal 3 to a unit and summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Trifarian Shieldbreaker</style></link>.
05NX014.descriptionRaw: Deal 3 to a unit and summon a Trifarian Shieldbreaker.
05NX014.name: Weapons of the Lost

05NX007.description: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Lost Soul</style></link> in hand.
05NX007.descriptionRaw: Last Breath: Create a Lost Soul in hand.
05NX007.flavorText:
"The Demacians palpably lost their will to fight upon seeing our fallen--who were so selflessly cut down by those brave Vanguard--rise once more. Victory was never in question."
- Excerpt from the Lady of Blood's field report, recipient unknown
05NX007.name: Twinblade Revenant

05NX004.descriptionRaw: Play: Discard 1 to draw a unit.
05NX004.flavorText: Dr. Esslanger was once a respected and retiring physician who garnered his credible reputation through years of hard work. But it wasn't until a young noblewoman was brought to his study, her blood blackened by betrayal, that he truly began serving Noxus.
05NX004.name: Grave Physician

05NX016.description: When a non-<link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> ally in hand is discarded, create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> copy of it in hand.
05NX016.descriptionRaw: When a non-Fleeting ally in hand is discarded, create a Fleeting copy of it in hand.
05NX016.flavorText: Under cover of night, Lady Faris Noradi led her Gray Legion out of the Noxian capital. It took three hard, bloody weeks, but they finally neared the small Demacian outpost her scouts had identified. It was time for the demonstration.
05NX016.name: The Lady of Blood

05NX002.description: Grant me +2|+1 once you've discarded 3+ cards this game. <style=Variable></style>
05NX002.descriptionRaw: Grant me +2|+1 once you've discarded 3+ cards this game.
05NX002.flavorText: "What could better instill loyalty in a would-be traitor than the sight of a butchered conspirator, brought back to fight under the Noxian banner? They will all serve, one way or another." - The Lady of Blood
05NX002.name: Noble Rebel

05BW005.description: When you play a spell, grant +1|+0 to the <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> other ally that isn't <link=keyword.Immobile><sprite name=Immobile><sprite name=Reckless><style=Keyword>Immobile</style></link>.
05BW005.descriptionRaw: When you play a spell, grant +1|+0 to the weakest other ally that isn't Immobile.
05BW005.levelupDescription: You've played 5+ spells with an allied Nami in play.<style=Variable></style>
05BW005.levelupDescriptionRaw: You've played 5+ spells with an allied Nami in play.
05BW005.flavorText:
"Have you said your goodbyes, young Tidecaller?"
"Yes, greatmother."
"Are you afraid?"
"...Yes, greatmother."
"Good. To be afraid is to be cautious. But trust yourself, as we trust you. Now, go. And may the currents keep you."
05BW005.name: Nami

05BW005T2.description:
Deal 2 randomly to an enemy or the enemy Nexus and create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Flow</style></link> in hand.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Nami</style></link> in your deck.
05BW005T2.descriptionRaw:
Deal 2 randomly to an enemy or the enemy Nexus and create a Flow in hand.
Create a Nami in your deck.
05BW005T2.name: Nami's Ebb

05BW005T1.description: When you play a spell, grant +2|+1 to the <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> other ally that isn't <link=keyword.Immobile><sprite name=Immobile><sprite name=Reckless><style=Keyword>Immobile</style></link>.
05BW005T1.descriptionRaw: When you play a spell, grant +2|+1 to the weakest other ally that isn't Immobile.
05BW005T1.flavorText:
"Do you think she's far along in her journey?"
"We can only hope, Tama."
"I can see her now... Beautiful eyes glowing in the light of the moon, the shine of saltwater glistening on her scales."
"This burden... the fate of our people. It should not be hers alone."
"She is doing her part, as we are doing ours, Loto. All we can do is believe in her, and love her with all our hearts."
05BW005T1.name: Nami

05BW006.description: Deal 2 randomly to an enemy or the enemy Nexus and create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Flow</style></link> in hand.
05BW006.descriptionRaw: Deal 2 randomly to an enemy or the enemy Nexus and create a Flow in hand.
05BW006.name: Ebb

05BW006T2.description: Heal an ally or your Nexus 2, and create an <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Ebb and Flow</style></link> in hand.
05BW006T2.descriptionRaw: Heal an ally or your Nexus 2, and create an Ebb and Flow in hand.
05BW006T2.name: Flow

05BW006T1.description: Deal 2 randomly to an enemy or the enemy Nexus and heal an ally or your Nexus 2.
05BW006T1.descriptionRaw: Deal 2 randomly to an enemy or the enemy Nexus and heal an ally or your Nexus 2.
05BW006T1.flavorText: "I decide what the tide will bring." - Nami
05BW006T1.name: Ebb and Flow

05BW002.flavorText: "Sure, a few of 'em hunt us, like they hunt everything. But y'know, most landwalkers I meet are just looking to enjoy their time in the big blue, same as us. We're all just people."
05BW002.name: Journeying Sandhopper

05BW008.description: When you play a spell, give me +2|+0 this round.
05BW008.descriptionRaw: When you play a spell, give me +2|+0 this round.
05BW008.flavorText: "Many of our tribe find Loto somewhat unnerving. They see only a tireless fighter, and the distance in his troubled gaze. But I know what's truly in his heart--fear that he is not strong enough to save us... and extraordinary love." - Tama, Marai Songstress
05BW008.name: Abyssal Guard

05BW011.description: When you play 2 spells each round, grant other allies +1|+1. <style=Variable></style>
05BW011.descriptionRaw: When you play 2 spells each round, grant other allies +1|+1.
05BW011.flavorText: "LISTEN HERE, SOWDIER. I'LL HAVE YOU KNOW I HAVE OVA FWEE-HUNDWED CONFIRMED KWILLS AND I'M DA TOP ADMIWAL IN ALL DA MAWINE'S FORCES SO WHEN I SAY SWIM, YOU BETTA SWIM, OKAY? OKAY THANK YOU!"
05BW011.name: Fleet Admiral Shelly

05BW003.description: Deal 1 to two different randomly targeted enemies and create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Crashing Wave</style></link> in your deck.
05BW003.descriptionRaw: Deal 1 to two different randomly targeted enemies and create a Crashing Wave in your deck.
05BW003.name: Tidal Wave

05BW003T1.description: Deal 2 to four different randomly targeted enemies and create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Colossal Wave</style></link> in your deck.
05BW003T1.descriptionRaw: Deal 2 to four different randomly targeted enemies and create a Colossal Wave in your deck.
05BW003T1.name: Crashing Wave

05BW003T2.description: Deal 4 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus.
05BW003T2.descriptionRaw: Deal 4 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus.
05BW003T2.name: Colossal Wave

05BW004.description:
If you would get a mana gem, instead refill your spell mana.
When you play a spell, create in hand a random spell that costs 3 or less and grant it <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>.
05BW004.descriptionRaw:
If you would get a mana gem, instead refill your spell mana.
When you play a spell, create in hand a random spell that costs 3 or less and grant it Fleeting.
05BW004.flavorText: To the Marai, the Leo'lei is a herald of great change. It is said each flourish of its graceful wings influences the flow of the tides.
05BW004.name: Avatar of the Tides

05BW001.description: When I'm summoned, summon a random 1 cost follower.
05BW001.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, summon a random 1 cost follower.
05BW001.flavorText: The Marai rarely desire to venture far from home. But Ai'la was born with curiosity in her heart--and though she is bound by duty to her tribe, she spends each waking moment dreaming of the day she can truly be free.
05BW001.name: Marai Warden

05BW010.description: When I'm summoned, create in deck 5 random 6+ cost spells and reduce their costs to 3.
05BW010.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, create in deck 5 random 6+ cost spells and reduce their costs to 3.
05BW010.flavorText: The Marai's ancestral home is protected by the celestial light of a moonstone. Every hundred years, its light begins to wane, and a new Tidecaller is tasked with finding another--for without it, the Marai people would be plunged into darkness, and fall prey to the horrors that lurk in the depths.
05BW010.name: Marai Greatmother

05BW013.description: When I'm summoned, if you've played a spell this round, grant me <link=keyword.Elusive><sprite name=Elusive><style=Keyword>Elusive</style></link>.
05BW013.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, if you've played a spell this round, grant me Elusive.
05BW013.flavorText:
"The ocean believes that the wave will return,
gives trust to the ebb, to the flow, to the churn.
So 'ere the wave crashes against the shore, 
the ocean delights in the crest's bold roar."
- A verse from 'Serenade for the Tidecaller'
05BW013.name: Marai Songstress

05PZ015.description: Whenever your opponent draws, plant 1 <link=card.shuffle><style=AssociatedCard>Flashbomb Trap</style></link> in the top 8 cards of the enemy deck.
05PZ015.descriptionRaw: Whenever your opponent draws, plant 1 Flashbomb Trap in the top 8 cards of the enemy deck.
05PZ015.flavorText:
"Officer was witnessed pursuing suspect at a high speed into a trap of her own making. Following the arrest, officer proceeded to submit her own speeding citation and fine, claiming (somewhat dramatically) 'Justice is a two-way street.'" 
- Excerpt from a Warden beat report
05PZ015.name: Justice Rider

05PZ012.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Pick a spell in the top 5 cards of your deck and create an exact <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> copy in hand, then place those top 5 cards into your deck
05PZ012.descriptionRaw: Play: Pick a spell in the top 5 cards of your deck and create an exact Fleeting copy in hand, then place those top 5 cards into your deck
05PZ012.flavorText: Detectives are nothing without leads. An archivist's job is to collect every scrap of intel and create new possibilities where none previously existed.
05PZ012.name: Station Archivist

05PZ019.description: Pick a player to discard their lowest cost card to draw 3.
05PZ019.descriptionRaw: Pick a player to discard their lowest cost card to draw 3.
05PZ019.name: Most Wanted

05PZ023.flavorText: "Yeah so I've been 'elping Jayce an' them lot 'tinker around with this new thing. Powerformative technology, we call it. Truth be told, Jayce said I'll be listed as co-inventor once the documentation's done! Them bigwigs know where the real smarts is, eh?"
05PZ023.name: Forge Worker

05PZ031.description: When I'm summoned, draw <link=card.champ1><style=AssociatedCard>Jayce</style></link>. <link=keyword.AttackSkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Attack</style></link>: Deal 3 to the enemy Nexus. For each 6+ cost spell you've played this game, increase it by 1.
05PZ031.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, draw Jayce. Attack: Deal 3 to the enemy Nexus. For each 6+ cost spell you've played this game, increase it by 1.
05PZ031.flavorText:
"The magnanimous Albus Ferros has once again THRUST himself into the spotlight, dramatically outbidding Clans Cadwalder and Giopara for the rights to sponsor Jayce's Hexgate research. 'A fine day for Ferros is a fine day for Piltover', as the saying goes, and yesterday was a very fine day for Clan Ferros, indeed!"
- Excerpt from a sponsored spread in the Piltover Daily
05PZ031.name: Albus Ferros

05PZ031T1.flavorText: "First, the investment. Then, the dividend." - Albus Ferros
05PZ031T1.name: Ferros' Dividend

05PZ027.description: Deal 3 to an enemy or the enemy Nexus, and 3 to another.
05PZ027.descriptionRaw: Deal 3 to an enemy or the enemy Nexus, and 3 to another.
05PZ027.name: Shock Blast

05PZ022.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant me <link=keyword.Quick Strike><sprite name=QuickStrike><style=Keyword>Quick Attack</style></link> or <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link>.
05PZ022.descriptionRaw: Play: Grant me Quick Attack or Challenger.
05PZ022.levelupDescription: You've played two 6+ cost spells. <style=Variable></style> When I level up, create an <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Acceleration Gate</style></link> in hand.
05PZ022.levelupDescriptionRaw: You've played two 6+ cost spells.  When I level up, create an Acceleration Gate in hand.
05PZ022.flavorText:
"So, Rosa, as you know, this powerformative tech promises to change the world."
"Truly groundbreaking work, Jayce. The way those coinhiberators splice together. It's breathtaking."
"It sure is. All Axel's idea, too! Right, my good man?"
"Well, you know me, mate. Don't like to brag..."
05PZ022.name: Jayce

05PZ022T8.description: Each round, the first time you play a 6+ cost spell, copy it with the same targets.
05PZ022T8.descriptionRaw: Each round, the first time you play a 6+ cost spell, copy it with the same targets.
05PZ022T8.flavorText: "Cannon's primed, and hammer's engaged. This is going to be one for the history books, folks."
05PZ022T8.name: Jayce

05PZ022T1.description:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant me <link=keyword.Quick Strike><sprite name=QuickStrike><style=Keyword>Quick Attack</style></link> or <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link>.
Each round, the first time you play a 6+ cost spell, copy it with the same targets.
05PZ022T1.descriptionRaw:
Play: Grant me Quick Attack or Challenger.
Each round, the first time you play a 6+ cost spell, copy it with the same targets.
05PZ022T1.flavorText: "Cannon's primed, and hammer's engaged. This is going to be one for the history books, folks."
05PZ022T1.name: Jayce

05PZ022T2.description: Deal 3 to an enemy or the enemy Nexus, and 3 to another. Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Jayce</style></link> in your deck.
05PZ022T2.descriptionRaw: Deal 3 to an enemy or the enemy Nexus, and 3 to another. Create a Jayce in your deck.
05PZ022T2.name: Jayce's Shock Blast

05PZ022T7.levelupDescription: You've played two 6+ cost spells. <style=Variable></style> When I level up, create an <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Acceleration Gate</style></link> in hand.
05PZ022T7.levelupDescriptionRaw: You've played two 6+ cost spells.  When I level up, create an Acceleration Gate in hand.
05PZ022T7.flavorText:
"So, Rosa, as you know, this powerformative tech promises to change the world."
"Truly groundbreaking work, Jayce. The way those coinhiberators splice together. It's breathtaking."
"It sure is. All Axel's idea, too! Right, my good man?"
"Well, you know me, mate. Don't like to brag..."
05PZ022T7.name: Jayce

05PZ022T6.levelupDescription: You've played two 6+ cost spells. <style=Variable></style> When I level up, create an <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Acceleration Gate</style></link> in hand.
05PZ022T6.levelupDescriptionRaw: You've played two 6+ cost spells.  When I level up, create an Acceleration Gate in hand.
05PZ022T6.flavorText:
"So, Rosa, as you know, this powerformative tech promises to change the world."
"Truly groundbreaking work, Jayce. The way those coinhiberators splice together. It's breathtaking."
"It sure is. All Axel's idea, too! Right, my good man?"
"Well, you know me, mate. Don't like to brag..."
05PZ022T6.name: Jayce

05PZ022T9.description: Each round, the first time you play a 6+ cost spell, copy it with the same targets.
05PZ022T9.descriptionRaw: Each round, the first time you play a 6+ cost spell, copy it with the same targets.
05PZ022T9.flavorText: "Cannon's primed, and hammer's engaged. This is going to be one for the history books, folks."
05PZ022T9.name: Jayce

05PZ022T3.description: Give allies +2|+0 and <link=keyword.Quick Strike><sprite name=QuickStrike><style=Keyword>Quick Attack</style></link> this round. If they already have it or <link=keyword.Double Strike><sprite name=DoubleStrike><style=Keyword>Double Attack</style></link>, give them a random keyword instead.
05PZ022T3.descriptionRaw: Give allies +2|+0 and Quick Attack this round. If they already have it or Double Attack, give them a random keyword instead.
05PZ022T3.name: Acceleration Gate

05PZ017.description: Deal 2 to a unit. If you've added 2+ cards to your hand this round, deal 3 to it instead.
05PZ017.descriptionRaw: Deal 2 to a unit. If you've added 2+ cards to your hand this round, deal 3 to it instead.
05PZ017.flavorText: "Better let 'em air out a minute. Greenies can't take the smell. But lemme tells ya... once you're accustomed, nothin' like it!" - Puffcap Peddler
05PZ017.name: Sump Fumes

05PZ013.description: Deal 2 to a unit and plant 2 <link=card.shuffle><style=AssociatedCard>Flashbomb Traps</style></link> in the top 8 cards of the enemy deck.
05PZ013.descriptionRaw: Deal 2 to a unit and plant 2 Flashbomb Traps in the top 8 cards of the enemy deck.
05PZ013.name: Piltover Peacemaker

05PZ020.description: Give an ally +2|+0 this round. If you've added 2+ cards to your hand this round, give it <link=keyword.Elusive><sprite name=Elusive><style=Keyword>Elusive</style></link> this round.
05PZ020.descriptionRaw: Give an ally +2|+0 this round. If you've added 2+ cards to your hand this round, give it Elusive this round.
05PZ020.flavorText: "We'll surround the location while using smokespinners to mask our movements..." - Caitlyn
05PZ020.name: Ambush

05PZ024.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> a 6+ cost spell from your regions.
05PZ024.descriptionRaw: Play: Manifest a 6+ cost spell from your regions.
05PZ024.flavorText:
"About the only good part of Ferros financing my work was getting to team up with Reggie. Not only is the man one of the most competent people I've ever worked with, he's a heck of a guy, too."
- Excerpt from Jayce's journal
05PZ024.name: Ferros Financier

05PZ010.description:
Plant 2 <link=card.shuffle><style=AssociatedCard>Flashbomb Traps</style></link> in the top 8 cards of the enemy deck.
Draw 1.
05PZ010.descriptionRaw:
Plant 2 Flashbomb Traps in the top 8 cards of the enemy deck.
Draw 1.
05PZ010.name: Advanced Intel

05PZ014.description: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Plant 5 <link=card.shuffle><style=AssociatedCard>Flashbomb Traps</style></link> in the top 5 cards of the enemy deck or activate the effects of all traps in the top 5 cards of the enemy deck.
05PZ014.descriptionRaw: Play: Plant 5 Flashbomb Traps in the top 5 cards of the enemy deck or activate the effects of all traps in the top 5 cards of the enemy deck.
05PZ014.flavorText: Corina smiled as the Piltover Wardens burst down her door, as they trampled her precious flowers underfoot, as they sent up clouds of toxic pollen. All as planned.
05PZ014.name: Corina, Mastermind

05PZ014T1.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Plant 5 <link=card.shuffle><style=AssociatedCard>Flashbomb Traps</style></link> in the top 5 cards of the enemy deck.
05PZ014T1.descriptionRaw: Play: Plant 5 Flashbomb Traps in the top 5 cards of the enemy deck.
05PZ014T1.name: Beguiling Blossom

05PZ014T2.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Activate the effects of all traps in the top 5 cards of the enemy deck.
05PZ014T2.descriptionRaw: Play: Activate the effects of all traps in the top 5 cards of the enemy deck.
05PZ014T2.flavorText: "Right where I want you." - Corina Veraza
05PZ014T2.name: Volatile Bloom

05PZ002.flavorText: "This a popular case, you know. Just had a chap in here earlier looking at it. Enjoy!" - Station Archivist
05PZ002.name: Insider Knowledge

05PZ008.description: Deal 1 damage to a random ally.
05PZ008.descriptionRaw: Deal 1 damage to a random ally.
05PZ008.name: Flashbomb Trap

05PZ021.description: When I am summoned, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Forge Worker</style></link>. When you play a 6+ cost spell, destroy me and refill your spell mana.
05PZ021.descriptionRaw: When I am summoned, summon a Forge Worker. When you play a 6+ cost spell, destroy me and refill your spell mana.
05PZ021.flavorText: If Piltover is a city driven by invention, then its forges are its engines.
05PZ021.name: The Forge Of Tomorrow

05PZ025.flavorText: "Takes two things to get an idea off the page and into your hands. Funding's one half of the equation, the other's a good forge. And it's not just the tools or the hardware in the forge; if your chief doesn't have what it takes to run things, well, your idea's staying on paper." - Jayce
05PZ025.name: Forge Chief

05PZ006.description: <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>Strike</style></link>: Plant 2 <link=card.shuffle><style=AssociatedCard>Flashbomb Traps</style></link> in the top 8 cards of the enemy deck.
05PZ006.descriptionRaw: Strike: Plant 2 Flashbomb Traps in the top 8 cards of the enemy deck.
05PZ006.levelupDescription: 5+ of your traps have been activated.<style=Variable></style>
05PZ006.levelupDescriptionRaw: 5+ of your traps have been activated.
05PZ006.flavorText: Caitlyn was always a dogged and thorough investigator, a quality that helped propel her fast through the ranks of Piltover enforcement. But when a case concerning a certain 'C' came along, one that countless other enforcers had abandoned, it seemed almost as though Caitlyn had finally met her match. Almost.
05PZ006.name: Caitlyn

05PZ004.description: When Iâ€™m summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Most Wanted</style></link> in hand.
05PZ004.descriptionRaw: When Iâ€™m summoned, create a Most Wanted in hand.
05PZ004.flavorText: From unloading silently into the street to prepping the ram, setup didn't take long. It was just a matter of waiting on Caitlyn's cue.
05PZ004.name: Officer Squad

05PZ009.description: <link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Plant 2 <link=card.shuffle><style=AssociatedCard>Flashbomb Traps</style></link> in the top 8 cards of the enemy deck.
05PZ009.descriptionRaw: Nexus Strike: Plant 2 Flashbomb Traps in the top 8 cards of the enemy deck.
05PZ009.flavorText: Zayne Asako, like all Zaunite kids, had to grow up fast on those violent and dark understreets. After losing his brother to yet another senseless gang crime, he committed himself to Piltover enforcement, hoping reason and law would make his home finally safe.
05PZ009.name: Sting Officer

05PZ016.description: Place an enemy follower into the enemy deck, then your opponent draws 1.
05PZ016.descriptionRaw: Place an enemy follower into the enemy deck, then your opponent draws 1.
05PZ016.flavorText: The grand city of Piltover is home to some of the finest minds in Runeterra. Piltover's jails are also home to some of the finest minds in Runeterra.
05PZ016.name: Coup de Grace

05PZ030.description: When you draw or create me in hand or each <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: while I'm in hand, transform me into a random 6+ cost spell.
05PZ030.descriptionRaw: When you draw or create me in hand or each Round Start: while I'm in hand, transform me into a random 6+ cost spell.
05PZ030.flavorText:
"...configuring hextech into a stable state was the most difficult hurdle I faced. Most nights, it felt like the crystals and hexite were actively conspiring to trip me up, and it was only through extensive trial and error that I was able to get the component parts working in harmony..."
- Excerpt from Jayce's journal
05PZ030.name: Hextech Anomaly

05PZ028.description: Grant me +2|+0 once you've played a 6+ cost spell this game.
05PZ028.descriptionRaw: Grant me +2|+0 once you've played a 6+ cost spell this game.
05PZ028.flavorText: "The people of this city worship at the feet of 'intelligence'. But what good is the greatest mind without the means to express itself? No. I will show Piltover true greatness. It will tower over them. It will blot out the sun. And it will carry my name." - Albus Ferros
05PZ028.name: Ferros Skycruiser

05PZ038.description: Deal 4 to an enemy and 1 to all other enemies.
05PZ038.descriptionRaw: Deal 4 to an enemy and 1 to all other enemies.
05PZ038.flavorText: "They're supposed to go up, not EVERYWHERE! Oh, my!" - Heimerdinger
05PZ038.name: Rocket Barrage

05PZ035.description: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Create a copy of me in the enemy deck with 2 <link=card.shuffle><style=AssociatedCard>Poison Puffcaps</style></link> attached.
05PZ035.descriptionRaw: Last Breath: Create a copy of me in the enemy deck with 2 Poison Puffcaps attached.
05PZ035.flavorText: The stink of a whump in the height of puffcap season is unlike any other. Imagine an open sewer full of week-old fish and rotten eggs, and you're halfway there.
05PZ035.name: Stinky Whump

05PZ006T2.description: <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>Strike</style></link>: Plant 4 <link=card.shuffle><style=AssociatedCard>Flashbomb Traps</style></link> in the top 8 cards of the enemy deck and deal damage to the enemy Nexus equal to the number of your traps activated this round. <style=Variable></style>
05PZ006T2.descriptionRaw: Strike: Plant 4 Flashbomb Traps in the top 8 cards of the enemy deck and deal damage to the enemy Nexus equal to the number of your traps activated this round.
05PZ006T2.flavorText: She burst in, leveled her rifle at the culprit, and looked down the scope. There, smiling through the looking glass, was a familiar face.
05PZ006T2.name: Caitlyn

05PZ006T1.description:
Deal 2 to a unit and plant 2 <link=card.shuffle><style=AssociatedCard>Flashbomb Traps</style></link> in the top 8 cards of the enemy deck.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Caitlyn</style></link> in your deck.
05PZ006T1.descriptionRaw:
Deal 2 to a unit and plant 2 Flashbomb Traps in the top 8 cards of the enemy deck.
Create a Caitlyn in your deck.
05PZ006T1.name: Caitlyn's Piltover Peacemaker

05PZ029.description: Grant Tech allies <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +1|+0 once you've played a 6+ cost spell this game.
05PZ029.descriptionRaw: Grant Tech allies everywhere +1|+0 once you've played a 6+ cost spell this game.
05PZ029.flavorText: The Hextech Handler was initially constructed to transport raw materials through Piltover, but as time went on, the locals apparently developed a soft spot for him. Jayce's forge crew nicknamed him Nugget, a Piltovan lord reportedly donated a hat, and passing kids now adorn him with whatever they have to hand.
05PZ029.name: Hextech Handler

05SI014.description: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Create in hand a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> copy of a non-<link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> spell you played last round.
05SI014.descriptionRaw: Round Start: Create in hand a Fleeting copy of a non-Fleeting spell you played last round.
