05SI014.flavorText: The Blessed Isles forget. The Shadow Isles remember. The Shadow Isles forget. The Blessed Isles remember.
05SI014.name: Catalogue of Regrets

05SI013.description: Each round, the first time you kill a unit with a spell, summon an <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Mistwraith</style></link>.
05SI013.descriptionRaw: Each round, the first time you kill a unit with a spell, summon an Ephemeral Mistwraith.
05SI013.flavorText: The Black Mist traps its victims in endless cycles of self-imposed torment. Through the Mistcatchers, Tek and Kana give those souls a chance to break that cycle for themselves.
05SI013.name: Mistkeepers

05SI009.description: When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Darkness</style></link> in hand if you don't have one. Your damage and kill spells accelerate to <link=keyword.Fast><sprite name=Fast><style=Keyword>Fast</style></link>.
05SI009.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned or Attack: Create a Darkness in hand if you don't have one. Your damage and kill spells accelerate to Fast.
05SI009.levelupDescription: I've seen you kill 3+ units with spells or an allied Lucian die.<style=Variable></style>
05SI009.levelupDescriptionRaw: I've seen you kill 3+ units with spells or an allied Lucian die.
05SI009.flavorText: "To be a Sentinel is to fight. To lose yourself or to lose the ones you love. But more than that? It means to live. For yourself... and for the ones you love."
05SI009.name: Senna

05SI016.description: Kill a unit and give all enemies <nobr>-2|-0</nobr> this round.
05SI016.descriptionRaw: Kill a unit and give all enemies -2|-0 this round.
05SI016.flavorText: "No shadow without light. No death without life." - Senna
05SI016.name: Dawning Shadow

05SI004.description: Each round, the first time you kill a unit with a spell, deal 2 to the enemy Nexus.
05SI004.descriptionRaw: Each round, the first time you kill a unit with a spell, deal 2 to the enemy Nexus.
05SI004.flavorText: "Pups is pups." - Wisdom scrawled upon the soul
05SI004.name: Watcher on the Isles

05SI012.description: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Darkness</style></link> in hand if you don't have one.
05SI012.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, create a Darkness in hand if you don't have one.
05SI012.flavorText: "I can feel the sun no longer. Even so, I wield its memory--and that is enough."
05SI012.name: Solari Sentinel

05SI008.description: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Darkness</style></link> in hand if you don't have one. When you play your next <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Darkness</style></link> this round, copy it targeting the enemy Nexus.
05SI008.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, create a Darkness in hand if you don't have one. When you play your next Darkness this round, copy it targeting the enemy Nexus.
05SI008.flavorText: "You asked me, Senna, what brought me to this fight. I have lost nothing to the Mist, it does not threaten my home. It exists, and it should not. I am here to discover why. Do I need sentiment to join your cause?"
05SI008.name: Ixtali Sentinel

05SI029.flavorText: There is a little of fear in everything. It lays quietly at the heart of mystery. It is the spark of joy in awe and wonder. It grants life its purpose - death, its power. It is everything. It is nothing.
05SI029.name: Darkness

05SI010.description: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Darkness</style></link> in hand if you don't have one. Your next <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Darkness</style></link> this round costs 0 and gains â€œI deal damage to all enemy targets.â€
05SI010.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, create a Darkness in hand if you don't have one. Your next Darkness this round costs 0 and gains â€œI deal damage to all enemy targets.â€
05SI010.flavorText:
"Another nightmare?"
"Wasn't all bad. You weren't there."
"Dolt. What was the bad part?"
"You weren't there."
05SI010.name: Dess & Ada

05SI009T1.description: When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Darkness</style></link> in hand if you don't have one. Your damage and kill spells accelerate to <link=keyword.Fast><sprite name=Fast><style=Keyword>Fast</style></link> and cost 1 less.
05SI009T1.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned or Attack: Create a Darkness in hand if you don't have one. Your damage and kill spells accelerate to Fast and cost 1 less.
05SI009T1.flavorText: "We were wrong. The Black Mist isn't heartless. It's not random. It has a goal. But that means we can track it. Means it can bleed."
05SI009T1.name: Senna

05SI009T2.description:
Kill a unit and give all enemies <nobr>-2|-0</nobr> this round.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Senna</style></link> in your deck.
05SI009T2.descriptionRaw:
Kill a unit and give all enemies -2|-0 this round.
Create a Senna in your deck.
05SI009T2.flavorText: "No shadow without light. No death without life." - Senna
05SI009T2.name: Senna's Dawning Shadow

05SI011.description: The first time you kill a unit with a spell, grant me +2|+1.
05SI011.descriptionRaw: The first time you kill a unit with a spell, grant me +2|+1.
05SI011.flavorText: What must the Mist see when it looks upon Maeve? Exuberance, confidence--irrepressible optimism. How it must long to snuff that taunting flame. For what can death fear, but life?
05SI011.name: Burgeoning Sentinel

05SI015.description: The first time you kill a unit with a spell, grant me +2|+1.
05SI015.descriptionRaw: The first time you kill a unit with a spell, grant me +2|+1.
05SI015.flavorText: The Buhru and Sentinel philosophy align on a single crucial point: all things must end, and some must be made to end.
05SI015.name: Buhru Sentinel

05MT004.description: When I'm summoned, if you've targeted allies in 4 different rounds, grant me <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>Spellshield</style></link>, <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link>, and <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link>. <style=Variable></style>
05MT004.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, if you've targeted allies in 4 different rounds, grant me Spellshield, Overwhelm, and Challenger.
05MT004.flavorText: For centuries, the demon Camphor stalked the lands of Targon, pulling from her victims the very strengths that defined them. From the mighty, she would take strength; from the wise, wisdom. But she had no interest in these boons. Instead, she feasted on the suffering, doubt, and misery she inflicted. Camphor was a monster in every sense of the word.
05MT004.name: Camphor, the Doubt

05MT006.flavorText: "Targonians need no further proof of the gods' cruelty. Look at what they have done to us. Look at what they have done to our most cherished companions." - Pantheon
05MT006.name: Wounded Whiteflame

05MT008.description: Grant an ally +1|+1 and <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy.
05MT008.descriptionRaw: Grant an ally +1|+1 and Stun an enemy.
05MT008.flavorText: Pantheon was well-versed in warfare. He knew from countless fights that his enemies would always track his spear, and rarely his shield.
05MT008.name: Shield Vault

05MT014.flavorText: "Targon's night sky is a wondrous thing of unimaginable beauty. It is all too easy to lose oneself gazing at that expanse, not knowing how far the stars stretch, and what manner of being might be looking back..." - Targonian climber
05MT014.name: Celestial Wonder

05MT003.levelupDescription: You've targeted allies in 5+ different rounds.<style=Variable></style>
05MT003.levelupDescriptionRaw: You've targeted allies in 5+ different rounds.
05MT003.flavorText: Here stands Atreus, who had his freedoms stripped from him by the very Aspects he revered. Here stands the embers of War, who left Atreus with gifts few mortals can comprehend. Here stands a man, ready to fight and die for those he cherishes.
05MT003.name: Pantheon

05MT013.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant an ally <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>Spellshield</style></link> or <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link>. If you don't, grant it to me.
05MT013.descriptionRaw: Play: Grant an ally Spellshield or Overwhelm. If you don't, grant it to me.
05MT013.flavorText: Iula still remembers the burning grief that coursed through her after she learned of her husband's death. When Pantheon came to her, asking if she would help him destroy a creature that feasted on this very pain, her answer was swift.
05MT013.name: Iula

05MT013T3.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant an ally <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link>. If you don't, grant it to me.
05MT013T3.descriptionRaw: Play: Grant an ally Overwhelm. If you don't, grant it to me.
05MT013T3.name: Iula

05MT013T4.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant an ally <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>Spellshield</style></link>. If you don't, grant it to me.
05MT013T4.descriptionRaw: Play: Grant an ally Spellshield. If you don't, grant it to me.
05MT013T4.name: Iula

05MT009.flavorText: Warring against the gods seemed a fool's errand, but through the scars and through the screams, those brave few learned lessons. The gods thought singularly, selfishly, and had lost the gift of camaraderie. This would be their weapon. This would be their armor.
05MT009.name: Battle Bonds

05MT003T2.description: Once a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Pantheon</style></link> has leveled up, grant me a random keyword for each round you've targeted allies this game. <style=Variable></style>
05MT003T2.descriptionRaw: Once a Pantheon has leveled up, grant me a random keyword for each round you've targeted allies this game.
05MT003T2.flavorText: Here stands Pantheon, who took up his spear and swore to drive all gods and demons from this land we call home.
05MT003T2.name: Pantheon

05MT003T1.description:
Grant an ally +1|+1 and <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Pantheon</style></link> in your deck.
05MT003T1.descriptionRaw:
Grant an ally +1|+1 and Stun an enemy.
Create a Pantheon in your deck.
05MT003T1.flavorText: Pantheon was well-versed in warfare. He knew from countless fights that his enemies would always track his spear, and rarely his shield.
05MT003T1.name: Pantheon's Shield Vault

05MT010.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant an ally +1|+1 and <link=vocab.Silence><style=Vocab>Silence</style></link> an enemy follower.
05MT010.descriptionRaw: Play: Grant an ally +1|+1 and Silence an enemy follower.
05MT010.flavorText: Eshiyme was once a revered oracle who used her Sight to guide those in need. But this gift was stolen from her by Camphor, who intended to feast on her inevitable anguish. How sorely the demon underestimated brave Eshiyme.
05MT010.name: Blinded Mystic

05MT002.flavorText: "It is in the bonds of kinship that we must find our strength." - Pantheon
05MT002.name: We Stand Together

05MT012.description: When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Gem</style></link> in hand.
05MT012.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned or Attack: Create a Gem in hand.
05MT012.flavorText: The colossi are ancient and venerated protectors of Targon's most revered sites. To harm them is to insult the mountain itself. To torture them is a crime no Targonian can forgive.
05MT012.name: Freed Colossus

05MT011.description: If your opponent has more units than you, grant an ally +1|+1 for each extra unit they have.
05MT011.descriptionRaw: If your opponent has more units than you, grant an ally +1|+1 for each extra unit they have.
05MT011.flavorText: These brave few knew they were stepping into warfare with beings of unimaginable power. They knew death was likely. But still, they stepped.
05MT011.name: Against the Odds

05MT005.flavorText: Tor felt his life fading with every heartbeat, but in that grave and looming darkness, where he was expected to embrace dread, he instead found purpose. He would not only face death willingly, but would bring with him the very demon who had dared to cut his life short. This is how he would be remembered. This would be Tor's saga.
05MT005.name: Saga Seeker

05DE003.description:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Swap my Health and your Nexus' Health. 
I can't be blocked by enemies with less Health than me.
05DE003.descriptionRaw:
Play: Swap my Health and your Nexus' Health. 
I can't be blocked by enemies with less Health than me.
05DE003.flavorText:
"An honorable tribute to those gone, but never forgotten: When the people of Demacia see the sun's rays shining off his form, they will know hope, and the indomitable spirit that inspired his construction will live on through him." 
- Durand workshop plaque
05DE003.name: Gorlith the Unscalable

05DE009.description: When I'm summoned, grant other allies +0|+3.
05DE009.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, grant other allies +0|+3.
05DE009.levelupDescription: <link=vocab.RoundEnd><style=Vocab>Round End</style></link>: Your allies have 25+ total Health.<style=Variable></style>
05DE009.levelupDescriptionRaw: Round End: Your allies have 25+ total Health.
05DE009.flavorText: For many years after his creation, Galio lay dormant, unfeeling, unknowing. It wasn't until magic brought him to life and he experienced the resulting thrill of battle that he knew the joy of being among the living. Now, when he slept, he missed such wonderful things!
05DE009.name: Galio

05DE009T3.description: Grant an ally +0|+3. At the next <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>, grant it +0|+2. Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Galio</style></link> in your deck.
05DE009T3.descriptionRaw: Grant an ally +0|+3. At the next Round Start, grant it +0|+2. Create a Galio in your deck.
05DE009T3.flavorText: Even the sight of Galio is enough to inspire the noble hearts of Demacians.
05DE009T3.name: Galio's Shield of Durand

05DE009T1.description:
When I'm summoned, grant other allies +0|+3. 
Each round, the first time an ally takes damage, <link=vocab.Rally><style=Vocab>Rally</style></link>.
05DE009T1.descriptionRaw:
When I'm summoned, grant other allies +0|+3. 
Each round, the first time an ally takes damage, Rally.
05DE009T1.flavorText: When he awoke, Galio was overjoyed to find a whole family had been crafted for him, a facsimile of the same family that would carry on the legacy of his maker for years to come. They were just like him - they wouldn't break.
05DE009T1.name: Galio

05DE020.description: Grant an ally +0|+3. At the next <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>, grant it +0|+2.
05DE020.descriptionRaw: Grant an ally +0|+3. At the next Round Start, grant it +0|+2.
05DE020.flavorText: Even the sight of Galio is enough to inspire the noble hearts of Demacians.
05DE020.name: Shield of Durand

05DE021.description: To play, spend all of your mana. Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Dauntless Vanguard</style></link> and grow its stats to that amount. If 9+ mana was spent, grant other Elite allies +2|+2.
05DE021.descriptionRaw: To play, spend all of your mana. Summon a Dauntless Vanguard and grow its stats to that amount. If 9+ mana was spent, grant other Elite allies +2|+2.
05DE021.flavorText: When it seems all hope is lost, the soldiers of Demacia look to the Vanguard.
05DE021.name: Might of the Vanguard

05DE017.description: Fully heal an ally. Then, that ally and an enemy <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> each other.
05DE017.descriptionRaw: Fully heal an ally. Then, that ally and an enemy strike each other.
05DE017.name: Winds of War

05DE010.description: When you summon another ally, grant it +0|+1.
05DE010.descriptionRaw: When you summon another ally, grant it +0|+1.
05DE010.flavorText: "It may not be evident to the untrained, but the work of a great artist is in one chip of the chisel to the next."
05DE010.name: Durand Sculptor

05DE013.description: <link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: I take all damage for my supported ally this round.
05DE013.descriptionRaw: Support: I take all damage for my supported ally this round.
05DE013.flavorText: Following the stag-mounted Ranger's lead, the petricite guardian dwarfed the very creature that had inspired its elegant design.
05DE013.name: Petricite Stag

05DE015.flavorText: The placid mountain drakes are slow to anger despite their appearance, and their stoicism around other mountain beasts makes them natural protectors of otherwise vulnerable flocks.
05DE015.name: Mountain Drake

05DE019.description: <link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: Give my supported ally +0|+2 and <link=keyword.Formidable><sprite name=Formidable><style=Keyword>Formidable</style></link> this round.
05DE019.descriptionRaw: Support: Give my supported ally +0|+2 and Formidable this round.
05DE019.flavorText: "The Ranger Elmheart has brought us grim news," the architect said calmly, focusing on rerolling the parchment to hide how his hands shook. He turned to the waiting sculptors and gave them a stiff nod. "It seems the time has come for Demacia's unseen protectors to come out of hiding."
05DE019.name: Durand Architect

05DE014.descriptionRaw: Play: Grant an ally +0|+1 and Tough.
05DE014.flavorText: Shireen looked up from her work at the sound of pounding hoofbeats. The ranger's haste left her uneasy, but curious. She urged her petricite bird to take flight, and followed in the ranger's wake.
05DE014.name: Durand Protege

05DE012.description: When you summon another ally, grant me <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link>.
05DE012.descriptionRaw: When you summon another ally, grant me Challenger.
05DE012.flavorText: As the Broadwing passed overhead, the battered Demacian soldiers below let out a cheer, inspired by its enduring form.
05DE012.name: Petricite Broadwing

05DE018.flavorText: "It's always a joy to see them come to life. You forget how distinct each is, their personalities reflections of the artist who made them." - Durand Sculptor
05DE018.name: Petricite Hound

06NX024.description:
<link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Deal 2 to an enemy.
Your <link=keyword.Fast><sprite name=Fast><style=Keyword>Fast</style></link> spells, <link=keyword.Slow><sprite name=Slow><style=Keyword>Slow</style></link> spells, and <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skills</style></link> have "When I damage a <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stunned</style></link> or damaged enemy, kill it."
06NX024.descriptionRaw:
Play: Deal 2 to an enemy.
Your Fast spells, Slow spells, and Skills have "When I damage a Stunned or damaged enemy, kill it."
06NX024.flavorText: "Act Two: A duplicitous lord with little to his name but a pilfered Kashuri gauntlet charms an audience of Ionians. However, his mask is crude, and easily seen through. He begs for his life, claiming ignorance. The iron hand he sought to rule with lies empty."
06NX024.name: Lord Broadmane

06NX033.description: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> 2 enemies or spend 6 mana to summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Legion General</style></link>. <style=Variable></style>
06NX033.descriptionRaw: Stun 2 enemies or spend 6 mana to summon a Legion General.
06NX033.flavorText: Assignment is one of the first great decisions that lies before every battle. A good commander knows that the key to victory...
06NX033.name: Strategic Execution

06NX012.description: <link=keyword.Elemental Skill><sprite name=ElementalSkill><style=Keyword>Attack</style></link>: I deal 2 to my blocker. If it's dead or gone, I deal 2 to the enemy Nexus instead.
06NX012.descriptionRaw: Attack: I deal 2 to my blocker. If it's dead or gone, I deal 2 to the enemy Nexus instead.
06NX012.levelupDescription: I've seen you play 6 <link=keyword.Fast><sprite name=Fast><style=Keyword>Fast</style></link> spells, <link=keyword.Slow><sprite name=Slow><style=Keyword>Slow</style></link> spells, or <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skills</style></link>.<style=Variable></style> When I level up, create <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Tibbers</style></link> in hand.
06NX012.levelupDescriptionRaw: I've seen you play 6 Fast spells, Slow spells, or Skills. When I level up, create Tibbers in hand.
06NX012.flavorText: Over a decade ago, Amoline Kiosar fled the Ravenbloom Conservatory with an invaluable and incandescent asset in her control. Ravenbloom's scouts searched for her in every corner of the empire, but none of the rumors they heard led them to Amoline. And so, years later, when news arrived of a lost girl burning with rage in the northern Ironspike Mountains, Fynn Retrick reluctantly gathered his things and left to investigate. He expected to find nothing. How wrong he was.
06NX012.name: Annie

06NX012T3.description:
Pick a unit. The next time it takes 1 or more damage this round, kill it.
Create an <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Annie</style></link> in your deck.
06NX012T3.descriptionRaw:
Pick a unit. The next time it takes 1 or more damage this round, kill it.
Create an Annie in your deck.
06NX012T3.flavorText: Headmistress Telsi spoke at length about the Noxian tenets, leaving the children before her increasingly bored and restless. But, while most students largely contained their outbursts, Annie acted. First with smoke, then with fire.
06NX012T3.name: Annie's Disintegrate

06NX012T6.description: Deal 2 to <link=card.parentRef><style=AssociatedCard>Annie</style></link>'s blocker. If it's dead or gone, deal 2 to the enemy Nexus instead.
06NX012T6.descriptionRaw: Deal 2 to Annie's blocker. If it's dead or gone, deal 2 to the enemy Nexus instead.
06NX012T6.name: Molten Shield

06NX012T7.description: <link=keyword.Elemental Skill><sprite name=ElementalSkill><style=Keyword>Attack</style></link>: I deal 3 to my blocker and <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> it. If it's dead or gone, I deal 3 to the enemy Nexus instead.
06NX012T7.descriptionRaw: Attack: I deal 3 to my blocker and Stun it. If it's dead or gone, I deal 3 to the enemy Nexus instead.
06NX012T7.flavorText:
"I've found her. She's Amoline's, no doubt. Same eyes, same giggle. I'll bring her back within the fortnight. Having spoken to the girl, I ask that you be kind to her. I believe there's good in there, along with the dark."
- Excerpt of a letter from Fynn Retrick
06NX012T7.name: Annie

06NX012T5.description: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy, then deal 2 to all <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stunned</style></link> or damaged enemies.
06NX012T5.descriptionRaw: Stun an enemy, then deal 2 to all Stunned or damaged enemies.
06NX012T5.name: Pyroclastic Arrival

06NX012T1.description: <link=keyword.Elemental Skill><sprite name=ElementalSkill><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy, then deal 2 to all <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stunned</style></link> or damaged enemies.
06NX012T1.descriptionRaw: Play: Stun an enemy, then deal 2 to all Stunned or damaged enemies.
06NX012T1.flavorText: The demon Tybaulk had infested the minds of countless victims over the centuries. Slowly, inexorably, he would lead them to the fire, and watch his flames feast on scorched flesh. But in young Annie, Tybaulk found a will completely indomitable, and a talent for magic that rivaled even his own.
06NX012T1.name: Tibbers

06NX012T8.description: Deal 3 and <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> <link=card.parentRef><style=AssociatedCard>Annie</style></link>'s blocker. If it's dead or gone, deal 3 to the enemy Nexus instead.
06NX012T8.descriptionRaw: Deal 3 and Stun Annie's blocker. If it's dead or gone, deal 3 to the enemy Nexus instead.
06NX012T8.name: Molten Shield

06NX029.description: When an ally with 5+ Power dies, create a random follower with 5+ Power in hand.
06NX029.descriptionRaw: When an ally with 5+ Power dies, create a random follower with 5+ Power in hand.
06NX029.flavorText:
"Today I found myself thinking back to my small infirmary in Penrose Hill, and the years I spent there trying to unlock the secrets of physiology. Years! I've now been in Lady Noradi's employ for just a few short months, but I know now that I learned nothing. How simple I was. How fortunate."
- Notes from Dr. Esslanger
06NX029.name: The Gray Apothecary

06NX032.description: When an ally attacks, I attack with it.
06NX032.descriptionRaw: When an ally attacks, I attack with it.
06NX032.flavorText: "Drakehounds are a delight, aren't they? So eager to please. So malleable. If only my enemies held the same qualities." - Thorn of the Rose
06NX032.name: Obedient Drakehound

06NX030.descriptionRaw: I gain all allied everywhere buffs.
06NX030.flavorText: "Act One: An ex-soldier, having abandoned his post following the theft of an ancient Kashuri artifact, hides at a Qayanvi bar, full of arrogance and too much drink. Little does he know, his stolen treasure whispers of all it sees to its true owner! His life pours away like so much wine, Noxian crimson on Ionian gold."
06NX030.name: Legion Deserter

06NX013.description: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy or if it's already <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stunned</style></link> deal 2 to it instead.
06NX013.descriptionRaw: Play: Stun an enemy or if it's already Stunned deal 2 to it instead.
06NX013.flavorText:
"Student: Sydell Kythera
Teacher: J. Willough
Report: I am spiderbit on left forearm. Sydell claims a misunderstanding, but his smirk belies his innocence. He is ordered to two weeks additional chores (refectory)."
- Ravenbloom discipline card
06NX013.name: Spell Slinger

06NX040.description: Each round, the first time an ally with 5+ Power attacks, <link=vocab.Rally><style=Vocab>Rally</style></link>.
06NX040.descriptionRaw: Each round, the first time an ally with 5+ Power attacks, Rally.
06NX040.flavorText: "At my command, you will fight! If you kill your sparring partner, find another! If you fall, then die knowing your death made Noxus stronger! Trifarian soldiers... begin!" - Trifarian Assessor
06NX040.name: Trifarian Training Pits

06NX028.description:
<link=vocab.Countdown><style=Vocab>Countdown 11</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Tybaulk</style></link> in hand.
I <link=vocab.Advance><style=Vocab>advance</style></link> 1 round for each <link=keyword.Fast><sprite name=Fast><style=Keyword>Fast</style></link> spell, <link=keyword.Slow><sprite name=Slow><style=Keyword>Slow</style></link> spell, or <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skill</style></link> you've played this game. <style=Variable></style>
06NX028.descriptionRaw:
Countdown 11: Create a Tybaulk in hand.
I advance 1 round for each Fast spell, Slow spell, or Skill you've played this game.
06NX028.flavorText:
"...by now, word has no doubt reached you of the Roseguard Academy's dismal failure. I expect you will learn from your sister school's failings. I expect you will manage your facility in a manner that benefits the empire."
- A scorched letter found in the conservatory's rubble
06NX028.name: Ravenbloom Conservatory

06NX028T1.description: When I'm summoned, grant allies <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +1|+0 and for the rest of the game, all of your spells and <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skills</style></link> deal 1 extra damage.
06NX028T1.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, grant allies everywhere +1|+0 and for the rest of the game, all of your spells and Skills deal 1 extra damage.
06NX028T1.flavorText:
"...it burns in me. This dark presence. It whispers to me. Fire. FIRE. In the flames, I see its eyes. Black and unblinking. Staring. Smiling. Urging me to step in. Urging me to join the rest. Silhouettes in the inferno. Reaching out. Come home. Come home."
- Remains of a decrepit Nockmirchian diary
06NX028T1.name: Tybaulk

06NX014.description: Pick a unit. The next time it takes 1 or more damage this round, kill it.
06NX014.descriptionRaw: Pick a unit. The next time it takes 1 or more damage this round, kill it.
06NX014.flavorText: Headmistress Telsi spoke at length about the Noxian tenets, leaving the children before her increasingly bored and restless. But, while most students largely contained their outbursts, Annie acted. First with smoke, then with fire.
06NX014.name: Disintegrate

06NX031.flavorText: The crowd gasped as the two shackled yetis were brought into the Bordent's legendary fighting pit. No one thought the beasts strong enough to break their chains, because none of them had ever faced a yeti's might before.
06NX031.name: Captive Yeti

06NX009.description: <link=keyword.AttackSkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Attack</style></link>: I deal 3 damage to my blocker. If it's dead or gone, I deal 3 damage to the enemy Nexus instead.
06NX009.descriptionRaw: Attack: I deal 3 damage to my blocker. If it's dead or gone, I deal 3 damage to the enemy Nexus instead.
06NX009.flavorText: "Act Three: A cruel keeper and her pet. The greyback is innocent even in grisly purpose - the artifact it bears forces subservience. The keeper refuses to scream as she is fed to her pet. If only all Noxians were so noble in their demise."
06NX009.name: Captive Greyback

06NX009T1.description: Deal 3 to <link=card.parentRef><style=AssociatedCard>Captive Greyback</style></link>'s blocker. If it's dead or gone, deal 3 to the enemy Nexus instead.
06NX009T1.descriptionRaw: Deal 3 to Captive Greyback's blocker. If it's dead or gone, deal 3 to the enemy Nexus instead.
06NX009T1.flavorText: "Let that be a lesson. Subjugators live only until the first revolt." - Jhin
06NX009T1.name: Obeyed Order

06NX015.description: Each round, the first time you play a <link=keyword.Fast><sprite name=Fast><style=Keyword>Fast</style></link> spell, <link=keyword.Slow><sprite name=Slow><style=Keyword>Slow</style></link> spell, or <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skill</style></link>, I play <link=card.skill><style=AssociatedCard>Magic Embers</style></link>.
06NX015.descriptionRaw: Each round, the first time you play a Fast spell, Slow spell, or Skill, I play Magic Embers.
06NX015.flavorText: "First time I met Daani must've been a couple years ago. Lovely lad. Lovely family, too. Then, on my last trip, I stopped by his village and found poor Daani sat in the square, alone. Said he was waiting for his family to come home. Poor lad must've been sat there months. Didn't have the heart to tell him what I'd seen down the way..." - Fynn Retrick
06NX015.name: Manasoul Student

06NX037.description: Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.create1><style=AssociatedCard>Sharpened Resolve</style></link>, <link=card.create2><style=AssociatedCard>Whirling Death</style></link>, or <link=card.create3><style=AssociatedCard>Weapons of the Lost</style></link> in hand.
06NX037.descriptionRaw: Create a Fleeting Sharpened Resolve, Whirling Death, or Weapons of the Lost in hand.
06NX037.flavorText: "Clara darling, you have to clean the blood from the tokens." - Ophelia Noradi, Crimson Aristocrat
06NX037.name: Noxian Tellstones

06NX015T1.flavorText: "Whoa... I can SEE the magic!" - Manasoul Student
06NX015T1.name: Magic Embers

06NX008.description: When you play a <link=keyword.Fast><sprite name=Fast><style=Keyword>Fast</style></link> spell, <link=keyword.Slow><sprite name=Slow><style=Keyword>Slow</style></link> spell, or <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skill</style></link>, grant me +1|+0.
06NX008.descriptionRaw: When you play a Fast spell, Slow spell, or Skill, grant me +1|+0.
06NX008.flavorText: "Many of the children are of an age where their natural inclinations lead them to rebel against formal direction. Fortunate, then, that the eldest of them is both favored by the rest, and malleable to our cause. If the students choose to ignore our lessons, then we will teach through her." - Headmistress Telsi
06NX008.name: The Prefect

06NX013T1.description: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy or if it's already <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stunned</style></link> deal 2 to it instead.
06NX013T1.descriptionRaw: Stun an enemy or if it's already Stunned deal 2 to it instead.
06NX013T1.name: Stiffened Sinews

06NX024T1.flavorText: Fine tools are wasted on the unsophisticated craftsman.
06NX024T1.name: Kashuri Gauntlet

06MT044.descriptionRaw: Daybreak: Give other allies +0|+2 this round.
06MT044.flavorText: Stellacorns are born of stars, with some burning hotter than others.
06MT044.name: Solari Stellacorn

06MT036.description: Fully heal all allies, then grow their Power to equal their Health.
06MT036.descriptionRaw: Fully heal all allies, then grow their Power to equal their Health.
06MT036.flavorText: "We must show ourselves compassion first of all. The rest will follow." - Soraka
06MT036.name: Consult the Heavens

06MT039.flavorText: "It is said the celestial dragons are born from the nebulae themselves, springing forth fully formed from hazy cosmic dust. But how would we mere mortals know? From far away, all we see is their light." - Herald of Dragons
06MT039.name: Dragon Roost

06MT045.description: <link=keyword.Invoke><style=Keyword>Invoke</style></link> a low, medium, and high cost Celestial card.
06MT045.descriptionRaw: Invoke a low, medium, and high cost Celestial card.
06MT045.flavorText: "The stars, they are foretelling great potential. Something is coming. What shape will they take? It is not for me to know! What do you think, Kulun?" - Moondreamer
06MT045.name: Celestial Trifecta

06MT043.description: Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.spell1><style=AssociatedCard>Behold the Infinite</style></link>, <link=card.spell2><style=AssociatedCard>Hush</style></link>, or <link=card.spell3><style=AssociatedCard>Blessing of Targon</style></link> in hand.
06MT043.descriptionRaw: Create a Fleeting Behold the Infinite, Hush, or Blessing of Targon in hand.
06MT043.flavorText: "It's the strangest thing, Shorin... Even without turning the stone over, I know exactly what constellation is painted on it." - Tyari the Traveler
06MT043.name: Targonian Tellstones

06MT029.description:
When I'm summoned, plant a <link=card.chime><style=AssociatedCard>Chime</style></link> on the top card of your deck.
<link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: Grant my supported ally +1|+1.
06MT029.descriptionRaw:
When I'm summoned, plant a Chime on the top card of your deck.
Support: Grant my supported ally +1|+1.
06MT029.flavorText:
"...but I heard Esmus was created by the Caretaker himself, and with her birth, sound came to the world!"
"I say lies! It is known that Esmus bears the face of an old singer who had the heart of an angel but the voice of the dead... until Bard himself granted her a voice of pure beauty!"
"I say lies! Esmus is..."
- An instance of the Birth of Esmus, a popular bard's game
06MT029.name: Esmus, Breath of the World

06MT038.description: <link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link>: Give other allies +2|+1 and <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link> this round.
06MT038.descriptionRaw: Nightfall: Give other allies +2|+1 and Overwhelm this round.
06MT038.flavorText:
"Mother Moon, lend us your strength,
Though darkness surrounds us,
With your light, we shall overcome."
- Lunari prayer
06MT038.name: The Winding Light

06MT047.description: When I'm summoned or when I count down, plant 3 <link=card.chime><style=AssociatedCard>Chimes</style></link> in your deck. <link=vocab.Countdown><style=Vocab>Countdown 2</style></link><style=Variable></style>: Draw 1.
06MT047.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned or when I count down, plant 3 Chimes in your deck. Countdown 2: Draw 1.
06MT047.flavorText: "Then I seen it--thousands of 'em, all singin' and dancin' this way and that-un. Next thing I know, I seen a flash o' light, and theyâ€™re all gone, the temple with 'emâ€“not a stone to see. And in me hands? Well Old Gaff was left there holdin' a chime." - Old Gaffâ€™s tale, part 3
06MT047.name: Mystic Vortex

06MT041.description: My <link=keyword.Fated><sprite name=Fated><style=Keyword>Fated</style></link> buffs are granted to allied <link=card.me><style=AssociatedCard>Starhound Packs</style></link> <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link>.
06MT041.descriptionRaw: My Fated buffs are granted to allied Starhound Packs everywhere.
06MT041.flavorText: The starhounds could not be beckoned or persuaded by climbers on their journey. They were aloof, seemingly inured to the mountain's magics.
06MT041.name: Starhound Pack

06MT049.description: Grant an ally +1|+2 and remove all negative keywords from it.
06MT049.descriptionRaw: Grant an ally +1|+2 and remove all negative keywords from it.
06MT049.flavorText: Those that hear the bell ring are struck by the purity of its tone.
06MT049.name: Mikhael's Blessing

06RU025.description:
<link=vocab.Origin><style=Vocab>Origin</style></link>: <link=card.origin><style=AssociatedCard>Agony's Embrace</style></link>.
When I'm summoned, summon a random Husk.
06RU025.descriptionRaw:
Origin: Agony's Embrace.
When I'm summoned, summon a random Husk.
06RU025.levelupDescription: When I see you or an ally kill an allied Husk, give me its positive keywords this round and I level up.
06RU025.levelupDescriptionRaw: When I see you or an ally kill an allied Husk, give me its positive keywords this round and I level up.
06RU025.flavorText: The priestess' pupils were blown wide, and her hand trembled with nervous excitement. She was ready. This was the single moment Evelynn craved more than any other. She grinned, and slowly shed her visage. Then, as always, the screaming began.
06RU025.name: Evelynn

06RU025T4.description: When you play an ally, kill me to grant it my stats and positive keywords.
06RU025T4.descriptionRaw: When you play an ally, kill me to grant it my stats and positive keywords.
06RU025T4.flavorText: "Look me in the eye. Tell me I hurt you." - Solitude
06RU025T4.name: Breakneck Husk

06RU025T7.description: When you play an ally, kill me to grant it my stats and positive keywords.
06RU025T7.descriptionRaw: When you play an ally, kill me to grant it my stats and positive keywords.
06RU025T7.name: Haunted Husk

06RU025T14.description: You may put any cards that summon Husks into your deck during deckbuilding.
06RU025T14.descriptionRaw: You may put any cards that summon Husks into your deck during deckbuilding.
06RU025T14.name: Agony's Embrace

06RU025T5.description:
When you or an ally kill an allied Husk, give me its positive keywords this round.
<link=vocab.RoundEnd><style=Vocab>Round End</style></link>: Summon a random Husk. If fewer than 6 allies have died this game, transform me back into <nobr><link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Evelynn</style></link>.</nobr> <style=Variable></style>
06RU025T5.descriptionRaw:
When you or an ally kill an allied Husk, give me its positive keywords this round.
Round End: Summon a random Husk. If fewer than 6 allies have died this game, transform me back into Evelynn.
06RU025T5.flavorText: As Evelynn stalked Runeterra, she attracted the attentions of lesser demons, each hoping to destroy the Widowmaker and feast on her power. She butchered most, of course, but a few talented individuals caught her eye. Today, they live on, bound to their mistress, and when the mood strikes, Evelynn lets them out to play.
06RU025T5.name: Evelynn

06RU025T8.description: When you play an ally, kill me to grant it my stats and positive keywords.
06RU025T8.descriptionRaw: When you play an ally, kill me to grant it my stats and positive keywords.
06RU025T8.flavorText: "Look at you. You are a pathetic, useless worm." - Domination
06RU025T8.name: Warded Husk

06RU025T12.description: When you play an ally, kill me to grant it my stats and positive keywords.
06RU025T12.descriptionRaw: When you play an ally, kill me to grant it my stats and positive keywords.
06RU025T12.name: Fading Husk

06RU025T10.description: When you play an ally, kill me to grant it my stats and positive keywords.
06RU025T10.descriptionRaw: When you play an ally, kill me to grant it my stats and positive keywords.
06RU025T10.name: Thrashing Husk

06RU025T3.description: When you play an ally, kill me to grant it my stats and positive keywords.
06RU025T3.descriptionRaw: When you play an ally, kill me to grant it my stats and positive keywords.
06RU025T3.flavorText: "Oh, the look on your face!" - Solitude
06RU025T3.name: Scattered Husk

06RU025T1.description: When you play an ally, kill me to grant it my stats and positive keywords.
06RU025T1.descriptionRaw: When you play an ally, kill me to grant it my stats and positive keywords.
06RU025T1.name: Desperate Husk

06RU025T9.description: When you play an ally, kill me to grant it my stats and positive keywords.
06RU025T9.descriptionRaw: When you play an ally, kill me to grant it my stats and positive keywords.
06RU025T9.flavorText: "I wore you out? Already? Shame." - Evelynn
06RU025T9.name: Enraged Husk

06RU025T11.description: When you play an ally, kill me to grant it my stats and positive keywords.
06RU025T11.descriptionRaw: When you play an ally, kill me to grant it my stats and positive keywords.
06RU025T11.flavorText: "Told you it'd be a good time. Didn't say whose." - Sultur
06RU025T11.name: Hardy Husk

06RU025T2.description: When you play an ally, kill me to grant it my stats and positive keywords.
06RU025T2.descriptionRaw: When you play an ally, kill me to grant it my stats and positive keywords.
06RU025T2.flavorText: "Flesh. Bone. Screams. I want it all." - Vora
06RU025T2.name: Stubborn Husk

06RU025T6.description:
Stop all enemy spells and skills targeting <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Evelynn</style></link> and she <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> an enemy.
Create an <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Evelynn</style></link> in your deck.
06RU025T6.descriptionRaw:
Stop all enemy spells and skills targeting Evelynn and she strikes an enemy.
Create an Evelynn in your deck.
06RU025T6.name: Evelynn's Last Caress

06RU001.description:
<link=vocab.Origin><style=Vocab>Origin</style></link>: <link=card.origin><style=AssociatedCard>The Wandering Caretaker</style></link>.
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Plant 3 <link=card.chime><style=AssociatedCard>Chimes</style></link> in your deck.
06RU001.descriptionRaw:
Origin: The Wandering Caretaker.
Attack: Plant 3 Chimes in your deck.
06RU001.levelupDescription: You've increased the total stats of allies in play or hand by <nobr>20+.<style=Variable></style></nobr>
06RU001.levelupDescriptionRaw: You've increased the total stats of allies in play or hand by 20+.
06RU001.flavorText: "Aye, Old Gaff's seen his share o' strange! First time was the Caretaker 'imself, I reckon. Like a star streamin' 'cross the sky, he was. Felt like the whole world stopped a minute, and it was just me 'n' himâ€¦" - Old Gaffâ€™s tale, part 1
06RU001.name: Bard

06RU001T8.description:
Draw a follower, then activate the effects of all boons in the top 3 cards of your deck.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Bard</style></link> in your deck.
06RU001T8.descriptionRaw:
Draw a follower, then activate the effects of all boons in the top 3 cards of your deck.
Create a Bard in your deck.
06RU001T8.flavorText: Songs tell of Bard hiding chimes amongst the towns of Runeterra, said to raise spirits and inspire spontaneous bouts of joyful dance.
06RU001T8.name: Bard's Traveler's Call

06RU001T4.description:
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Plant 6 <link=card.chime><style=AssociatedCard>Chimes</style></link> in your deck.
When you activate a <link=card.chime><style=AssociatedCard>Chime</style></link>, grant +1|+1 to a random ally in play.
06RU001T4.descriptionRaw:
Attack: Plant 6 Chimes in your deck.
When you activate a Chime, grant +1|+1 to a random ally in play.
06RU001T4.flavorText:
"Sound the horn for the young and old
Sound it loud for all to behold. 
Kings bow down and sing their praise
To The Caretaker and his curious ways." - Runeterran Ballad
06RU001T4.name: Bard

06RU001T9.description:
You may put any cards that plant <link=card.chime><style=AssociatedCard>Chimes</style></link> into your deck during deckbuilding. 
<link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: If you have 3+ mana gems, plant a <link=card.chime><style=AssociatedCard>Chime</style></link> in your deck for each Bard that started the game in your deck.
06RU001T9.descriptionRaw:
You may put any cards that plant Chimes into your deck during deckbuilding. 
Round Start: If you have 3+ mana gems, plant a Chime in your deck for each Bard that started the game in your deck.
06RU001T9.flavorText: A mysterious traveler from beyond the cosmos, Bard is a being of harmony and balance, whose ear is attuned to the symphony of creation and the discord within. Surrounded by a choir of peculiar creatures, known as meeps, the Wandering Caretaker's curious works are celebrated in songs and stories across Runeterra.
06RU001T9.name: The Wandering Caretaker

06RU001T3.description: Grant a random ally in hand +1|+1.
06RU001T3.descriptionRaw: Grant a random ally in hand +1|+1.
06RU001T3.flavorText: On still windless nights, cast your eyes to the heavens and listen for the soft symphony of tinkling chimes. In that moment you will know that He is watching.
06RU001T3.name: Chime

06RU002.descriptionRaw:
Origin: The Virtuoso. 
Attack: Deal 2 to all Stunned enemies.
06RU002.levelupDescriptionRaw: You've played 12+ Fast spells, Slow spells, or Skills.
06RU002.flavorText: "Overture: We open on the city of Qayanvi, where an old master summons a young pupil. He is tasked with disposing a group of nefarious villains and recovering stolen sacred artifacts. The actor is keen, but he does not as yet take his place. For now he simply prepares, waiting in the wings."
06RU002.name: Jhin

06RU002T1.description:
<style=Variable></style>
<link=keyword.AttackSkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Attack</style></link>: Deal 4 to all <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stunned</style></link> enemies and the enemy Nexus.
06RU002T1.descriptionRaw: Attack: Deal 4 to all Stunned enemies and the enemy Nexus.
06RU002T1.name: Jhin

06RU002T5.description:
If a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Jhin</style></link> started in your deck, for every 3 <link=keyword.Fast><sprite name=Fast><style=Keyword>Fast</style></link> spells, <link=keyword.Slow><sprite name=Slow><style=Keyword>Slow</style></link> spells, or <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skills</style></link> you play while you <link=vocab.Behold><style=Vocab>Behold</style></link> <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Jhin</style></link>, play <link=card.cast><style=AssociatedCard>Lotus Trap</style></link>.
You may put any follower that has a <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skill</style></link> into your deck during deckbuilding.
06RU002T5.descriptionRaw:
If a Jhin started in your deck, for every 3 Fast spells, Slow spells, or Skills you play while you Behold Jhin, play Lotus Trap.
You may put any follower that has a Skill into your deck during deckbuilding.
06RU002T5.flavorText: "The gun, my instrument; the bullet, my song." - Jhin
06RU002T5.name: The Virtuoso

06RU002T12.description: Deal 4 to all <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stunned</style></link> enemies and the enemy Nexus.
06RU002T12.descriptionRaw: Deal 4 to all Stunned enemies and the enemy Nexus.
06RU002T12.name: Curtain Call

06RU002T4.description: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus. If <link=card.jhin><style=AssociatedCard>Jhin</style></link> is in play, <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> the <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> enemy.
06RU002T4.descriptionRaw: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus. If Jhin is in play, Stun the weakest enemy.
06RU002T4.name: Lotus Trap

06RU002T2.description:
Deal 1 to a unit. Create a <link=card.spell2><style=AssociatedCard>Second Bounce</style></link> in hand at the next <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Jhin</style></link> in your deck.
06RU002T2.descriptionRaw:
Deal 1 to a unit. Create a Second Bounce in hand at the next Round Start.
Create a Jhin in your deck.
06RU002T2.name: Jhin's Dancing Grenade

06RU046.description: Deal 1 to a unit. Create a <link=card.spell2><style=AssociatedCard>Second Bounce</style></link> in hand at the next <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>.
06RU046.descriptionRaw: Deal 1 to a unit. Create a Second Bounce in hand at the next Round Start.
06RU046.name: Dancing Grenade

06RU044.description: Stop all enemy spells and skills targeting <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Evelynn</style></link> and she <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> an enemy.
06RU044.descriptionRaw: Stop all enemy spells and skills targeting Evelynn and she strikes an enemy.
06RU044.name: Last Caress

06RU045.description: Draw a follower, then activate the effects of all boons in the top 3 cards of your deck.
06RU045.descriptionRaw: Draw a follower, then activate the effects of all boons in the top 3 cards of your deck.
06RU045.flavorText: Songs tell of Bard hiding chimes amongst the towns of Runeterra, said to raise spirits and inspire spontaneous bouts of joyful dance.
06RU045.name: Traveler's Call

06FR029.description: <link=keyword.Frostbite><sprite name=Frostbite><style=Keyword>Frostbite</style></link> an enemy and summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Rimefang Pack</style></link>. <style=Variable></style>
06FR029.descriptionRaw: Frostbite an enemy and summon a Rimefang Pack.
06FR029.flavorText: With the cold, so too come the rimefangs, and they don't have to outpace their prey... merely outwait them.
06FR029.name: Frozen in Fear

06FR033.description: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Get an empty mana gem.
06FR033.descriptionRaw: Last Breath: Get an empty mana gem.
06FR033.flavorText: The cycle of life and death looks different in the Freljord. The harsh environment ensures that little goes to waste.
06FR033.name: Hunting Boar

06FR038.description:
Deal 3 to ALL units.
<link=keyword.Enlightened><style=Keyword>Enlightened</style></link>: Instead, deal 3 to all enemies and heal your Nexus 3.
06FR038.descriptionRaw:
Deal 3 to ALL units.
Enlightened: Instead, deal 3 to all enemies and heal your Nexus 3.
06FR038.flavorText: In the shadow of the great Cryophoenix's wings, her followers rejoiced, and her enemies shuddered.
06FR038.name: Wings of the Cryophoenix

06FR030.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Frozen Thrall</style></link> or <link=vocab.Advance><style=Vocab>advance</style></link> all your <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Frozen Thralls</style></link> 1 round.
06FR030.descriptionRaw: Play: Summon a Frozen Thrall or advance all your Frozen Thralls 1 round.
06FR030.flavorText: The strange, whistling cry of the creature overhead was barely audible, but as it rung off the ravine's stone walls, the scouts felt it vibrate along their bones. Before their very eyes, cracks rapidly formed along the surface of the ice, disproportionate and quick.
06FR030.name: Harbinger of Thralls

06FR039.description: Transform an allied follower into an <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Alpha Wildclaw</style></link>.
06FR039.descriptionRaw: Transform an allied follower into an Alpha Wildclaw.
06FR039.flavorText: "Great wildclaw spirit, grant us your power!" - Udyr
06FR039.name: Wildclaw's Ferocity

06FR028.description: When I'm summoned, grant units in your deck my stats, then draw a unit with 5+ Power.
06FR028.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, grant units in your deck my stats, then draw a unit with 5+ Power.
06FR028.flavorText: Avarosan lorekeepers are often seasoned elders of the tribe, protectors of the people and seasoned storytellers. They keep the tradition of both the hunt and fight alive through story and song.
06FR028.name: Revna, the Lorekeeper

06FR030T2.flavorText:
The ice grows thin at daylight break,
And with the thaw, Her servants wake.
06FR030T2.name: Harbinger of Thralls

06FR030T1.descriptionRaw: Play: Advance all your Frozen Thralls 1 round.
06FR030T1.flavorText:
The ice grows thin at daylight break,
And with the thaw, Her servants wake.
06FR030T1.name: Harbinger of Thralls

06FR037.description: Grant an enemy "<link=keyword.Frostbite><sprite name=Frostbite><style=Keyword>Frostbite</style></link> me at the next <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>."
06FR037.descriptionRaw: Grant an enemy "Frostbite me at the next Round Start."
06FR037.flavorText: One must always test the ice before stepping onto it, no matter how thick it may look.
06FR037.name: Cracking Ice

06BC045.description: Give allies +1|+1 this round. If they're created, give them +2|+2 instead.
06BC045.descriptionRaw: Give allies +1|+1 this round. If they're created, give them +2|+2 instead.
06BC045.flavorText: "HELLO. I MUSHROOM I TALKING I DON'T KNOW WHY OR HOW OR WHAT IS HAPPEN PLEASE LET ME BE MUSHROOM. PLEASE. THANK. BYE." - Mushroom
06BC045.name: Sneezy Biggledust!

06BC036.descriptionRaw:
Play: Manifest a Yordle.
Attack: Grant Yordle allies +1|+0.
06BC036.flavorText: "EVERYONE loves Paparo! Every summer, he brings us trinkets from all across the world, and they're always either tasty, pretty, or topsy-turvy! Sometimes, all three!" - Ava Achiever
06BC036.name: Paparo the Great

06BC040.description: Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.spell3><style=AssociatedCard>Electro Harpoon</style></link>, <link=card.spell2><style=AssociatedCard>Heroic Refrain</style></link>, or <link=card.spell1><style=AssociatedCard>Yordle Contraption</style></link> in hand.
06BC040.descriptionRaw: Create a Fleeting Electro Harpoon, Heroic Refrain, or Yordle Contraption in hand.
06BC040.flavorText: Yordles are always down for a game... but don't be surprised if the rules change in the middle of one!
06BC040.name: Bandle Tellstones

06BC039.description: Deal 2 to a unit and summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Scrappy Bomb</style></link>.
06BC039.descriptionRaw: Deal 2 to a unit and summon a Scrappy Bomb.
06BC039.flavorText: "Well, that's not good," Giselle said quietly, ducking behind cover.
06BC039.name: Drop the Bomb

06BC044.description: Deal 2 to an enemy and <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> another. Plant 6 <link=card.chime><style=AssociatedCard>Chimes</style></link> in your deck.
06BC044.descriptionRaw: Deal 2 to an enemy and Stun another. Plant 6 Chimes in your deck.
06BC044.flavorText:
"Mama, where does the Caretaker go?"
"He goes everywhere, love. As far as the eye can reach."
"Why?"
"Ah, my sweet. Do not think on why. Not even our wisest elders can understand the Caretaker's ways..."
- A mother and child
06BC044.name: Cosmic Binding

06BC026.description: When I'm summoned, plant a <link=card.chime><style=AssociatedCard>Chime</style></link> on the top card of your deck.
06BC026.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, plant a Chime on the top card of your deck.
06BC026.flavorText: "..second time was the big 'un. I was sweepin' the floors, when all a sudden I spot me dinner spilt on the table and me pots 'n' pans waddlin' on two legs, hurryinâ€™ out the door! I followed fast as these kneesâ€™d go, and I found â€˜em at that temple, rummaginâ€™ through the shelves like they was lookinâ€™ for somethinâ€™.â€ - Old Gaffâ€™s tale, part 2
06BC026.name: Byrd, The Bellringer

06BC030.description: Deal 1 to a unit. If one of your traps or boons activated this round, deal 3 to it instead.
06BC030.descriptionRaw: Deal 1 to a unit. If one of your traps or boons activated this round, deal 3 to it instead.
06BC030.flavorText: "If it starts to glow, it's gonna blow!" - Bandle Scout rule number 463
06BC030.name: Proximity Puffcap

06BC031.description: When I'm summoned, plant a <link=card.chime><style=AssociatedCard>Chime</style></link> on the top card of your deck, then double the boons in your deck.
06BC031.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, plant a Chime on the top card of your deck, then double the boons in your deck.
06BC031.flavorText:
"Gave me a right fright, it did. Arms sproutin' all over. Teeth big as boulders. Oh, and when that creature ran that mallet 'cross its teeth, made a song so eerie, thought I'd die. Ran for my life, I did. But not before I seen it... holes in the sky! Musta been hundreds of 'em!"
- Old Gaffâ€™s tale, part 4
06BC031.name: Maduli, The Gatekeeper

06BC035.description: When an ally with an attachment attacks, grant that attachment +1|+0.
06BC035.descriptionRaw: When an ally with an attachment attacks, grant that attachment +1|+0.
06BC035.flavorText: The leaves of the papertree shimmer with the same fae magic that created the tree itself. And, just like the birds that inspired their form, they find the allure of shiny things impossible to resist.
06BC035.name: The Papertree

06IO005.description: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> a unit with 3 or less Health.
06IO005.descriptionRaw: Recall a unit with 3 or less Health.
06IO005.name: Gruesome Theater

06IO038.description:
I cost 2 less if you've supported an ally this game.
Give an ally Barrier this round.
06IO038.descriptionRaw: I cost 2 less if you've supported an ally this game.Give an ally Barrier this round.
06IO038.flavorText: "Trust the balance. Walk the divide." - Shen
06IO038.name: Moral Support

06IO012.description: Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Keeper of Masks</style></link> now or at the next <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>. Draw 1.
06IO012.descriptionRaw: Summon a Keeper of Masks now or at the next Round Start. Draw 1.
06IO012.flavorText:
"Old masks let young eyes see clearly."
- Keeper of Masks
06IO012.name: Kinkou's Call

06IO009.descriptionRaw: Start a free attack with 2 Dragonlings.
06IO009.name: Dragon Ambush

06IO033.description:
For the rest of the game, when you <link=vocab.BladeDance><style=Vocab>Blade Dance</style></link>, summon another attacking <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Blade</style></link>.
<link=vocab.BladeDance><style=Vocab>Blade Dance</style></link> 1.
06IO033.descriptionRaw:
For the rest of the game, when you Blade Dance, summon another attacking Blade.
Blade Dance 1.
06IO033.flavorText: "Lead the dance, and I'll follow!" - Ribbon Dancer
06IO033.name: Storm of Blades

06IO004.description: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> a unit with less Power than me.
06IO004.descriptionRaw: Play: Recall a unit with less Power than me.
06IO004.flavorText: "An extraordinary creator, The Maker. A legendary artisan! Her art, peerless! Her execution, flawless! It is a great honor to be in her presence, let alone wield an instrument of her making." - Kashuri Witness
06IO004.name: The Maker

06IO010.description:
When I'm summoned, draw <link=card.champ1><style=AssociatedCard>Yasuo</style></link> and <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>Strongest</style></link> enemy.
When you gain the attack token, <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>Strongest</style></link> enemy.
06IO010.descriptionRaw:
When I'm summoned, draw Yasuo and Stun the Strongest enemy.
When you gain the attack token, Stun the Strongest enemy.
06IO010.flavorText: For most, peace is a happy home and the warm quiet found in a loved one's hold. For Yasuo, it is that rare moment when the winds calm and offer promise instead of remembrance.
06IO010.name: Windswept Hillock

06IO036.description: Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.create1><style=AssociatedCard>Gruesome Theater</style></link>, <link=card.create2><style=AssociatedCard>Ritual of Renewal</style></link>, or <link=card.create3><style=AssociatedCard>Stand United</style></link> in hand.
06IO036.descriptionRaw: Create a Fleeting Gruesome Theater, Ritual of Renewal, or Stand United in hand.
06IO036.flavorText: "Learning to read your opponent is an essential skill, even outside of a fight. But most importantly, the purpose of a game is to have fun. Now, fetch me my footbath!" - Inspiring Mentor
06IO036.name: Ionian Tellstones

06IO012T1.description: Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Keeper of Masks</style></link> at the next <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>. Draw 1.
06IO012T1.descriptionRaw: Summon a Keeper of Masks at the next Round Start. Draw 1.
06IO012T1.flavorText:
"Old masks let young eyes see clearly."
- Keeper of Masks
06IO012T1.name: Kinkou's Call

06IO012T2.descriptionRaw: Summon a Keeper of Masks. Draw 1.
06IO012T2.flavorText:
"Old masks let young eyes see clearly."
- Keeper of Masks
06IO012T2.name: Kinkou's Call

06IO003.flavorText: "Act Four: A young priestess enters our story. Her tale is one of tragedy, conveyed on the pale lips of those she betrayed. Desperate to repent for her transgression, she carries in her arms a great burden, a gilded gift for the Noxians she welcomed to her land. We are left to wonder: was it sorrow or the bullet that broke her heart?"
06IO003.name: The Stagehand

06IO003T1.flavorText: "An actor must not shy from the spotlight." - Jhin
06IO003T1.name: Stunning Performance

06IO004T1.description: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> a unit with less Power than me.
06IO004T1.descriptionRaw: Recall a unit with less Power than me.
06IO004T1.flavorText: "Training is a path, and at its end lies perfection." - The Maker
06IO004T1.name: Peerless Artistry

06IO035.description: When another ally gets <link=keyword.Barrier><sprite name=Barrier><style=Keyword>Barrier</style></link>, give me <link=keyword.Barrier><sprite name=Barrier><style=Keyword>Barrier</style></link> this round if I don't have it.
06IO035.descriptionRaw: When another ally gets Barrier, give me Barrier this round if I don't have it.
06IO035.flavorText: "Embrace the Balance on every level. Mind, body, spirit. Resist the impetuous urges of youth. Elevate your perspective." - Shen
06IO035.name: Kinkou Student

06PZ032.description: Pick one of two new 2 cost spells to create in hand and set its cost to 0 this round. Repeat two more times.
06PZ032.descriptionRaw: Pick one of two new 2 cost spells to create in hand and set its cost to 0 this round. Repeat two more times.
06PZ032.flavorText: Zaun's first songspinner was surprisingly reliable. The only downside was that nobody could figure out how to control the volume.
06PZ032.name: Sputtering Songspinner

06PZ042.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Pick a card in hand. Create 4 exact copies of it in your deck and reduce their costs by 1.
06PZ042.descriptionRaw: Play: Pick a card in hand. Create 4 exact copies of it in your deck and reduce their costs by 1.
06PZ042.flavorText:
"Well, all I'm gonna say about today is that things could have gone better. Gonna leave it at that. Future me... you know what we did."
- Kay's diary
06PZ042.name: Evil Imperfectionist

06PZ025.description:
When I'm summoned, summon a random Husk.
When you summon a 1 cost ally, grant it a random keyword.
06PZ025.descriptionRaw:
When I'm summoned, summon a random Husk.
When you summon a 1 cost ally, grant it a random keyword.
06PZ025.flavorText:
"On my walk home from the Entresol, I saw again that poor vagabond sobbing in a small alleyway. That so many veer around her so pointedly breaks my heart as much as her own palpable dismay. So, tomorrow, should we cross paths again, I will endeavor to help her in any way I can."
- Notes from Lady Sempescu's diary
06PZ025.name: Solitude

06PZ043.description: Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.create1><style=AssociatedCard>Aftershock</style></link>, <link=card.create2><style=AssociatedCard>Hextech Transmogulator</style></link>, or <link=card.create3><style=AssociatedCard>Progress Day!</style></link> in hand.
06PZ043.descriptionRaw: Create a Fleeting Aftershock, Hextech Transmogulator, or Progress Day! in hand.
06PZ043.flavorText: "You won't find a finer set of pieces anywhere in the world, good sir. My daughter put her heart into every last detail." - Corin Reveck
06PZ043.name: Piltovan Tellstones

06PZ027.description: Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.create1><style=AssociatedCard>Shady Character</style></link> or <link=card.create2><style=AssociatedCard>Chempunk Shredder</style></link> in hand and reduce its cost by 1.
06PZ027.descriptionRaw: Create a Fleeting Shady Character or Chempunk Shredder in hand and reduce its cost by 1.
06PZ027.flavorText: Zaun's best night life is invite-only. If you're not in the band, you've gotta really be somebody to snag a spot. Or find a ticket on the ground.
06PZ027.name: Discreet Invitation

06PZ038.description: Grant an ally <link=keyword.Elusive><sprite name=Elusive><style=Keyword>Elusive</style></link> and "<link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Draw 1."
06PZ038.descriptionRaw: Grant an ally Elusive and "Nexus Strike: Draw 1."
06PZ038.flavorText: "You guys won't BELIEVE what I found today!" - Sumpsnipe Scavenger
06PZ038.name: Scavenged Camocloaker

06PZ039.description: To play, discard up to 2 cards. Create that many followers from your regions that cost 1 more and reduce their costs by 1.
06PZ039.descriptionRaw: To play, discard up to 2 cards. Create that many followers from your regions that cost 1 more and reduce their costs by 1.
06PZ039.flavorText: Down in the depths of Zaun, the locals are forced to turn the scraps and the dregs they salvage into workable material. After decades of practice, they've become rather good at it.
06PZ039.name: Salvaged Scrap

06BW006.description: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: <link=vocab.Spawn><style=Vocab>Spawn</style></link> 1, then I gain Power equal to your <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Tentacle</style></link>'s Power this round.
06BW006.descriptionRaw: Attack: Spawn 1, then I gain Power equal to your strongest Tentacle's Power this round.
06BW006.levelupDescription: I've seen myself or allied <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Tentacles</style></link> deal 15+ damage.<style=Variable></style>
06BW006.levelupDescriptionRaw: I've seen myself or allied Tentacles deal 15+ damage.
06BW006.flavorText: The "Eye of Nagakabouros" is merely a name, but Illaoi takes it as a challenge to live as if her god is a constant--and easily-bored--companion.
06BW006.name: Illaoi

06BW006T1.description:
When you <link=vocab.Spawn><style=Vocab>Spawn</style></link>, increase its <nobr>value by 1.</nobr>
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: <link=vocab.Spawn><style=Vocab>Spawn</style></link> 1, then fully heal your <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Tentacle</style></link> and I gain stats equal to its stats this round.
06BW006T1.descriptionRaw:
When you Spawn, increase its value by 1.
Attack: Spawn 1, then fully heal your strongest Tentacle and I gain stats equal to its stats this round.
06BW006T1.flavorText: A life lesson: If ever you have the chance to leap from the rigging of a fine ship and crash like thunderous repentance upon your foes, do so. It is most invigorating.
06BW006T1.name: Illaoi

06BW006T2.description:
<link=vocab.Spawn><style=Vocab>Spawn</style></link> 2, then your <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Tentacle</style></link> and an enemy <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> each other.
Create an <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Illaoi</style></link> in your deck.
06BW006T2.descriptionRaw:
Spawn 2, then your strongest Tentacle and an enemy strike each other.
Create an Illaoi in your deck.
06BW006T2.flavorText: "Life is a test. And pain is the teacher more often than we might like." - Illaoi
06BW006T2.name: Illaoi's Tentacle Smash

06BW006T3.flavorText: There is no greater symbol of what lurks below. Whether it means you harm or not is irrelevant to the fear--the panic that rises in your chest. Nature supplies spectacle, but your mind supplies intent.
06BW006T3.name: Tentacle

06BW036.description: I have +1|+0 for each different round you've damaged the enemy Nexus.
06BW036.descriptionRaw: I have +1|+0 for each different round you've damaged the enemy Nexus.
06BW036.flavorText: "Ain't no place bloodier in Bilgewater than the bay. Just look at them rats. Reared on blood, they are. Can't get enough o' the stuff. Creepy little scrits." - Jagged Butcher
06BW036.name: Wharf Rat

06BW038.description:
Once you're <link=keyword.Deep><sprite name=Deep><style=Keyword>Deep</style></link>, heal your allies and Nexus 3. 
<style=Variable></style>
06BW038.descriptionRaw: Once you're Deep, heal your allies and Nexus 3.
06BW038.flavorText:
"What does it want?!"
"It... it's after the oranges!"
"By the Bearded Lady, JUST GIVE IT THE WHOLE BUSHEL!" - Unlucky sailors
06BW038.name: Megatusk

06BW030.flavorText: Nagakabouros is a god of providence--provided one survives the act of worship.
06BW030.name: Eye of Nagakabouros

06BW011.description: When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: <link=vocab.Spawn><style=Vocab>Spawn</style></link> 2. Then, if your <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> <link=card.tentacle><style=AssociatedCard>Tentacle</style></link> has 12+ Power, create a <link=card.spell><style=AssociatedCard>Nagakabouros' Tantrum</style></link> in hand.
06BW011.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned or Round Start: Spawn 2. Then, if your strongest Tentacle has 12+ Power, create a Nagakabouros' Tantrum in hand.
06BW011.flavorText: "The Mother Serpent. The Great Kraken. The Bearded Lady. Nagakabouros cares little for names, and less for the restless dead." - Illaoi
06BW011.name: Nagakabouros

06BW011T1.description: <link=card.parentRef><style=AssociatedCard>Nagakabouros</style></link> starts a free attack with 4 <link=card.unitRef><style=AssociatedCard>Nagakabouros' Tentacle</style></link>.
06BW011T1.descriptionRaw: Nagakabouros starts a free attack with 4 Nagakabouros' Tentacle.
06BW011T1.flavorText: It is a common Buhru story that the land was once whole, and Nagakabouros shattered it into islands to provide greater challenge for navigators. It's a story, of course. Nagakabouros didn't shatter the land. Nobody questions, however, whether she could if she felt like it.
06BW011T1.name: Nagakabouros' Tantrum

06BW011T5.description: When I'm summoned, grow my stats to that of your <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> <link=card.tentacle><style=AssociatedCard>Tentacle</style></link> and grant me its keywords.
06BW011T5.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, grow my stats to that of your strongest Tentacle and grant me its keywords.
06BW011T5.flavorText: "To say you've witnessed Nagakabouros after seeing her tendrils is to say you know the sun after witnessing daylight. Nagakabouros is more than enormous. Nagakabouros is unending." - Falaweh, Buhru Priestess
06BW011T5.name: Nagakabouros' Tentacle

06BW011T4.description: When I'm summoned, grow my stats to that of your <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> <link=card.tentacle><style=AssociatedCard>Tentacle</style></link> and grant me its keywords.
06BW011T4.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, grow my stats to that of your strongest Tentacle and grant me its keywords.
06BW011T4.flavorText: "To say you've witnessed Nagakabouros after seeing her tendrils is to say you know the sun after witnessing daylight. Nagakabouros is more than enormous. Nagakabouros is unending." - Falaweh, Buhru Priestess
06BW011T4.name: Nagakabouros' Tentacle

06BW011T3.description: When I'm summoned, grow my stats to that of your <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> <link=card.tentacle><style=AssociatedCard>Tentacle</style></link> and grant me its keywords.
06BW011T3.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, grow my stats to that of your strongest Tentacle and grant me its keywords.
06BW011T3.flavorText: "To say you've witnessed Nagakabouros after seeing her tendrils is to say you know the sun after witnessing daylight. Nagakabouros is more than enormous. Nagakabouros is unending." - Falaweh, Buhru Priestess
06BW011T3.name: Nagakabouros' Tentacle

06BW011T2.description: When I'm summoned, grow my stats to that of your <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> <link=card.tentacle><style=AssociatedCard>Tentacle</style></link> and grant me its keywords.
06BW011T2.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, grow my stats to that of your strongest Tentacle and grant me its keywords.
06BW011T2.flavorText: "To say you've witnessed Nagakabouros after seeing her tendrils is to say you know the sun after witnessing daylight. Nagakabouros is more than enormous. Nagakabouros is unending." - Falaweh, Buhru Priestess
06BW011T2.name: Nagakabouros' Tentacle

06BW021.description:
Deal 3 to an enemy unit.
<link=vocab.Spawn><style=Vocab>Spawn</style></link> 3.
Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
06BW021.descriptionRaw:
Deal 3 to an enemy unit.
Spawn 3.
Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
06BW021.flavorText: "We learn as children to ride the dangerous waters. To struggle is to die. It is natural that the first trial a priestess must overcome is forgetting this lesson; to battle the undertow with all her might. For a Truth Bearer is not the swimmer--she is the current." - Illaoi
06BW021.name: Riptide Sermon

06BW045.flavorText: Not much keeps the circling sharks of Ripper's Bay away. Once they've had a taste of blood, they're eager for more.
06BW045.name: Blood in the Water

06BW028.description: <link=vocab.Spawn><style=Vocab>Spawn</style></link> 2, then your <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Tentacle</style></link> and an enemy <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> each other.
06BW028.descriptionRaw: Spawn 2, then your strongest Tentacle and an enemy strike each other.
06BW028.flavorText: "Life is a test. And pain is the teacher more often than we might like." - Illaoi
06BW028.name: Tentacle Smash

06BW035.descriptionRaw: Attack: Spawn 1 and give your strongest Tentacle Overwhelm this round.
06BW035.flavorText: Summoning Nagakabouros involves little in the way of ritual or rite. She answers the call of those whose soul can rise to match the ocean's, every swell, every thrash. It is a battle few can withstand.
06BW035.name: The Sea's Voice

06BW015.descriptionRaw: Spawn 2, or spend 5 mana to Spawn 4 instead.
06BW015.flavorText: Prayer to Nagakabouros is not about supplication, nor about asking and receiving. Hers is a blessing not unlike life: strive, struggle, push, and occasionally, reward will find you.
06BW015.name: Answered Prayer

06BW007.descriptionRaw: Round Start: Deal 2 to me and Spawn 1.
06BW007.flavorText: When terrors swarm out from the Shadow Isles, the idol glows bright--a blazing beacon on the horizon.
06BW007.name: Watchful Idol

06BW037.descriptionRaw: Manifest a follower you can afford.
06BW037.flavorText:
"Alright, Baz. You sure you wanna try again?"
"Third time's a charm, Gav. Besides, I reckon we've fought everything this stinkin' city's got goin' for it."
"Fought, and lost, Baz." - Baz and Gav, aspiring bounty hunters
06BW037.name: Ransom Riches

06BW041.description: Pick 1 of 2 non-champion cards from the enemy hand and create a copy in your hand. <link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: I cost 1 less.
06BW041.descriptionRaw: Pick 1 of 2 non-champion cards from the enemy hand and create a copy in your hand. Plunder: I cost 1 less.
06BW041.flavorText: "FIVE aces? Looks like I win again!" - Pool Shark
06BW041.name: Swindle

06BW016.flavorText: Life is sweetest in simplicity. Salt spray in your face, birdsong in your ears... and an uncomplicated foe on the horizon.
06BW016.name: Buhru Lookout

06BW009.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: A 1 cost ally starts a free attack.
06BW009.descriptionRaw: Play: A 1 cost ally starts a free attack.
06BW009.flavorText: "Recall the ocean's wisdom! If you do not move, you will be moved! Follow my voice if you've lost your way--for your foe surely knows their own."
06BW009.name: Buhru Leader

06BW043.description: Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.cardA><style=AssociatedCard>More Powder!</style></link>, <link=card.cardB><style=AssociatedCard>Playful Trickster</style></link>, or <link=card.cardC><style=AssociatedCard>Chum the Waters</style></link> in hand.
06BW043.descriptionRaw: Create a Fleeting More Powder!, Playful Trickster, or Chum the Waters in hand.
06BW043.flavorText: "Don't try to catch someone bluffin' in a match of 'stones. Bilgewater's full of good liars. If you really wanna win, you gotta watch the hands." - Twisted Fate
06BW043.name: Bilgewater Tellstones

06BW018.description:
When I'm summoned, summon a random Husk.
When you summon a 1 cost ally, grant the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> enemy <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link>.
06BW018.descriptionRaw:
When I'm summoned, summon a random Husk.
When you summon a 1 cost ally, grant the strongest enemy Vulnerable.
06BW018.flavorText: Evelynn's first encounter with Steem was a violent, thrilling affair. Evelynn remembered how he smiled with unbridled pleasure as she flayed him, and how he returned the suffering just as eagerly when it was his turn.
