After finally overpowering Steem, Evelynn chose then not to destroy the lesser demon, but to bind him to her forever. Perhaps, she thought, they could share their mutual love for butchery with the world.
06BW018.name: Steem

06BW015T4.flavorText: Prayer to Nagakabouros is not about supplication, nor about asking and receiving. Hers is a blessing not unlike life: strive, struggle, push, and occasionally, reward will find you.
06BW015T4.name: Answered Prayer

06BW015T5.flavorText: Prayer to Nagakabouros is not about supplication, nor about asking and receiving. Hers is a blessing not unlike life: strive, struggle, push, and occasionally, reward will find you.
06BW015T5.name: Answered Prayer

06SH014.description:
When I'm summoned, grant me all positive keywords allies have had this game.
When an ally has a new positive keyword, grant it to me. <style=Variable></style>
06SH014.descriptionRaw:
When I'm summoned, grant me all positive keywords allies have had this game.
When an ally has a new positive keyword, grant it to me.
06SH014.flavorText: "We had heard tales of Void breaches before, and the devastation that came with them. But to see it myself... I don't know that I will ever rid my eyes of that sight, or my heart of that horror." - Belveth survivor
06SH014.name: Void Abomination

06SH016.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant a unit and me each other's positive keywords. <style=Variable></style>
06SH016.descriptionRaw: Play: Grant a unit and me each other's positive keywords.
06SH016.flavorText: "It spoke to me as... as if it knew me. Like it wanted me to meet... something..." - Kai'Sa
06SH016.name: Hive Herald

06SH009.description: When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: If you have the attack token, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Second Skin</style></link> in hand.
06SH009.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned or Round Start: If you have the attack token, create a Second Skin in hand.
06SH009.flavorText: Just a few days prior, Kai'Sa noticed her second skin bristling with new excitement, pulling her with ever-increasing vigor toward the Shuriman coast. Something was wrong, and as Kai'Sa neared Belveth, she soon realized the scale of the horror unfolding before her.
06SH009.name: Kai'Sa

06SH048.description: <link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> an allied landmark that has been destroyed this game and summon it.
06SH048.descriptionRaw: Manifest an allied landmark that has been destroyed this game and summon it.
06SH048.flavorText: â€œA moment in time, preserved.â€ - Zilean
06SH048.name: Rite of Passage

06SH037.description:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant an enemy <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link>.
When an enemy is <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenged</style></link>, give it -2|-0 this round.
06SH037.descriptionRaw:
Play: Grant an enemy Vulnerable.
When an enemy is Challenged, give it -2|-0 this round.
06SH037.flavorText: Their sanity withered away like dunes in the wind--and in its place, a seed of anger flourished into a fury no desert waters could quench.
06SH037.name: Baccai Witherclaw

06SH008.flavorText: Shalatai reeled at the horror before her. There lay Ferai, the kind butcher's daughter, crushed to death. Beside her was Gorrub, the fisherman's son, still reaching toward his love with lifeless hands. So many memories gone. So many lives lost. With a grimace, Shalatai turned to the evil, ready to give her life to save the rest of her people.
06SH008.name: Belvethi Elder

06SH042.description: Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.create1><style=AssociatedCard>Ruthless Predator</style></link>, <link=card.create2><style=AssociatedCard>Weight of Judgment</style></link>, or <link=card.create3><style=AssociatedCard>Spirit Fire</style></link> in hand.
06SH042.descriptionRaw: Create a Fleeting Ruthless Predator, Weight of Judgment, or Spirit Fire in hand.
06SH042.flavorText: "A game of Tellstones is never about who wins--it's about how great you look while playing!" - Akshan
06SH042.name: Shuriman Tellstones

06SH009T4.description: Deal 1 for each positive keyword <link=card.level2><style=AssociatedCard>Kai'Sa</style></link> has to enemies or the enemy Nexus (lowest health first).
06SH009T4.descriptionRaw: Deal 1 for each positive keyword Kai'Sa has to enemies or the enemy Nexus (lowest health first).
06SH009T4.name: Icathian Rain

06SH009T2.description:
When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: If you have the attack token, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Second Skin</style></link> in hand.
<link=keyword.AttackSkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Attack</style></link>: Deal 1 for each positive keyword I have to enemies or the enemy Nexus (lowest health first).
06SH009T2.descriptionRaw:
When I'm summoned or Round Start: If you have the attack token, create a Second Skin in hand.
Attack: Deal 1 for each positive keyword I have to enemies or the enemy Nexus (lowest health first).
06SH009T2.flavorText: Kai'Sa worked as fast as she could. Another salvo tore through another abomination, sending it crashing to the ground. She had learned how to fight the Void long ago, but these creatures... they were different.
06SH009T2.name: Kai'Sa

06SH009T3.description: Grant allied <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Kai'Sas</style></link> <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> another ally's positive keywords.
06SH009T3.descriptionRaw: Grant allied Kai'Sas everywhere another ally's positive keywords.
06SH009T3.name: Second Skin

06SH009T1.description:
Grant an ally <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link> and <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>SpellShield</style></link>.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Kai'Sa</style></link> in your deck.
06SH009T1.descriptionRaw:
Grant an ally Overwhelm and SpellShield.
Create a Kai'Sa in your deck.
06SH009T1.flavorText: "I'll show you how to fight." - Kai'Sa
06SH009T1.name: Kai'Sa's Supercharge

06SH050.description: Give enemies -2|-0 this round. Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Instant Century</style></link> in hand.
06SH050.descriptionRaw: Give enemies -2|-0 this round. Create a Fleeting Instant Century in hand.
06SH050.flavorText: The sands of time flow without thought or consideration. Theirs is a scheme of cruel indifference, but not all are slave to its callous machinations...
06SH050.name: Sands of Time

06SH049.description:
I cost 2 less for each different Ascended ally you've summoned this game.
<link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> a card from the Emperor's Deck with cost 9 or less.
06SH049.descriptionRaw:
I cost 2 less for each different Ascended ally you've summoned this game.
Manifest a card from the Emperor's Deck with cost 9 or less.
06SH049.flavorText: â€œLook upon our work--look what we have built!â€ - Azir
06SH049.name: Glory's Call

06SH036.description: When you summon a champion, destroy me to grant it +2|+1 and <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>SpellShield</style></link>.
06SH036.descriptionRaw: When you summon a champion, destroy me to grant it +2|+1 and SpellShield.
06SH036.flavorText: Nasus emerged from the sarcophagus, his mind clear and his wounds fully healed. He scribbled a few notes and peered at the sarcophagi hanging high above, pondering the mental state of the beastly aberrations resting within. Time would tell if this magic could bring the baccai back from their insanity, a magic the other Ascended had once protested. But they were gone now and Renekton and his madness were not. Nasus scribbled a few more words, hoping he had finally found a way to save his brother.
06SH036.name: Chamber of Renewal

06SH011.descriptionRaw: Grant an ally Overwhelm and SpellShield.
06SH011.flavorText: "I'll show you how to fight." - Kai'Sa
06SH011.name: Supercharge

06SH017.description: Deal 1 to a follower. If you've <link=keyword.Evolve><sprite name=Evolve><style=Keyword>Evolved</style></link>, deal  3 to a unit instead. <style=Variable></style>
06SH017.descriptionRaw: Deal 1 to a follower. If you've Evolved, deal  3 to a unit instead.
06SH017.name: Void Seeker

06SH007.description:
While in hand, I have a random keyword that changes each round. When I'm summoned, grant me this keyword.
<style=Variable></style>
06SH007.descriptionRaw: While in hand, I have a random keyword that changes each round. When I'm summoned, grant me this keyword.
06SH007.flavorText: Dharna remembered throwing open the windows that morning and smelling the freshly baked loaves. Down the way, fishermen had already began hauling the day's catch up to the noon markets. She remembered smiling, thinking it would be a fine day.
06SH007.name: Voidling

06SH010.flavorText: The Void eruption in the city of Belveth was both sudden and terrifying. Most of the civilians were terrified by the chaos that quickly enveloped the city, and fled for safety as fast as they were able. Most, but not Koyemi.
06SH010.name: Void Blaster

06SH034.description:
When I'm summoned, summon a random Husk.
When you summon a 1 cost ally, grant it +1|+0.
06SH034.descriptionRaw:
When I'm summoned, summon a random Husk.
When you summon a 1 cost ally, grant it +1|+0.
06SH034.flavorText: Sometimes, all the powerful want is to feel powerless.
06SH034.name: Domination

06DE045.flavorText: "No more hiding! Step into the light, and shine brightly with me!" - Lux
06DE045.name: Inspiring Light

06DE038.description:
Other allies and your Nexus have <link=keyword.Tough><sprite name=Tough><style=Keyword>Tough</style></link>.
When an ally survives damage, grant it +1|+1.
06DE038.descriptionRaw:
Other allies and your Nexus have Tough.
When an ally survives damage, grant it +1|+1.
06DE038.flavorText: "I couldn't help but overhear your fervent whispering, dear wife. I advise you to exercise more caution when discussing family matters in so public a place. You can never be certain who might be listening."
06DE038.name: Lord Eldred, Mageseeker Leader

06DE037.description: Give an ally +2|+2 and <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link> this round or summon an <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Honored Lord</style></link>.
06DE037.descriptionRaw: Give an ally +2|+2 and Challenger this round or summon an Honored Lord.
06DE037.flavorText: "At once, King Jarvan. We shall see it done at any cost." - Barrett Buvelle, Honored Lord
06DE037.name: Royal Decree

06DE035.flavorText: Mageseekers place towering petricite obelisks throughout their compounds, ensuring that even the strongest mages are rendered completely powerless.
06DE035.name: Petricite Pillar

06DE042.description: Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.create1><style=AssociatedCard>Prismatic Barrier</style></link>, <link=card.create2><style=AssociatedCard>Detain</style></link>, or <link=card.create3><style=AssociatedCard>For Demacia!</style></link> in hand.
06DE042.descriptionRaw: Create a Fleeting Prismatic Barrier, Detain, or For Demacia! in hand.
06DE042.flavorText: "Why do they call it 'King's Gambit'? Queens take risks, too!" - Cithria of Cloudfield
06DE042.name: Demacian Tellstones

06DE036.description: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Draw a unit. If it's a Dragon, summon it attacking.
06DE036.descriptionRaw: Attack: Draw a unit. If it's a Dragon, summon it attacking.
06DE036.flavorText: "Luckily, my research suggests that broodfathers spend most of their time hunting a good distance from their young. It goes without saying that if the male should return, we would all be dragon food! Ha ha!" - Anden Mayne, Egghead Researcher
06DE036.name: Protective Broodfather

06DE037T2.description: Give an ally +2|+2 and <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link> this round.
06DE037T2.descriptionRaw: Give an ally +2|+2 and Challenger this round.
06DE037T2.flavorText: "At once, King Jarvan. We shall see it done at any cost." - Barrett Buvelle, Honored Lord
06DE037T2.name: Royal Decree

06DE037T1.flavorText: "At once, King Jarvan. We shall see it done at any cost." - Barrett Buvelle, Honored Lord
06DE037T1.name: Royal Decree

06DE030.description: Summon a random Husk and grant it +1|+0.
06DE030.descriptionRaw: Summon a random Husk and grant it +1|+0.
06DE030.name: Allure

06SI012.description: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: When another ally gains Power from <link=keyword.Hallowed><sprite name=Hallowed><style=Keyword>Hallowed</style></link>, so do I. <link=keyword.Drain><style=Keyword>Drain</style></link> 2 from the enemy Nexus.
06SI012.descriptionRaw: Attack: When another ally gains Power from Hallowed, so do I. Drain 2 from the enemy Nexus.
06SI012.flavorText: Gwen snip-snip-snipped her way through the Black Mist, thinking it strange how completely it enveloped the area, and once she had, the enchanted manse stood out amongst the bleak woods like a beacon. Little wonder Gwen was drawn to it. How curious it was--but also, how grand!
06SI012.name: Gwen

06SI012T5.description: <link=keyword.Drain><style=Keyword>Drain</style></link> 1 from the enemy Nexus one time for every 2 power <link=card.parent><style=AssociatedCard>Gwen</style></link> has. (<style=Variable></style>max 50 times, min 2 times)
06SI012T5.descriptionRaw: Drain 1 from the enemy Nexus one time for every 2 power Gwen has. (max 50 times, min 2 times)
06SI012T5.name: Snip Snip Snip!

06SI012T2.description:
Kill an ally to deal damage equal to its Power to an enemy.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Gwen</style></link> in your deck.
06SI012T2.descriptionRaw:
Kill an ally to deal damage equal to its Power to an enemy.
Create a Gwen in your deck.
06SI012T2.name: Gwen's Thread the Needle

06SI012T1.description: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: When another ally gains Power from <link=keyword.Hallowed><sprite name=Hallowed><style=Keyword>Hallowed</style></link>, so do I. <link=keyword.Drain><style=Keyword>Drain</style></link> 1 from the enemy Nexus one time for every 2 Power I have.
06SI012T1.descriptionRaw: Attack: When another ally gains Power from Hallowed, so do I. Drain 1 from the enemy Nexus one time for every 2 Power I have.
06SI012T1.flavorText: She knew that the Black Mist must be driven back from wherever it had spread to, and the joy and light these spirits lent her efforts cut through it readily. If she could help their celebration in the meantime, all the better!
06SI012T1.name: Gwen

06SI020.description: Kill an ally to deal 3 to a unit and if <link=card.evelynn><style=AssociatedCard>Evelynn</style></link> started in your deck, summon a random Husk.
06SI020.descriptionRaw: Kill an ally to deal 3 to a unit and if Evelynn started in your deck, summon a random Husk.
06SI020.flavorText: "Be as loud as you like." - Evelynn
06SI020.name: Hate Spike

06SI013.description: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Revive an attacking <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> copy of the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> dead ally other than <link=card.me><style=AssociatedCard>Eternal Dancers</style></link> with my power or less.
06SI013.descriptionRaw: Attack: Revive an attacking Ephemeral copy of the strongest dead ally other than Eternal Dancers with my power or less.
06SI013.flavorText: It's always easier to join someone on the dance floor than be the first person on it. The twins, however, are always delighted to show others how it's done.
06SI013.name: Eternal Dancers

06SI037.description: Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <nobr><link=card.create1><style=AssociatedCard>Mark of the Isles</style></link></nobr>, <link=card.create2><style=AssociatedCard>Spirit Journey</style></link>, or <link=card.create3><style=AssociatedCard>Crumble</style></link> in hand.
06SI037.descriptionRaw: Create a Fleeting Mark of the Isles, Spirit Journey, or Crumble in hand.
06SI037.flavorText: "Polished... decorations. Tokens... learn rules. Curious game. Breathtaking... unparalleled craftsmanship... unforgettable." - Recovered journal
06SI037.name: Shadow Isles Tellstones

06SI040.description: Revive the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> dead allied follower and grant it <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> and <link=keyword.Fearsome><sprite name=Fearsome><style=Keyword>Fearsome</style></link>. Give enemies -1|-0 this round.
06SI040.descriptionRaw: Revive the strongest dead allied follower and grant it Ephemeral and Fearsome. Give enemies -1|-0 this round.
06SI040.flavorText: Spirits can be banished for a time, but they always return.
06SI040.name: Harrowing Return

06SI009.flavorText: Their repertoire was impressive, from minuets and waltzes to ballads and folk songs, but truth be told, the party's guests were dying for something new.
06SI009.name: Ghastly Band

06SI027.description: Kill an ally to deal damage equal to its Power to an enemy.
06SI027.descriptionRaw: Kill an ally to deal damage equal to its Power to an enemy.
06SI027.name: Thread the Needle

06SI018.description: When I'm summoned, summon a random Husk.
06SI018.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, summon a random Husk.
06SI018.flavorText: Unlike other demons, who lure their victims in with false pretenses, Vora is too single-minded in her craving, too overwhelmed by desire. Rather than a predator who stalks her food, she is a wild beast who must be fed.
06SI018.name: Vora

06SI015.flavorText: "Keep it lively! Double-time!" - Conductor of the Mists
06SI015.name: Strike Up The Band

06SI030.description: Create copies in hand of 2 allied followers that have died this game.
06SI030.descriptionRaw: Create copies in hand of 2 allied followers that have died this game.
06SI030.flavorText: "Here we are, dear. I hear tonight will be quite a splendid affair, and I suspect we'll see many familiar faces!" - Ghostly Reveler
06SI030.name: Formal Invitation

06SI026.description: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Create a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Ghastly Band</style></link> in hand.
06SI026.descriptionRaw: Last Breath: Create a Ghastly Band in hand.
06SI026.flavorText: "Play on, my friends! We will have a livelier concert than ever before!"
06SI026.name: Conductor Of The Mists

06SI033.descriptionRaw: Countdown 2: Revive the strongest dead ally.
06SI033.flavorText: The sound of sword on shield was like a death knell, and it drew forth spirits whose tethers to the world had not quite been cut, whose will could not be quelled even in death.
06SI033.name: Haunted Tomb

06SI016.flavorText:
"We CORDIALLY INVITE you to the party of a lifetime at THE MIDNIGHT REVEL. Join us in celebration at PORCELAIN MANSE for drink, dance, and delight! (Celebrations to end promptly at the 13th hour)" 
- An invitation written in elegant cursive
06SI016.name: Boisterous Host

06SI028.flavorText: What would a fancy party be without fancy refreshments?
06SI028.name: Phantom Butler

06SI043.flavorText: Even in the Shadow Isles, old growth still finds new purpose.
06SI043.name: Undergrowth

06SI022.flavorText: Whether he was a ghost, a memory, or a dream, something about him was familiar...
06SI022.name: Ghostly Paramour

06SI019.description: When I'm summoned, summon a random Husk.
06SI019.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, summon a random Husk.
06SI019.flavorText:
"Beware those who smile on these haunted isles. Perhaps they are too newly arrived to understand the brutality of this place. Perhaps they are crazed. Perhaps they are something else entirely. But beware."
- Notes from Jens Tommen
06SI019.name: Sultur

06NX022.description: Draw an ally with 5+ Power, or grow an ally to 5 Power this round.
06NX022.descriptionRaw: Draw an ally with 5+ Power, or grow an ally to 5 Power this round.
06NX022.flavorText: "Few are given the opportunity to serve in the Trifarian Legion. Do not squander this chance." - Trifarian Assessor
06NX022.name: Legionary Charge

06NX019.description: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Grow my Power to that of the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>equipped</style></link> ally this round.
06NX019.descriptionRaw: Attack: Grow my Power to that of the strongest equipped ally this round.
06NX019.flavorText:
â€œBeen having dreams again, hearing that voice in the dark. Ten years... a whole bloody decade spent as the empire's obedient dog. Go there. Kill that. And for what? The glory of Noxus? Gloryâ€™s a pretty lie, and I fell for it. But no more. Kaynâ€™s shown me a different path, and it leads to vengeance.â€
- Royce, The Butcherâ€™s journal
06NX019.name: Noxian Defector

06NX020T1.description: <link=vocab.RoundEnd><style=Vocab>Round End</style></link>: The <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>Strongest</style></link> enemy and I <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> each other.
06NX020T1.descriptionRaw: Round End: The Strongest enemy and I strike each other.
06NX020T1.flavorText: Ancient muscles flexed once more. The warrior heard her general's call, and knew where she was needed--south, in the lands she once knew as Icathia.
06NX020T1.name: Naganeka of Zuretta

06NX020T5.flavorText: The steppes of eastern Valoran were known to be barren, unfit to feed or home the Noxii people. But as the centuries fell by, a new empire was founded, hungry for expansion. Fallow lands found new fertility under new farming techniques, and weapons once thought safely buried become uncovered once again.
06NX020T5.name: The Darkin Ballista

06NX022T1.flavorText: "Few are given the opportunity to serve in the Trifarian Legion. Do not squander this chance." - Trifarian Assessor
06NX022T1.name: Legionary Charge

06NX022T2.description: Grow an ally to 5 Power this round.
06NX022T2.descriptionRaw: Grow an ally to 5 Power this round.
06NX022T2.flavorText: "Few are given the opportunity to serve in the Trifarian Legion. Do not squander this chance." - Trifarian Assessor
06NX022T2.name: Legionary Charge

06NX023.flavorText: Triskâ€™s life was turned upside down when, during what would be her last fishing tournament, she somehow managed to fish up a sputtering Jax. He refuses to discuss the incident, but the sea monster Trisk rescued him from gets bigger each time she retells it.
06NX023.name: Ionian Hookmaster

06NX044.description: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Grow other attacking allies' Power to mine this round.
06NX044.descriptionRaw: Attack: Grow other attacking allies' Power to mine this round.
06NX044.flavorText: "A good mother teaches her children to hunt. But a great mother... she does the hunting for them." - Elise
06NX044.name: Skulking String-Puller

06NX041.description: <link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: Deal 1 to my supported ally to give me +1|+1 this round.
06NX041.descriptionRaw: Support: Deal 1 to my supported ally to give me +1|+1 this round.
06NX041.flavorText: "It's rather fun, feeding the birds. I wagered with poor Feoward that they'd sup blood as keenly as a Bordent basilisk, and lo and behold: the pigeons are Noxian indeed!" - Edvin Cortain, Crimson Curator
06NX041.name: Crimson Pigeon

06NX020.description: You may spend 8 mana to play me as <link=card.unit><style=AssociatedCard>Naganeka of Zuretta</style></link>.
06NX020.descriptionRaw: You may spend 8 mana to play me as Naganeka of Zuretta.
06NX020.flavorText: The steppes of eastern Valoran were known to be barren, unfit to feed or home the Noxii people. But as the centuries fell by, a new empire was founded, hungry for expansion. Fallow lands found new fertility under new farming techniques, and weapons once thought safely buried become uncovered once again.
06NX020.name: The Darkin Ballista

06NX039.description: Deal 2 to an ally to give allies +2|+0 this round.
06NX039.descriptionRaw: Deal 2 to an ally to give allies +2|+0 this round.
06NX039.flavorText: "It's not a feast until someone starts screaming. So scream, boy." - Vladimir
06NX039.name: Reveler's Feast

06NX026.flavorText: Vessid isn't the Bordent's fastest Reckoner, but when his great hammers find their target, there's never much of an opponent left to fight back.
06NX026.name: Great Hammers

06NX034.descriptionRaw: An Equipped ally strikes an enemy.
06NX034.flavorText: "Brothers in blood, once again!" - Noxian Defector
06NX034.name: Furious Wielder

06NX036.flavorText: For months, he'd slogged through the cold and the rain, a thankless task with no end in sight. And yet the end came. Finally, he would make something of himself.
06NX036.name: Rune Squire

06NX027.description: Destroy an enemy's equipment. An ally and that enemy <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> each other.
06NX027.descriptionRaw: Destroy an enemy's equipment. An ally and that enemy strike each other.
06NX027.flavorText:
"One two, watch him scream,
The soldier's caught on fi-re,
three four, watch him burn,
Tibbers wants a py-re!" - Annie
06NX027.name: Brutal Skirmish

06MT035.description:
I have +2|+2 for each ally that died with its power increased.
<link=vocab.Empowered><style=Vocab>Empowered</style></link> 16: Transform me into <link=card.transform><style=AssociatedCard>Xolaani, Aspect's Bane</style></link>.
06MT035.descriptionRaw:
I have +2|+2 for each ally that died with its power increased.
Empowered 16: Transform me into Xolaani, Aspect's Bane.
06MT035.flavorText: Xolaani watched on as Anaakco fell to his knees, subjugated by the very enemy he sought so desperately to destroy. Slowly, the beat of his heart rang out in unison with the others. Another heart to control. Another body to command.
06MT035.name: Xolaani the Bloodweaver

06MT007.flavorText: "Ah, I see it now... the shapes left in the mountain were merely imprints--conduits for the beings from the realm beyond the stars..." - Lorekeeper Skai'en
06MT007.name: Seraphic Wyvern

06MT037.description: <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> an ally and create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Corrupted Form</style></link> with its stats.
06MT037.descriptionRaw: Obliterate an ally and create a Corrupted Form with its stats.
06MT037.flavorText: The fallen god-warriors entombed in these weapons could not be easily defeated, and so instead were contained.
06MT037.name: Seal In Steel

06MT037T1.flavorText: While the Darkin were entombed in the weapons they carried, they slowly changed until they resembled nothing of their original form.
06MT037T1.name: Corrupted Form

06MT031.description:
<link=vocab.RoundEnd><style=Vocab>Round End</style></link>: Grant allies in play and in hand +1|+1.
<link=vocab.Empowered><style=Vocab>Empowered</style></link> 5: <link=keyword.Elusive><sprite name=Elusive><style=Keyword>Elusive</style></link>, <link=keyword.Lifesteal><sprite name=Lifesteal><style=Keyword>Lifesteal</style></link>, and <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link>.
06MT031.descriptionRaw:
Round End: Grant allies in play and in hand +1|+1.
Empowered 5: Elusive, Lifesteal, and Overwhelm.
06MT031.flavorText: "Some revere the Aspects as gods. Others see them as messengers from the realm beyond. Still others fear them... and perhaps rightly so." - Lorekeeper Skai'en
06MT031.name: Mihira, Aspect of Justice

06MT010.description:
Give an ally "I can't take damage or die" this round. 
Give all allies +1|+0 this round.
06MT010.descriptionRaw:
Give an ally "I can't take damage or die" this round. 
Give all allies +1|+0 this round.
06MT010.name: Divine Judgment

06MT016.flavorText: "Yes... I recognize you. The message you bear... it can only be a summons." - Ryze
06MT016.name: Winged Messenger

06MT035T1.description:
I have +2|+2 for each ally that died with its power increased.
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Transform attacking non-Darkin followers into exact copies of me.
06MT035T1.descriptionRaw:
I have +2|+2 for each ally that died with its power increased.
Attack: Transform attacking non-Darkin followers into exact copies of me.
06MT035T1.flavorText: More. More. Even the great hero of legend Mihira could not withstand Xolaani's overwhelming strength. The earth seemed to shudder to one beat now, such was the hemomantic power growing within Xolaani. She took a moment to observe the battlefield, and wept with the joy filling her soul. Soon, this world would be united in peace. In love. In silence.
06MT035T1.name: Xolaani, Aspect's Bane

06MT042.description:
<link=keyword.Daybreak><style=Keyword>Daybreak</style></link>: Give <link=keyword.Daybreak><style=Keyword>Daybreak</style></link> allies +1|+1 this round.
<link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link>: Grant <link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link> allies +1|+0.
06MT042.descriptionRaw:
Daybreak: Give Daybreak allies +1|+1 this round.
Nightfall: Grant Nightfall allies +1|+0.
06MT042.flavorText: In the twilight hours and just before sunrise the owl can be heard, its call a reminder of the liminal places between dusk and dawn.
06MT042.name: Twilit Protector

06MT008.description:
I have +1|+0 for each time an ally attacked with increased Power.
When I'm summoned, grant allies +1|+0.
<link=vocab.Empowered><style=Vocab>Empowered</style></link> 6: <link=keyword.Quick Strike><sprite name=QuickStrike><style=Keyword>Quick Attack</style></link>.
06MT008.descriptionRaw:
I have +1|+0 for each time an ally attacked with increased Power.
When I'm summoned, grant allies +1|+0.
Empowered 6: Quick Attack.
06MT008.flavorText: "The Demacians know her as the Winged Protector, but those of us who live under the vault of stars in Targon know her as the daughter of Justice, bearing divine purpose and a sword of starfire." - Lorekeeper Skai'en
06MT008.name: Kayle

06MT008T2.description:
I have +1|+0 for each time an ally attacked with increased Power.
When I'm summoned or level up, grant allies +1|+1.
<link=vocab.Empowered><style=Vocab>Empowered</style></link> 16: <link=keyword.Double Strike><sprite name=DoubleStrike><style=Keyword>Double Attack</style></link>.
06MT008T2.descriptionRaw:
I have +1|+0 for each time an ally attacked with increased Power.
When I'm summoned or level up, grant allies +1|+1.
Empowered 16: Double Attack.
06MT008T2.flavorText: "We would surely know her to see her, should she ever return... but I worry there is little reason for her to do so beyond a threat so dire that it requires her interference." - Lorekeeper Skai'en
06MT008T2.name: Kayle

06MT008T1.description:
Give an ally "I can't take damage or die" this round. 
Give all allies +1|+0 this round.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Kayle</style></link> in your deck.
06MT008T1.descriptionRaw:
Give an ally "I can't take damage or die" this round. 
Give all allies +1|+0 this round.
Create a Kayle in your deck.
06MT008T1.name: Kayle's Divine Judgment

06MT004.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Pick an ally, it <link=vocab.Improvise><style=Vocab>Improvises</style></link>. If you don't, I <link=vocab.Improvise><style=Vocab>Improvise</style></link>.
06MT004.descriptionRaw: Play: Pick an ally, it Improvises. If you don't, I Improvise.
06MT004.flavorText: Jax helped Chaska rescue their herd from rampaging faefolk. Then, Chaska rescued Jax from rampaging faefolk. They travel together whenever one of them doesnâ€™t wander off.
06MT004.name: Wandering Shepherd

06MT017.flavorText: "It is said that when Mihira left this place, she left a part of herself behind--a holy flame, burning brightly. For years, my family has tended to that fire, keeping it lit in the hopes that she may yet return."
06MT017.name: Divine Clerk

06MT040.description:
Once you've <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> an ally this game, I cost 2 less.
Give an ally <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>SpellShield</style></link> this round.
06MT040.descriptionRaw:
Once you've Equipped an ally this game, I cost 2 less.
Give an ally SpellShield this round.
06MT040.flavorText: Look to the night sky and focus your eyes on a small swathe of the firmament. Now imagine all those lived within it, all the knowledge gained and all the experiences lived over countless millennia. Imagine all that information condensed into a shard that could fit into the palm of your hand. Think of how much wisdom you would hold. How much power.
06MT040.name: The Expanse's Protection

06MT034.description: <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> a unit or landmark. Heal your Nexus 3.
06MT034.descriptionRaw: Obliterate a unit or landmark. Heal your Nexus 3.
06MT034.flavorText: "Who would arrive in our hour of need?" - Shuriman Elder
06MT034.name: Celestial Impact

06MT033.flavorText: Many call upon the might of dragons, though it manifests differently across Runeterra. Those that invoke the power of a celestial dragon may discover they possess an inner strength that burns as bright and hot as a star.
06MT033.name: Draconic Bands

06MT053.description: When you play a spell, grant a random ally in hand +1|+1.
06MT053.descriptionRaw: When you play a spell, grant a random ally in hand +1|+1.
06MT053.flavorText: Eyes kind but expression hidden behind a veil, she offers crystal prayer beads to those making ready to begin their pilgrimages. She asks nothing from them in return, for the price will be paid on the Mountain.
06MT053.name: Generous Gemcrafter

06MT006.description:
<link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: Grant my supported ally +1|+1.
You may spend 8 mana to play me as <link=card.unit><style=AssociatedCard>Horazi</style></link>.
06MT006.descriptionRaw:
Support: Grant my supported ally +1|+1.
You may spend 8 mana to play me as Horazi.
06MT006.flavorText: Perhaps those who imprisoned the Darkin thought that burying the legendary warrior Horazi within an orb of star metal would sufficiently dim her irascible will. But as her general stirred, so too did Horazi, who found that even Targon's ancient protectors could be tempted by promises whispered from afar.
06MT006.name: The Darkin Lodestone

06MT006T2.description: <link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: Grow my supported ally's stats to mine. Give it my positive keywords this round.
06MT006T2.descriptionRaw: Support: Grow my supported ally's stats to mine. Give it my positive keywords this round.
06MT006T2.flavorText: Horazi was gifted a higher perspective in the burning celestial matter that imprisoned her. She glimpsed the secrets of the cosmos, and of the infinite passage of time that preceded and followed her existence. She learned so much, and yet her hatred for the coward Xolaani remained.
06MT006T2.name: Horazi

06MT006T3.flavorText: Perhaps those who imprisoned the Darkin thought that burying the legendary warrior Horazi within an orb of star metal would sufficiently dim her irascible will. But as her general stirred, so too did Horazi, who found that even Targon's ancient protectors could be tempted by promises whispered from afar.
06MT006T3.name: The Darkin Lodestone

06MT018.description: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> enemies with less Power than me.
06MT018.descriptionRaw: Play: Stun enemies with less Power than me.
06MT018.flavorText: "I fear the day has finally come... Justice returns on golden wings, and with her she brings a shining army!" - Lorekeeper Skai'en
06MT018.name: Lawkeeper

06MT052.description: Grant an ally in play and an ally in hand <link=keyword.Spirit><sprite name=Spirit><style=Keyword>Spirit</style></link>.
06MT052.descriptionRaw: Grant an ally in play and an ally in hand Spirit.
06MT052.name: Celestial Blessing

06MT018T1.description: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> enemies with less Power than me.
06MT018T1.descriptionRaw: Stun enemies with less Power than me.
06MT018T1.flavorText: "Gaze upon its golden light and know judgment!" - Mihira, Aspect of Justice
06MT018T1.name: Blinding Light

06MT032.description: When I'm summoned or once you've <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> an ally this game, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Gem</style></link> in hand.
06MT032.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned or once you've Equipped an ally this game, create a Gem in hand.
06MT032.flavorText: She sought an end to the conflict between Sun and Moon, day and night. The bow offered power, though it came with a terrible cost - yet she pledged herself to it anyway, hoping that it would stop the war once and for all.
06MT032.name: Lunari Cultist

06RU008.descriptionRaw:
Origin: Grandmaster at Arms.
Auto-Equip: The Light of Icathia.
06RU008.levelupDescription: Equipped allies have attacked with 16+ total Power. <style=Variable></style>
06RU008.levelupDescriptionRaw: Equipped allies have attacked with 16+ total Power.
06RU008.flavorText: Centuries ago, Jax lost his homeland to the Void. Now, he travels the world, searching for warriors with the strength of will--and the sheer gall--to one day stand against that terrible foe.
06RU008.name: Jax

06RU008T6.description: If <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Jax</style></link> has leveled, <link=card.selfref><style=AssociatedCard>The Light of Icathia</style></link> has <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link>.
06RU008T6.descriptionRaw: If Jax has leveled, The Light of Icathia has Overwhelm.
06RU008T6.flavorText: "It's a stick with a heavy bit at the end. Weapon enough for me." - Jax
06RU008T6.name: The Light of Icathia

06RU008T7.description:
<link=vocab.AutoEquip><style=Vocab>Auto-Equip</style></link> <link=card.equipment><style=AssociatedCard>The Light of Icathia</style></link>.
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Give me +1|+1 this round for each <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> ally.
06RU008T7.descriptionRaw:
Auto-Equip The Light of Icathia.
Attack: Give me +1|+1 this round for each Equipped ally.
06RU008T7.flavorText: "Icathia's been quiet a long time. But while I'm still standin', her people's roar will echo forever!" - Jax
06RU008T7.name: Jax

06RU008T5.description: You may put any Weaponmaster cards into your deck during deckbuilding.
06RU008T5.descriptionRaw: You may put any Weaponmaster cards into your deck during deckbuilding.
06RU008T5.name: Grandmaster at Arms

06RU008T8.description:
Give <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Jax</style></link> <link=keyword.Barrier><sprite name=Barrier><style=Keyword>Barrier</style></link> this round and <link=vocab.Forge><style=Vocab>Forge</style></link> him.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Jax</style></link> in your deck.
06RU008T8.descriptionRaw:
Give Jax Barrier this round and Forge him.
Create a Jax in your deck.
06RU008T8.flavorText: "That's right, eyes on the champ!" - Jax
06RU008T8.name: Jax's Counter Strike

06RU006.description:
<link=vocab.Origin><style=Vocab>Origin</style></link>: <link=card.origin><style=AssociatedCard>The Rune Mage</style></link>.
When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Create 2 <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Delve Into The Pasts</style></link> in your deck.
06RU006.descriptionRaw:
Origin: The Rune Mage.
When I'm summoned or Round Start: Create 2 Delve Into The Pasts in your deck.
06RU006.flavorText: Ryze crested the ridge, accompanied by Kayle's silent servant. He looked down on a land scarred by war, and caught sight of the darkin monstrosities warring below. For centuries, he had watched on as humanity veered from one catastrophe to another. What if, he thought, his efforts were futile, and Runeterra was doomed to die?"
06RU006.name: Ryze

06RU006T2.description:
When I'm <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Played</style></link>, if I'm unique, activate all your other World Runes.
When I'm <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Played</style></link> or activated, deal 2 to the <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> enemy.
06RU006T2.descriptionRaw:
When I'm Played, if I'm unique, activate all your other World Runes.
When I'm Played or activated, deal 2 to the weakest enemy.
06RU006T2.flavorText: Of all the wrongs Ryze had witnessed in his time on Runeterra, this cut the deepest. How could his own master, who inculcated in Ryze the virtues of control and patience, lose himself so fully to the World Runes? How?!
06RU006T2.name: Shard of Betrayal

06RU006T3.description:
Draw 3. Discard any followers drawn.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Ryze</style></link> in your deck.
06RU006T3.descriptionRaw:
Draw 3. Discard any followers drawn.
Create a Ryze in your deck.
06RU006T3.flavorText: "The shards will show me the path..." - Ryze
06RU006T3.name: Ryze's Realm Warp

06RU006T7.description:
When I'm <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Played</style></link>, if I'm unique, activate all your other World Runes.
When I'm <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Played</style></link> or activated, refill your spell mana.
06RU006T7.descriptionRaw:
When I'm Played, if I'm unique, activate all your other World Runes.
When I'm Played or activated, refill your spell mana.
06RU006T7.flavorText: Lust for power seemed a common trait among the Runeterrans. Even Targon's revered few craved it, and so when they realized that simple flattery could bring them the power of the stars themselves, they didn't hesitate.
06RU006T7.name: Shard of Reverence

06RU006T6.description:
When I'm <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Played</style></link>, if I'm unique, activate all your other World Runes.
When I'm <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Played</style></link> or activated, heal allied <link=card.ryze><style=AssociatedCard>Ryzes</style></link> and your Nexus 2.
06RU006T6.descriptionRaw:
When I'm Played, if I'm unique, activate all your other World Runes.
When I'm Played or activated, heal allied Ryzes and your Nexus 2.
06RU006T6.flavorText: Love. A fog that blinds the wise to reason, and that rids the patient of patience. Ryze watched on as the King lowered his beloved beneath the waters, and closed his eyes as the screaming began. Ryze felt the cold grip of undeath spread through the room, then beyond. All for love.
06RU006T6.name: Shard of Hope

06RU006T9.flavorText: "THEY ARE MINE TO CONTROL! MINE!" - Tyrus
06RU006T9.name: Overload

06RU006T5.description:
When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Create 2 <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Delve Into The Pasts</style></link> in your deck.
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Activate all your World Runes. If you have 5 unique World Runes, destroy the enemy Nexus.
06RU006T5.descriptionRaw:
When I'm summoned or Round Start: Create 2 Delve Into The Pasts in your deck.
Attack: Activate all your World Runes. If you have 5 unique World Runes, destroy the enemy Nexus.
06RU006T5.flavorText: Ryze pulled himself back to the present. The mindscapes he'd visited had answered his questions, and filled him with purpose. The flaws of Runeterra's people, great as they were, should not condemn them to oblivion.
06RU006T5.name: Ryze

06RU006T1.description:
When I'm <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Played</style></link>, if I'm unique, activate all your other World Runes.
When I'm <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Played</style></link> or activated, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Rune Prison</style></link> in hand or if you have one, reduce its cost by 1.
06RU006T1.descriptionRaw:
When I'm Played, if I'm unique, activate all your other World Runes.
When I'm Played or activated, create a Rune Prison in hand or if you have one, reduce its cost by 1.
06RU006T1.flavorText: The god-warriors of Shurima were thought peerless. Perfect. But years of war against an unstoppable foe eventually bowed their spirits, then broke them entirely. Xolaani and Aatrox turned on each other in a dispute that soon threatened Runeterra's very existence.
06RU006T1.name: Shard of Madness

06RU006T8.description:
You may put any non-targeted <link=keyword.Burst><sprite name=Burst><style=Keyword>Burst</style></link> and <link=keyword.Focus><sprite name=Focus><style=Keyword>Focus</style></link> spells into your deck during deckbuilding.
At the start of the game, create 2 <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Delve Into The Past</style></link> in your deck for each Ryze that started the game in your deck.
06RU006T8.descriptionRaw:
You may put any non-targeted Burst and Focus spells into your deck during deckbuilding.
At the start of the game, create 2 Delve Into The Past in your deck for each Ryze that started the game in your deck.
06RU006T8.flavorText: Can this world be saved? And if it can... should it?
06RU006T8.name: The Rune Mage

06RU006T11.description: Choose one of two World Runes you don't have in play or in hand and create it in hand. If you can't, I cost 1 less and draw 1.
06RU006T11.descriptionRaw: Choose one of two World Runes you don't have in play or in hand and create it in hand. If you can't, I cost 1 less and draw 1.
06RU006T11.flavorText: Before him, the world teetered on the brink of apocalypse. Ryze had the power to save Runeterra, but as he watched the carnage unfolding ahead of him, a single question lingered in him: should he? He resolved to create mindscapes of Runeterra's pivotal moments, and let his understanding of the land's history decide its future.
06RU006T11.name: Delve Into The Past

06RU006T4.description:
When I'm <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Played</style></link>, if I'm unique, activate all your other World Runes.
When I'm <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Played</style></link> or activated, draw 1.
06RU006T4.descriptionRaw:
When I'm Played, if I'm unique, activate all your other World Runes.
When I'm Played or activated, draw 1.
06RU006T4.flavorText: Ryze watched on as the mindscape before him constructed itself. Before him. the Icathians warred with Shurima in a desperate bid for freedom. Ryze knew too well what came next, but watched on regardless. Cruel purple tendrils burst out, engulfing the battlefield. Icathia reached for freedom, but in the darkness, unleashed the Void upon Runeterra.
06RU006T4.name: Shard of Violence

06RU005.description:
<link=vocab.Origin><style=Vocab>Origin</style></link>: <link=card.origin><style=AssociatedCard>The Shadow Reaper</style></link>.
<link=vocab.AutoEquip><style=Vocab>Auto-Equip</style></link>: <link=card.equipment><style=AssociatedCard>The Darkin Scythe</style></link>.
When I kill an enemy, heal me 2.
06RU005.descriptionRaw:
Origin: The Shadow Reaper.
Auto-Equip: The Darkin Scythe.
When I kill an enemy, heal me 2.
06RU005.levelupDescription: I've <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>struck</style></link> twice.<style=Variable></style> When I level up, <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> me.
06RU005.levelupDescriptionRaw: I've struck twice. When I level up, Recall me.
06RU005.flavorText: As another body fell, Kayn let out a gleeful laugh, knowing that he would soon unleash the second Darkin weapon that lay below. Within him, Rhaast's anticipation grew, knowing that Kaynâ€™s undoing was finally near.
06RU005.name: Kayn

06RU005T11.flavorText: As Kayn yielded his spirit to the Darkin, his anger subsided and an unbearable emptiness was left in its place. The young warrior was gone. Only Rhaast remained.
06RU005T11.name: Corrupted Scythe

06RU005T10.flavorText: Kaynâ€™s anger grew into a fearsome blaze amidst Rhaast's furious screams. The Darkin's hold on the shadow warrior burned away, and when Kayn rose to his feet, he knew the full power of the Darkin was his to command.
06RU005T10.name: Shadow Scythe

06RU005T4.description:
Give <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Kayn</style></link> <link=keyword.Quick Strike><sprite name=QuickStrike><style=Keyword>Quick Attack</style></link> this round. He starts a free attack <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenging</style></link> an enemy.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Kayn</style></link> in your deck.
06RU005T4.descriptionRaw:
Give Kayn Quick Attack this round. He starts a free attack Challenging an enemy.
Create a Kayn in your deck.
06RU005T4.name: Kayn's Shadowstep

06RU005T2.description:
<link=vocab.AutoEquip><style=Vocab>Auto-Equip</style></link>: <link=card.equipment><style=AssociatedCard>Corrupted Scythe</style></link>.
When I kill an enemy, fully heal me and heal your Nexus 2.
06RU005T2.descriptionRaw:
Auto-Equip: Corrupted Scythe.
When I kill an enemy, fully heal me and heal your Nexus 2.
06RU005T2.flavorText: Rhaast let out a triumphant howl. Years of waiting, yearning, and now... he was finally free. He lifted Xolaaniâ€™s blades and put them to his tongue, savoring the taste of fresh blood. He closed his eyes in bliss, and a smile crept across his face for the first time in millennia. The reaping had begun.
06RU005T2.name: Rhaast

06RU005T8.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Transform me and all copies of me into <link=card.Rhaast><style=AssociatedCard>Rhaast</style></link> or <link=card.TheShadowAssassin><style=AssociatedCard>The Shadow Assassin</style></link>.
06RU005T8.descriptionRaw: Play: Transform me and all copies of me into Rhaast or The Shadow Assassin.
06RU005T8.flavorText: A fierce and sudden flash of anger overwhelmed Kayn, and a terrible, searing pain passed behind his eyes, bringing him to his knees. Rhaastâ€™s triumphant laughter echoed all around him, mocking and merciless. He had known this day would come--the day he would finally prevail or lose himself to the Darkin...
06RU005T8.name: Kayn

06RU005T1.flavorText: Tremendous power flowed through his veins. Freed from the Darkinâ€™s influence, the full power of the shadows was his to command. Kayn laughed, slipping into darkness, and emerged a moment later only to silently slit the throat of the guard before him.
06RU005T1.name: The Shadow Assassin

06RU005T6.description: You may put any Cultist cards into your deck during deckbuilding. Once you've summoned 4+ Cultist units, draw a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Kayn</style></link>.
06RU005T6.descriptionRaw: You may put any Cultist cards into your deck during deckbuilding. Once you've summoned 4+ Cultist units, draw a Kayn.
06RU005T6.flavorText: Only two outcomes are possible: either Kayn bends Rhaast to his will, or he is consumed by it.
06RU005T6.name: The Shadow Reaper

06RU026.description:
<link=vocab.Origin><style=Vocab>Origin</style></link>: <link=card.origin><style=AssociatedCard>The World Ender</style></link>.
<link=vocab.AutoEquip><style=Vocab>Auto-Equip</style></link>: <link=card.item><style=AssociatedCard>The Darkin Blade</style></link>.
When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link>: Heal your Nexus 2 and create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>World Ender</style></link> in hand if you don't have one.
06RU026.descriptionRaw:
Origin: The World Ender.
Auto-Equip: The Darkin Blade.
When I'm summoned or strike: Heal your Nexus 2 and create a World Ender in hand if you don't have one.
06RU026.flavorText: Even across continents, Aatrox felt her awakening. How the hatred still burned. He had already broken her statues, now he could wage a final war against the Coward of Icathia, and through destroying her, end this pitiful existence.
06RU026.name: Aatrox

06RU026T4.description:
<link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Aatrox</style></link> and an enemy <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> each other.
Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Deathbringer Descent</style></link> in hand.
06RU026T4.descriptionRaw:
Aatrox and an enemy strike each other.
Create a Deathbringer Descent in hand.
06RU026T4.flavorText: "I am the ender of worlds!" - Aatrox
06RU026T4.name: Deathbringer Slash

06RU026T2.descriptionRaw: Aatrox and an enemy strike each other.
06RU026T2.name: Deathbringer Descent

06RU026T5.description:
<link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Aatrox</style></link> and an enemy <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> each other.
Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Deathbringer Slash</style></link> in hand.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Aatrox</style></link> in your deck.
06RU026T5.descriptionRaw:
Aatrox and an enemy strike each other.
Create a Deathbringer Slash in hand.
Create a Aatrox in your deck.
06RU026T5.name: Aatrox's Deathbringer Sweep

06RU026T1.flavorText: "By my sword, this world must die." - Aatrox
06RU026T1.name: The Darkin Blade

06RU026T7.description:
I cost 1 less for each time an <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> or Darkin ally has struck this game.
<link=vocab.Assimilate><style=Vocab>Assimilate</style></link> allied followers <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> with Darkin.
06RU026T7.descriptionRaw:
I cost 1 less for each time an Equipped or Darkin ally has struck this game.
Assimilate allied followers Equipped with Darkin.
06RU026T7.name: World Ender

06RU026T3.description:
<link=vocab.AutoEquip><style=Vocab>Auto-Equip</style></link>: <link=card.item><style=AssociatedCard>The Darkin Blade</style></link>.
Darkin allies cost 5 less.
When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link>: Heal your Nexus 2.
06RU026T3.descriptionRaw:
Auto-Equip: The Darkin Blade.
Darkin allies cost 5 less.
When I'm summoned or strike: Heal your Nexus 2.
06RU026T3.flavorText: The battle gathered pace. Xolaani had finally found the courage to face him, and as the two ancient enemies warred, the terrain itself began to wither and bend beneath their fury. An army of celestials descended upon them, desperate to save their dying land--but it was too late. Aatrox would have his day. He would find his peace.
06RU026T3.name: Aatrox

06RU026T6.description: You may put any non-Champion Darkin into your deck during deckbuilding. Once you've played or summoned 3+ different other Darkin, draw a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Aatrox</style></link>.
06RU026T6.descriptionRaw: You may put any non-Champion Darkin into your deck during deckbuilding. Once you've played or summoned 3+ different other Darkin, draw a Aatrox.
06RU026T6.flavorText: Peace. Peace through war. Peace through death. Peace through oblivion.
06RU026T6.name: The World Ender

06RU033.flavorText: The monks of Hirana send unruly students to the fisherfolk for a lesson in patience. Only a handful ever choose to return to the monastery.
06RU033.name: Combat Reel

06RU041.descriptionRaw: Give Jax Barrier this round and Forge him.
06RU041.flavorText: "That's right, eyes on the champ!" - Jax
06RU041.name: Counter Strike

06RU034.flavorText: Do NOT wash it with soap. Warm water or magic only.
06RU034.name: Pan O' Pain

06RU009.descriptionRaw:
Origin: The Arrow of Retribution.
Auto-Equip The Darkin Bow.
06RU009.flavorText: What if, over time, the man that became the Darkin remembered himself, prompted by the mortal voices within? What if, instead of overcoming those voices entirely, he came to believe in them?
06RU009.name: Varus

06RU009T10.description:
Give an enemy <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link> and give an ally +1|+0 this round.
Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.selfRef><style=AssociatedCard>Chain of Corruption</style></link> in hand.
06RU009T10.descriptionRaw:
Give an enemy Vulnerable and give an ally +1|+0 this round.
Create a Fleeting Chain of Corruption in hand.
06RU009T10.name: Chain of Corruption

06RU009T9.description:
Give an enemy <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link> and give an ally +1|+0 this round.
Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.selfRef><style=AssociatedCard>Chain of Corruption</style></link> in hand. 
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Varus</style></link> in your deck.
06RU009T9.descriptionRaw:
Give an enemy Vulnerable and give an ally +1|+0 this round.
Create a Fleeting Chain of Corruption in hand. 
Create a Varus in your deck.
06RU009T9.name: Varus' Chain of Corruption

06RU009T7.description: When you play a spell or <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>equip</style></link> an ally, give me +1|+0 (max +5|+0) until the next time my bearer <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link>.
06RU009T7.descriptionRaw: When you play a spell or equip an ally, give me +1|+0 (max +5|+0) until the next time my bearer strikes.
06RU009T7.flavorText: Heartlights Kai and Valmar were not the first to bear the bow and host Varus' inhuman power... but they were the first to remind him of his lost humanity.
06RU009T7.name: The Darkin Bow

06RU009T6.description:
<link=vocab.AutoEquip><style=Vocab>Auto-Equip</style></link> <link=card.item><style=AssociatedCard>The Darkin Bow</style></link>. 
<link=card.item><style=AssociatedCard>The Darkin Bow</style></link> activates twice and has max +10|+0.
06RU009T6.descriptionRaw:
Auto-Equip The Darkin Bow. 
The Darkin Bow activates twice and has max +10|+0.
06RU009T6.flavorText: Varus was empowered, bolstered, reminded of who he was and what he had yet to become. He embraced the sum of his parts instead of working against them--and when they acted, they acted as one.
06RU009T6.name: Varus

06RU009T11.description:
You may put any Cultist cards into your deck during deckbuilding.
Once you've played 3+ Cultist spells, draw a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Varus</style></link>.
06RU009T11.descriptionRaw:
You may put any Cultist cards into your deck during deckbuilding.
Once you've played 3+ Cultist spells, draw a Varus.
06RU009T11.flavorText: "We will seek out our betrayers, and we will bring them oblivion." - Varus
06RU009T11.name: The Arrow of Retribution

06RU043.flavorText: "If I am to act, I must act now." - Ryze
06RU043.name: Realm Warp

06RU029.flavorText: Catch and release is an excellent tactic whether you're fishing or fighting.
06RU029.name: Fishawhack

06RU040.description: Give <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Kayn</style></link> <link=keyword.Quick Strike><sprite name=QuickStrike><style=Keyword>Quick Attack</style></link> this round. He starts a free attack <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenging</style></link> an enemy.
06RU040.descriptionRaw: Give Kayn Quick Attack this round. He starts a free attack Challenging an enemy.
06RU040.name: Shadowstep

06RU012.flavorText: The flavors in this pot are so good it hurts.
06RU012.name: Pot O' Pain

06RU028.flavorText: Her spectral guardian bursts from the amulet whenever Fireth is in danger. She seems to have no memory of these events, and aggressively denies its existence when her allies try to explain.
06RU028.name: Sandworn Amulet

06RU039.description:
<link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Aatrox</style></link> and an enemy <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> each other.
Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Deathbringer Slash</style></link> in hand.
06RU039.descriptionRaw:
Aatrox and an enemy strike each other.
Create a Deathbringer Slash in hand.
06RU039.name: Deathbringer Sweep

06RU010.flavorText: This wrench is the only belonging Pesh brought with him when he made the move from Piltover to Bilgewater. Itâ€™s not magic or anything, though you might think otherwise when you see him put it to work.
06RU010.name: The Fix-Em 5000

06RU030.flavorText: Fireth says her mother made this rake for her. Exactly where her mother found an artifact of the ancient empire, and exactly why she attached it to a rake, Fireth cannot say.
06RU030.name: Upcycled Rake

06RU031.flavorText: Chaska takes a philosophical approach to shepherding. Their flock is whomever happens to be in the vicinity.
06RU031.name: Shepherd's Authority

06FR004.description: The first time you <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>equip</style></link> an ally, <link=vocab.Forge><style=Vocab>Forge</style></link> it.
06FR004.descriptionRaw: The first time you equip an ally, Forge it.
06FR004.flavorText: Ornn made the living forge many, many years ago, and only went looking for it recently. He never once thought it might go looking for a new owner and wander off on its own.
06FR004.name: Weaponsmith's Apprentice

06FR011.description:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equip</style></link> me with an exact copy of an ally's equipment or the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> equipment from hand.
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: <link=vocab.Forge><style=Vocab>Forge</style></link> me twice.
06FR011.descriptionRaw:
Play: Equip me with an exact copy of an ally's equipment or the strongest equipment from hand.
Attack: Forge me twice.
06FR011.levelupDescription: An ally has <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>struck</style></link> for 8+ damage in one <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link>.<style=Variable></style>
06FR011.levelupDescriptionRaw: An ally has struck for 8+ damage in one strike.
06FR011.flavorText: If anyone asked Ornn why he had so little patience, he would answer simply that he did have patience. Tremendous patience, in fact, and that was why his work was incomparable. He simply did not have patience for PEOPLE. But nobody asked, and so he never answered.
06FR011.name: Ornn

06FR011T2.description:
<link=vocab.Forge><style=Vocab>Forge</style></link> an ally and deal 1 to ALL units, then do it again.
Create an <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Ornn</style></link> in your deck.
06FR011T2.descriptionRaw:
Forge an ally and deal 1 to ALL units, then do it again.
Create an Ornn in your deck.
06FR011T2.flavorText: "An iron will must be forged!" - Ornn
06FR011T2.name: Ornn's Bellows Breath

06FR011T1.description:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equip</style></link> me with an exact copy of an ally's equipment or the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> equipment from hand.
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: <link=vocab.Forge><style=Vocab>Forge</style></link> me twice, then summon an attacking <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Spirit of the Ram</style></link> with my stats.
06FR011T1.descriptionRaw:
Play: Equip me with an exact copy of an ally's equipment or the strongest equipment from hand.
Attack: Forge me twice, then summon an attacking Spirit of the Ram with my stats.
06FR011T1.flavorText: Some believe that when the world truly needs him, the chosen of Ornn will finally be able to find their god. Isn't that just the way of withdrawn, ornery gods? To be found only in the very last place you look?
06FR011T1.name: Ornn

06FR011T4.flavorText: "What remains after the fire is either forged, or melted. Better to be steel that takes shape than... something that burns away!" - Ornn
06FR011T4.name: Spirit of the Ram

06FR035.description: Give an ally +0|+3 this round. If it's damaged, give it +2|+3 instead.
06FR035.descriptionRaw: Give an ally +0|+3 this round. If it's damaged, give it +2|+3 instead.
06FR035.flavorText: "Do not worry, little poro. I am with you!" - Braum
06FR035.name: Here to Help

06FR034.description: <link=keyword.Frostbite><sprite name=Frostbite><style=Keyword>Frostbite</style></link> the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> enemy. If you've <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> an ally this game, copy me.
06FR034.descriptionRaw: Frostbite the strongest enemy. If you've Equipped an ally this game, copy me.
06FR034.flavorText: Anaakca moved with such speed that the Freljord itself seemed to follow in her wake. Those who survived her butchery soon felt their skin freeze, and their hearts still.
06FR034.name: The Unforgiving Cold

06FR018.description:
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Grant the top 2 allies in your deck +1|+1.
You may spend 8 mana to play me as <link=card.unit><style=AssociatedCard>Anaakca</style></link>.
06FR018.descriptionRaw:
Attack: Grant the top 2 allies in your deck +1|+1.
You may spend 8 mana to play me as Anaakca.
06FR018.flavorText:
"Warmother, the grip of winter has tightened. The Avarosans have fled beyond their outposts. North is the sea... our only path leads east."
"Do not listen to him, Warmother. That way is the Pale, and beyond it, the whispering wilds. I say better to die than face that cursed land."
"How fortunate for you both that neither must decide my people's fate."
"True, Warmother. But perhaps there is a third way. Let me travel east. Better a scout is lost to darkness than all of our people."
- Warmother Sejuani conferring with her generals
06FR018.name: The Darkin Spear

06FR018T1.description: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: From the top 6 cards of your deck, summon an attacking follower or non-Champion Darkin and grant it +1|+1.
06FR018T1.descriptionRaw: Attack: From the top 6 cards of your deck, summon an attacking follower or non-Champion Darkin and grant it +1|+1.
06FR018T1.flavorText: With newfound vigor, the great warrior Anaakca sped south through the Freljord and into Demacian lands. The outposts prepared as best they could to repel her assault, but no mere mortal would stand between Anaakca's fury and the coward who stoked it.
06FR018T1.name: Anaakca

06FR018T3.description: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Grant the top 2 allies in your deck +1|+1.
06FR018T3.descriptionRaw: Attack: Grant the top 2 allies in your deck +1|+1.
06FR018T3.flavorText:
"Warmother, the grip of winter has tightened to the east. South, the Avarosans have fled beyond their outposts. North is the sea... our only path leads east."
"No, Warmother. That way is the Pale, and beyond it, the whispering wilds. I say better to die than face that cursed land."
"How fortunate for you both that neither must decide my people's fate."
"True, Warmother. But perhaps there is a third way. Let me travel East. Better a scout is lost to darkness than all of our people."
- Warmother Sejuani, conferring with her generals
06FR018T3.name: The Darkin Spear

06FR012.description: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Time and Dedication</style></link> in hand.
06FR012.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, create a Time and Dedication in hand.
06FR012.flavorText: "My mother told me of Ornn, as her mother told her, and her mother before... and now I will tell you. Listen closely. Do not interrupt. Long ago, across a great, hot, churning sea..."
06FR012.name: Favored Artisan

06FR012T1.flavorText: "You may be worthy of this. Do not prove me wrong." - Ornn
06FR012T1.name: Time and Dedication

06FR005.description: When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Time and Dedication</style></link> in hand.
06FR005.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned or Round Start: Create a Fleeting Time and Dedication in hand.
06FR005.flavorText: Alone in Hearth-Home's forge with nothing but the sound of the molten river's slow coursing below, and the ring of Hammer on anvil... he quite liked that.
06FR005.name: Ornn's Forge

06FR040.description: When I'm summoned, grant allies +1|+1 for each different subtype youâ€™ve summoned this game. <style=Variable></style>
06FR040.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, grant allies +1|+1 for each different subtype youâ€™ve summoned this game.
06FR040.flavorText: "...an' there was a BIG creature that cared for aaaaaaall of the LIL' creatures..." - Ingvar the Younger
06FR040.name: Warden of the Tribes

06FR020.description: Deal 1 to EVERYTHING or destroy a unit's equipment.
06FR020.descriptionRaw: Deal 1 to EVERYTHING or destroy a unit's equipment.
06FR020.flavorText: The cold spares nothing and no one.
06FR020.name: Fracture

06FR027.flavorText: While troll aren't typically known for their intellect, they can be surprisingly ingenious.
06FR027.name: Woolly Snailmoth

06FR032.description: Heal your Nexus 4 and grant all allies and equipment in your deck +1|+1. Draw 1 of them.
06FR032.descriptionRaw: Heal your Nexus 4 and grant all allies and equipment in your deck +1|+1. Draw 1 of them.
06FR032.flavorText: "Come, warm yourself by the fire." - Hearthblood Mender
06FR032.name: Gift of the Hearthblood

06FR022.description: <link=vocab.Forge><style=Vocab>Forge</style></link> an ally and deal 1 to ALL units, then do it again.
06FR022.descriptionRaw: Forge an ally and deal 1 to ALL units, then do it again.
06FR022.flavorText: "An iron will must be forged!" - Ornn
06FR022.name: Bellows Breath

06FR021.flavorText: "Come on, you have to take your medicine! You won't feel better 'til you do!" - Ingvar the Younger
06FR021.name: Pouty Poro

06FR023.description: The first time I'm <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link>, create a 4 cost copy of me in hand. Grant it the equipment's stats.
06FR023.descriptionRaw: The first time I'm Equipped, create a 4 cost copy of me in hand. Grant it the equipment's stats.
06FR023.flavorText: Though he would not admit it, Ornn was quite pleased with the colossi. They served the exact purpose he assigned to them, and best of all, they did not speak.
06FR023.name: Wrought Colossus

06FR008.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Forge><style=Vocab>Forge</style></link> an ally twice and heal it and your Nexus 3.
06FR008.descriptionRaw: Play: Forge an ally twice and heal it and your Nexus 3.
06FR008.flavorText: The Hearthblood were gone, all of them, when Ornn decided to leave the world. Generations passed and their name was all but forgotten. More recently, however, the tales of Ornn resurfaced, and it was whispered that some had begun to return to the way of the Hearthblood.
06FR008.name: Hearthblood Mender

06FR009.flavorText: When Fiske had first envisioned an apprentice, he imagined someone dedicated, serious about their craft, strong, and capable. Kindra was none of those things. She was prone to daydreaming. She would rather play than work. She was always fussing with that silly little turtle of hers. However... she was learning. That was what mattered.
06FR009.name: Adept Weaponsmith

06FR020T1.flavorText: The cold spares nothing and no one.
06FR020T1.name: Fracture

06FR020T2.flavorText: The cold spares nothing and no one.
06FR020T2.name: Fracture

06FR017.flavorText: The Winter's Claw was right. The Avarosans HAD been too soft. It was time for a new leader, one that would not seek to unify the Freljord through peace, but rule over it.
06FR017.name: Icevale Cultist

06FR041.description: Get an empty mana gem. <link=keyword.Enlightened><style=Keyword>Enlightened</style></link>: I cost 1. Draw 1.
06FR041.descriptionRaw: Get an empty mana gem. Enlightened: I cost 1. Draw 1.
06FR041.flavorText: Strange runes pulse from the facets of the gem in your hand. With an eerie flash their light rises off the surface, curling up your arm in a chilling whorl. But rather than freezing, its chill is invigorating, as though the cold itself imbued you with its essence.
06FR041.name: Winter's Touch

06FR036.description:
Get an empty mana gem.
Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Feral Mystic</style></link>.
06FR036.descriptionRaw:
Get an empty mana gem.
Summon a Feral Mystic.
06FR036.flavorText: "The spirits, the stars... again, they bring us together." - Hyara Allseer
06FR036.name: Wild Mysticism

06BC015.description: <link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Plant a <link=card.portal><style=AssociatedCard>Mysterious Portal</style></link> in the top 4 cards of your deck.
06BC015.descriptionRaw: Nexus Strike: Plant a Mysterious Portal in the top 4 cards of your deck.
06BC015.flavorText: Norraâ€™s worked quickly, thoughts of home in mind. Portalwork was notoriously tricky business, and she hadnâ€™t even had her first cup of tea yet. But Norra loved a good puzzle, especially the type that found her hopelessly lost in pocket dimensions between space and time. She worked faster, thinking fondly of her cat, who would be worried and expecting dinner.
06BC015.name: Norra

06BC015T2.description:
Your <link=card.portal><style=AssociatedCard>Mysterious Portals</style></link> now summon 4, 5, 6, or 7 cost followers instead.
<link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Plant a <link=card.portal><style=AssociatedCard>Mysterious Portal</style></link> in the top 4 cards of your deck.
06BC015T2.descriptionRaw:
Your Mysterious Portals now summon 4, 5, 6, or 7 cost followers instead.
Nexus Strike: Plant a Mysterious Portal in the top 4 cards of your deck.
06BC015T2.flavorText: With a whiz and a snap, the totemâ€™s various bits and bobs sprang to life, a knick-knack spinning here, a doohickey flashing there. As the room rumbled and groaned, a portal materialized high above, and the vague silhouette of cat ears appeared within. Norra squealed, spilling her tea in delight. Had she finally found the way home?
06BC015T2.name: Norra

06BC015T3.description: Summon a random 2 or 3 cost follower. If your board is full, create a 0 cost <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> copy in hand instead.
06BC015T3.descriptionRaw: Summon a random 2 or 3 cost follower. If your board is full, create a 0 cost Fleeting copy in hand instead.
06BC015T3.flavorText: Another mysterious portal... where would this one lead?
06BC015T3.name: Mysterious Portal

06BC015T1.description:
Plant 2 <link=card.portal><style=AssociatedCard>Mysterious Portals</style></link> in the top 4 cards of your deck.
Draw 1.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Norra</style></link> in your deck.
06BC015T1.descriptionRaw:
Plant 2 Mysterious Portals in the top 4 cards of your deck.
Draw 1.
Create a Norra in your deck.
06BC015T1.flavorText:
â€œI ought to take the Low Roads more often! Silly me, I always forget to mind my head...â€œ
- Norra
06BC015T1.name: Norra's Portalpalooza

06BC043.description: Create 3 random 1 cost Poros in hand.
06BC043.descriptionRaw: Create 3 random 1 cost Poros in hand.
06BC043.flavorText: "...AN' DEN DA PORO WAS LIKE "HEY YOU I WANNA SNAX TOO!" SO DA POROS GATHERED TOGETHER AT DA GREAT MEETING OF DA POROS TO TALK ABOUT ALL DA PORO PROBLEMS LIKE WHERE ARE DA SNAX AND WHY AREN'T THERE MORE POROS AND..." - Ingvar the Younger
06BC043.name: Poro Stories

06BC051.description: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Deal damage equal to my Power to a unit.
06BC051.descriptionRaw: Play: Deal damage equal to my Power to a unit.
06BC051.flavorText: â€œHEY! ANYBODY NEED SOME POTASSIUM?â€ - Nanners, just moments before â€œThe Incidentâ€
06BC051.name: Banana Blaster

06BC051T1.descriptionRaw: Deal damage equal to my Power.
06BC051T1.flavorText: Believe it or not, very overripe bananas can still be healthy! Just donâ€™t tell Nanners. Please, please donâ€™t tell Nanners.
06BC051T1.name: Rotten Banana

06BC047.description: Give an ally with an attachment the stats and keywords of its attachment this round and move the attachment to another ally.
06BC047.descriptionRaw: Give an ally with an attachment the stats and keywords of its attachment this round and move the attachment to another ally.
06BC047.flavorText: Youâ€™d think a shepherd would have no place on the battlefield, but the skillset has surprising utility. You just have to think about all the combatants as sheep in need of herding.
06BC047.name: Sharesies

06BC019.description: When I'm summoned, plant a <link=card.portal><style=AssociatedCard>Mysterious Portal</style></link> in the top 4 cards of your deck.
06BC019.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, plant a Mysterious Portal in the top 4 cards of your deck.
06BC019.flavorText: Ashane was once a renowned tea maker before finding herself lost in Realmâ€™s End. While experimenting with new flavors, an unfortunate blend of two leaves had put her into a deep sleep--she dreamed strange dreams about odd creatures and impossible structures, silhouetted against an endless horizon. But upon waking, she discovered it had been no dream at all.
06BC019.name: The Tea Maker

06BC029.description:
<link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>Strike</style></link>: Refill 1 spell mana.
You may spend 8 mana to play me as <link=card.unit><style=AssociatedCard>Baalkux</style></link>.
06BC029.descriptionRaw:
Strike: Refill 1 spell mana.
You may spend 8 mana to play me as Baalkux.
06BC029.flavorText: The bandlewood seemed a perfect place to hide a Darkin weapon, they reasoned. Bandlewoods are, by their very nature, impossible to navigate, and the yordles would know to steer clear of such abject malevolence. But the Targonians failed to realize the efficacy of such strange magic, and the effects it would have over the local flora.
06BC029.name: The Darkin Staff

06BC029T1.description: When you spend spell mana, grant me <link=keyword.Impact><sprite name=Impact><style=Keyword>Impact</style></link> for every spell mana you spend.
06BC029T1.descriptionRaw: When you spend spell mana, grant me Impact for every spell mana you spend.
06BC029T1.flavorText: Baalkux felt the tree's limbs grip the staff inside which he lay dormant. Quickly, he gripped back. His life erupted from the darkin staff and coursed through the tree's ancient boughs and branches. There was no heart to control here. No blood to bend. Baalkux could finally return to his general, and atone for his past transgressions.
06BC029T1.name: Baalkux

06BC029T3.flavorText: The bandlewood seemed a perfect place to hide a Darkin weapon, they reasoned. They are, at their core, impossible to navigate, and the yordles would know to steer clear of such abject malevolence. But the Targonians failed to realize the efficacy of bandle magic, and the effects it would have over the local flora.
06BC029T3.name: The Darkin Staff

06BC038.description:
Once you've <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> an ally this game, I cost 2 less. 
Grow an ally to 4|4 this round.
06BC038.descriptionRaw:
Once you've Equipped an ally this game, I cost 2 less. 
Grow an ally to 4|4 this round.
06BC038.flavorText: "There is so much power in us." - Varus
06BC038.name: The Sudden Surge

06BC017.description:
Plant 2 <link=card.portal><style=AssociatedCard>Mysterious Portals</style></link> in the top 4 cards of your deck.
Draw 1.
06BC017.descriptionRaw:
Plant 2 Mysterious Portals in the top 4 cards of your deck.
Draw 1.
06BC017.flavorText:
â€œI ought to take the Low Roads more often! Silly me, I always forget to mind my head...â€œ
- Norra
06BC017.name: Portalpalooza
