06BC020.description: Give me +1|+0 for each of your traps or boons that was activated this round.
06BC020.descriptionRaw: Give me +1|+0 for each of your traps or boons that was activated this round.
06BC020.flavorText: The magic of papercraft can be somewhat unpredictable. It is as much about the intention that goes into creating something new as the creation's desire to be shaped.
06BC020.name: Origami Slicer

06BC028.description: Once you've <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> an ally this game, grant me <link=keyword.Elusive><sprite name=Elusive><style=Keyword>Elusive</style></link>.
06BC028.descriptionRaw: Once you've Equipped an ally this game, grant me Elusive.
06BC028.flavorText: Person, plant, animal... the Darkin's corruptive influence spares no one and nothing.
06BC028.name: Blooming Cultist

06BC021.description: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Plant a <link=card.portal><style=AssociatedCard>Mysterious Portal</style></link> in the top 4 cards of your deck.
06BC021.descriptionRaw: Last Breath: Plant a Mysterious Portal in the top 4 cards of your deck.
06BC021.flavorText: Heâ€™d only been born the day before, but Marv--as Norra affectionally called him--took great pride in serving as her assistant. However, he sternly insisted on being referred to as "junk" and not "trash", as the latter held a negative connotation.
06BC021.name: Junk Construct

06BC042.description: When an allied follower transforms into another follower, transform me into an exact copy of it.
06BC042.descriptionRaw: When an allied follower transforms into another follower, transform me into an exact copy of it.
06BC042.name: Curious Changelings

06BC023.description: Return a <link=keyword.Fast><sprite name=Fast><style=Keyword>Fast</style></link> or <link=keyword.Slow><sprite name=Slow><style=Keyword>Slow</style></link> spell to hand or destroy a unit's <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipment</style></link>. Draw 1.
06BC023.descriptionRaw: Return a Fast or Slow spell to hand or destroy a unit's Equipment. Draw 1.
06BC023.flavorText: "Dear me! Was it this way, that way, or... this-a-that-way? I never can remember!" - Norra
06BC023.name: Puzzling Signposts

06BC041.description: When I'm discarded, summon me. When you summon a Mecha Yordle, grant it a random keyword.
06BC041.descriptionRaw: When I'm discarded, summon me. When you summon a Mecha Yordle, grant it a random keyword.
06BC041.flavorText: Big or small, inanimate or otherwise, if there's a doodad you want found, try Skrappy's! Just don't ask Skrappy where it is, because she is not a believer in cataloguing.
06BC041.name: Skrappy's Partsapalooza

06BC011.description: Plant a <link=card.portal><style=AssociatedCard>Mysterious Portal</style></link> in the top 4 cards of your deck and plant a <link=card.chime><style=AssociatedCard>Chime</style></link> on the top card of your deck.
06BC011.descriptionRaw: Plant a Mysterious Portal in the top 4 cards of your deck and plant a Chime on the top card of your deck.
06BC011.flavorText: Wandering through the various realms as he pleases, Bard listens, knowing that a great conflict approaches - one that could silence the song of creation.
06BC011.name: Magical Journey

06BC032.description: For each ally, plant a <link=card.portal><style=AssociatedCard>Mysterious Portal</style></link> and 3 <link=card.chime><style=AssociatedCard>Chimes</style></link> in the top 10 cards of your deck and plant a <link=card.flashbomb><style=AssociatedCard>Flashbomb Trap</style></link> and 3 <link=card.puffcap><style=AssociatedCard>Poison Puffcaps</style></link> in the enemy deck.
06BC032.descriptionRaw: For each ally, plant a Mysterious Portal and 3 Chimes in the top 10 cards of your deck and plant a Flashbomb Trap and 3 Poison Puffcaps in the enemy deck.
06BC032.name: Eclectic Collection

06BC024.description: Each round, the first time one of your traps or boons activate, give allies +1|+1 and <link=keyword.Impact><sprite name=Impact><style=Keyword>Impact</style></link> this round.
06BC024.descriptionRaw: Each round, the first time one of your traps or boons activate, give allies +1|+1 and Impact this round.
06BC024.flavorText: Gaspar was the first yordle to arrive in Realmâ€™s End. For many years, he wandered alone amidst the twisting paths and portals that all seemed to lead nowhere. Having decided that no one should ever have to do the same, he now helps other lost travelers find their way home.
06BC024.name: Realm's Caretaker

06BC033.flavorText: "Behold! From the ruins of a sunken ferry, I fetched the boxing glove. From the depths of the city they call Zaun, I recovered springs, and from the forges of Demacia, I found metal! This is truly a creation of the world!" - Paparo the Great
06BC033.name: Mechapulverizer

06BC016.description: When I'm summoned, if one of your traps or boons has activated this round, draw 1.
06BC016.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, if one of your traps or boons has activated this round, draw 1.
06BC016.flavorText: Considering it his duty to possess immense knowledge, he collects tomes from various travelers who have passed through Realmâ€™s End. Unfortunately, all of this knowledge appears to have gone to his head.
06BC016.name: Living Library

06IO044.description: When I'm summoned, reduce the cost of spells in your deck by half, rounded up.
06IO044.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, reduce the cost of spells in your deck by half, rounded up.
06IO044.flavorText: "Some seek peace through meditation. Others seek knowledge for self-reflection. Those that find their center by expression, by creation--they may bring peace to others, too." - Karma
06IO044.name: Serene Sky-Singer

06IO013.description:
Give an ally +2|+0 this round.
Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Meditate</style></link> in hand.
06IO013.descriptionRaw:
Give an ally +2|+0 this round.
Create a Meditate in hand.
06IO013.name: Wuju Style

06IO023.description:
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Summon an attacking <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Dragonling</style></link>. 
You may spend 9 mana to play me as <link=card.unit><style=AssociatedCard>Praa the Breachwalker</style></link>.
06IO023.descriptionRaw:
Attack: Summon an attacking Dragonling. 
You may spend 9 mana to play me as Praa the Breachwalker.
06IO023.flavorText: "In the bridge between worlds, I have long sensed a shadow that pulses with silent rage. Though I know better than to delve into the darkness after it, the pulse has lately grown stronger, faster--and I fear the creatures of the spirit realm will soon begin searching for it." - Shen
06IO023.name: The Darkin Fan

06IO029.description:
<link=vocab.Flow><style=Vocab>Flow</style></link>: I cost 2 less. 
When I'm summoned, draw a spell.
06IO029.descriptionRaw:
Flow: I cost 2 less. 
When I'm summoned, draw a spell.
06IO029.flavorText: "Master Doran believed each eye of the Spirit of Wuju offered unique insight into a person's being. But try as I might, all my helm's lenses can behold are different shades of green. What am I missing?" - Lui, Disciple of Doran
06IO029.name: The Spirit of Wuju

06IO037.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=keyword.Capture><sprite name=Capture><style=Keyword>Capture</style></link> an ally. When you attack for the first time each round, summon an <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> copy of it attacking.
06IO037.descriptionRaw: Play: Capture an ally. When you attack for the first time each round, summon an Ephemeral copy of it attacking.
06IO037.flavorText: "What is one life, but a shadow of existence? Embrace the darkness, and you will live forever." - Zed
06IO037.name: The Black Flame

06IO014.description: <link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Recall me and transform me into <link=card.spell><style=AssociatedCard>Shimon Wind</style></link>
06IO014.descriptionRaw: Nexus Strike: Recall me and transform me into Shimon Wind
06IO014.flavorText: Ting grinned as the attackers flooded the temple. Finally, a chance to prove himself! First Wukong, then Yi... both had dismissed his talents. Let the others run to find their "master"! He was ready. He was the Shimon Wind.
06IO014.name: Vastayan Disciple

06IO023T1.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>, and when I transform: Summon two <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> copies of me. Grant one <link=keyword.Lifesteal><sprite name=Lifesteal><style=Keyword>Lifesteal</style></link>, one <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link> and me <link=keyword.Elusive><sprite name=Elusive><style=Keyword>Elusive</style></link>.
06IO023T1.descriptionRaw: Play, and when I transform: Summon two Ephemeral copies of me. Grant one Lifesteal, one Challenger and me Elusive.
06IO023T1.flavorText: His general's call stirred him from slumber. As his senses came to him, Praa found himself looking through a weighted veil to a lush, unfamiliar land. Slowly, inexorably, he stepped through the divide, and buried his feet in Runeterra's soil once more. For Aatrox. For victory. For peace. For death.
06IO023T1.name: Praa the Breachwalker

06IO023T3.flavorText: "In the bridge between worlds, I have long sensed a shadow that pulses with silent rage. Though I know better than to delve into the darkness after it, the pulse has lately grown stronger, faster, and I fear that the creatures of the spirit realm will soon begin searching for it." - Shen
06IO023T3.name: The Darkin Fan

06IO008.description: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Reduce the cost of a spell in your hand by 1 and <link=vocab.Flow><style=Vocab>Flow</style></link>: Grant all allied <link=card.selfRef><style=AssociatedCard>Master Yis</style></link> <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>Everywhere</style></link> +2|+0.
06IO008.descriptionRaw: Round Start: Reduce the cost of a spell in your hand by 1 and Flow: Grant all allied Master Yis Everywhere +2|+0.
06IO008.levelupDescription: Allied Master Yis have dealt 12+ damage.<style=Variable></style>
06IO008.levelupDescriptionRaw: Allied Master Yis have dealt 12+ damage.
06IO008.flavorText: Master Yi's mind drifted to the Darkin weapon. Ever since its discovery, he'd been troubled by a terrible sense of foreboding. Some of his students had taken a keen interestâ€“too keenâ€“so he had the curved blades placed under guard, deep within the temple. With some effort, he pushed those thoughts from his mind and continued his meditation. Passing on the teachings of Wuju was all that mattered, and Jun showed great promise.
06IO008.name: Master Yi

06IO040.description: Pick a follower. Summon an exact <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> copy of it. If it's an enemy, <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> it.
06IO040.descriptionRaw: Pick a follower. Summon an exact Ephemeral copy of it. If it's an enemy, Stun it.
06IO040.flavorText: To the Ionians, wind is the most capricious of the elements. Capricious, but not untamable.
06IO040.name: Twin Wind Technique

06IO011.description: The first time I am <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link>, give me <link=keyword.Barrier><sprite name=Barrier><style=Keyword>Barrier</style></link> and <link=keyword.Lifesteal><sprite name=Lifesteal><style=Keyword>Lifesteal</style></link> this round.
06IO011.descriptionRaw: The first time I am Equipped, give me Barrier and Lifesteal this round.
06IO011.flavorText: At his signal, Jun unleashed a series of blows as precise as any Yi would have made himself. Though he deftly avoided the attack, he bowed before her, pride in his smile.
06IO011.name: Jun, the Prodigy

06IO015.descriptionRaw:
Flow: I cost 2 less.
Play: Stun an enemy.
06IO015.flavorText: What is this one's role in this strange and gruesome show? Ah, more than audience, she is observer, the lens through which all things pass and must be held up against truth and beauty. The Witness!
06IO015.name: The Witness

06IO030.description:
When I'm summoned, draw an equipment.
The first time each round an unequipped ally is <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link>, refill 2 spell mana.
06IO030.descriptionRaw:
When I'm summoned, draw an equipment.
The first time each round an unequipped ally is Equipped, refill 2 spell mana.
06IO030.flavorText:
"Mistfall is sacred ground. The swords at the site have been here for centuries... and it is my belief that any blade left here with a poem on its hilt will invite the spirits of lost wielders to imbue it with their blessing."
- Disciple of Doran, handwritten scroll
06IO030.name: Mistfall

06IO014T1.descriptionRaw: Summon a Vastayan Disciple and draw 1.
06IO014T1.name: Shimon Wind

06IO008T2.description:
Give an ally +2|+0 this round.
Create <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Meditate</style></link> in hand. Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Master Yi</style></link> in your deck.
06IO008T2.descriptionRaw:
Give an ally +2|+0 this round.
Create Meditate in hand. Create a Master Yi in your deck.
06IO008T2.name: Master Yi's Wuju Style

06IO008T1.description:
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: I immediately strike the <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>Weakest</style></link> enemy. 
<link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Reduce the cost of a spell in your hand by 1 and <link=vocab.Flow><style=Vocab>Flow</style></link>: Grant all allied <link=card.selfRef><style=AssociatedCard>Master Yis</style></link> <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>Everywhere</style></link> +2|+0.
06IO008T1.descriptionRaw:
Attack: I immediately strike the Weakest enemy. 
Round Start: Reduce the cost of a spell in your hand by 1 and Flow: Grant all allied Master Yis Everywhere +2|+0.
06IO008T1.flavorText: From the corner of his eye, Yi saw the flash of steel and heard the unmistakable thud of a lifeless body. Could it have been her? How could he have failed his pupils so utterly? They were untrained and unprepared. But he was a master of Wuju, and neither shame nor shadow would win the day.
06IO008T1.name: Master Yi

06IO034.description:
If you've <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> an ally this game, I cost 1 less.
Give an ally +2|+0 or +0|+2 this round.
06IO034.descriptionRaw:
If you've Equipped an ally this game, I cost 1 less.
Give an ally +2|+0 or +0|+2 this round.
06IO034.flavorText: Angry tears streamed down Junâ€™s face as she surveyed the bodies littering the ground. She had failed them. She had failed her master. And now, only one choice remainedâ€¦
06IO034.name: Momentous Choice

06IO028.description: Give an ally <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link> this round. If it's <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link>, draw 1.
06IO028.descriptionRaw: Give an ally Challenger this round. If it's Equipped, draw 1.
06IO028.flavorText: Everything's hungry for the right bait.
06IO028.name: Entrancing Lure

06IO025.description: Once you've <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> an ally this game, create a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow Fiend</style></link> in hand.
06IO025.descriptionRaw: Once you've Equipped an ally this game, create a Shadow Fiend in hand.
06IO025.flavorText: In the darkness, he'd seen it - a weapon to cut through the shadows. And in that moment, he heard a voice call to him, distant but powerful. He followed it to Kayn, the truth of its words guiding him.
06IO025.name: Shadowblade Fanatic

06IO015T1.flavorText: The Kashuri spies are mostly observers, but they are well-equipped in case they are ever attacked.
06IO015T1.name: Scintillating Artifact

06IO039.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Navori Brigand</style></link> or give other allies +1|+1 this round.
06IO039.descriptionRaw: Play: Summon a Navori Brigand or give other allies +1|+1 this round.
06IO039.flavorText: The longtail first befriended his Brigand pal one winter's evening, as the two shared the remnants of an abandoned campfire. By the week's end, the two had discovered a common sense of mischief, and a strong interest in the golden shine of coin.
06IO039.name: Navori Longtail

06IO039T2.flavorText: The longtail first befriended his Brigand pal one winter's evening, as the two shared the remnants of an abandoned campfire. By the week's end, the two had discovered a common sense of mischief, and a strong interest in the golden shine of coin.
06IO039T2.name: Navori Longtail

06IO039T1.descriptionRaw: Play: Give other allies +1|+1 this round.
06IO039T1.flavorText: The longtail first befriended his Brigand pal one winter's evening, as the two shared the remnants of an abandoned campfire. By the week's end, the two had discovered a common sense of mischief, and a strong interest in the golden shine of coin.
06IO039T1.name: Navori Longtail

06IO032.description:
<link=vocab.Flow><style=Vocab>Flow</style></link>: I cost 2 less.
<link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> a unit or landmark. If it has any attachments, destroy them first.
06IO032.descriptionRaw:
Flow: I cost 2 less.
Recall a unit or landmark. If it has any attachments, destroy them first.
06IO032.flavorText: "You are not worthy of the power you hold." - Rhaast
06IO032.name: Unworthy Soul

06IO001.description: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Preparation</style></link> in hand.
06IO001.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, create a Preparation in hand.
06IO001.flavorText:
"I have learned what knowledge I could to continue this sacred art. As for Doran, and his master, and his master before him... I hope their spirits will guide my hammer."
- Disciple of Doran, handwritten scroll
06IO001.name: Disciple of Doran

06IO001T1.description: Reduce the cost of a spell in your hand by 1.
06IO001T1.descriptionRaw: Reduce the cost of a spell in your hand by 1.
06IO001T1.flavorText:
"A warrior is only as able as they are prepared."
- Wuju words of wisdom
06IO001T1.name: Preparation

06IO016.description: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: <link=vocab.Flow><style=Vocab>Flow</style></link>: Summon <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>The Empyrean</style></link> and grant it <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link>.
06IO016.descriptionRaw: Round Start: Flow: Summon The Empyrean and grant it Ephemeral.
06IO016.flavorText: "The shape of the water reflects the shape of your desire. Tell me, wanderer... what do you see?"
06IO016.name: Dragoncaller

06PZ034.description: Deal 6 to a unit. If it would die, <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> it instead.
06PZ034.descriptionRaw: Deal 6 to a unit. If it would die, Obliterate it instead.
06PZ034.flavorText: For some creatures, death just isn't enough.
06PZ034.name: Hexbliterator

06PZ006.description: Create a random new 2 cost spell in hand, reduce it's cost by 2 and grant it <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>.
06PZ006.descriptionRaw: Create a random new 2 cost spell in hand, reduce it's cost by 2 and grant it Fleeting.
06PZ006.flavorText: There's nothing more satisfying than good reverb.
06PZ006.name: Encore

06PZ021.description: When I'm summoned, create a random new 2 cost spell in hand.
06PZ021.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, create a random new 2 cost spell in hand.
06PZ021.flavorText: Seraphine and her dad never talked about her "secret" trips to the Undercity, or the subtle upgrades she kept making to her stage. She was sure he'd forbid her from participating in Zaun's grungiest musical duel, but one night he tucked the flyer under her door. All she could do was smile, and get to work.
06PZ021.name: Seraphine

06PZ021T1.description:
Deal 2 to a unit. If you've played 6+ other new spells this game, deal 1 to another unit. <style=Variable></style>
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Seraphine</style></link> in your deck.
06PZ021T1.descriptionRaw:
Deal 2 to a unit. If you've played 6+ other new spells this game, deal 1 to another unit. 
Create a Seraphine in your deck.
06PZ021T1.name: Seraphine's High Note

06PZ021T2.description:
When I'm summoned, create a random new 2 cost spell in hand.
When you play a new spell that costs 2 or less, copy it with the same targets.
06PZ021T2.descriptionRaw:
When I'm summoned, create a random new 2 cost spell in hand.
When you play a new spell that costs 2 or less, copy it with the same targets.
06PZ021T2.flavorText: She'd never heard anything like it--maybe nobody had. Together, on that stage, they made something new.
06PZ021T2.name: Seraphine

06PZ040.description:
When I'm summoned, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Back Alley Barkeep</style></link>.
Your new cards cost 1 less.
06PZ040.descriptionRaw:
When I'm summoned, summon a Back Alley Barkeep.
Your new cards cost 1 less.
06PZ040.flavorText: After drying the last of the glasses, the barkeep took a moment to look over his place. This spot, this home from home, had seen so many strangers become friends, and wore the graffiti and dents from many a wild night. The barkeep smiled to himself. It wasn't a perfect place, but it was his.
06PZ040.name: Back Alley Bar

06PZ008.description: You may spend 8 mana to play me as <link=card.unit><style=AssociatedCard>Styraatu</style></link>.
06PZ008.descriptionRaw: You may spend 8 mana to play me as Styraatu.
06PZ008.flavorText: As the Targonians pondered where they should scatter the Darkin weapons, one of their kind suggested the lands that would become known as Zaun. Buried deep within the walls of the cavernous and winding passageways would be perfect, they assumed. Far from human reach. But not Chirean.
06PZ008.name: The Darkin Harp

06PZ018.description: Deal 2 to a unit. If you've played 6+ other new spells this game, deal 1 to another unit. <style=Variable></style>
06PZ018.descriptionRaw: Deal 2 to a unit. If you've played 6+ other new spells this game, deal 1 to another unit.
06PZ018.name: High Note

06PZ014.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> a spell that costs 5 and set its cost to 2.
06PZ014.descriptionRaw: Play: Manifest a spell that costs 5 and set its cost to 2.
06PZ014.flavorText: "It's not about how big your voice is, it's about how big your heart is!" - Fanclub President
06PZ014.name: Fanclub President

06PZ030.description: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Create a new 2 cost spell in hand and grant it <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>.
06PZ030.descriptionRaw: Attack: Create a new 2 cost spell in hand and grant it Fleeting.
06PZ030.flavorText:
"Oh dear, sounds like rain."
"Huh? Dad, it's so bright outside."
"Quick, cover the blueprints! It's a BRAINstorm!"
"Daaaaad."
- Seraphine & her father
06PZ030.name: Inspired Plans

06PZ046.flavorText: â€œMagic is merely scientific truth yet to be discovered.â€ - Jayce
06PZ046.name: Formula

06PZ008T3.flavorText: As the Targonians pondered where they should scatter the Darkin weapons, one of their kind suggested the lands that would become known as Zaun. Buried deep within the walls of the cavernous and winding passageways would be perfect, they assumed. Far from human reach. But not Chirean.
06PZ008T3.name: The Darkin Harp

06PZ008T2.description: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Draw 2, then reduce those cards' costs by 2.
06PZ008T2.descriptionRaw: Attack: Draw 2, then reduce those cards' costs by 2.
06PZ008T2.flavorText: Styraatu burst through the processing plant, furious and impatient. Her rage was known even before the tendrils of madness found their way into her mind, but now... now she would make them all pay. First here, in this land of technology, then south, where she would war alongside her general once again.
06PZ008T2.name: Styraatu

06PZ007.description: Once you've <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> an ally this game, create in hand a new spell that costs 2 and set its cost to 0 this round.
06PZ007.descriptionRaw: Once you've Equipped an ally this game, create in hand a new spell that costs 2 and set its cost to 0 this round.
06PZ007.flavorText: "I have always been willing to sacrifice in the name of science. No matter the personal risk, the limitless, inexhaustible power I gained through the exchange was more than reward."
06PZ007.name: Ambitious Cultist

06PZ041.description: When I'm summoned, if I was created, draw 1 and grant me +2|+1.
06PZ041.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, if I was created, draw 1 and grant me +2|+1.
06PZ041.flavorText: When they're not sleeping in the middle of the day or throwing up in the middle of the night, cats are always up to some brand of mischief.
06PZ041.name: Cunning Kitten

06PZ036.description: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Deal 1 to all enemies. If you've played 6+ new spells this game, deal 3 instead. <style=Variable></style>
06PZ036.descriptionRaw: Play: Deal 1 to all enemies. If you've played 6+ new spells this game, deal 3 instead.
06PZ036.flavorText: "Zaun! I hope you're ready to scream, 'cause we're about to sink this place all over again!" - Zaun Diva
06PZ036.name: The Zaun Diva

06PZ036T3.description: Deal 1 to all enemies. If you've played 6+ new spells this game, deal 3 instead.
06PZ036T3.descriptionRaw: Deal 1 to all enemies. If you've played 6+ new spells this game, deal 3 instead.
06PZ036T3.flavorText: "The Diva's show is totally worth the hearing damage!" - Fans, probably
06PZ036T3.name: Fatal Encore

06PZ010.description: <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>Strike</style></link>: Create a random new 2 cost spell in hand.
06PZ010.descriptionRaw: Strike: Create a random new 2 cost spell in hand.
06PZ010.flavorText: Once, he'd dreamed of leaving Zaun and traveling the world with a song in his heart. Now, the world was asleep in her room, waiting for the songs tomorrow might bring.
06PZ010.name: Acoustician

06PZ022.description:
Draw 2.
<link=vocab.Flow><style=Vocab>Flow</style></link>: Reduce those cards' costs by 1.
06PZ022.descriptionRaw:
Draw 2.
Flow: Reduce those cards' costs by 1.
06PZ022.flavorText: Music's all about timing, but once in a while you've gotta just let loose.
06PZ022.name: Drum Solo

06PZ029.description:
Give an ally +2|+0 and <link=keyword.Quick Strike><sprite name=QuickStrike><style=Keyword>Quick Attack</style></link> this round.
<link=vocab.Flow><style=Vocab>Flow</style></link>: Create a new 2 cost spell in hand.
06PZ029.descriptionRaw:
Give an ally +2|+0 and Quick Attack this round.
Flow: Create a new 2 cost spell in hand.
06PZ029.name: Crowd Pleaser

06PZ020.description: <link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Reduce the cost of the most expensive spell in your hand by 1.
06PZ020.descriptionRaw: Nexus Strike: Reduce the cost of the most expensive spell in your hand by 1.
06PZ020.flavorText: You wouldn't find his name on any of the blueprints, or credited in any of the songs, but those in the know agreed: Acorn was the heart of the whole operation.
06PZ020.name: Acorn, the Hextechnician

06PZ009.description:
<link=vocab.Flow><style=Vocab>Flow</style></link>: I cost 2 less.
Deal 1 to all enemies.
06PZ009.descriptionRaw:
Flow: I cost 2 less.
Deal 1 to all enemies.
06PZ009.flavorText: It takes a special sound to break through Zaun's rattle and clang, but the Diva always delivers.
06PZ009.name: Caustic Riff

06PZ037.description: Deal 1 to a unit. If you've <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> an ally this game, copy me with the same target.
06PZ037.descriptionRaw: Deal 1 to a unit. If you've Equipped an ally this game, copy me with the same target.
06PZ037.flavorText: If discord be the cacophony of destruction, then butcher on.
06PZ037.name: The Violent Dischord

06PZ019.descriptionRaw: Round Start: Flow: Refill 2 spell mana.
06PZ019.flavorText: If he had things his way, NOBODY would get in.
06PZ019.name: Zaun Bouncer

06PZ033.description: Your spells and <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skills</style></link> deal 1 extra damage.
06PZ033.descriptionRaw: Your spells and Skills deal 1 extra damage.
06PZ033.flavorText:
"Location: Sector 3, Underway 19B
Item: Illegal Firearm
Notes: Confiscated during Operation: Sumplight. Weapon is highly dangerous. Handle with extreme care."
- Piltover Warden field report
06PZ033.name: Gatalyst v1.0

06BW029.flavorText: Pesh met Jax in a dockside brawl, and their timely escape was more convenience than partnership. But Pesh has been ferrying Jax about ever since, because things break around Jax, and if thereâ€™s one thing Pesh likes more than a good scrap, itâ€™s a break in need of fixing.
06BW029.name: Piltovan Castaway

06BW034.description: Destroy a unit's equipment and deal 2 to it.
06BW034.descriptionRaw: Destroy a unit's equipment and deal 2 to it.
06BW034.flavorText: "WHO THROWS AN ANCHOR IN A BAR FIGHT?! WHAT IS WRONG WITH YOU LOT?!!" - Bilgewater Bartender
06BW034.name: Heavy Metal

06BW027.description: To play, discard 1. Draw 2 and if you discarded an equipment, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Icathian Mirage</style></link>.
06BW027.descriptionRaw: To play, discard 1. Draw 2 and if you discarded an equipment, summon a Icathian Mirage.
06BW027.flavorText: Jaxâ€™s crew is proof that a whole can be greater than the sum of its parts. Still, Pesh insists on a different philosophy: sometimes, parts are pretty great on their own.
06BW027.name: Parts Made Whole

06BW039.description:
Once you've <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> an ally this game, I cost 2 less.
Draw 2 and grant them <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>.
06BW039.descriptionRaw:
Once you've Equipped an ally this game, I cost 2 less.
Draw 2 and grant them Fleeting.
06BW039.flavorText: Though Ibaaros' old bones moved slow, the waters that surged ahead of him moved at an almost incomprehensible speed.
06BW039.name: The Unending Wave

06BW026.description: When <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> allies attack, deal 1 to the enemy nexus.
06BW026.descriptionRaw: When Equipped allies attack, deal 1 to the enemy nexus.
06BW026.flavorText: It didn't matter where the power came from--her goddess would not care. What mattered was the glory it would bring her through the monsters she slayed.
06BW026.name: Buhru Cultist

06BW014.description:
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Draw 1 at next <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link> and grant it <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>. 
You may spend 9 mana to play me as <link=card.unit><style=AssociatedCard>Ibaaros</style></link>.
06BW014.descriptionRaw:
Attack: Draw 1 at next Round Start and grant it Fleeting. 
You may spend 9 mana to play me as Ibaaros.
06BW014.flavorText:
"Steer clear, steer clear, of the strait of Daray,
Where the waters whisper and the winds betray,
Where sea beast and bird so seldom foray,
For fear o' the darkness deep 'neath the strait of Daray."
- Bilgewater rhyme
06BW014.name: The Darkin Harpoon

06BW014T1.description: I have +1|+1 for each card you've drawn this game. I can only be blocked by enemies with 4 or more Power.
06BW014T1.descriptionRaw: I have +1|+1 for each card you've drawn this game. I can only be blocked by enemies with 4 or more Power.
06BW014T1.flavorText: Ibaaros, the Champion of the Dunes, lifted himself through the water. His blood coursed with that same familiar yearning from years before. To serve. To obey. To submit.
06BW014T1.name: Ibaaros

06BW014T3.description: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Draw 1 at the next <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link> and grant it <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>.
06BW014T3.descriptionRaw: Attack: Draw 1 at the next Round Start and grant it Fleeting.
06BW014T3.flavorText:
"Steer clear, steer clear, of the strait of Daray,
Where the waters whisper and the winds betray,
Where sea beast and bird so seldom foray,
For fear o' the darkness deep 'neath the strait of Daray."
- Bilgewater rhyme
06BW014T3.name: The Darkin Harpoon

06BW004.description: Give an enemy <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link> this round. If it dies this round, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
06BW004.descriptionRaw: Give an enemy Vulnerable this round. If it dies this round, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
06BW004.name: Test of Spirit

06BW044.descriptionRaw: Nexus Strike: Draw 1 and grant it Fleeting.
06BW044.flavorText: "Nasty, thievin' little monsters, they are. Easy enough to spot 'em when they've filched somethin', at least."
06BW044.name: Wily Newtfish

06BW047.description: When you play a spell, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Powder Keg</style></link>.
06BW047.descriptionRaw: When you play a spell, summon a Powder Keg.
06BW047.flavorText: "Bibi is a little... unhinged, sure. But that's what we love about her!" - Ai'la, Marai Warden
06BW047.name: Mischievous Marai

06BW023.flavorText:
"Like the saying goes, nothin' ends a Bilgewater quarrel faster than a cutlass."
"Except maybe a pistol."
"Shut up, Baz."
- Baz and Gav, aspiring bounty hunters
06BW023.name: Jagged Cutlass

06BW042.description: Deal 2 to a unit. Draw 1 at the next <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link> for each damage dealt and grant them <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>.
06BW042.descriptionRaw: Deal 2 to a unit. Draw 1 at the next Round Start for each damage dealt and grant them Fleeting.
06BW042.flavorText: "Rex'll take care of the boom, don't you worry - an' I'll take care of the treasure. I'll take care of Rex's share too, elsewise he'll try to put it in the cannon, an' that's always a mess." - Petty Officer
06BW042.name: Loaded Vessel

06BW026T1.flavorText: Yes... this weapon will certainly please Mother Serpent.
06BW026T1.name: Piercing Bolt

06SH004T1.description: The first time I'm <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> grant me +2|+2.
06SH004T1.descriptionRaw: The first time I'm Equipped grant me +2|+2.
06SH004T1.flavorText: Long did these devoted few tend their lady's temples. Long did they sweep back the sands and expel would-be desecrators. Long did they pray for her return. Her kindness. Her control.
06SH004T1.name: Darkinthrall

06SH004T4.description: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>LastBreath</style></link>: If my bearer is not a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Darkinthrall</style></link>, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Darkinthrall</style></link>.
06SH004T4.descriptionRaw: LastBreath: If my bearer is not a Darkinthrall, summon a Darkinthrall.
06SH004T4.name: The Darkin Bloodletters

06SH032.description: <link=keyword.Countdown><style=Keyword>Countdown 2</style></link><style=Variable></style>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Treasure of the Sands</style></link> in hand.
06SH032.descriptionRaw: Countdown 2: Create a Treasure of the Sands in hand.
06SH032.flavorText:
"Why must you touch everything?"
"What, you think it's booby-trapped? You think some boulder's just gonna come rollin' outtaâ€“"
"RUNNN!"
- Argus and Silvio, tomb robbers
06SH032.name: Buried Armory

06SH035.description: When you <link=vocab.Slay><style=Vocab>slay</style></link> a unit, reduce the cost of the next Darkin Unit you play by 1.
06SH035.descriptionRaw: When you slay a unit, reduce the cost of the next Darkin Unit you play by 1.
06SH035.flavorText: The altar throbbed with life once more, shaking the sands around it with a slow and steady beat. Each of Xolaani's disciples felt the same beat deep in their heart. Every muscle, every thought, every moment... they were all hers to control.
06SH035.name: The Altar of Blood

06SH046.description: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Ruinous Acolyte</style></link> in hand. When you destroy me create an <link=card.selfref><style=AssociatedCard>Acolyte's Reliquary</style></link> in the top 5 cards of your deck.
06SH046.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, create a Ruinous Acolyte in hand. When you destroy me create an Acolyte's Reliquary in the top 5 cards of your deck.
06SH046.flavorText: "Our hands shape the desert!" - Ruinous Acolyte
06SH046.name: Acolyte's Reliquary

06SH033.description: <link=vocab.Predict><style=Vocab>Predict</style></link>. Give a unit "I take double damage and if I would die, <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> me instead" this round.
06SH033.descriptionRaw: Predict. Give a unit "I take double damage and if I would die, Obliterate me instead" this round.
06SH033.flavorText: "Only fools seek power beyond their control." - Xerath
06SH033.name: Curse of the Tomb

06SH028.description: When you summon an ally or an ally dies, grant each of its positive keywords to 3 allies in your deck.
06SH028.descriptionRaw: When you summon an ally or an ally dies, grant each of its positive keywords to 3 allies in your deck.
06SH028.flavorText: The Hive Herald raised two hands to the colossal structure above. "A THRONE," he screamed, "FOR AN EMPRESS." The void gate above pulsed with life. Soon.
06SH028.name: Void Gate

06SH005.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Predict><style=Vocab>Predict</style></link>. If you pick a Darkin or an equipment, grant me +1|+1.
06SH005.descriptionRaw: Play: Predict. If you pick a Darkin or an equipment, grant me +1|+1.
06SH005.flavorText: In his hand he clutched a braided belt, a gift from his friend Rhaast before their Ascension ceremony - but even as he revered the Darkinâ€™s power, he harbored a secret resentment in his beastly heart.
06SH005.name: Forsaken Baccai

06SH056.flavorText: Sometimes you're drawn to the light, and sometimes it's drawn to you.
06SH056.name: Castigate

06SH040.description: Once you've <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>equipped</style></link> an ally this game, I cost 2 less. Revive the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>Strongest</style></link> dead allied champion.
06SH040.descriptionRaw: Once you've equipped an ally this game, I cost 2 less. Revive the Strongest dead allied champion.
06SH040.flavorText:
â€œYouâ€™ll never die, because Iâ€™ll never let you.â€
- Xolaani
06SH040.name: Heedless Resurrection

06SH021.flavorText: As the assault continued, larger and even more ferocious creatures poured from the widening gate. The city of Belveth was lost, though, as the cruelty of fate would have it, its name would live on.
06SH021.name: Camouflaged Horror

06SH051.description:
When you summon another ally, <link=vocab.Advance><style=Vocab>advance</style></link> your highest <link=keyword.Countdown><style=Keyword>Countdown</style></link> landmark 1 round.
When I'm summoned, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Hibernating Rockbear</style></link>.
06SH051.descriptionRaw:
When you summon another ally, advance your highest Countdown landmark 1 round.
When I'm summoned, summon a Hibernating Rockbear.
06SH051.flavorText: "The rockdoubbs treat Sadira like one of their own. She'd run away with 'em in a heartbeat if I let her, the little scamp!" - Kadira, Desert Naturalist
06SH051.name: Rockbear Shepherd

06SH055.description: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Deal 4 to me. Draw a champion and grant it +2|+2. If your deck started with 6+ different champions, summon it instead.
06SH055.descriptionRaw: Round Start: Deal 4 to me. Draw a champion and grant it +2|+2. If your deck started with 6+ different champions, summon it instead.
06SH055.flavorText: The faithful stand as evil encroaches, offering the last of their strength to channel the light of justice. A desperate call for deliverance they know will be answered before darkness consumes them.
06SH055.name: Priestess Of Desert Light

06SH004.description:
<link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: If my bearer is not a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Darkinthrall</style></link>, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Darkinthrall</style></link>.
You may spend 6 mana and kill an ally to play me as <link=card.unit><style=AssociatedCard>Xolaani</style></link>.
06SH004.descriptionRaw:
Last Breath: If my bearer is not a Darkinthrall, summon a Darkinthrall.
You may spend 6 mana and kill an ally to play me as Xolaani.
06SH004.flavorText: As the fighting raged on, Jun, desperate and badly wounded, turned to the voice whispering in her thoughts. "You will never die," it said, soft as summer rain, "because I will never let you."
06SH004.name: The Darkin Bloodletters

06SH031.flavorText:
"Put those down, Silvio!"
"Why? It ain't like the poor bugger's coming back for 'em!"
"Some things should stay buried." 
- Argus and Silvio, tomb robbers
06SH031.name: Treasure of the Sands

06SH004T2.description:
To play me, kill an ally.
<link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>The Darkin Bloodletters</style></link> in hand.
06SH004T2.descriptionRaw:
To play me, kill an ally.
Last Breath: Create a The Darkin Bloodletters in hand.
06SH004T2.flavorText: Shurima's Ascended were doomed the moment they took up arms against the Void. This was an enemy that could never be beaten, and while the god-warriors were all but guaranteed immortality, their minds were never as resilient. Madness consumed them all. Xolaani, once a beloved and gifted healer, began using her hemomantic powers to control her brethren, and soon enough, the hatred between her and Aatrox boiled over into civil war.
06SH004T2.name: Xolaani

06SH021T1.flavorText: With each corpse, the Void grew. Knowledge. Matter. Perspective. It began to feel. It began to want.
06SH021T1.name: Feed the Void

06SH038.descriptionRaw: Strike: Create a Lucky Find in hand.
06SH038.flavorText: "Chase what you want. Without mercy." - Ruin Runner
06SH038.name: Swinging Glaive

06DE048.flavorText: â€œIf ye be friend, then ye are welcome here, but woe to any who intrude upon this realm with evil in their heart, for they shall taste the vengeance of its mighty protector!â€
06DE048.name: Blocking Badgerbear

06DE024.description: Give an ally +1|+1 this round or <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>equip</style></link> it with an equipment in hand that costs 2 or less.
06DE024.descriptionRaw: Give an ally +1|+1 this round or equip it with an equipment in hand that costs 2 or less.
06DE024.flavorText: This move is more painful if the party hasn't eaten yet.
06DE024.name: Catch!

06DE025.description: When I'm summoned, give <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> allies <link=keyword.Barrier><sprite name=Barrier><style=Keyword>Barrier</style></link> this round.
06DE025.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, give Equipped allies Barrier this round.
06DE025.flavorText: "The boy is a liability. I was adamant he should not be taken along on our hunt, as still he refers to the foul creature as his 'sister'. It is a naivete so profound, it is frankly revolting. Yet, I suppose I do pity him well enough. At the very least, this will be an important lesson for him." - From the personal journal of Sirius Rowill, Zealous Ranger-Knight
06DE025.name: Kind-hearted Recruit

06DE033.description: Destroy a unit's equipment, and if it's a follower, <link=vocab.Silence><style=Vocab>Silence</style></link> it.
06DE033.descriptionRaw: Destroy a unit's equipment, and if it's a follower, Silence it.
06DE033.flavorText: "You've brought this upon yourself." - Lord Eldred, Mageseeker Leader
06DE033.name: Silence and Suppress

06DE039.description: Summon 2 <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Icathian Mirages</style></link> <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> with up to 2 <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipment</style></link> in hand that cost 2 or less.
06DE039.descriptionRaw: Summon 2 Icathian Mirages Equipped with up to 2 Equipment in hand that cost 2 or less.
06DE039.flavorText: Jax has spent countless dreams fighting alongside his lost kin. Some battles they win, some they lose, but always, they are together.
06DE039.name: Roar of Icathia

06DE011.description: You may spend 5 mana to play me as <link=card.unit><style=AssociatedCard>Joraal</style></link>.
06DE011.descriptionRaw: You may spend 5 mana to play me as Joraal.
06DE011.flavorText:
"My son, listen now. That shield must never be touched. Long ago, it was gifted to our house on the condition that we keep it safe, and leave it be. It is my responsibility, and when I pass, it will be yours. Do you hear me now? You must never climb to it again. You must never touch it."
"But mama, the voice inside... it cries to me. It sounds so sad."
"...All the more reason, my son."
- Lady Fortis and her son
06DE011.name: The Darkin Aegis

06DE021.description: When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Tumble</style></link> in hand or if you have one, reduce its cost by 1.
06DE021.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned or Round Start: Create a Tumble in hand or if you have one, reduce its cost by 1.
06DE021.flavorText: "Our target was once human, which means it's smarter than your average beast. One wrong move could spell death for us all. Stay within eyesight of one another, call out anything suspicious--but above all else, remember..."
06DE021.name: Vayne

06DE021T3.description: <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equip</style></link> an ally with an equipment in hand that costs 2 or less. It starts a free attack.
06DE021T3.descriptionRaw: Equip an ally with an equipment in hand that costs 2 or less. It starts a free attack.
06DE021T3.name: Tumble

06DE021T2.description:
If you've attacked 2+ times this round, I cost 5 less.
An ally <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> an enemy.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Vayne</style></link> in your deck.
06DE021T2.descriptionRaw:
If you've attacked 2+ times this round, I cost 5 less.
An ally strikes an enemy.
Create a Vayne in your deck.
06DE021T2.name: Vayne's Condemn

06DE021T1.description: When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Create a 0 cost <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Tumble</style></link> in hand or if you have one, reduce its cost to 0.
06DE021T1.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned or Round Start: Create a 0 cost Tumble in hand or if you have one, reduce its cost to 0.
06DE021T1.name: Vayne

06DE043.description: The first time you summon an Elite, grant me +2|+2.
06DE043.descriptionRaw: The first time you summon an Elite, grant me +2|+2.
06DE043.flavorText: "She's not as fast as a silverwing, but you'd be surprised how fast her little legs can carry her." - Cithria, Lady of Clouds
06DE043.name: Trusty Ramhound

06DE011T1.description: Your opponent's spells cost 2 more while I am attacking.
06DE011T1.descriptionRaw: Your opponent's spells cost 2 more while I am attacking.
06DE011T1.flavorText: A mighty Ascended tactician known as the Aegis of Eternity, Joraal seemed impervious to attack, even for the immortal god-warriors of Shurima. But the war against the Void raged on, and as resilient as Joraal's body was, it was his mind that broke. And how it broke.
06DE011T1.name: Joraal

06DE011T4.flavorText:
"My son, listen now. That shield must never be touched. Long ago, it was gifted to our house on the condition that we keep it safe, and leave it be. It is my responsibility, and when I pass, it will be yours. Do you hear me now? You must never climb to it again. You must never touch it."
"But mama, the voice inside... it cries to me. It sounds so sad."
"...All the more reason, my son."
- Lady Fortis and her son
06DE011T4.name: The Darkin Aegis

06DE018.description:
If you've attacked 2+ times this round, I cost 5 less.
An ally <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> an enemy.
06DE018.descriptionRaw:
If you've attacked 2+ times this round, I cost 5 less.
An ally strikes an enemy.
06DE018.name: Condemn

06DE041.descriptionRaw: Give allies +4|+4 this round and Rally.
06DE041.name: Champions' Strength

06DE026.description: Create an <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Icathian Mirage</style></link> in hand that costs 0 this round, or create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Golden Spatula</style></link> in hand.
06DE026.descriptionRaw: Create an Icathian Mirage in hand that costs 0 this round, or create a Golden Spatula in hand.
06DE026.flavorText:
Legends say the original wielder of the Golden Spatula was a marine creature of outstanding culinary prowess--one who sought to become a warrior as strong and fearless as Jax.

Other, more credible legends say that particular legend was fabricated entirely by a certain cook who was very, VERY lost in the sauce.
06DE026.name: Icathian Myths

06DE044.description: I don't take damage from enemy spells or <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skills</style></link>.
06DE044.descriptionRaw: I don't take damage from enemy spells or Skills.
06DE044.flavorText: "Nothing is stronger than petricite." - Durand Architect
06DE044.name: Petricite Charger

06DE017.description: An ally and an enemy <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> each other, or an <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> ally <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> an enemy, then is unequipped.
06DE017.descriptionRaw: An ally and an enemy strike each other, or an Equipped ally strikes an enemy, then is unequipped.
06DE017.name: Fish Fight

06DE040.description: Pick a follower or equipment from the top 4 cards of your deck. Draw it, place the rest into your deck.
06DE040.descriptionRaw: Pick a follower or equipment from the top 4 cards of your deck. Draw it, place the rest into your deck.
06DE040.flavorText: Soft, enticing whispers plant desire deep within the heart. Like a splinter, this festers and grows into hunger. Hunger gives way to transgression, which in turn brings death. And so the cycle continues.
06DE040.name: Tempting Prospect

06DE017T1.description: An ally and an enemy <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> each other.
06DE017T1.descriptionRaw: An ally and an enemy strike each other.
06DE017T1.name: Fish Fight

06DE017T2.name: Fish Fight

06DE028.description:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equip</style></link> me with an equipment that costs 2 or less from hand. 
The first time I would die while <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link>, fully heal me and destroy the equipment instead.
06DE028.descriptionRaw:
Play: Equip me with an equipment that costs 2 or less from hand. 
The first time I would die while Equipped, fully heal me and destroy the equipment instead.
06DE028.flavorText:
"Kian, if you're reading this... I'm hopefully dead. I can't control what's happening to me. The blood under my nails won't wash off. I'm so itchy. I scratch and scratch but nothing helps. It hurts. I just want it to stop. If I'm still alive somehow, promise me you'll stop trying to find me.

I would ask for forgiveness, but I don't deserve it. Be good to mother, okay?"
- Crumpled letter found in a torn-up satchel
06DE028.name: Bloodcursed Harpy

06DE027.descriptionRaw: Attack: Give Equipped allies +1|+1 this round.
06DE027.flavorText:
"Janan, was it? What can you tell me about Sirius?"
"Oh, Ranger-Knight Rowill? A few years ago, he had his title revoked. Apparently, he willfully disregarded every order he was given. Seems he does whatever he wants and doesn't take 'no' for an answer."
"Ah."
"So... why did you let him join this hunt, anyway?"
"I didn't."
"Then, why... oh, right. Fantastic."
- Vayne and Janan, Widowed Huntress
06DE027.name: Zealous Ranger-Knight

06DE026T1.description: Create an <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Icathian Mirage</style></link> in hand that costs 0 this round.

Legends say the original wielder of the golden spatula was a marine creature of outstanding culinary prowess--one who sought to become a warrior as strong and fearless as Jax.

Other, more credible legends say that particular legend was fabricated entirely by a certain cook who was very, VERY lost in the sauce.

06DE026T2.descriptionRaw: Create a Golden Spatula in hand.
06DE026T2.flavorText:
Legends say the original wielder of the golden spatula was a marine creature of outstanding culinary prowess--one who sought to become a warrior as strong and fearless as Jax.

Other, more credible legends say that particular legend was fabricated entirely by a certain cook who was very, VERY lost in the sauce.
06DE026T2.name: Icathian Myths

06DE019.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equip</style></link> me with an equipment that costs 2 or less from hand.
06DE019.descriptionRaw: Play: Equip me with an equipment that costs 2 or less from hand.
06DE019.flavorText: "Though the woman seems a competent enough fighter, her grief is fresh and threatens to overwhelm her. Despair is indeed a compelling motivator--I should know--but unbridled so? Mayhap she is looking to die..." - From the personal journal of Sirius Rowill, Zealous Ranger-Knight
06DE019.name: Widowed Huntress

06DE032.flavorText: The standard sword and shield of choice for Demacia's helmeted brothers-in-arms.
06DE032.name: Demacian Steel

06DE029.description: The first time an ally is <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link>, grant me <link=keyword.Tough><sprite name=Tough><style=Keyword>Tough</style></link>.

06DE029.flavorText: "Back, foul creature! Rend even a single hair from Purity's immaculate coat and I will see that you suffer AN ETERNITY OF AGONY!" - Sirius Rowill, Zealous Ranger-Knight
06DE029.name: Steadfast Elkin

06DE010.description: Once you've <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> an ally this game, grant me <link=keyword.Scout><sprite name=Scout><style=Keyword>Scout</style></link>.
06DE010.descriptionRaw: Once you've Equipped an ally this game, grant me Scout.
06DE010.flavorText: Years of suppressing her magical abilities bred within her a fathomless self-hatred she maliciously unleashed on her victims. Once she had defected from the ranger-knights, her anger was aimless until a voice called in the darkness. It spoke of a new order, one where she could practice her cruelty unfettered.
06DE010.name: Ranger-Knight Defector

06DE006.description: When I'm summoned, I <link=vocab.Improvise><style=Vocab>Improvise</style></link>, then <link=vocab.Forge><style=Vocab>Forge</style></link> me.
06DE006.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, I Improvise, then Forge me.
06DE006.flavorText: After his time in the Demacian military, Breshi thought heâ€™d retire and cook at a quiet hamlet tavern. Jax ruined this retirement with a tavern brawl and a particularly bad opinion on hardboiled eggs. Since then, Breshiâ€™s embraced a new lot in life: teaching Jax some taste.

06DE034.description:
If an ally died this round, I cost 2 less.
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equip</style></link> me with an equipment that costs 2 or less from hand and <link=vocab.Forge><style=Vocab>Forge</style></link> me.
06DE034.descriptionRaw:
If an ally died this round, I cost 2 less.
Play: Equip me with an equipment that costs 2 or less from hand and Forge me.
06DE034.flavorText: "I've had Maggie since she was a pup. She may be long in the tooth, but she's still sharp as a fresh-whetted blade. I'd give my life for hers--and I know she'd give hers for mine." - Janan, Widowed Huntress
06DE034.name: Faithful Wolfdog

06DE024T1.description: <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equip</style></link> an ally with an equipment that costs 2 or less.
06DE024T1.descriptionRaw: Equip an ally with an equipment that costs 2 or less.
06DE024T1.flavorText: This move is more painful if the party hasn't eaten yet.
06DE024T1.name: Catch!

06DE024T2.flavorText: This move is more painful if the party hasn't eaten yet.
06DE024T2.name: Catch!

06SI045.descriptionRaw: Kill an ally to summon 2 Ephemeral copies of it.
06SI045.name: Soul Cleave

06SI007.description:
To play me, kill an ally.
You may spend 10 mana to play me as <link=card.unit><style=AssociatedCard>Taarosh</style></link>.
06SI007.descriptionRaw:
To play me, kill an ally.
You may spend 10 mana to play me as Taarosh.
06SI007.flavorText: Straining against the confines of his cell, Taarosh heard his general's call. He would answer it, one way or another.
06SI007.name: The Darkin Halberd

06SI034.flavorText: "I don't know what wicked magic they work, and I don't WANNA know. All's I need to know is that if they rise up, they're gettin' killed. Again." - Watcher on the Isles
06SI034.name: Wraith of Echoes

06SI029.description: If an ally died this round, I cost 2 less.
06SI029.descriptionRaw: If an ally died this round, I cost 2 less.
06SI029.flavorText: "There can be no justice... only revenge." - Kalista
06SI029.name: Malefic Spear

06SI032.descriptionRaw: Kill a unit with total Power and Health of 4 or less, or destroy a unit's equipment.
06SI032.flavorText: However death manifests on the Shadow Isles, may it be blessedly swift.
06SI032.name: Quietus

06SI007T4.description: To play me, kill an ally.
06SI007T4.descriptionRaw: To play me, kill an ally.
06SI007T4.name: The Darkin Halberd

06SI007T1.description: Each round, the first time I attack, fill your attackers with revived <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> copies of the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> followers you've <link=vocab.Slay><style=Vocab>slain</style></link> this game.

06SI007T1.flavorText: Legend says Taarosh was mere moments from destroying Xolaani when the Darkin were set upon by the Targonians. As centuries passed, he sensed the land around him become corrupted, tainted with rot and perpetual stench of death. How he dreamt of steeping Xolaani in this same suffering once he'd claimed his freedom.
06SI007T1.name: Taarosh

06SI031.description: Give an ally "<link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Icathian Mirage</style></link> with my equipment" this round.
06SI031.descriptionRaw: Give an ally "Last Breath: Summon a Icathian Mirage with my equipment" this round.
06SI031.flavorText: Sometimes, the best you can do for a fallen ally is to take up their weapon and continue the fight.
06SI031.name: Blades of the Fallen

06SI014.description:
When I am summoned, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Ghastly Band</style></link>.
<link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: If you have the attack token, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Ghastly Band</style></link>.
06SI014.descriptionRaw:
When I am summoned, summon a Ghastly Band.
Round Start: If you have the attack token, summon a Ghastly Band.
06SI014.flavorText: "The players are ready, the stage is set, our audience is waiting--Maestro, if you please!" - Boisterous Host
06SI014.name: Opulent Foyer

06SI038.descriptionRaw: Attack: Summon an attacking Ghastly Band.
06SI038.flavorText: Striving for perfection was limiting, rigid. Perfection had no life; could not breathe. However, perfect imperfection--now, that was something to strive for.
06SI038.name: Redeemed Prodigy

06SI003.flavorText: Jax asked for Firethâ€™s name two dozen times in their first weeks of travel together, but she would only ever growl, â€œI am the Reaper!â€. Breshi found a novel solutionâ€”heâ€™d just baked a cake, you see, and needed the name of the groupâ€™s strongest member to properly celebrate.

06SI006.flavorText: "The Box does not give its secrets freely, Shieda Kayn. They come at a grim price. But if you have the courage to gaze into the shadow of shadows, you will find that wonderful, terrible things lay within." - Ysdra, Keeper of the Box
06SI006.name: Keeper of the Box

06SI031T1.flavorText: Perhaps they are a mirage. Perhaps she and hers hail from a remote, hidden village. She says nothing of her origin, and Jax does not ask. But when she rises from the sands and stands beside him, they fight in perfect, soundless, impossible harmony.
06SI031T1.name: Icathian Mirage

06SI039.description: Kill an ally to summon an <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Encroaching Mist</style></link>.
06SI039.descriptionRaw: Kill an ally to summon an Encroaching Mist.
06SI039.flavorText: Only a fool would stare into the Black Mist in hopes of deciphering a familiar shape.
06SI039.name: Shape of Fear

06SI042.description: When I would gain <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link>, grant me +1|+1 instead.
06SI042.descriptionRaw: When I would gain Ephemeral, grant me +1|+1 instead.
06SI042.flavorText: Soldiers that had been trained to withstand punishment in life were only more diligent and able in death--undeterred by cold, pain, or fear.
06SI042.name: Deathless Knight

06SI036.descriptionRaw: Kill ALL units except Darkin allies and Equipped allies.
06SI036.flavorText: As she took hold of the weapons, her humanity fled, and in its place a hateful essence filled the emptying vessel that was once the student Jun. It washed through her, over her, around her, and out into the world, stirring the slumbering Darkin.
06SI036.name: Utter Devastation

06SI032T2.flavorText: However death manifests on the Shadow Isles, may it be blessedly swift.
06SI032T2.name: Quietus

06SI032T1.description: Kill a unit with total Power and Health of 4 or less.
06SI032T1.descriptionRaw: Kill a unit with total Power and Health of 4 or less.
06SI032T1.flavorText: However death manifests on the Shadow Isles, may it be blessedly swift.
06SI032T1.name: Quietus

06SI046.flavorText: â€œ...and so I'll stand watch, into eternity, for mine is a duty beyond life, and beyond death.â€
06SI046.name: Ceaseless Sentry

06SI041.description:
When you summon an <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> ally, grant it +1|+0.
<link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link>: Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Sapling</style></link>.
06SI041.descriptionRaw:
When you summon an Ephemeral ally, grant it +1|+0.
Nightfall: Summon a Sapling.
06SI041.flavorText: Far from the Shadow Isles' shores are copses of trees thought long-dead, crooked and unmoving to all but the most keen observer--who will note that in that moon-drenched soil, new life stirs.
06SI041.name: Moonlit Glenkeeper

07PZ009.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Predict><style=Vocab>Predict</style></link>, then draw 1 and reduce its cost by 1.
07PZ009.descriptionRaw: Play: Predict, then draw 1 and reduce its cost by 1.
07PZ009.flavorText: â€œThis little guy just needed a bit of tinkering. Fresh gears here, a new arm there, and they get a new lease on life. Timeâ€™s a gift everyone should get a little more of, I say.â€ - Ekko

07PZ017.descriptionRaw: When you play a spell, plant 1 Flashbomb Trap in the top 8 cards of the enemy deck.
07PZ017.flavorText: "...And you know what else makes these babies better than mushrooms? You decide when they explode! How's THAT for value?"
07PZ017.name: Flashbomb Peddler

07PZ005.description: Deal 1 to an enemy and the enemy Nexus. Discard up to 2 to increase the damage by 1 for each card discarded.
07PZ005.descriptionRaw: Deal 1 to an enemy and the enemy Nexus. Discard up to 2 to increase the damage by 1 for each card discarded.

07NX007.levelupDescriptionRaw: I've seen you play 6 cards. Resets when you start a round with the attack token.

<link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: Give it +2|+1 instead.

07NX004.name: Adroit Artificer

When I'm summoned, I <link=vocab.Improvise><style=Vocab>Improvise</style></link>.

07DE008.description:
When I'm summoned, draw a unit.
When you summon an ally, grow its stats to equal its cost.
07DE008.descriptionRaw:
When I'm summoned, draw a unit.
When you summon an ally, grow its stats to equal its cost.
07DE008.flavorText: The first time she saw the Altar, Cithria found herself at a loss for words. For a while, she could only stand in awe of the majesty of those honored heroes. Would she ever be bold enough to stand by their side?
07DE008.name: Altar to Unity

07PZ019.description: I have +1|+0 for each 1 cost ally you've summoned this game.
07PZ019.descriptionRaw: I have +1|+0 for each 1 cost ally you've summoned this game.
07PZ019.flavorText: "I have to draw da horse LOTS of legs, Mister Lizard, 'cause we gotta get to da castle FAST. Uh oh, he came out a lil'... oopy goopy. And a lil' gween." - Ingvar the Younger
07PZ019.name: Chemtech Catermobile

07PZ021.description: Allies that have a different subtype than other allies in play cost 1 less.
07PZ021.descriptionRaw: Allies that have a different subtype than other allies in play cost 1 less.
07PZ021.flavorText: "I won't hurt you, friend! I came to this jungle for science, not destruction."
07PZ021.name: Anura & Froop

07PZ022.description: Deal 1 to an enemy or the enemy Nexus, and 1 to another.
07PZ022.descriptionRaw: Deal 1 to an enemy or the enemy Nexus, and 1 to another.
07PZ022.flavorText: Most Piltovans could care less about the patterns of the wind. But for many Zaunites, even a stray breeze smells of salvation.
07PZ022.name: Divine Draft

07PZ013.description: If your Nexus would take non-<link=card.cardref><style=AssociatedCard>Poison Puffcap</style></link> damage, your opponent plants 5 <link=card.cardref><style=AssociatedCard>Poison Puffcaps</style></link> in your deck for each damage instead.
07PZ013.descriptionRaw: If your Nexus would take non-Poison Puffcap damage, your opponent plants 5 Poison Puffcaps in your deck for each damage instead.
07PZ013.flavorText: Deep beneath the streets of Zaun, you are what you eat.
07PZ013.name: Sump Monument

07PZ015.description: To play, spend all your mana. Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Runaway Scraptrap</style></link> and grow its stats to that amount.
07PZ015.descriptionRaw: To play, spend all your mana. Summon a Runaway Scraptrap and grow its stats to that amount.
07PZ015.flavorText: "A scientist's primary responsibility is to control variables. The consequences of accidents, in a field of study such as ours--oh, I shudder to think of it!" - Professor Heimerdinger
07PZ015.name: Epic Scraptraption

07PZ015T1.flavorText: "Now, let me see--perhaps if we added... Oh, dear! Someone get after that contraption!" - Professor Heimerdinger
07PZ015T1.name: Runaway Scraptrap

07NX028.description: <link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Deal damage to the enemy Nexus equal to half its Health, rounded up.
07NX028.descriptionRaw: Nexus Strike: Deal damage to the enemy Nexus equal to half its Health, rounded up.
07NX028.flavorText: Noxus is an empire built for expansion above all. Wood, stone or steel--nothing can stop the advance of a Noxian battering ram.
07NX028.name: Captain Kalrix

07NX034.description: Allies cost 1 less. When you play an ally, deal 2 to it.
07NX034.descriptionRaw: Allies cost 1 less. When you play an ally, deal 2 to it.
07NX034.flavorText: "Come, my friends, sit! The company is good and the drinks are flowing. I simply cannot wait to show you what's for supper." - Vladimir
07NX034.name: Crimson Banquet Hall

07NX032.description: When my bearer plays a <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skill</style></link>, copy it.
07NX032.descriptionRaw: When my bearer plays a Skill, copy it.
07NX032.flavorText: The Ravenbloom Conservatory was especially renowned for its collection of texts, many of which ultimately became fuel for the roaring fire set by one notoriously difficult pupil...
07NX032.name: Ravenborn Tome

07NX033.description: When I'm summoned, grant me +1|+1 for each different subtype other allies have. <style=Variable></style>
07NX033.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, grant me +1|+1 for each different subtype other allies have.
07NX033.flavorText: "Be careful, you imbeciles! Noxians only buy fighting beasts in perfect condition. So much as a scratch, and it's coming out of your pay!" - Big Game Tycoon
07NX033.name: Bonehide Tri-tail

07RU015.description:
<link=vocab.Origin><style=Vocab>Origin</style></link>: <link=card.origin><style=AssociatedCard>The Poro King's Decree</style></link>.
Each round, the first time you summon another Poro, create a <link=card.baseSnax><style=AssociatedCard>Poro Snax</style></link> in hand.
07RU015.descriptionRaw:
Origin: The Poro King's Decree.
Each round, the first time you summon another Poro, create a Poro Snax in hand.
07RU015.levelupDescription: You've summoned 6+ other new Poros. When I level up, create a random Special Snax in hand.<style=Variable></style>
07RU015.levelupDescriptionRaw: You've summoned 6+ other new Poros. When I level up, create a random Special Snax in hand.
07RU015.flavorText: Ingvar knows potential when she sees it. Homemade appearance aside, this beloved companion could easily be the ruler of a gajillion trillion Poros--with the right amount of imagination.
07RU015.name: The Poro King

07RU015T3.description:
Draw 2 different Poro followers and grant them +1|+1.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>The Poro King</style></link> in your deck.
07RU015T3.descriptionRaw:
Draw 2 different Poro followers and grant them +1|+1.
Create a The Poro King in your deck.
07RU015T3.flavorText: They may be small, but there's strength in numbers. Round, fuzzy, terrifyingly plentiful numbers.
07RU015T3.name: The Poro King's Council Call

07RU015T6.description: Grant Poro allies <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +1|+1. Give 2 Poro allies <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link> this round.
07RU015T6.descriptionRaw: Grant Poro allies everywhere +1|+1. Give 2 Poro allies Challenger this round.
07RU015T6.flavorText: Served piping hot and bursting with bold, roasty flavors, an early morning pick-me-up will do any Poro some good.
07RU015T6.name: Espresso Snax

07RU015T2.description: Grant Poro allies <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +1|+1. Give Poro allies <link=keyword.Impact><sprite name=Impact><style=Keyword>Impact</style></link> this round.
07RU015T2.descriptionRaw: Grant Poro allies everywhere +1|+1. Give Poro allies Impact this round.
07RU015T2.flavorText: With hot sausage, flaky dough, and a triple simmered spicy sauce, this treat comes in at a solid ten on Ingvar's Super Spicy Scale, and is one of her all-time favorites.
07RU015T2.name: Pepper Snax

07RU015T1.description: You may put any non-champion cards with the word "Poro" on them into your deck during deckbuilding.
07RU015T1.descriptionRaw: You may put any non-champion cards with the word "Poro" on them into your deck during deckbuilding.
07RU015T1.flavorText: "Dis is His Super-Highness Poro King's Dee-cree, for pwotection of all da peoples..." - Ingvar the Younger
07RU015T1.name: The Poro King's Decree

07RU015T7.description: Grant Poro allies <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +1|+1. Grant allied champions <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +1|+1 and a random keyword.
07RU015T7.descriptionRaw: Grant Poro allies everywhere +1|+1. Grant allied champions everywhere +1|+1 and a random keyword.
07RU015T7.flavorText: "All da colors DO taste different, if you tink reaaaaaallly hard about it." - Ingvar the Younger
07RU015T7.name: Colorful Snax

07RU015T4.description: Each round, the first time you summon another Poro, create a random Special Snax in hand.
07RU015T4.descriptionRaw: Each round, the first time you summon another Poro, create a random Special Snax in hand.
07RU015T4.flavorText: "MOOOM, come look! Mister Highness Poro King is comin' to liiiiife! Look, he really is! I'm not makin' it up this time, I pinky pwomise!" - Ingvar the Younger
07RU015T4.name: The Poro King

07RU015T5.descriptionRaw: Grant Poro allies everywhere +1|+1. Frostbite an enemy.
07RU015T5.flavorText: This pastry boasts frosting hand-made with all the flavors of the Freljord: powder snow, packed snow, and--you guessed it--snowfall!
07RU015T5.name: Frosted Snax

07RU012.description:
<link=vocab.Origin><style=Vocab>Origin</style></link>: <link=card.origin><style=AssociatedCard>Many-Shaped Jungle Friends!</style></link>
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: You may <link=vocab.Disguise><style=Vocab>disguise</style></link> me as 1 of 3 two cost followers from my <link=vocab.Origin><style=Vocab>Origin</style></link>.
07RU012.descriptionRaw:
Origin: Many-Shaped Jungle Friends!
Play: You may disguise me as 1 of 3 two cost followers from my Origin.
07RU012.levelupDescription: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: You've attacked with allies that have 6+ different subtypes.<style=Variable></style>
07RU012.levelupDescriptionRaw: Attack: You've attacked with allies that have 6+ different subtypes.
07RU012.flavorText: Neeko can take many shapes, but her heart never changes--always leading her back to her family and her forest.
07RU012.name: Neeko

07RU012T2.description: When I level up or <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Grant allies that have a subtype <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +1|+1.
07RU012T2.descriptionRaw: When I level up or Attack: Grant allies that have a subtype everywhere +1|+1.
07RU012T2.flavorText: "Shapes and colors, colors and shapes--Neeko can be them all!"
07RU012T2.name: Neeko

07RU012T4.description: You may put Bird, Cat, Dog, Elnuk, Fae, Reptile, and Spider followers into your deck during deckbuilding.
07RU012T4.descriptionRaw: You may put Bird, Cat, Dog, Elnuk, Fae, Reptile, and Spider followers into your deck during deckbuilding.
07RU012T4.flavorText: "Neeko will lead us to protect the jungle! Well... Neeko will lead us to Nidalee--and then we will all protect the jungle together!" - Neeko
07RU012T4.name: Many-Shaped Jungle Friends!

07RU012T1.description:
Summon an exact <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> copy of an ally, then swap them.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Neeko</style></link> in your deck.
07RU012T1.descriptionRaw:
Summon an exact Ephemeral copy of an ally, then swap them.
Create a Neeko in your deck.
07RU012T1.flavorText: "Neeko is here, Neeko is there--Neeko could be anywhere!" - Neeko
07RU012T1.name: Neeko's Shapesplitter

07RU017.description: Summon an exact <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> copy of an ally, then swap them.
07RU017.descriptionRaw: Summon an exact Ephemeral copy of an ally, then swap them.
07RU017.flavorText: "Neeko is here, Neeko is there--Neeko could be anywhere!" -Neeko
07RU017.name: Shapesplitter

07RU016.description: Draw 2 different Poro followers and grant them +1|+1.
07RU016.descriptionRaw: Draw 2 different Poro followers and grant them +1|+1.
07RU016.flavorText: They may be small, but there's strength in numbers--round, fuzzy, terrifingly plentiful numbers.
07RU016.name: Council Call

07BW043.description: Deal 1 to a unit. <link=vocab.Spawn><style=Vocab>Spawn</style></link> 1 for each damage dealt.
07BW043.descriptionRaw: Deal 1 to a unit. Spawn 1 for each damage dealt.
07BW043.flavorText: Only the most learned can bend the elements to their will.
07BW043.name: Tidal Invocation

07BW035.description:
Your cards in hand have <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>.
When you play a card, draw 1.
07BW035.descriptionRaw:
Your cards in hand have Fleeting.
When you play a card, draw 1.
07BW035.flavorText: "I reckon you ought to know your hand and hold it close, or be prepared to lose it all." - Twisted Fate
07BW035.name: The Swindler's Den

07BW042.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> a follower that has a different subtype than allies in play.
07BW042.descriptionRaw: Play: Manifest a follower that has a different subtype than allies in play.
07BW042.flavorText: "There's a reason we keep this scruffy little guy around: haven't had a wharf rat problem in years!" - Dreadway Deckhand
07BW042.name: Deck Hunter

07BW039.description: Each round, the first time you summon a 1 cost ally, refill 1 spell mana.
07BW039.descriptionRaw: Each round, the first time you summon a 1 cost ally, refill 1 spell mana.
07BW039.flavorText: "Mister Lizard, what are you doing here? You like Poros too!?" - Ingvar the Younger
07BW039.name: Dragon Prince Grinzo

07BW033.description:
Summon a random Husk.
Grant 1 cost allies <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +1|+1.
07BW033.descriptionRaw:
Summon a random Husk.
Grant 1 cost allies everywhere +1|+1.
07BW033.flavorText: Some Bilgewater sailors stuff cotton in their ears on the quietest nights at sea. They know well that music from beneath the waves promises nothing but a watery tomb.
07BW033.name: Siren Song

07IO041.description: Heal your Nexus 3 and draw 2 spells.
07IO041.descriptionRaw: Heal your Nexus 3 and draw 2 spells.
07IO041.flavorText: "The wind is the wanderer's only ally." - Yasuo
07IO041.name: Rejuvenating Breeze

07IO043.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Pick 1 of 3 <link=keyword.Fast><sprite name=Fast><style=Keyword>Fast</style></link> or <link=keyword.Slow><sprite name=Slow><style=Keyword>Slow</style></link> spells in the enemy's hand or deck. Create a <link=card.cardref><style=AssociatedCard>Carvings of Divination</style></link> for it.
07IO043.descriptionRaw: Play: Pick 1 of 3 Fast or Slow spells in the enemy's hand or deck. Create a Carvings of Divination for it.
07IO043.flavorText: The eye unbound from the material world sees all. Blind though he may seem, those who mistake the oracle for an easy target are rebuked swiftly and without mercy.
07IO043.name: All-Seeing Oracle

07IO043T1.flavorText: "Watch how the sticks fall. Only when you look beyond what you see will you understand your fate." - All-Seeing Oracle
07IO043T1.name: Carvings of Divination

07IO049.descriptionRaw: Nexus Strike: Summon a random Husk.
07IO049.flavorText: "Hush, we're nearly there. You said you wanted to meet my friend, didn't you? Trust me--she's going to love you."
07IO049.name: Airis

07SH038.descriptionRaw:
Ambush 1
Nexus Strike: Summon a Pakaa Protector.
07SH038.flavorText: Cuteness is an appearance, but ferocity is an instinct. Given time and teaching, even the littlest pakiti grow wild and strong.
07SH038.name: Pakaa Cub

07SH038T2.description:
Transform my <link=card.shadow><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow in the Brush</style></link> into a <link=card.parent><style=AssociatedCard>Pakaa Cub</style></link>.
