If my <link=card.shadow><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow in the Brush</style></link> leaves play, <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> me.
07SH038T2.descriptionRaw:
Transform my Shadow in the Brush into a Pakaa Cub. 
If my Shadow in the Brush leaves play, Obliterate me.
07SH038T2.name: Pakaa Cub's Ambush

07SH038T1.flavorText: Pakiti are naturally inquisitive, and prone to jumping four-paws first into unfamiliar situations. With new dangers lurking in the jungle, pack guardians keep a closer eye than ever on their cubs--even if you can't see them.
07SH038T1.name: Pakaa Protector

07SH041.flavorText: Jungle reconnaissance is the least desirable assignment for one reason above all: it is full of surprises.
07SH041.name: Facecheck

07SH004.description: Give an ally +2|+0 this round. If it is a <link=card.shadow><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow in the Brush</style></link>, give it +2|+2 instead.
07SH004.descriptionRaw: Give an ally +2|+0 this round. If it is a Shadow in the Brush, give it +2|+2 instead.
07SH004.name: Prowl

07SH013.levelupDescription: I've seen you summon or transform 4 other allies.<style=Variable></style>
07SH013.levelupDescriptionRaw: I've seen you summon or transform 4 other allies.
07SH013.flavorText: "I will always protect you, lizard girl. We will make these poachers pay. Together." - Nidalee
07SH013.name: Nidalee

07SH013T3.description:
Give an ally +2|+0 this round. If it is a <link=card.shadow><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow in the Brush</style></link>, give it +2|+2 instead.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Nidalee</style></link> in your deck.
07SH013T3.descriptionRaw:
Give an ally +2|+0 this round. If it is a Shadow in the Brush, give it +2|+2 instead.
Create a Nidalee in your deck.
07SH013T3.name: Nidalee's Prowl

07SH013T4.description:
<link=vocab.Ambush><style=Vocab>Ambush 2</style></link>
<link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Transform me back into <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Nidalee</style></link> and create a <link=card.javelin><style=AssociatedCard>Javelin Toss</style></link> in hand.
07SH013T4.descriptionRaw:
Ambush 2
Nexus Strike: Transform me back into Nidalee and create a Javelin Toss in hand.
07SH013T4.flavorText: "The men call her Kashdaji as an insult. But she commands the jungle--and they cannot hide the fact that they are afraid." -from Anura's field journal, day 32
07SH013T4.name: Packmother Nidalee

07SH013T7.description:
Transform my <link=card.shadow><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow in the Brush</style></link> into a <link=card.parent><style=AssociatedCard>Nidalee</style></link>. 
If my <link=card.shadow><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow in the Brush</style></link> leaves play, <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> me.
07SH013T7.descriptionRaw:
Transform my Shadow in the Brush into a Nidalee. 
If my Shadow in the Brush leaves play, Obliterate me.
07SH013T7.name: Nidalee's Ambush

07SH013T5.description:
Transform my <link=card.shadow><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow in the Brush</style></link> into a <link=card.parent><style=AssociatedCard>Packmother Nidalee</style></link>. 
If my <link=card.shadow><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow in the Brush</style></link> leaves play, <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> me.
07SH013T5.descriptionRaw:
Transform my Shadow in the Brush into a Packmother Nidalee. 
If my Shadow in the Brush leaves play, Obliterate me.
07SH013T5.name: Packmother Nidalee's Ambush

07SH013T6.flavorText: You never know what could be concealed in the underbrush.
07SH013T6.name: Shadow in the Brush

07SH013T2.description: Deal  4 to an enemy. If there are no enemies when I'm played, I target the enemy Nexus instead.
07SH013T2.descriptionRaw: Deal  4 to an enemy. If there are no enemies when I'm played, I target the enemy Nexus instead.
07SH013T2.name: Javelin Toss

07SH009.description:
<link=vocab.Ambush><style=Vocab>Ambush 3</style></link>
When I transform from <link=card.ambush><style=AssociatedCard>Avenging Vastaya's Ambush</style></link>, stop all enemy <link=keyword.Fast><sprite name=Fast><style=Keyword>Fast</style></link> spells, <link=keyword.Slow><sprite name=Slow><style=Keyword>Slow</style></link> spells, and <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skills</style></link>.
07SH009.descriptionRaw:
Ambush 3
When I transform from Avenging Vastaya's Ambush, stop all enemy Fast spells, Slow spells, and Skills.
07SH009.flavorText: "Do not fear, little ones. I will protect you--and see my debt to Nidalee repaid."
07SH009.name: Avenging Vastaya

07SH009T1.description: Stop all enemy <link=keyword.Fast><sprite name=Fast><style=Keyword>Fast</style></link> spells, <link=keyword.Slow><sprite name=Slow><style=Keyword>Slow</style></link> spells, and <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skills</style></link>.
07SH009T1.descriptionRaw: Stop all enemy Fast spells, Slow spells, and Skills.
07SH009T1.flavorText: "Last time, your cowardly tricks took me by surprise. That will not happen again." -Kuulcan
07SH009T1.name: Enough!

07SH009T2.description:
Transform my <link=card.shadow><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow in the Brush</style></link> into an <link=card.parent><style=AssociatedCard>Avenging Vastaya</style></link>. 
If my <link=card.shadow><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow in the Brush</style></link> leaves play, <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> me.
07SH009T2.descriptionRaw:
Transform my Shadow in the Brush into an Avenging Vastaya. 
If my Shadow in the Brush leaves play, Obliterate me.
07SH009T2.name: Avenging Vastaya's Ambush

07SH039.description:
<link=vocab.Ambush><style=Vocab>Ambush 0</style></link>
When I'm summoned or transform, grant the <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> enemy <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link>.
07SH039.descriptionRaw:
Ambush 0
When I'm summoned or transform, grant the weakest enemy Vulnerable.
07SH039.flavorText: "This here beauty can turn even a novice into a tree-climbing, boulder-jumping professional. Cost me a fortune, but I'm sure I can pay off those loans with the skin of a rare beastie or two..."
07SH039.name: All-Terrain Trooper

07SH044.description:
<link=vocab.Ambush><style=Vocab>Ambush 4</style></link>
When I transform, summon a <link=card.selfRef><style=AssociatedCard>Aurora Hallunatis</style></link>.
07SH044.descriptionRaw:
Ambush 4
When I transform, summon a Aurora Hallunatis.
07SH044.flavorText: "How I would like to see one myself! Most of the expeditioners believe Aurora Hallunatis is a myth, but one young man swears otherwise. He tells me that the bird is brilliantly colored with a wingspan as long as a man is tall. To look into its eyes, he confides in me one night, is to understand that you are prey." - From Anura's field journal, day 21
07SH044.name: Aurora Hallunatis

07SH003.description:
<link=vocab.Ambush><style=Vocab>Ambush 3</style></link>
When I transform from <link=card.ambush><style=AssociatedCard>Blimp-Pack Poacher's Ambush</style></link>, the next time I block or am blocked this round, <link=keyword.Capture><sprite name=Capture><style=Keyword>Capture</style></link> my enemy.
07SH003.descriptionRaw:
Ambush 3
When I transform from Blimp-Pack Poacher's Ambush, the next time I block or am blocked this round, Capture my enemy.
07SH003.flavorText: "Ha! Try and get me now, silly beasts. Even gravity can't defeat the superior species!"
07SH003.name: Blimp-Pack Poacher

07SH003T2.flavorText: "A positively resplendid find! Rowain is sure to reward me for this." - Blimp-Pack Poacher
07SH003T2.name: Secure the Goods

07SH003T3.description:
Transform my <link=card.shadow><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow in the Brush</style></link> into a <link=card.parent><style=AssociatedCard>Blimp-Pack Poacher</style></link>. 
If my <link=card.shadow><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow in the Brush</style></link> leaves play, <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> me.
07SH003T3.descriptionRaw:
Transform my Shadow in the Brush into a Blimp-Pack Poacher. 
If my Shadow in the Brush leaves play, Obliterate me.
07SH003T3.name: Blimp-Pack Poacher's Ambush

07SH011.description: When I'm summoned or the first time an ally transforms each round, grant the <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> enemy <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link>.
07SH011.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned or the first time an ally transforms each round, grant the weakest enemy Vulnerable.
07SH011.name: Bushwhack Trap

07SH046.description: When you play a follower, transform me into an exact copy of it this round.
07SH046.descriptionRaw: When you play a follower, transform me into an exact copy of it this round.
07SH046.flavorText: "And dis here is da MOST BE-YOUUU-TI-FUL and favorite stop on da tour. So many people liked my tour dat dey built a BIIIG STRONG CHIP, who will be a stop on da tour forever and ever. Let's go say "HIII BIG CHIP!" Big Chip loves EVERYbody, and ex-speshal-ty all the people who have come along on his tour." - Adventures with Chip, part 6
07SH046.name: Valley of Imitation

07SH039T1.description:
Transform my <link=card.shadow><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow in the Brush</style></link> into an <link=card.parent><style=AssociatedCard>All-Terrain Trooper</style></link>. 
If my <link=card.shadow><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow in the Brush</style></link> leaves play, <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> me.
07SH039T1.descriptionRaw:
Transform my Shadow in the Brush into an All-Terrain Trooper. 
If my Shadow in the Brush leaves play, Obliterate me.
07SH039T1.name: All-Terrain Trooper's Ambush

07SH043.flavorText: As its oldest residents, some say pairofants hold the memory and heart of the jungle itself. Though normally gentle creatures, they will not hesitate to defend their home against any threat--great or small.
07SH043.name: Towering Pairofant

07SH043T2.description:
Transform my <link=card.shadow><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow in the Brush</style></link> into a <link=card.parent><style=AssociatedCard>Towering Pairofant</style></link>. 
If my <link=card.shadow><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow in the Brush</style></link> leaves play, <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> me.
07SH043T2.descriptionRaw:
Transform my Shadow in the Brush into a Towering Pairofant. 
If my Shadow in the Brush leaves play, Obliterate me.
07SH043T2.name: Towering Pairofant's Ambush

07SH040.description: The first time an ally transforms, grant me +2|+1.
07SH040.descriptionRaw: The first time an ally transforms, grant me +2|+1.
07SH040.flavorText: "Small omnivorous mammals covered in bristle-like spikes, which may be released at high velocities when disturbed. Tail is barbed and agile, likely used as a defensive weapon. According to experienced expeditioners, the creatures are notoriously grouchy and difficult to handle..." - From Anura's field journal, day 3
07SH040.name: Bristlehog

07SH044T1.description:
Transform my <link=card.shadow><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow in the Brush</style></link> into an <link=card.parent><style=AssociatedCard>Aurora Hallunatis</style></link>. 
If my <link=card.shadow><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow in the Brush</style></link> leaves play, <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> me.
07SH044T1.descriptionRaw:
Transform my Shadow in the Brush into an Aurora Hallunatis. 
If my Shadow in the Brush leaves play, Obliterate me.
07SH044T1.name: Aurora Hallunatis's Ambush

07SH005.description:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> a card with <link=vocab.Ambush><style=Vocab>Ambush</style></link>.
When an ally transforms, double its Power and Health.
07SH005.descriptionRaw:
Play: Manifest a card with Ambush.
When an ally transforms, double its Power and Health.
07SH005.flavorText: "You lost everything to WHAT? A scientist and a reptile freak? Well, what are you standing around for, you buffoons? Go out there and get my money back!"
07SH005.name: Big Game Tycoon

07FR011.description: When you summon an ally, grow its Health to equal its Power.
07FR011.descriptionRaw: When you summon an ally, grow its Health to equal its Power.
07FR011.flavorText: Though the meaning of this temple has long been lost to time, its stone guardian still stands, unbent by the weight of many avalanches. Rimed with frost, he seems to be imbued with some strange and alluring light...
07FR011.name: Temple to True Ice

07FR010.description: <link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: Grow an ally's stats to mine.
07FR010.descriptionRaw: Plunder: Grow an ally's stats to mine.
07FR010.flavorText: Though the snowy razorclaw primarily hunts small mammals, this Freljordian beast has enough claws to make nearly anything into a meal.
07FR010.name: Snowy Razorclaw

07FR015.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Pick an ally. Grant it and all other allies that share a subtype with it +1|+1 or <link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> a follower that shares a subtype with it.
07FR015.descriptionRaw: Play: Pick an ally. Grant it and all other allies that share a subtype with it +1|+1 or Manifest a follower that shares a subtype with it.
07FR015.flavorText: Self-appointed Poro supervisor and explorer of the Freljord, Ingvar is sure that adventure is out there--and she's going to find it.
07FR015.name: Ingvar the Younger

07FR015T1.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant an ally and all other allies that share a subtype with it +1|+1.
07FR015T1.descriptionRaw: Play: Grant an ally and all other allies that share a subtype with it +1|+1.
07FR015T1.flavorText: Self-appointed Poro supervisor and explorer of the Freljord, Ingvar is sure that adventure is out there--and she's going to find it.
07FR015T1.name: Ingvar the Younger

07FR015T2.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> a follower that shares a subtype with an ally.
07FR015T2.descriptionRaw: Play: Manifest a follower that shares a subtype with an ally.
07FR015T2.flavorText: Self-appointed Poro supervisor and explorer of the Freljord, Ingvar is sure that adventure is out there--and she's going to find it.
07FR015T2.name: Ingvar the Younger

07FR017.description: <link=keyword.Elemental Skill><sprite name=ElementalSkill><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Deal 2 to ALL other units.
07FR017.descriptionRaw: Play: Deal 2 to ALL other units.
07FR017.flavorText: The violence of the crystalline stormraptor is indiscriminate and instantaneous, turning the tide of battle within moments. The bird is considered by many to the first omen of a great and terrible storm--one meant to reshape the bones of the earth itself.
07FR017.name: Crystalline Stormraptor

07FR017T1.flavorText: "You want to know how to survive the shriek of the stormraptor? Ha. When you hear the bird's call, the only thing left to do is pray." - Avarosan Outrider
07FR017T1.name: Piercing Lightning

07FR016.description: When I'm summoned, grant the top 3 units in your deck +1|+1. If an ally has a different subtype than me, draw 1 of those units.
07FR016.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, grant the top 3 units in your deck +1|+1. If an ally has a different subtype than me, draw 1 of those units.
07FR016.flavorText: With a bony exterior belying its big heart, these reliable steeds are vital for clearing icy mountain passes.
07FR016.name: Glacial Saurian

07SI010.description:
When I'm summoned, summon 2 <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Necrotic Nestlings</style></link>. 
When another ally dies, <link=keyword.Drain><style=Keyword>drain</style></link> 1 from the enemy Nexus.
07SI010.descriptionRaw:
When I'm summoned, summon 2 Necrotic Nestlings. 
When another ally dies, drain 1 from the enemy Nexus.
07SI010.flavorText: Found only in the darkest reaches of the Shadow Isles, these spiders secrete a deadly necrovenom, which numbs the skin even as it begins to rot the flesh.
07SI010.name: Necrotic Arachnoid

07SI010T1.flavorText: Where there's one, there's always more... and necrovenom works fast.
07SI010T1.name: Necrotic Nestling

07SI012.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: If an ally has a different subtype than me, give an enemy <nobr>-2|-0</nobr> this round.
07SI012.descriptionRaw: Play: If an ally has a different subtype than me, give an enemy -2|-0 this round.
07SI012.flavorText: Tufted webspinners take great care in crafting their nests. They are especially doting on their spiderlings... but equally vicious when it comes to potential threats.
07SI012.name: Tufted Webspinner

07SI013.description: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Create in deck an exact copy of your <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> <link=card.selfref><style=AssociatedCard>Proliferating Darkwraith</style></link> in deck, then double the stats of <link=card.selfref><style=AssociatedCard>Proliferating Darkwraiths</style></link> in deck.
07SI013.descriptionRaw: Last Breath: Create in deck an exact copy of your strongest Proliferating Darkwraith in deck, then double the stats of Proliferating Darkwraiths in deck.
07SI013.flavorText: "This Mist has taught me many things. Most importantly, it has taught me to know when to run." - Ixtali Sentinel
07SI013.name: Proliferating Darkwraith

07SI004.description: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: When another ally gains Power from <link=keyword.Hallowed><sprite name=Hallowed><style=Keyword>Hallowed</style></link>, so does my bearer.
07SI004.descriptionRaw: Attack: When another ally gains Power from Hallowed, so does my bearer.
07SI004.flavorText: "With a good pair of scissors, and quality thread, you can set almost anything aright!" - Gwen
07SI004.name: Sacred Shears

07MT009.description: For the top 9 cards in your deck, draw each Dragon and reduce their costs to 0 this round, then shuffle the rest into your deck.
07MT009.descriptionRaw: For the top 9 cards in your deck, draw each Dragon and reduce their costs to 0 this round, then shuffle the rest into your deck.
07MT009.flavorText: "To know one dragon is to master the self. To know many is to master the world." - Ottrani Dragon-Worshiper
07MT009.name: Age of Dragons

07MT013.description: <link=keyword.Invoke><style=Keyword>Invoke</style></link> a Celestial that costs 7 or more, or pay 8 to reduce the cost of your Celestials <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> by half, rounded up.
07MT013.descriptionRaw: Invoke a Celestial that costs 7 or more, or pay 8 to reduce the cost of your Celestials everywhere by half, rounded up.
07MT013.flavorText: The Arbiter stands perennial watch as blessings of the heavens descend.
07MT013.name: Cosmic Call

07MT013T1.description: Reduce the cost of your Celestials <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> by half, rounded up.
07MT013T1.descriptionRaw: Reduce the cost of your Celestials everywhere by half, rounded up.
07MT013T1.flavorText: The Arbiter stands perennial watch as blessings of the heavens descend.
07MT013T1.name: Cosmic Call

07MT013T2.description: <link=keyword.Invoke><style=Keyword>Invoke</style></link> a Celestial that costs 7 or more.
07MT013T2.descriptionRaw: Invoke a Celestial that costs 7 or more.
07MT013T2.flavorText: The Arbiter stands perennial watch as blessings of the heavens descend.
07MT013T2.name: Cosmic Call

07MT006.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> an ally and grant it my stats.
07MT006.descriptionRaw: Play: Recall an ally and grant it my stats.
07MT006.flavorText: "There are few sights more splendid than the meeting of the sun and the moon." - Diana
07MT006.name: Star-Crossed Lovers

07BC020.description: When one or more of your traps or boons activate, plant 2 of it in that player's deck.
07BC020.descriptionRaw: When one or more of your traps or boons activate, plant 2 of it in that player's deck.
07BC020.flavorText: Nobody can say how long Mister Thrift has been collecting, or where he came from. He seems friendly enough--never mind that troublesome trail of tripping hazards he leaves in his wake.
07BC020.name: Mister Thrift

07BC016.description: When I'm discarded, <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equip</style></link> me to a random unequipped ally.
07BC016.descriptionRaw: When I'm discarded, Equip me to a random unequipped ally.
07BC016.flavorText: "I can't lie--I'm prone to losing my tools. This one, though, always pops back up right when I need it!" - Safety Inspector
07BC016.name: Return-o Wrench

07BC018.description:
When I'm summoned, plant a <link=card.portal><style=AssociatedCard>Mysterious Portal</style></link> in the top 4 cards of your deck.
When you summon a created ally, grant it <link=keyword.Impact><sprite name=Impact><style=Keyword>Impact</style></link>.
07BC018.descriptionRaw:
When I'm summoned, plant a Mysterious Portal in the top 4 cards of your deck.
When you summon a created ally, grant it Impact.
07BC018.flavorText: At the forefront of any research, there are bound to be surprises--luckily, this is a fortunate one.
07BC018.name: Portal Scholar

07BC011.description: When I'm summoned, grant other allies that have subtypes +1|+1 and <link=keyword.Impact><sprite name=Impact><style=Keyword>Impact</style></link>.
07BC011.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, grant other allies that have subtypes +1|+1 and Impact.
07BC011.flavorText: Unfortunately for this crew of Piltovan poachers, they only look harmless.
07BC011.name: Ferocious Fluffs

07DE014.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Pick a unit from the top 5 cards of your deck that costs 3 or less. Summon it and place the rest into your deck.
07DE014.descriptionRaw: Play: Pick a unit from the top 5 cards of your deck that costs 3 or less. Summon it and place the rest into your deck.
07DE014.flavorText: The Demacian draft sergeant carries a weighty responsibility. His recruits will go on to occupy many different posts, all united in their duty to and love for Demacia.
07DE014.name: Scrutinizing Sergeant

07DE015.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: If an ally has a different subtype than me, <link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> a Demacian spell.
07DE015.descriptionRaw: Play: If an ally has a different subtype than me, Manifest a Demacian spell.
07DE015.flavorText: "Recording first confirmed sighting of the lionhawk in nearly fifty years. Beautiful blue crest, intelligent eyes. Body is armored, but bones are light enough for at least tree-climbing, if not limited gliding. Wing structures almost reminiscent of Demacian silverwings. Will return with more measurements." - From Anura's field journal, day 12
07DE015.name: Crested Lionhawk

07DE011.description: Spells that cost less than 3 cost 3 instead.
07DE011.descriptionRaw: Spells that cost less than 3 cost 3 instead.
07DE011.flavorText: "Silence! This is no mere game, as you claim, but the cloak of some insidious arcane engagement. I mean to expose you as a cheat and a mage, you old scoundrel--even if I have to burn this whole establishment down to do it!"
07DE011.name: Mageseeker Junior

07DE016.descriptionRaw: Attack: Grant other Formidable allies everywhere +0|+1.
07DE016.flavorText: A long-time companion of the Durand family, Balen's great size belies his gentle precision. Though he began as an assistant, Balen is greatly gifted in the craft and uniquely inspired in its practice--and the Durands are proud to call him their friend.
07DE016.name: Balen the Benevolent

08SI042.description:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Kill up to 2 allies.
When you <link=vocab.Slay><style=Vocab>slay</style></link> another ally, revive it.
08SI042.descriptionRaw:
Play: Kill up to 2 allies.
When you slay another ally, revive it.
08SI042.levelupDescription: 15+ allies have died. Allies with 5+ Power count twice. <style=Variable></style>
08SI042.levelupDescriptionRaw: 15+ allies have died. Allies with 5+ Power count twice.
08SI042.flavorText: Bound to his armor kept in the heart of the Immortal Bastion, Mordekaiser has forged a throne of his own making in the Grey Realm. For every one who would seek to destroy him, there are more who will serve him in both life and death.
08SI042.name: Mordekaiser

08SI042T5.description:
An ally starts a free attack <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenging</style></link> the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>Strongest</style></link> enemy.
Kill ALL other units.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Mordekaiser</style></link> in your deck.
08SI042T5.descriptionRaw:
An ally starts a free attack Challenging the Strongest enemy.
Kill ALL other units.
Create a Mordekaiser in your deck.
08SI042T5.name: Mordekaiser's Realm of Death

08SI042T1.description:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Kill up to 2 allies.
When you <link=vocab.Slay><style=Vocab>slay</style></link> another ally, revive it.
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: For the rest of the game, when you <link=vocab.Slay><style=Vocab>slay</style></link> a unit, <link=keyword.Drain><style=Keyword>Drain</style></link> 1 from the enemy Nexus.
08SI042T1.descriptionRaw:
Play: Kill up to 2 allies.
When you slay another ally, revive it.
Attack: For the rest of the game, when you slay a unit, Drain 1 from the enemy Nexus.
08SI042T1.flavorText: "Serve me! Relinquish your pitiful souls. I will give them iron everlasting. I am oblivion inevitable!"
08SI042T1.name: Mordekaiser

08SI040.description:
When I'm summoned, grant me <link=keyword.Deathless><sprite name=Deathless><style=Keyword>Deathless</style></link>.
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Give enemies -1|-0 this round.
08SI040.descriptionRaw:
When I'm summoned, grant me Deathless.
Attack: Give enemies -1|-0 this round.
08SI040.flavorText: Camavor's dragons were once magnificent and respected--but even they were not safe from the all-consuming corruption of the Ruination. Erastin is no exception, his long-lost regality now twisted into the garish appearance of the deathless.
08SI040.name: Erastin, the Disgraced

08SI007.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant <link=keyword.Deathless><sprite name=Deathless><style=Keyword>Deathless</style></link> to an ally in hand.
08SI007.descriptionRaw: Play: Grant Deathless to an ally in hand.
08SI007.flavorText: It matters not what form souls took before their imprisonment in the Grey Realm. There, individuality has little value. Faceless and fearless, the Legion serves the Iron Revenant all the better for its uniformity.
08SI007.name: Legion of the Severed

08SI003.description: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: The next time you revive an ally, create a copy of me in hand.
08SI003.descriptionRaw: Last Breath: The next time you revive an ally, create a copy of me in hand.
08SI003.flavorText: "It was long ago that we were chained. Soon you too will know our suffering, and we will all suffer, forever and ever, until we are granted oblivion at Master's hand..."
08SI003.name: Shackled Ghasts

08SI021.description: When another ally dies, or <nobr><link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>:</nobr> Plant 4 <link=card.chime><style=AssociatedCard>Chimes</style></link> in your deck.
08SI021.descriptionRaw: When another ally dies, or Last Breath: Plant 4 Chimes in your deck.
08SI021.flavorText: Don't worry about that ominous ringing--it's just old Chimeslime making his rounds. He's always happy to see new arrivals--but they sure aren't happy to see him.
08SI021.name: Lonely Chimeslime

08SI030.description: <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> 6 cards from the bottom of the enemy deck.
08SI030.descriptionRaw: Obliterate 6 cards from the bottom of the enemy deck.
08SI030.flavorText: For some of Runeterra's deepest sea monsters, a jaull-ship is a light snack.
08SI030.name: Watery Grave

08SI037T1.flavorText: The skitter of a thousand iron-clawed hands and the gnashing of spectral teeth promise a nasty end to any who refuse to serve.
08SI037T1.name: Thousand-Clawed Deathwinder

08SI037.description:
To play me, kill an ally.
When I'm summoned, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Thousand-Clawed Deathwinder</style></link>.
08SI037.descriptionRaw:
To play me, kill an ally.
When I'm summoned, summon a Thousand-Clawed Deathwinder.
08SI037.flavorText: These hounds never forget the scent of one who tried to flee--and when the hounds corner their prey, a deathwinder is never far behind.
08SI037.name: Spectral Ironhound

08SI041.description: Kill an ally to deal 5 to a unit.
08SI041.descriptionRaw: Kill an ally to deal 5 to a unit.
08SI041.flavorText: "Darkness is destiny for all but me." - Mordekaiser
08SI041.name: Death's Grasp

08SI036.description:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=keyword.Curse><sprite name=Curse><style=Keyword>Curse</style></link> an enemy with <link=card.curse><style=AssociatedCard>Terror</style></link>.
When you summon a <link=vocab.Titanic><style=Vocab>Titanic</style></link> ally, destroy me to draw 2.
08SI036.descriptionRaw:
Play: Curse an enemy with Terror.
When you summon a Titanic ally, destroy me to draw 2.
08SI036.flavorText: "These souls, we offer you. This road, we pave in bone before you. These realms, we rend asunder, to make way for your army of iron everlasting." - Deathgrasp Cultist
08SI036.name: Threshold of the Grey

08SI004.description:
An ally starts a free attack <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenging</style></link> the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>Strongest</style></link> enemy.
Kill ALL other units.
08SI004.descriptionRaw:
An ally starts a free attack Challenging the Strongest enemy.
Kill ALL other units.
08SI004.name: Realm of Death

08SI026.description: When I'm summoned or you summon a <link=vocab.Titanic><style=Vocab>Titanic</style></link> ally, <link=keyword.Curse><sprite name=Curse><style=Keyword>Curse</style></link> the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> enemy with <link=card.curse><style=AssociatedCard>Terror</style></link>.
08SI026.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned or you summon a Titanic ally, Curse the strongest enemy with Terror.
08SI026.flavorText: In the eyes of his followers, the Iron Revenant is the only hope for those who seek oblivion. Peace through domination--these cultists welcome it with open arms.
08SI026.name: Deathgrasp Cultist

08SI026T1.description: While I'm in hand, <style=Variable>the cursed unit</style> has <nobr> -<style=Variable>3</style>|-0.</nobr>
08SI026T1.descriptionRaw: While I'm in hand, the cursed unit has  -3|-0.
08SI026T1.flavorText: You feel an overwhelming sense of dread.
08SI026T1.name: Terror

08SI018.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Pick an Explorer spell to create in hand.
08SI018.descriptionRaw: Play: Pick an Explorer spell to create in hand.
08SI018.flavorText: "The terrain is inscrutable. The visibility, close to none. I have encountered enemies at every turn--but strangely, unexpected allies too." - From the expedition records of the Explorer's Guild Far Reaches Division, allocation: Shadow Isles
08SI018.name: Spectral Surveyor

08SI015.description:
To play me, kill an ally.
<link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Heal your Nexus 2.
08SI015.descriptionRaw:
To play me, kill an ally.
Last Breath: Heal your Nexus 2.
08SI015.flavorText: Beasts of war have value to any army. In the Grey Realm, they are the tortured amalgamations of souls, each one violently consumptive in its insentience.
08SI015.name: Amalgamation Of Vile Rites

08BW008.description: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Slipstream</style></link> in the top 6 cards of your deck.
08BW008.descriptionRaw: Attack: Create a Slipstream in the top 6 cards of your deck.
08BW008.flavorText: In the north, a new challenger awaits Nilah and her monster-hunting crew: a creature called the Volibear, who threatens to destroy the Freljord that once worshipped him. For Nilah, the chance to test her skills against a monster others call a god is the opportunity of a lifetime. Not to mention the lesser monstrosities she will add to her list of accomplishments along the way.
08BW008.name: Nilah

08BW008T1.description: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Slipstream</style></link> in the top 6 cards of your deck and deal 2 damage to all enemies and the enemy Nexus. They cannot drop below 1 Health from this damage.
08BW008T1.descriptionRaw: Attack: Create a Slipstream in the top 6 cards of your deck and deal 2 damage to all enemies and the enemy Nexus. They cannot drop below 1 Health from this damage.
08BW008T1.flavorText: "Monster! I am called Nilah of the Seventh Layer! It is my name, not yours, which will be remembered by history."
08BW008T1.name: Nilah

08BW008T5.description:
Deal 2 damage to a unit. It can't drop below 1 Health from this damage.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Nilah</style></link> in your deck.
08BW008T5.descriptionRaw:
Deal 2 damage to a unit. It can't drop below 1 Health from this damage.
Create a Nilah in your deck.
08BW008T5.name: Nilah's Formless Blade

08BW032.description: Give allies +1|+0 this round and heal damaged allies 2.
08BW032.descriptionRaw: Give allies +1|+0 this round and heal damaged allies 2.
08BW032.name: Joy Unending

08BW038.descriptionRaw:
Play: Deal 1 to anything.
Your Skills Drain.
08BW038.flavorText: She moves in a dance of water and blades, pulling steel from the roil of foam and spray. She need not see to feel the flow of her weapons--they are water animate, and to water they must always return.
08BW038.name: Chakram Dancer

08BW015.description:
When I'm summoned, draw a <link=card.champ1><style=AssociatedCard>Nilah</style></link>.
Each round, when you play your third card, give other allies +2|+0 and <link=keyword.Brash><sprite name=Brash><style=Keyword>Brash</style></link> this round. <style=Variable></style>
When I would gain <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>, reveal me instead.
08BW015.descriptionRaw:
When I'm summoned, draw a Nilah.
Each round, when you play your third card, give other allies +2|+0 and Brash this round. 
When I would gain Fleeting, reveal me instead.
08BW015.flavorText: "I hear that strange-shaped ship is the fastest Bilgewater's seen. Nimble, too. Got a peculiar captain, but seemed to me like she knows what she's about. Maybe we could stand to learn a thing or two." - Bilgewater bartender
08BW015.name: The Tidedancer

08BW002.description: Deal 2 damage to a unit. It can't drop below 1 Health from this damage.
08BW002.descriptionRaw: Deal 2 damage to a unit. It can't drop below 1 Health from this damage.
08BW002.flavorText: "Monsters who call themselves gods have a long way to fall, no matter the land." - Nilah
08BW002.name: Formless Blade

08BW025.description: Once you've drawn 3+ cards in a round this game, grant me +1|+1 and <link=keyword.Brash><sprite name=Brash><style=Keyword>Brash</style></link>.
08BW025.descriptionRaw: Once you've drawn 3+ cards in a round this game, grant me +1|+1 and Brash.
08BW025.flavorText: "Hey, bud, what's all the fuss about? Relax! There's nothing in the water we can't handle!" - Dedicant of the Challenge
08BW025.name: Master Lookout

08BW026.description: When I'm summoned, <link=vocab.Updraft><style=Vocab>Updraft</style></link> your hand to grant me +1|+1 for each card <link=vocab.Updraft><style=Vocab>Updrafted</style></link> and draw 2.
08BW026.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, Updraft your hand to grant me +1|+1 for each card Updrafted and draw 2.
08BW026.flavorText: "Oh, c'mon, are you even trying? I feel like I gotta hold back, and man, I hate that!"
08BW026.name: Dedicant of the Challenge

08BW028.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Pick an Explorer spell to create in hand.
08BW028.descriptionRaw: Play: Pick an Explorer spell to create in hand.
08BW028.flavorText: "Odd specimen. Very blue. Eyes quite large. Uncomfortably large. Will acquire for further study." - From the expedition records of the Explorer's Guild Far Reaches Division, allocation: Piltover
08BW028.name: Octo Adventurer

08BW028T4.description: Heal an ally or your Nexus 2.
08BW028T4.descriptionRaw: Heal an ally or your Nexus 2.
08BW028T4.flavorText: "Get me some of that, uh... chocolatey stuff you make. Best chocolatey stuff within two days' travel. Oh, and extra hot, please." - Scholarly Pioneer
08BW028T4.name: Explorer's Refreshments

08BW028T3.description: Disable an enemy's positive keywords this round and again at next <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>.
08BW028T3.descriptionRaw: Disable an enemy's positive keywords this round and again at next Round Start.
08BW028T3.flavorText: "Was little crack. Became big one. Now very dried out." - Octo Adventurer
08BW028T3.name: Explorer's Blunder

08BW028T1.flavorText: "It seems the Isles have come to enjoy my company." - Spectral Surveyor
08BW028T1.name: Explorer's Malfunction

08BW028T2.flavorText: "A little damage to the artifacts is no problem. Makes 'em seem more authentic." - Armed Acquisitioner
08BW028T2.name: Explorer's Excavation

08BW038T1.flavorText: "Water takes shapes myriad and wonderful." - Chakram Dancer
08BW038T1.name: Flowing Chakram

08BW009.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> two different Elemental spells you've played this game. They cost 0 this round.
08BW009.descriptionRaw: Play: Manifest two different Elemental spells you've played this game. They cost 0 this round.
08BW009.flavorText: "The mind is a river. Over time, the dedication of its flow carves the faces of the mountains. And like the mind, with momentum, it may grow ever wider and touch new shores."
08BW009.name: Wizened Helmsman

08BW010.description: For the rest of the game, all of your Elemental spells and <link=keyword.Elemental Skill><sprite name=ElementalSkill><style=Keyword>Skills</style></link> deal 1 extra damage.
08BW010.descriptionRaw: For the rest of the game, all of your Elemental spells and Skills deal 1 extra damage.
08BW010.flavorText: "In the hands of the wise, water shapes all." - Dedicant of Wisdom
08BW010.name: Deluge

08BW031.description: When you spend mana to play another unit, create a random card in hand of equal cost. It costs 0 and is <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>.
08BW031.descriptionRaw: When you spend mana to play another unit, create a random card in hand of equal cost. It costs 0 and is Fleeting.
08BW031.flavorText: Despite its appetite for even the strangest sea-beasts, there are some monsters even Bilgewater's most experienced captains won't hunt. They speak of Sefirsa in whispered tones, as a hypnotic light moving deep beneath the waves; a monster perched upon a mass grave of sunken ships and drowned men.
08BW031.name: Sefirsa, Scourge of the Deep

08BW037.description: When you play a card with cost equal to my Power, grant me +1|+1.
08BW037.descriptionRaw: When you play a card with cost equal to my Power, grant me +1|+1.
08BW037.flavorText: "Say, uh, dontcha want to put some more down? No risk, no reward, ya know. This is a lucky table tonight, I'll tell ya. And the house deals fair at this fine establishment--swear it on my mama's tongue."
08BW037.name: Honest Croupier

08BW036.description: When you spend mana to play a unit, refill 1 spell mana.
08BW036.descriptionRaw: When you spend mana to play a unit, refill 1 spell mana.
08BW036.flavorText: "The reef has long been both shelter and ally. It cares for us, as we care for it, so that neither will fall to the darkness of the Murk." - Marai Greatmother
08BW036.name: Marai Reef Spire

08BW023.description: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Slipstream</style></link> in the top 6 cards of your deck.
08BW023.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, create a Slipstream in the top 6 cards of your deck.
08BW023.flavorText: "Look, my friends, at how the whole world moves with us! The waves dance beneath the hull, the wind in the sails, the birds upon the breeze. Join me in our highest calling, and rejoice!"
08BW023.name: Vikrash the Exuberant

08PZ007.description:
Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Galesong Swallow</style></link> and grant it +1|+1 for each other Elemental spell and <link=keyword.Elemental Skill><sprite name=ElementalSkill><style=Keyword>Skill</style></link> you've played this game. <style=Variable></style>
Draw 1.
08PZ007.descriptionRaw:
Summon a Galesong Swallow and grant it +1|+1 for each other Elemental spell and Skill you've played this game. 
Draw 1.
08PZ007.flavorText: When galesong swallows gather in numbers, a storm is never far off.
08PZ007.name: Galesong Flock

08PZ031.description: Pick an allied follower. Transform my bearer into an exact copy of it while I'm equipped.
08PZ031.descriptionRaw: Pick an allied follower. Transform my bearer into an exact copy of it while I'm equipped.
08PZ031.name: Shady Spectacles

08PZ025.description: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Grant a random 6+ cost spell in hand "When I'm played, summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Prototype Porobot</style></link>."
08PZ025.descriptionRaw: Last Breath: Grant a random 6+ cost spell in hand "When I'm played, summon a Prototype Porobot."
08PZ025.flavorText: "It's just a prototype," the apprentice cried as flames engulfed the lab. "I didn't program it to eat every gear in sight! I don't even know where all that metal is GOING!"
08PZ025.name: Prototype Porobot

08PZ005.description:
Give an ally +2|+0 this round.
Draw 2.
08PZ005.descriptionRaw:
Give an ally +2|+0 this round.
Draw 2.
08PZ005.flavorText: "Be at peace! The storm may rage around you, but it shall not harm you." - Janna
08PZ005.name: Eye Of The Storm

08PZ019.description:
If you've drawn 3+ cards this round, I cost 2 less.
Deal 3 to a unit and 2 to the enemy Nexus.
08PZ019.descriptionRaw:
If you've drawn 3+ cards this round, I cost 2 less.
Deal 3 to a unit and 2 to the enemy Nexus.
08PZ019.flavorText: "The tempest is at my command." - Janna
08PZ019.name: Divine Whirlwind

08PZ028.description: When you play a spell, draw 1. When you draw while you have a full hand, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
08PZ028.descriptionRaw: When you play a spell, draw 1. When you draw while you have a full hand, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
08PZ028.flavorText: Zaun demands adaptation--and the chemtech drake is no exception, cast in the sickly green light of augmentation as it clings to the underbelly of the city. The twin shadows of the drake's ruined wings loom along darkened passageways, harbingers of a fury born from anguish at its own corruption.
08PZ028.name: Chemtech Drake

08PZ001.description:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Updraft><style=Vocab>Updraft</style></link> 2 to draw 2 at the next <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>.
Each round, the first 3 times you draw a card, reduce its cost by 1 this round. <style=Variable></style>
08PZ001.descriptionRaw:
Play: Updraft 2 to draw 2 at the next Round Start.
Each round, the first 3 times you draw a card, reduce its cost by 1 this round.
08PZ001.levelupDescription: I've seen you play 8 cost reduced cards.<style=Variable></style>
08PZ001.levelupDescriptionRaw: I've seen you play 8 cost reduced cards.
08PZ001.flavorText: "Zaun is closer to Janna than pretty much anywhere else. After all, she's the one who saved the poor souls Piltover left to die. Yeah--if there's answers to be had, I'll get 'em here." - Windborne Mariner
08PZ001.name: Janna

08PZ001T3.description:
<link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Draw 1.
When you draw a card, reduce its cost by 1 this round.
08PZ001T3.descriptionRaw:
Round Start: Draw 1.
When you draw a card, reduce its cost by 1 this round.
08PZ001T3.flavorText: "Go no further! Violate my protection and you shall see the breath torn from your lungs, and your very self scattered by the winds!"
08PZ001T3.name: Janna

08PZ001T1.description:
Give an ally +2|+0 this round.
Draw 2.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Janna</style></link> in your deck.
08PZ001T1.descriptionRaw:
Give an ally +2|+0 this round.
Draw 2.
Create a Janna in your deck.
08PZ001T1.flavorText: "Be at peace! The storm may rage around you, but it shall not harm you." - Janna
08PZ001T1.name: Janna's Eye Of The Storm

08PZ026.flavorText: "All children of the wind answer my call." - Janna
08PZ026.name: Galesong Call

08PZ006.description: When you play an Elemental spell or <link=keyword.Elemental Skill><sprite name=ElementalSkill><style=Keyword>Skill</style></link>, copy it with the same targets.
08PZ006.descriptionRaw: When you play an Elemental spell or Skill, copy it with the same targets.
08PZ006.flavorText: "Come, Iascylla! You are old indeed, if Ashlesh knows your name. But old or young, pretty or ugly, no matter. There is no higher honor for any monster than to fall to my blade upon the open sea." - Nilah
08PZ006.name: Iascylla, Figurehead of the Deep

08PZ018.description: If you've drawn 3+ cards this round, I cost 2 less.
08PZ018.descriptionRaw: If you've drawn 3+ cards this round, I cost 2 less.
08PZ018.flavorText: "Yeah, I had what I wanted. But I got it all by taking, and taking leaves a man empty. First thing I found to follow was the wind, so now I'm here, hoping she'll push me onto a better path."
08PZ018.name: Windborne Mariner

08PZ008.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Updraft><style=Vocab>Updraft</style></link> 1 to either draw 1 or refill your spell mana.
08PZ008.descriptionRaw: Play: Updraft 1 to either draw 1 or refill your spell mana.
08PZ008.flavorText: Convinced that she was saved by the wind spirit as a young girl, Maryam has preached Janna's virtues from her home country of Shurima all the way to Zaun. Now serving as the Zaun temple matriarch, she is dedicated to passing forward Janna's kindness to the young and downtrodden.
08PZ008.name: Maryam, Temple Caretaker

08PZ026T1.flavorText: "These galesong swallows are flighty creatures. Half the time they seem to be made up entirely of water! Still, I've learned the hard way to avoid upsetting them..." - Intrepid Mariner
08PZ026T1.name: Galesong Swallow

08PZ009.description:
<link=vocab.RoundEnd><style=Vocab>Round End</style></link>: <link=vocab.Updraft><style=Vocab>Updraft</style></link> your hand. 
<link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Draw that many cards plus 1.
08PZ009.descriptionRaw:
Round End: Updraft your hand. 
Round Start: Draw that many cards plus 1.
08PZ009.flavorText: Much was lost in the disastrous collapse that ultimately delineated Zaun from Piltover. Janna may have lost her temple to the waves, but she saved the people who worshipped in it.
08PZ009.name: Sunken Temple

08PZ002.description:
Deal 2 to a unit.
Increase my damage by 1 for each other card you've played this round, up to 3 times. <style=Variable></style>
08PZ002.descriptionRaw:
Deal 2 to a unit.
Increase my damage by 1 for each other card you've played this round, up to 3 times.
08PZ002.name: Howling Gale

08PZ008T3.descriptionRaw: Play: Updraft 1 to refill your spell mana.
08PZ008T3.flavorText: Convinced that she was saved by the wind spirit as a young girl, Maryam has preached Janna's virtues from her home country of Shurima all the way to Zaun. Now serving as the Zaun temple matriarch, she is dedicated to passing forward Janna's kindness to the young and downtrodden.
08PZ008T3.name: Maryam, Temple Caretaker

08PZ008T2.flavorText: Convinced that she was saved by the wind spirit as a young girl, Maryam has preached Janna's virtues from her home country of Shurima all the way to Zaun. Now serving as the Zaun temple matriarch, she is dedicated to passing forward Janna's kindness to the young and downtrodden.
08PZ008T2.name: Maryam, Temple Caretaker

08PZ024.description: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: ALL players draw 1, then grant your opponent's card <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>.
08PZ024.descriptionRaw: Round Start: ALL players draw 1, then grant your opponent's card Fleeting.
08PZ024.flavorText: "It's two for one today, and today only! Fresh fish, caught just this...uh, month? Two for one! What do you mean you don't want the second one? It's free!"
08PZ024.name: Charlatan Fishmonger

08PZ020.description:
If you've drawn 3+ cards this round, I cost 2 less.
When I'm summoned, draw 2 at the next <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>.
08PZ020.descriptionRaw:
If you've drawn 3+ cards this round, I cost 2 less.
When I'm summoned, draw 2 at the next Round Start.
08PZ020.flavorText: "My dear Zephyr. Come down from your clouds and perch on my shoulder awhile, won't you?" - Janna
08PZ020.name: Exalted Cloudwinder

08FR012.description:
Draw 1.
Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Sigil of the Storm</style></link>.
08FR012.descriptionRaw:
Draw 1.
Summon a Sigil of the Storm.
08FR012.flavorText: "In the name of Valhir, we make this offering..." - Valhir's Prophet
08FR012.name: Invocation Of Thunder

08FR033.description: When you play a <link=keyword.Slow><sprite name=Slow><style=Keyword>Slow</style></link> spell that targets a single ally, copy it onto me.
08FR033.descriptionRaw: When you play a Slow spell that targets a single ally, copy it onto me.
08FR033.flavorText: "You think an arrow or two will stop me? Hah! Whatever you throw at me becomes a weapon in my arsenal. Whatever is lost I will reforge in ice!"
08FR033.name: Bladebound Berserker

08FR019.flavorText: Cloaked in clouds and wreathed in lightning, the god-bear stands untouchable at the heart of the storm.
08FR019.name: Sky Splitter

08FR001.description: <link=keyword.Elemental Skill><sprite name=ElementalSkill><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Play <link=card.skill><style=AssociatedCard>Relentless Storm</style></link> 3 times. Each one targets a different random enemy or the enemy Nexus if none.
08FR001.descriptionRaw: Play: Play Relentless Storm 3 times. Each one targets a different random enemy or the enemy Nexus if none.
08FR001.flavorText: "Kneel to me, mortal, and I may spare you! Your power is feeble, but perhaps worthy enough to serve mine. Kneel, or be swept from the earth!"
08FR001.name: Volibear

08FR001T3.description: Deal 4 to a unit. If it's dead or gone, deal 2 to the enemy Nexus instead.
08FR001T3.descriptionRaw: Deal 4 to a unit. If it's dead or gone, deal 2 to the enemy Nexus instead.
08FR001T3.flavorText: "With these claws, I carve the very world!" - Volibear
08FR001T3.name: Relentless Storm

08FR001T2.description:
Deal 4 to ALL units except <link=vocab.Titanic><style=Vocab>Titanic</style></link> allies.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Volibear</style></link> in your deck.
08FR001T2.descriptionRaw:
Deal 4 to ALL units except Titanic allies.
Create a Volibear in your deck.
08FR001T2.name: Volibear's Stormbringer

08FR001T1.description:
<link=keyword.Elemental Skill><sprite name=ElementalSkill><style=Keyword>Play</style></link> or <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Play <link=card.skill><style=AssociatedCard>Relentless Storm</style></link> 3 times. Each one targets a different random enemy or the enemy Nexus if none.
Other allies have <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link>.
08FR001T1.descriptionRaw:
Play or Attack: Play Relentless Storm 3 times. Each one targets a different random enemy or the enemy Nexus if none.
Other allies have Overwhelm.
08FR001T1.flavorText: "You dare to insult me with a challenge? Puny girl from lands far away. I am the heart of the tundra! I am the storm, and to you I promise a forgettable death!"
08FR001T1.name: Volibear

08FR018.description:
Summon 2 random <link=vocab.Titanic><style=Vocab>Titanic</style></link> followers.
I cost 1 less for each Elemental spell or <link=keyword.Elemental Skill><sprite name=ElementalSkill><style=Keyword>Skill</style></link> you've played this game <nobr>(max 10).
08FR018.descriptionRaw:
Summon 2 random Titanic followers.
I cost 1 less for each Elemental spell or Skill you've played this game (max 10).
08FR018.flavorText: "With his body, I sculpted the mountains. With the fire of his maw, I carved a thousand fjords." - Volibear
08FR018.name: Clash of Giants

08FR011.description: When you play an Elemental spell or <link=keyword.Elemental Skill><sprite name=ElementalSkill><style=Keyword>Skill</style></link>, <link=vocab.Forge><style=Vocab>Forge</style></link> me.
08FR011.descriptionRaw: When you play an Elemental spell or Skill, Forge me.
08FR011.flavorText: "The Forgelord promised change and hammered out the chains of inaction instead. Those who worship a weak god are weak themselves. Only by Valhir's might will we be delivered to the glory of old!"
08FR011.name: Flamecaller Caprine

08FR008.description: Deal 4 to ALL units except <link=vocab.Titanic><style=Vocab>Titanic</style></link> allies.
08FR008.descriptionRaw: Deal 4 to ALL units except Titanic allies.
08FR008.name: Stormbringer

08FR024.description: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Grant the top 2 allies in your deck +1|+1.
08FR024.descriptionRaw: Attack: Grant the top 2 allies in your deck +1|+1.
08FR024.flavorText: Though they originating from Yadulsk, these pups have been domesticated by a number of Freljordian tribes for tracking, hunting, and avalanche recovery. With a hearty constitution and a healthy appetite for fun, they are beloved from tundra to taiga.
08FR024.name: Yadulski Snowdog

08FR015.descriptionRaw: Play: Summon 3 Sigils of the Storm.
08FR015.flavorText: Though few still worship him, all Freljordians know the tale of the Volibear's great battle with Rhond. Long before any mortal stepped foot in the frozen north, this earth-shattering struggle formed the ridges and rivers of the tundra itself.
08FR015.name: Rhond, the Magma Serpent

08FR030.description: When I'm summoned, summon 2 <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Frozen Thralls</style></link> and <link=vocab.Advance><style=Vocab>advance</style></link> them <nobr>to 2.</nobr>
08FR030.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, summon 2 Frozen Thralls and advance them to 2.
08FR030.flavorText: "She was v-vicious! Thralls burnt to black ice, avalanches beneath her claws, a roar that knocked snow off the mountains! A warrior queen, I tell you! K-killing thralls is the work of a warrior queen." - Babbling Bjerg
08FR030.name: Boadir of Blackened Ice

08FR002.description: When I'm summoned, summon an <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Sigil of the Storm</style></link>.
08FR002.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, summon an Sigil of the Storm.
08FR002.flavorText: "I see what the others cannot: the storm which will shatter the mountain, the breaking of the bones of the earth. The Freljord of old will be forged anew in blood--it is only a matter of time."
08FR002.name: Valhir's Prophet

08FR002T1.description:
Sigils of the Storm stack.
<link=vocab.Titanic><style=Vocab>Titanic</style></link> allies cost <style=Variable>1</style> less. Destroy me when you play a <link=vocab.Titanic><style=Vocab>Titanic</style></link> ally.
08FR002T1.descriptionRaw:
Sigils of the Storm stack.
Titanic allies cost 1 less. Destroy me when you play a Titanic ally.
08FR002T1.flavorText: In a treacherous mountain pass, a sigil hangs suspended, burning into the night. Much blood was offered to reach this point, and in signs like these the Volibear offers both his approval and his desire for more...
08FR002T1.name: Sigil of the Storm

08FR028.description: I have +1|+0 for each different subtype you've summoned this game. <style=Variable></style>
08FR028.descriptionRaw: I have +1|+0 for each different subtype you've summoned this game.
08FR028.flavorText: "There are beasts up here that even an avalanche won't stop. That's why a good harness is worth every coin." - Avarosan Trapper
08FR028.name: Handy Harness

08FR003.description: When you play a spell or <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skill</style></link>, summon an <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Sigil of the Storm</style></link>.
08FR003.descriptionRaw: When you play a spell or Skill, summon an Sigil of the Storm.
08FR003.flavorText: Occasionally, followers of the Volibear lose themselves so totally in their fanaticism that they begin to take on aspects of the bear himself. Nothing will stand in the way of Valhir's will--not even those the Ursine once called countrymen.
08FR003.name: Berserker Ursine

08RU014.description:
<link=vocab.Origin><style=Vocab>Origin</style></link>: <link=card.origin><style=AssociatedCard>Aspect of the Dragon</style></link>. <style=Variable></style>
I cost 1 less for each different Dragon Boon you've played this game.
<link=keyword.Elemental Skill><sprite name=ElementalSkill><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Play every Dragon Boon on me.
08RU014.descriptionRaw:
Origin: Aspect of the Dragon. 
I cost 1 less for each different Dragon Boon you've played this game.
Play: Play every Dragon Boon on me.
08RU014.levelupDescription: Your allies have attacked with 75+ total Power. <style=Variable></style>
08RU014.levelupDescriptionRaw: Your allies have attacked with 75+ total Power.
08RU014.flavorText: "Legend has it that this dragon is the oldest of all--that he is king of all winged beasts. If we tame him... why, Alatis, what else could possibly stand in our way? The world will finally understand that man and dragon are strongest together." - Volix, Dragon Allegiant
08RU014.name: Elder Dragon

08RU014T5.flavorText: The flames of infernal wrath rise ever higher.
08RU014T5.name: Infernal Might

08RU014T3.description: You may put any followers that cost 6+ into your deck during deckbuilding. When you play a unit with 6+ base cost, pick 1 of 2 Dragon Boons to play on it.
08RU014T3.descriptionRaw: You may put any followers that cost 6+ into your deck during deckbuilding. When you play a unit with 6+ base cost, pick 1 of 2 Dragon Boons to play on it.
08RU014T3.flavorText: Dragons bestow blessings both awesome and terrible.
08RU014T3.name: Aspect of the Dragon

08RU014T9.flavorText: Heat without equal poured from the Elder Dragon's maw. Alatis leapt into flight. "Stand fast," Volix cried. "Hold your lines! The world will know us as the men who tamed the king of beasts!"
08RU014T9.name: Elder Dragon

08RU014T2.flavorText: What some call poison, others call power.
08RU014T2.name: Chemtech Blight

08RU014T7.flavorText: Nimble as the breeze, decisive as the gale.
08RU014T7.name: Cloudbringer's Grace

08RU014T1.flavorText: The mountainous hide weathers any storm.
08RU014T1.name: Mountainous Vigor

08RU014T8.description:
Refill your mana to full. Draw all 6+ cost followers from the top 6 cards of your deck.
Create an <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Elder Dragon</style></link> in your deck.
08RU014T8.descriptionRaw:
Refill your mana to full. Draw all 6+ cost followers from the top 6 cards of your deck.
Create an Elder Dragon in your deck.
08RU014T8.flavorText: "This call--it is primeval. I see a kingdom of clouds. I see an awful winged host." - Ottrani Dragon-Worshiper
08RU014T8.name: Elder Dragon's Primordial Roar

08RU014T6.flavorText: These wings of water wash all wounds.
08RU014T6.name: Oceanic Will

08RU015.description: Refill your mana to full. Draw all 6+ cost followers from the top 6 cards of your deck.
08RU015.descriptionRaw: Refill your mana to full. Draw all 6+ cost followers from the top 6 cards of your deck.
08RU015.flavorText: "This call--it is primeval. I see a kingdom of clouds. I see an awful winged host." - Ottrani Dragon-Worshiper
08RU015.name: Primordial Roar

08NX003.description: <link=keyword.Elemental Skill><sprite name=ElementalSkill><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Deal 2 to an enemy and 2 to the enemy Nexus.
08NX003.descriptionRaw: Play: Deal 2 to an enemy and 2 to the enemy Nexus.
08NX003.flavorText: Noxian expansion has claimed many different peoples, settlements, and cultures. Frequently, wild creatures are also at the mercy of the war machine--but in the case of this dragon, each brutal step forward by Noxus is met with an equally brutal inferno of rage.
08NX003.name: Enraged Firespitter

08NX003T1.description: Deal 2 to an enemy and 2 to the enemy Nexus.
08NX003T1.descriptionRaw: Deal 2 to an enemy and 2 to the enemy Nexus.
08NX003T1.flavorText: Wood, steel, flesh--all of it melts in proximity to the firespitter's caustic rage.
08NX003T1.name: Spitfire

08NX024.description: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Deal 3 to an ally to deal 3 to an enemy.
08NX024.descriptionRaw: Play: Deal 3 to an ally to deal 3 to an enemy.
08NX024.flavorText: "Tear their souls from the cages of their bodies!" - Mordekaiser
08NX024.name: Iron Legionary

08NX024T1.description: Deal 3 to an ally to deal 3 to an enemy.
08NX024T1.descriptionRaw: Deal 3 to an ally to deal 3 to an enemy.
08NX024T1.flavorText: "It cuts... it hurts... in this realm and the next... and the next..." - Shackled Ghasts
08NX024T1.name: Soul Cleaver

08NX011.description: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus, increased by 1 for each other <link=card.selfref><style=AssociatedCard>Wildfire</style></link> you've played. Create a <link=card.selfref><style=AssociatedCard>Wildfire</style></link> in your deck.
08NX011.descriptionRaw: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus, increased by 1 for each other Wildfire you've played. Create a Wildfire in your deck.
08NX011.name: Wildfire

08NX019.descriptionRaw: Nexus Strike: Curse your opponent with Ichor.
08NX019.flavorText: While useful to the Noxian war machine, the razormace is also prized in the capitol's fighting pits. Few opponents--human or animal--are willing to take to the arena against this beast, and so the razormace's rare battles draw crowds from across the city.
08NX019.name: Red-Barbed Razormace

08NX019T1.description: While I'm in hand, <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Deal <style=Variable>1</style> to your Nexus.
08NX019T1.descriptionRaw: While I'm in hand, Round Start: Deal 1 to your Nexus.
08NX019T1.flavorText: You're bleeding. It's slow... but it shows no signs of stopping.
08NX019T1.name: Ichor

08NX014.description: Allied <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link> and <link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link> effects activate an additional time.
08NX014.descriptionRaw: Allied Attack and Support effects activate an additional time.
08NX014.flavorText: Headmistress Telsi's class on personal discipline is rife with arduous assignments, wrist-slapping, and detention slips. It has always been mandatory for students at the Ravenbloom Conservatory--otherwise, nobody would enroll.
08NX014.name: Headmistress Telsi

08NX012.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Pick an Explorer spell to create in hand.
08NX012.descriptionRaw: Play: Pick an Explorer spell to create in hand.
08NX012.flavorText: "You'd think it would be easier to dig in the desert--but no! Given enough time, sand readily turns to stone. Once again requesting funding for replacement tools." - From the expedition records of the Explorer's Guild Far Reaches Division, allocation: Shurima
08NX012.name: Armed Acquisitioner

08NX029.description: Kill a unit if it's damaged, otherwise deal 2 to it instead.
08NX029.descriptionRaw: Kill a unit if it's damaged, otherwise deal 2 to it instead.
08NX029.flavorText: "This is in your best interest. Trust me." - Lord Broadmane
08NX029.name: Kashuri Swipe

08NX009.flavorText: "It took centuries of planning to seal away that dreadful warmonger--and your pathetic friends intend to defeat him with 'joy'? You foolish girl. You will do nothing but incur the Revenant's wrath--and in doing, risk us all."
08NX009.name: Lord Mallat

08NX025.description: When an ally is revived, grant it <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link>.
08NX025.descriptionRaw: When an ally is revived, grant it Challenger.
08NX025.flavorText: "You smile, but I know the truth of your traitorous heart! They smiled to my face and ate from my table, even as they meant to put a sword through my back. I won't be taken for a fool again. You will die like the rest of them: screaming your apology!"
08NX025.name: Bladepierced Revenant

08SH009.flavorText: Some things are best left beneath the sands.
08SH009.name: Ancient Malediction

08SH014.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant two enemies -1|-0 and disable their positive keywords.
08SH014.descriptionRaw: Play: Grant two enemies -1|-0 and disable their positive keywords.
08SH014.flavorText: Despite its intimidating size, this swarmcaller is rarely violent. When its swarm nears a Shuriman settlement, villagers will leave offerings of soft fruit in the nearby desert to distract their visitors from more important crops.
08SH014.name: Horned Swarmcaller

08SH004.description: <link=keyword.Daybreak><style=Keyword>Daybreak</style></link> or when you activate another <link=keyword.Daybreak><style=Keyword>Daybreak</style></link>: Grant the <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> enemy <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link>.
08SH004.descriptionRaw: Daybreak or when you activate another Daybreak: Grant the weakest enemy Vulnerable.
08SH004.flavorText: The vast armies of Shurima stand ready to prove the might of the desert. When the order is given, they advance without hesitation.
08SH004.name: General of the Dunes

08SH005.description: <link=keyword.Daybreak><style=Keyword>Daybreak</style></link>: Draw a <link=card.me><style=AssociatedCard>Defenders of the Sun Disc</style></link>.
08SH005.descriptionRaw: Daybreak: Draw a Defenders of the Sun Disc.
08SH005.flavorText: "We are the keepers of the everlasting desert, the living history, the walkers of the path of radiance. We kneel before the Sun Disc and naught else, so that the world will kneel before Shurima's glory." - Azir
08SH005.name: Defenders of the Sun Disc

08SH012.description: Each round, the first time another ally dies, or <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Lucky Find</style></link> in hand.
08SH012.descriptionRaw: Each round, the first time another ally dies, or Last Breath: Create a Lucky Find in hand.
08SH012.flavorText: "That's a real haul, Barb. Knew I could count on you. Wait--what do you mean they saw you?!" - Vekauran Bruiser
08SH012.name: Tomb-Raider Barbara

08SH002.description: To play me, kill an ally or one of your mana gems 3 times.
08SH002.descriptionRaw: To play me, kill an ally or one of your mana gems 3 times.
08SH002.flavorText: The duneswallower slumbers at much larger depths than its smaller xer'sai cousins. Known to make an easy meal out of other xer'sai predators, it is rarely documented--likely for the fact that it can swallow entire dunes (and any witnesses) whole.
08SH002.name: Dune Swallower

08MT003.descriptionRaw: Play: Curse an enemy with Shackles twice.
08MT003.flavorText: "You come to me bruised and bleeding, and yet I've never seen a countenance so jubilant. You are a strange woman indeed--but you are safe here. Please rest, and when you're feeling better, I'd be keen to hear your story."
08MT003.name: Morgana

08MT003T4.description:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=keyword.Curse><sprite name=Curse><style=Keyword>Curse</style></link> an enemy with <link=card.curse><style=AssociatedCard>Shackles</style></link> twice.
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: <link=keyword.Curse><sprite name=Curse><style=Keyword>Curse</style></link> the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> enemy that isn't <link=keyword.Curse><sprite name=Curse><style=Keyword>Cursed</style></link> with <link=card.curse><style=AssociatedCard>Shackles</style></link> and deal 3 to <link=keyword.Curse><sprite name=Curse><style=Keyword>Cursed</style></link> enemies and 2 to the enemy Nexus.
08MT003T4.descriptionRaw:
Play: Curse an enemy with Shackles twice.
Attack: Curse the strongest enemy that isn't Cursed with Shackles and deal 3 to Cursed enemies and 2 to the enemy Nexus.
08MT003T4.flavorText: "You will regret this transgression! Be assured of this if nothing else: you will feel the suffering you have inflicted on others as a vise around your very soul. You will admit your sins, or be suffocated by them."
08MT003T4.name: Morgana

08MT003T3.description:
<link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy and <link=keyword.Curse><sprite name=Curse><style=Keyword>Curse</style></link> it with <link=card.curse><style=AssociatedCard>Shackles</style></link>.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Morgana</style></link> in your deck.
08MT003T3.descriptionRaw:
Stun an enemy and Curse it with Shackles.
Create a Morgana in your deck.
08MT003T3.flavorText: "Suffer, as you've made them suffer!" - Morgana
08MT003T3.name: Morgana's Dark Binding

08MT003T11.description: While I'm in hand, <style=Variable>the cursed unit</style> is <link=keyword.Immobile><sprite name=Immobile><sprite name=Reckless><style=Keyword>Immobile</style></link>.
08MT003T11.descriptionRaw: While I'm in hand, the cursed unit is Immobile.
08MT003T11.name: Shackles

08MT003T12.description: Deal 3 to <link=keyword.Curse><sprite name=Curse><style=Keyword>Cursed</style></link> enemies and 2 to the enemy Nexus.
08MT003T12.descriptionRaw: Deal 3 to Cursed enemies and 2 to the enemy Nexus.
08MT003T12.flavorText: "I am your torment, reflected a thousandfold!" - Morgana
08MT003T12.name: Soul Shackles

08MT005.descriptionRaw: Play: Curse 2 enemies with Shackles twice.
08MT005.flavorText: "It was in the names of my daughters that I embraced divinity. It was for my family that I forsook my own humanity, so that by this flaming sword I could forge anew a world of truth and justice."
08MT005.name: Mihira, Aspect Ascendant

08MT042.description:
<link=keyword.Curse><sprite name=Curse><style=Keyword>Curse</style></link> an enemy with <link=card.curse><style=AssociatedCard>Shackles</style></link>.
Increase the cost of enemy Curses <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> by 1.
08MT042.descriptionRaw:
Curse an enemy with Shackles.
Increase the cost of enemy Curses everywhere by 1.
08MT042.flavorText: "To find your freedom, admit the darkness within." - Morgana
08MT042.name: Sinner's Vise

08MT024.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>SpellShield</style></link> or <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link> to an ally in hand.
08MT024.descriptionRaw: Play: Grant SpellShield or Overwhelm to an ally in hand.
08MT024.flavorText: "Do not be afraid! Go on, and do not look back! We made this journey once, too. Now it is our duty to protect yours. Go quickly to her sanctuary, and the Veiled One will grant you the protection you seek."
08MT024.name: Ruby-Eyed Conjurer

08MT045.flavorText: The Mageseekers excelled at breaking people. They had bound his hands and his magic. They had taken his voice. But he had survived them before--and this time, he had the Veiled Lady on his side.
08MT045.name: Chained Caster

08MT024T1.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link> to an ally in hand.
08MT024T1.descriptionRaw: Play: Grant Overwhelm to an ally in hand.
08MT024T1.flavorText: "Do not be afraid! Go on, and do not look back! We made this journey once, too. Now it is our duty to protect yours. Go quickly to her sanctuary, and the Veiled One will grant you the protection you seek."
08MT024T1.name: Ruby-Eyed Conjurer

08MT024T2.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>SpellShield</style></link> to an ally in hand.
08MT024T2.descriptionRaw: Play: Grant SpellShield to an ally in hand.
08MT024T2.flavorText: "Do not be afraid! Go on, and do not look back! We made this journey once, too. Now it is our duty to protect yours. Go quickly to her sanctuary, and the Veiled One will grant you the protection you seek."
08MT024T2.name: Ruby-Eyed Conjurer

08MT015.descriptionRaw: Play: Curse an enemy with Shackles.
08MT015.flavorText: "Look, Dolly! I'm doing it, just like you taught me! Do you think we'll ever get to show mama how much I've learned? You think she already knows? Really?! I hope you're right." - Lisa
08MT015.name: Lisa and Dolly

08MT030.description: When you play a <link=keyword.Fast><sprite name=Fast><style=Keyword>Fast</style></link> spell, <link=keyword.Slow><sprite name=Slow><style=Keyword>Slow</style></link> spell, or <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skill</style></link>, grant other Dragon allies +1|+1.
08MT030.descriptionRaw: When you play a Fast spell, Slow spell, or Skill, grant other Dragon allies +1|+1.
08MT030.flavorText: Dragons can vary as greatly in their temperaments as they do in their appearance. For species as prone to all-consuming destruction as infernal drakes, there are those equally protective of their families and environments--like the slow-moving, affectionate gemdragon.
08MT030.name: Gentle Gemdragon

08MT023.descriptionRaw: Stun an enemy and Curse it with Shackles.
08MT023.flavorText: "Suffer, as you've made them suffer!" - Morgana
08MT023.name: Dark Binding

08MT031.description: When I'm summoned, heal your Nexus 2 and gain an extra mana gem next round.
08MT031.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, heal your Nexus 2 and gain an extra mana gem next round.
08MT031.flavorText: High on the slopes of Targon, a lone Ottrani has dedicated their life to dragons. They adorn themselves in shed scales and old bones, divining their path forward from the scattering of dragon teeth and the curling of smoke as it is carried up the mountain.
08MT031.name: Ottrani Dragon-Worshiper

08MT009.description: When I'm summoned or you summon a <link=vocab.Titanic><style=Vocab>Titanic</style></link> ally, heal your Nexus 3.
08MT009.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned or you summon a Titanic ally, heal your Nexus 3.
08MT009.flavorText: This veiled protector has not forgotten the blessing that elevated it above a mere beast--and repays this debt by ensuring any who seek a certain sanctuary on the slopes of Targon make the journey unscathed.
08MT009.name: Veiled Protector

08MT006.description: Give an ally <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>Spellshield</style></link> this round and <link=keyword.Curse><sprite name=Curse><style=Keyword>Curse</style></link> it with <link=card.curse><style=AssociatedCard>Shackles</style></link>.
08MT006.descriptionRaw: Give an ally Spellshield this round and Curse it with Shackles.
08MT006.name: Black Shield

08MT027.description:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Activate other allies' <link=keyword.Daybreak><style=Keyword>Daybreak</style></link> and <link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link> effects.
<link=keyword.Daybreak><style=Keyword>Daybreak</style></link>: Grant me <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link>.
<link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link>: Grant me <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>SpellShield</style></link>.
08MT027.descriptionRaw:
Play: Activate other allies' Daybreak and Nightfall effects.
Daybreak: Grant me Overwhelm.
Nightfall: Grant me SpellShield.
08MT027.flavorText: "A ring of fire burns above. In the heralded darkness, we are all the same." - Lunari wanespeaker
08MT027.name: Herald of Celestial Convergence

08MT025.description:
If you <link=vocab.Behold><style=Vocab>Behold</style></link> a <link=vocab.Titanic><style=Vocab>Titanic</style></link> unit, I cost 3 less.
Deal 7 to a unit.
08MT025.descriptionRaw:
If you Behold a Titanic unit, I cost 3 less.
Deal 7 to a unit.
08MT025.flavorText: "Oops, uh oh, dontcha worry about dat dere, just a little wipple in the wock, just a accident, not papa NOPE! Movin' on!" - Chip
08MT025.name: Seismic Shard

08DE006.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Pick an Explorer spell to create in hand.
08DE006.descriptionRaw: Play: Pick an Explorer spell to create in hand.
08DE006.flavorText: "It's cold. I'm cold. Everything is cold, all the time. There are some places people just aren't meant to live. Please send me somewhere warm after this." - From the expedition records of the Explorer's Guild Far Reaches Division, allocation: Freljord
08DE006.name: Scholarly Pioneer

08DE020.description: Grant an ally +0|+2. <link=keyword.Curse><sprite name=Curse><style=Keyword>Curse</style></link> your opponent with <link=card.curse><style=AssociatedCard>Suppression</style></link>.
08DE020.descriptionRaw: Grant an ally +0|+2. Curse your opponent with Suppression.
08DE020.flavorText: "Know the weight of your sins!" - Morgana
08DE020.name: Magical Fettering

08DE017.description: When I'm summoned, <link=keyword.Curse><sprite name=Curse><style=Keyword>Curse</style></link> your opponent with <link=card.curse><style=AssociatedCard>Suppression</style></link>.
08DE017.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, Curse your opponent with Suppression.
08DE017.flavorText: "We cannot allow them to reach the sanctuary of the fallen sister. Her magic is ancient and twisted, far beyond even my ability to suppress. Quickly, take these abominations back to the ship and then up the mountain after the rest of them!"
08DE017.name: Mageseeker Inquisitor

08DE017T1.description: While I'm in hand, you can't play spells other than curses.
08DE017T1.descriptionRaw: While I'm in hand, you can't play spells other than curses.
08DE017T1.flavorText: No magic moves to your call.
08DE017T1.name: Suppression

08DE025.description: When I'm summoned, reduce the cost of all allied units in hand by 1.
08DE025.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, reduce the cost of all allied units in hand by 1.
08DE025.flavorText: With thick tufted fur to insulate against the cold, this drake can reach much higher altitudes than most other dragons. Lively yet elusive, the drakes are usually spotted high overhead, wings cutting through the clouds as they jump from gust to gale.
08DE025.name: Cloud Drake

08DE010.description:
Give an ally +0|+2 this round.
That ally and an enemy <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> each other.
08DE010.descriptionRaw:
