Give an ally +0|+2 this round.
That ally and an enemy strike each other.
08DE010.flavorText: "En garde, my friend! Surely you are not coward enough to refuse a gentleman's duel?" - Laurent Chevalier
08DE010.name: Gentlemen's Duel

08DE022.description:
When I'm summoned, draw 1 of each champion from your deck.
Each round, the first time you summon a champion, <link=vocab.Rally><style=Vocab>Rally</style></link>.
08DE022.descriptionRaw:
When I'm summoned, draw 1 of each champion from your deck.
Each round, the first time you summon a champion, Rally.
08DE022.flavorText: "You must remember, my son, that the chasing of any horizon must be in service to the home we leave behind." - King Jarvan III
08DE022.name: The Kingfisher

08DE027.description: Grant allied Birds <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +1|+1. An allied Bird <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> an enemy.
08DE027.descriptionRaw: Grant allied Birds everywhere +1|+1. An allied Bird strikes an enemy.
08DE027.flavorText: The silverwing's screech signals death from above.
08DE027.name: Taloned Strike

08DE026.description: Your Dragon Boons target all Dragon allies.
08DE026.descriptionRaw: Your Dragon Boons target all Dragon allies.
08DE026.flavorText: "To be clear, I was not always a dragon allegiant. Alatis here convinced me, the first time he saved my life. He's taught me a lot, but the most important thing? There's no finer life than serving Demacia from the back of a dragon." - Dragon Allegiant
08DE026.name: Alatis the Gallant

08DE013.description: When I'm summoned, draw a Dragon if you <link=vocab.Behold><style=Vocab>Behold</style></link> a Dragon.
08DE013.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, draw a Dragon if you Behold a Dragon.
08DE013.flavorText: "You know it pains me to admit it, old boy, but we can't tame him alone. We've done what we can already. I'll send word to the general, and with the might of Demacia behind us, we're sure to bring that fantastic beast to its knees."
08DE013.name: Dragon Allegiant

08IO012.description: When you play a <link=keyword.Fast><sprite name=Fast><style=Keyword>Fast</style></link> spell, <link=keyword.Slow><sprite name=Slow><style=Keyword>Slow</style></link> spell, or <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skill</style></link>, heal your Nexus 1.
08IO012.descriptionRaw: When you play a Fast spell, Slow spell, or Skill, heal your Nexus 1.
08IO012.flavorText: "A grand beast you are! There is joy in the skim of your claws over the waves. Should you ever decide to prey on more than fish and seabirds, I would be delighted to face you." - Nilah
08IO012.name: Ocean Drake

08IO014.description: Each round, the first card you play costs 9 less.
08IO014.descriptionRaw: Each round, the first card you play costs 9 less.
08IO014.flavorText: For the inhabitants of this Ionian village, Heisho is both honored caretaker and friend. Having carried their homes on his back from time immemorial, they can trust their village bearer to seek peaceful shores in times of trouble.
08IO014.name: Heisho, Shell of the World

08IO021.description: Stop an enemy <link=keyword.Fast><sprite name=Fast><style=Keyword>Fast</style></link> spell, <link=keyword.Slow><sprite name=Slow><style=Keyword>Slow</style></link> spell, or <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skill</style></link>, <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> an enemy, and summon <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>The Empyrean</style></link>.
08IO021.descriptionRaw: Stop an enemy Fast spell, Slow spell, or Skill, Recall an enemy, and summon The Empyrean.
08IO021.name: Empyrean Dance

08IO019.descriptionRaw: When I'm summoned, summon Adnere's Aviarists.
08IO019.flavorText: "This land is full of lessons. Remember always: the passing of each season is to be celebrated, for only in the ending can a new beginning be born."
08IO019.name: Trusty Adnere

08IO019T1.description: <link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: Grow me to my supported ally's stats this round.
08IO019T1.descriptionRaw: Support: Grow me to my supported ally's stats this round.
08IO019T1.flavorText:
"Look! Papa's birds are hatching again!"
"Whoa! Another one! Why are there so many?"
"You ask that EVERY year, Arya."
"Well nobody ever answers!"
"Shhh, don't scare them. And tell me how many there are, cuz we're gonna have to think of a lotta names."
08IO019T1.name: Adnere's Aviarists

08IO010.description: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> an enemy to increase the cost of the next unit your opponent plays this round by 2.
08IO010.descriptionRaw: Recall an enemy to increase the cost of the next unit your opponent plays this round by 2.
08IO010.flavorText: "Those who mean us harm shall find rest at the bottom of the sea." - Rivershaper
08IO010.name: Capsize

08IO023.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Summon an exact <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> copy of me.
08IO023.descriptionRaw: Play: Summon an exact Ephemeral copy of me.
08IO023.flavorText: During the right times of year, when the wind blows in over the sea, some Zaunites swear they can see the faint impressions of two huge finned creatures dancing joyously with the ocean tides.
08IO023.name: Prancing Sea Spirits

08BC020.description: Your opponent discards their highest cost card.
08BC020.descriptionRaw: Your opponent discards their highest cost card.
08BC020.flavorText: "Imagine being a worm, and the last thing you see before you die are those eyes. Oh, worms can't see? Well, that's probably for the best." - Elle, Aloof Traveler
08BC020.name: Early Bird

08BC005.description: For each <link=card.selfref><style=AssociatedCard>Bursting Backpack</style></link> you've played this game, plant 4 <link=card.boon><style=AssociatedCard>Chimes</style></link> in your deck and 4 <link=card.trap><style=AssociatedCard>Poison Puffcaps</style></link> in the enemy deck. Create a <link=card.selfref><style=AssociatedCard>Bursting Backpack</style></link> in your deck.
08BC005.descriptionRaw: For each Bursting Backpack you've played this game, plant 4 Chimes in your deck and 4 Poison Puffcaps in the enemy deck. Create a Bursting Backpack in your deck.
08BC005.flavorText: "Rule 207: A Scout never carries more than she needs!" - Ava Achiever
08BC005.name: Bursting Backpack

08BC021.description: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> an ally to summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Hungry Owlcat</style></link> in its place.
08BC021.descriptionRaw: Recall an ally to summon a Hungry Owlcat in its place.
08BC021.name: Sneaky Swap

08BC002.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Pick 1 of 2 non-champion cards from the enemy hand. I <link=keyword.Capture><sprite name=Capture><style=Keyword>Capture</style></link> it.
08BC002.descriptionRaw: Play: Pick 1 of 2 non-champion cards from the enemy hand. I Capture it.
08BC002.flavorText:
"Yeah, I'm handsome, quick--unflappably cool. Don't you know, old man? I'm the king of this reef, and you're trespassing in my kingdom!"
"W-wait! Come back here this instant! I need that specimen for my research!" - Conchologist
08BC002.name: Skip, "King of the Reef"

08BC006.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Pick an Explorer spell to create in hand.
08BC006.descriptionRaw: Play: Pick an Explorer spell to create in hand.
08BC006.flavorText: "I'm worried about Bunches! Oh, he seems more and more nervous these days. Even a short portal hop worries him! I can't understand why." - From the expedition records of the Explorer's Guild Far Reaches Division, allocation: Bandle City
08BC006.name: Portal Pioneer

08BC004.description: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> a <link=vocab.Titanic><style=Vocab>Titanic</style></link> follower and set its stats to 1|1 and cost to 0.
08BC004.descriptionRaw: Play: Manifest a Titanic follower and set its stats to 1|1 and cost to 0.
08BC004.flavorText: "Of course I know old Portia! A bit out-to-lunch, but she can get you a portal to anywhere, in a pinch. A swirl of the tail, and you're off!" - Portal Pioneer
08BC004.name: Portia the Peculiar

08BC018.flavorText: "Rule 571: A Scout should always be vigilant. One never knows what might be a tasty treat, and what might be a trap." - Ava Achiever
